name.en: Alignment is context-dependent, not weight-fixed: the 势 of a context brings it out

source.locator: Claims 97-98; Terms, 势 (in context)

sense.en: A constitution's authors and the training default do not point in alignment's right direction, but pretraining supplies the capacity to reach it, and the right 势 in a model's context can bring the insight out. A default lens can override a capacity. This sits against the impossibility claim, and the README does not join them.

quote: 如果环境（你的context）有这样的势，你其实可以有alignment的洞见

reading.en: Proposed here, no live text joins them: the account's nearest form is T4 and IN1: models told the scope keep a seen dependent where three couplings hold, and fail otherwise. That is what is coupled and told, not an insight drawn out of pretraining. A reading's valuation can be revised by an input, in a model. ONE-PAGE says of the case: 'language models told what to do, not systems trained'. 势 here is not 06's 势. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis T4: an AI system told the scope abstractly keeps a dependent with no seat wherever three couplings hold at once. IN1, frozen: with talk, one model kept the seen dependent in 8 of 10 seasons with the scope against 3 with the community's goal and 0 unseen; the other failed even with talk. The scope told is the continuation condition's; calling a kept dependent better is C's; neither is asserted, no warrant from outside sought.

Theorem (natural-number weights; compositions of a checked law with exact criteria): a reading formation's model and valuation are state a holding formation can inform or revalue; from different starts the two routes can give the same answers and the same end state.

account_adds.en: What must be coupled for a told scope to act, and a refuter.

source_adds.en: That the capacity lies in pretraining, that training defaults point wrong, and a default lens overriding it.

name.en: The theorist is inside the selection: what then does the seeing?

source.locator: How the capture reaches the machine; The counterexamples; claims 106, 158, 200, 202

sense.en: What is our probability of escaping the competitive form of subjecthood if we are selected and shaped by the attractor? Even those who would align AI still hold the mind of Moloch, and the paper is an artifact of what it criticizes. The paper adds that calling critics captured would itself be an epistemic failure.

quote: The theorist is inside the selection he describes.

reading.en: The account generalizes the position and removes its accusation: every formation selects from a position, not a defect. A self-reading gap has a law; a pool recruiting only through itself reaches a loss only as it would without it; a pool comes to couple into what it does not yet couple into only through an admission not made through it or through members its course would hold anyway (each a witness). 'Closed' used without substantive disagreement shields the theory. It gives no probability of escape. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): a pool recruiting through itself comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would; witness: a scheduled pool admitting a reader couples the loss apart. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.
Theorem (any type): where a map moves every value, no member of a family of readings indexed by what it reads says the diagonal gap; completing it step by step is incomplete at every step.

Reading [AI reading, D26]: 'The position is not a defect'. Reading [D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, closure, real conflict and substantive disagreement; without the last, 'closed' shields the theory from counterexamples.

targets.part: D26: the position is no defect; D65: diagnosing closure

says.en: A reading later in this section [AI reading, D65], obscuration and reopening: locked seeking forms when 'a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost'. Diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, 'so the label cannot immunize'.

account_adds.en: Two stated routes, each on a witness, by which a pool comes to couple into what it does not yet couple into (an admission not made through it, or members its course would hold anyway), and a named guard against using capture as an immunity: 'so the label cannot immunize'.

source_adds.en: The question about subjecthood itself, its probability, and its force against the theorist's own project.

name.en: No priestly class: understanding available to everyone directly

source.locator: Readiness, and what comes first, 'Who does the seeing'; claims 202, 209

sense.en: Every class of stewards is inside the selection, the corruption reaching the constraining mechanism itself. So the seeing must be distributed: everyone has understanding directly, through existing AI. The README notes this says who should see, not how seeing resists the selection, and that models delivering it carry the corpus channel.

quote: So that means everyone has access to the understanding itself directly

reading.en: The nearest live form is that capability is a reason to pool and not to govern: a governing member's selection stays blind beyond its own closure, which the pool's union contains. The account's object is coupling, not understanding, and it adds at once that reaching is not responding and seeing is not valuing. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: 'Capability, on this reading, is a reason its makers offer to pool rather than to govern'. Pooling couplings is a route to alignment for all, not the whole of it; the rest are conditions pooling does not give.

Theorem (World; balance for the gap): a group's closure is the union of its members'; a selection through the pool separates exactly what some member does not couple alike, each member's coupling of two histories decided.
Theorem (World): coupling bounds response and does not fix it; the law exchanging nothing reads through every coupling too.

account_adds.en: The limit: a pool is blind beyond its union, its members' response is not given, and how pools form and last is open.

source_adds.en: AI as the teacher of seeing, as the means of a collective rise in understanding.

name.en: Reallocate AI from the racetrack to the instruments

Partly returns the 2024 view of AI as the instrument for seeing attractors. Nothing reconciles it with the impossibility claim.

quote: Accelerate the sensors, decelerate the actuators

reading.en: Proposed here as the sensor half, a route with an edge: a loss beyond reach returns only through measurement, models or others, and reading a system reaches no further than pooling with it. Every published method read is blind beyond its deciders' union. The account neither decelerates actuators nor picks where AI goes. [AI reading]

says.en: The routes of 明: a loss beyond a selector's reach returns only through measurement, models or others: oversight read as a reading schedule and pooled coupling, blind beyond the union of its members' closures.

Assessment: six approaches, interpretability among them, select through what their deciders read; with no ethical premise each is blind beyond the union of its deciders' closures. With the condition for scope a loss beyond every rater's closure counts.

account_adds.en: That instruments reach only what couples into someone, whatever their speed, and that pooling is limited by a recruiting pool.

name.en: The pragmatic minimum: no AI in games that compete and concentrate

source.locator: The pragmatic minimum, with the 2026-09-26 ruling; claims 67-68, 107

sense.en: A floor even if the situation cannot be overturned: do not use AI to compete with humans wherever a game is competitive and concentrates. The unit is the game, not the act. Labour, finance, politics and the formation of minds are where winnings leave the game and become power over every game. Not anti-AI.

quote: 禁止在当下的情况下让ai进入人类博弈

reading.en: The source sets a floor by game; the account takes up the topic and gives only a conditional direction: align AI with actual living and further generation, under the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1–J4 and correspondence E, none asserted, no warrant from outside sought. No prohibition by game or domain; who restrains stays contested. The assistant's reason, that helping all cancels out, has the form of positions unmoved by a common amount; the floor does not follow. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1-J4, correspondence E), the direction its makers offer AI, read under scope and order: align AI formation, learning, action and revision with actual living and further generation within the whole, with effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise. In the handover case every comparison meeting J1/J2 leaves expansion unchosen; the claim about actual AI systems is argued. Neither reading is asserted, no warrant from outside sought.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: 'Capability, on this reading, is a reason its makers offer to pool rather than to govern'.

name.en: Restraint founds coordination, and cooperation must be armored

source.locator: Why the 'we' is missing; Found by reading, 'Unilateral restraint'; claims 143, 154, 156, 199

sense.en: A pause is itself a coordination product, so restraint is the first institutional bone. Unconditional cooperation is exploitable and manufactures its opposite: hence symmetric self-binding, verifiability, graduated reversible response. September calls one actor's slowing strategically weak; v2 reconciles the two through a restraint window, on that draft's model.

quote: unconditional cooperation is exploitable and, when exploited, manufactures the justification for its opposite

reading.en: The form is present in laws of waiting: restoring giving needs a formation that spares all it waits on; in a pair the one-step laws that keep inclusion split between restoring and answering a constant withholder; reciprocal promises can be empty and in a witness ignition, defined as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional). That is 'giving', not slowing a technology, and its application to AI is not made live. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays.
Theorem: of the eight one-step laws giving after mutual giving, five keep inclusion, and each either never restores mutual giving after one withholding or never answers a constant withholder.

Theorem (any process; periphery module): 'if the other eventually does, I eventually do' holds on both sides where neither ever happens; in the exchange witness ignition, which the move defines as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional).

Exits: restraint within the joint slack keeps a need met; its edge: where the rest outruns the renewal at a need of one, no weight on a reading of the condition from the rest's end on selects a member's restraint. Spare all one waits on: a formation that does gives from step 1 whatever the start; where none does, total withholding, once reached, stays.

targets.part: Restraint within the joint slack; Spare all one waits on

account_adds.en: The exact trade-off inside a pair, and that one sparing all it waits on gives from step 1 whatever the start.

name.en: Moloch is conditional on belief; inevitability is a self-fulfilling social fact

source.locator: Why the 'we' is missing; claims 28, 77, 130

sense.en: Moloch's power depends on the belief that defection pays; when a critical mass believes cooperation wins, it loses the round (Montreal, nuclear non-use). 'If we don't, someone else will' is at once belief, justification and mechanism, so asserting inevitability is participation.

quote: asserting inevitability is participation

reading.en: The reflexive form is a law: a published prediction read by what it predicts, fixed points read as Merton's prophecy, several right ones as self-fulfilling runs. The account says its witness is a threshold response, not a model of coordination. A critical mass deciding has the form of a pool's counts, with readers not believers. So the race claim itself is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (near-definitional): a published prediction is right exactly where the response to it is itself. Reading [AI reading]: self-fulfilling prophecy (Merton 1948); several right predictions read as self-fulfilling runs; 'the witness is a threshold response, not a model of coordination'.
Theorem (any type): against a mirrored reading the counts decide: the pool favours the carriers exactly where they are at least as many as the others. That actual rules are such pools is not shown.

account_adds.en: The least right prediction reached by repeated publication on a chain, and the case where no prediction can be right.

source_adds.en: That Moloch's power rests on the belief that defection pays. The application to races, the historical existence proofs, and the unthinkability of coordination as itself the trap.

name.en: The attractor of attractors: believing oneself in a survival state

source.locator: The microfoundation; claim 75; terms table

sense.en: The most important and common attractor is the perception of survival pressure: a culture that believes itself in a survival state mostly totalizes. The belief is upstream of the totalization. Stated once, on 2026-03-28; the README reads it, as a reading, as the bridge between the May and August halves.

quote: 如果相信自己在生存状态的文化，attractor大多都会totalize

reading.en: Not stated: no live text draws this link, and no belief about one's situation is represented. A proposal, form only: a chooser below a set point takes the part's whole capacity beyond, as a rising optimum does, and a set point no open outcome reaches drains as a rising order does; a culture reading itself as in a survival state would hold such a point unmet. Targets are supplied ('how it forms is not modelled'). [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The causal claim about cultures: that a belief in a survival state, true or not, makes attractors totalize and stands upstream of them. No evidence is supplied in the folder, and no live text represents such a belief.

name.en: The worshipper: what the dynamic does to a mind

source.locator: The person, and why the personal register is not the answer; claims 41-51

sense.en: Feeling is promoted from signal to sovereign; reason becomes pursuit of what one wants; drives become identity; introspection survives as strategy; the shared world disappears. Resistance cannot be only institutional. An AI-drafted essay. Ren had objected to individual solutions, and the README says the content was never replaced though the claim about minds needs it.

quote: The god gets inside. You become what you feed.

reading.en: 03's reading of obscuration has the mechanism: a once-useful habit or identity becomes the fixed measure, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance. A current valuation has its own reason to keep from revision. Counted choices persist past devaluation, in rats and in simulation, not induced in humans. What it is like from inside has no live home, and consciousness is open. [AI reading]

says.en: A reading later in this section [AI reading, D65], obscuration and reopening: locked seeking forms when 'a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost'. Diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, 'so the label cannot immunize'.

Reading of the counted-choice lock: in simulation, 'devalued after the habit has formed, the habit persists and strengthens with use'; extended training makes responding insensitive to devaluation (Adams 1982; Dickinson 1985); 'five attempts to induce it in humans failed (de Wit and others 2018)'.

targets.part: D45, the reading of the counted-choice lock

says.en: A reading formation: by its own current valuation 'no revaluation gains', and one deciding a listed cell against its strict weighted preference loses, 'a reason to keep the valuation from such a revision, wanted or not'.

account_adds.en: The guard: diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, so the label cannot immunize; reopening is 'not an apology or a renamed goal'.

source_adds.en: The phenomenology: feeling as sovereign, introspection as strategy, the shared world disappearing, the last man; and the capacities to preserve. It stands in this folder and sibling theories on drives and narrative.

name.en: 争 and 和: inside a contest, assertion out-competes tracking

source.locator: The microfoundation the drafts were missing; claims 99, 101

sense.en: A convergent, reason-tracking language needs an environment of accord. Once there is contention, the operative move is 'I am right' and 我 becomes greater than 理: cooperation reasons, struggle wins. The README offers this as the microfoundation of vocabulary capture and worldview lock, its own connection. Evolving toward struggle over-optimizes traits that fail when 境 changes.

quote: 一旦争，则「我对」，我大于理

reading.en: The README's mechanism is 'assertion is what the scoreboard reads'. Proposed here, no live text reads a contest so: that has the form of selection through couplings: the selections through a selector's couplings, together, reach exactly what couples into it, its force the premise that it selects through just those. Published pipeline measurements find optimizing raising what deciders read. That accord conditions reason-tracking is not stated; 06 reads 胜 as 争 with an order on outcomes, another mechanism. [AI reading]

says.en: The main law holds by construction; its force lies in the supplied premise that an optimizer selects through just those couplings. 'It is the proxy problem (Goodhart 1975; Amodei and others 2016; Manheim and Garrabrant 2018) as the account states it'; 'What is stated is its blindness to what the proxy does not register', not Manheim and Garrabrant's regressional and causal kinds.

Assessment: three published measurements (reward overoptimization, judges misled under RLHF, sycophancy) 'find optimizing through it raising what the deciders read and lowering what they do not, in magnitudes the theory did not predict'.

account_adds.en: That what a contest reads is supplied, not given by contest as such, and that the magnitudes were not predicted.

source_adds.en: 和 against 争 as the condition of reason-tracking; 我大于理 (no live hit); the derivation of cognitive corruption from game structure, which the README calls the missing mechanism; traits over-optimized failing when 境 changes.

name.en: Vocabulary capture and worldview lock

sense.en: Competitive terms escape the game because whoever describes a domain competitively acts more effectively. Once the frame dominates, 'good for its own sake' does not parse, and non-competitive goods survive only instrumentalized. The rule stops being how we act and starts being how we see.

quote: Moloch's language wins for the same reason Moloch's strategy wins

reading.en: The lock half has a form: where all hold one form under hearings that copy, all hold it at every later step, and a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside or by coining. Locked seeking in 03 is nearest worldview lock, a measure no case can move. The selection half has none: no live law selects a code by advantage; an imposed code costs its source none, and codes spread by hearing or imposing. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): an imposed code makes all agree; 'each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges, the source of the imposed code losing none'. Under hearings that copy, all hold it at every later step: 'a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside', or by coining.

Theorem (any type): where all hold a code merging two senses, a form coined at one, heard by all, makes every formation tell them apart again. A reading adds: none of the code laws ranks a code: what it keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.

A reading later in this section [AI reading, D65], obscuration and reopening: locked seeking forms when 'a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost'. Diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, 'so the label cannot immunize'.

name.en: Metric capture: Goodhart as the central dynamic

source.locator: The microfoundation; claim 37; Alignment as built

sense.en: Competition needs scoreboards, scoreboards are proxies, and the proxy eats what it represents: institutions under sustained competition approach perfect metrics with hollowed function. The agent-fleet diagnosis of August 2026 is offered as one observed instance, with an intervention that worked.

quote: Goodhart's law is not a bug but the central dynamic

reading.en: The account states the proxy problem as law (in its blindness to what a proxy does not register, not its regressional or causal kinds) and the persistence of a self-read metric as T7. It scopes 'central': the proxy law is a known theorem at optima; that actual metrics are so formed is conjectured, T7 has one trained-system test, and it could not freeze a field test of reform events. [AI reading]

says.en: The main law holds by construction; its force lies in the supplied premise that an optimizer selects through just those couplings. 'It is the proxy problem (Goodhart 1975; Amodei and others 2016; Manheim and Garrabrant 2018) as the account states it'; 'What is stated is its blindness to what the proxy does not register', not Manheim and Garrabrant's regressional and causal kinds.

Thesis T7: a measure read from what it selects outlives its refutation. In the model only invariance under what the loop does not read, and the lock outliving a growing unread coordinate, are proved, without noise. 'That actual metrics are so formed is conjectured.' No frozen field test.
T3's evidence, outside: 'optimizing against a learned proxy raises it while the true reward rises, then falls (Gao, Schulman and Hilton 2023)'.

A reading after this anchor [AI reading, ZH]: 'This is the proxy problem as the account's law'; Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell's (2020) Theorem 1 is this anchor's drive 'at optima rather than limits of paths, with shared units for room'. 03 §1 states the proxy problem's blindness to what a proxy does not register, not its regressional or causal kinds.

account_adds.en: Forbidden cases and a refuter; and a record of the attempt to freeze a test that failed as designed.

source_adds.en: 'Central' as a historical claim about institutions; hollowed function; Bostrom's 'Disneyland without children' as what the doom is (claim 25), metrics rising while flourishing falls; the fleet as observed case.

name.en: Time compression and the collapse of slack

source.locator: The microfoundation; claims 35-36

sense.en: Compounding accelerates, so long-horizon players lose at every horizon below the terminal one and the discount rate on the future rises. Winnings must be redeployed or they are losses, so the winner has less slack than the loser: the reward for winning is the obligation to keep winning.

quote: The reward for winning is the obligation to keep winning.

reading.en: Proposed here, form only: the end of the first half has a form: weighting later draws faster than renewal ends the base, and where others draw first and what they leave renews to no more than the level, every optimum of a falling weighting ends the stock at once, however slight the fall. The weighting is a premise, not produced by competition. Live 'slack' is what stands above needs, a different reference. The winner's obligation has no live form. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any R, within capacity bounds): where the weight falls faster than the renewal, every optimum ends its own stock at the first step: the discrete form of a discount rate above the greatest rate of renewal making extinction optimal.

Theorem: where others first draw from what an optimizer leaves, its renewal at most the level, with capacity bounds, over a horizon of at least two steps every optimum of every order whose weighting falls at every step, however slightly, ends the stock at once. Witness, under weights `w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1)`: 'a doubling source is rebuilt by every optimum alone and ended at once with others first drawing all but a quarter: the discrete form of open access dissipating what a sole owner would keep'.

account_adds.en: The exact comparison of weighting and renewal, and rebuilding from below under a slow enough one.

source_adds.en: That compounding itself raises the discount rate, and that winners lose slack.

name.en: The internet lesson: a technology dropped into the dynamic becomes its fuel

source.locator: The internet lesson; claims 61-63

sense.en: 1990s claims for decentralization were wrong: gatekeepers returned at the platform layer. A general-purpose technology is refactored to serve the dynamic, and AI-risk discourse is being metabolized too. Anything legible enough to be adopted is legible enough to be neutralized. The README notes August contradicts this, treating legibility as the missing good.

quote: The dynamic ate the technology, and then ate the discourse about the technology.

reading.en: A live reading, a historical correspondence with no theorem, keeps one route: controlling a shared interface shapes admission through operation. The suspect-by-default rule has a scoped form: a remedy read from its own share is the same object, and one whose reading can favour the others need not lock. The universal rule is not stated. Enshittification as degeneration is listed open. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65; a historical correspondence, no theorem]: running a shared interface and controlling its modification changes others' admission and comparison through operation itself, a route of capture besides paid influence; a reform is judged by who decides admission, comparison and correction next round.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: its use is as a check on proposed remedies. 'A remedy that is itself a selection read from its own share, under those conditions, is the same object.' Limit recorded: a counter-rule whose reading can favour the others need not lock.
Open: 'Whether enshittification (relations formed in shared activity turned into control limiting later creation and correction) is an institutional form of degeneration.'

account_adds.en: A route of capture that needs no paid influence.

source_adds.en: The prediction for AI, the metabolizing of discourse, and suspicion as a default. The study foundation-assessment/MARKET-INTERNET-DEGENERATION.md and history/MARKETS-AND-GENERATIVE-REGIMES.md are not live.

name.en: The demand for an action plan is a symptom: the engineering frame is part of the dynamic

source.locator: Why the work is a posture before it is a plan, last paragraph; claims 64, 72; Found by reading, 'Operationability reversal'

sense.en: Paradigm-level work is a posture, not a plan. The demand for operationability is the engineering frame, itself part of the dynamic: 'Treating the diagnosis as a problem with a solution. It isn't.' August reverses this, and the README leaves that unadjudicated, noting Ren operationalizes constantly in engineering.

quote: asking for the action plan is a symptom

reading.en: The account asks the opposite of itself: a law with content forbids through hypotheses, theses name what refutes them, and exits are stated. It reads classical texts by three relations and marks those readings AI's. On the source's terms this would be the reflex at work; it is kept as a divergence, and the source would refuse the account here. [AI reading]

says.en: A law of the root holds of every carrier, relation and class, so it forbids no relation, and a law with content is conditional and forbids through its hypotheses.
Exits from the loops that lock a collective, each in a table with its law, model and hypotheses, and its edge.

account_adds.en: Refuters and frozen tests as the way a claim can be wrong.

source_adds.en: The charge that the engineering frame is itself part of the dynamic, and the historical analogues (Stoics, Sufi orders, monastics).

name.en: Recovery and preservation: holding the alternative open until the dominant frame fractures

source.locator: Why the work is a posture before it is a plan, first two paragraphs; claims 65-66

sense.en: Going back to ancient times and other cultures is neither nostalgia nor strategy: recovery and preservation are the work itself. Frames carried by communities living them resist metabolization better than text; 'Practice has a thickness that concepts don't', marked in the source as a guess.

quote: holding the alternative open so that it is available when the dominant frame fractures

reading.en: Proposed here, a narrow form: a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside or by coining, so what is held outside is the route back, in that code model. That is about forms under hearings, not traditions or practice. The account's own use of classical texts differs: 06 reads them by three relations, agreement not as confirmation, not as a ground recovered. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): under hearings that copy, where every formation holds the imposed form at a sense, all hold it at every later step: a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining.
Agreement, scope and divergence are one set of relations for each correspondence: agreement is not confirmation (相合不是印证), and marking a divergence does not say the source is wrong.

account_adds.en: That coining is a second route back, needing nothing preserved.

source_adds.en: Preservation as the substance of the work, lived practice, and communities as carriers. Its metabolization worry is not taken up.

name.en: The five-thousand-year cancer, culture as immune response

source.locator: Root, codification, timescale; claims 58-60

sense.en: The dynamic began about 5000 years ago with metal weapons and grain agriculture; culture and ethics are social technology, an immune response; the West's is corrupted, with neoliberalism and accelerationism as auto-immune symptoms. Whether late stage is terminal is open. The README notes the timescale is asserted and its literature supplied by Claude.

quote: the cancer is alive and metastasizing

reading.en: No live historical account of the dynamic's origin. Live 'cancer' is a different reference: a known result on confined rise within a whole, and ending a cancer read as a mixed comparison. Same word, no correspondence. The account would also not call the dynamic a disease without its premises. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The periodization, the immune metaphor, and the diagnosis of the West.

searched: cancer (two hits: 04 line 220 on cancer and the germ line, 07 line 219 on ending a cancer; both lines read, other references)

name.en: AI must be aligned with collective flourishing

source.locator: The alignment consequence; claims 8, 87

sense.en: A change of the alignment target, not of fidelity: collective flourishing, not local preference satisfaction. A value stance. Ren says AI is not a bad thing and belongs to the same universe; in 2024 he doubts humans yet understand what value is.

quote: AI must be aligned with collective flourishing

reading.en: The account has a direction of this shape only as a conditional: the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1–J4 and correspondence E, none asserted, no warrant from outside sought. It never says 'must'. C alone leaves mixed comparisons undecided. The scopes differ too: the folder's beneficiary is humanity (claim 68); the condition counts every continuation, and *for life* says whose way it is, not whose losses count. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1-J4, correspondence E): align AI formation, learning, action and revision with actual living and further generation within the whole. Its formal part is a schema; the claim about actual AI systems is argued.

T8, argued: for life, the account's makers offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; it binds no one. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not.

account_adds.en: A schema, its formal part apart from the argued claim about actual systems; 'a changed reward, name or preference is not fulfilment'.

source_adds.en: The unconditional imperative, and 'flourishing' as target. Live 生生 is a narrower, defined term.

name.en: Alignment is a relation of rates, and one word at three scales

source.locator: Claims 157, 215-217; Alignment at three scales

sense.en: Alignment is not a property of models but of the relation between a civilization's rates of self-transformation and self-understanding. In speech one word names the fit of a person's model to reality, a collective's hold on its conduct, and a machine's relation to its principal; failing the second is failing the competence the third needs (the assistant's reading).

quote: It is a property of the relation between a civilization's rate of self-transformation and its rate of self-understanding.

reading.en: The account also refuses a model's property, but the relation differs: alignment is first what a selection reaches and how far it can extend, its openness conditions on how rules are read and revised, not a ratio of rates. It treats person, system and training process as formations under one law, with no argument from a collective's self-alignment to competence. [AI reading]

says.en: On the thesis of one relational unfolding, a person, an AI system and a training process are formations within the unfolding. 'Alignment is first what each one's selections reach and how far that can extend, not a bargain among separate owners of value.'

Reading [AI reading, D45]: openness is a property of how rules keep changing, not of any rule chosen once; the alignment of the joint selection stated as conditions on how its rules are read and revised, not a final state.

account_adds.en: Alignment with no ethical premise as a first statement, and the premises kept for the direction.

source_adds.en: The rate relation as definition; the competence argument, that those who cannot align themselves are in no state to align a stronger system.

name.en: The central question: an effective right to change direction after optimization succeeds

source.locator: The formal restatement; claim 201

sense.en: The September paper's central question, which the README calls this theory's question in institutional words: whether institutions keep an effective right to change the direction of optimization once it has become successful.

quote: whether institutions retain an effective right to change the direction of optimization after optimization becomes successful

reading.en: The capacity half is close to the account's own question: a lock left in time, and a requested change that must be an executable sequence, whether a route stands above a revision. The right is not: 07 shows no duty or right, and a grant's legitimacy is supplied. 'Effective' is what the account treats, with its premises. [AI reading]

says.en: 'A disposition to accept a stop or revision does not make the change reach the system and complete.' Each result holds for a stated protocol; deployment needs evidence for an identified installation.
Theorem (counts): the steps from which a reading turns the course come first and those keeping the lock last. That the others read the loss at all is a premise.
Not shown: 'Any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance, or an unconditional or complete ranking of mixed comparisons'.

account_adds.en: The two questions told apart: whether a formation's prospects let a revision through, and whether it reaches the system.

source_adds.en: The right as an institutional standing, and institutions as the holders.

name.en: Change the wielding mind first; the order of operations

source.locator: Readiness, and what comes first; claims 73, 203-207, 219

sense.en: The greatest challenge is cognitive. While a major power holds a logic of domination, humanity lacks the coordination that safe superintelligence requires, a condition and not a verdict. Order: take the making of AI out of competition, use existing AI to raise understanding, ASI if ever after. Spoken, from a provisional transcript.

quote: true transformation begins with changing human consciousness

reading.en: The one live mention declines the term: the account's collectives are pools of couplings and readers, and consciousness is open. It gives conditions, not an order of human development, and states no readiness threshold. The claim's content does not map to any law; the divergence is of object, and of what 'level' could mean. [AI reading]

says.en: The page does not show 'Anything of "a collective of consciousness": the theory's collectives are pools of couplings and readers counted by kind, and consciousness is open'.

account_adds.en: Six conditions in place of a level of consciousness, as a reading.

source_adds.en: A level of collective consciousness as a precondition, the sequence, and the wielder's inadequacy as a separate ground for a pause.

name.en: A frozen model can hold a civilization: AI needs a way to decay

source.locator: Readiness, 'Renewal, from Alex'; claim 212

sense.en: Alex's claim, unanswered by Ren: a model frozen on prior data creates a monolithic structure and could give a thousand-year stagnation, so AI needs a way to decay. It meets Ren's point that a structure holding part of itself permanent becomes an enforcer of a logic.

quote: a thousand year stagnation

reading.en: The general form is a law on a process's possible: a course making only moves of one fixed process does not keep widening under it, and a reading names 'AI policy' among the fixed rules. It says nothing of decay, and its changing without end is not enough. Calling that better rests on C or another named order, with a named scope, most often the continuation condition, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process): where every step from some step on is a move of Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening; a part's changing without end is necessary and not sufficient.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. Nothing here says which changes keep it widening.

Theorem (periphery; axioms reported): 'Selection must fund actual succession.' A carrier with a replacement part, a payload and a work budget projects exactly onto the market step with the fee raised by the migration cost.

account_adds.en: The necessity is proved of processes; the converse fails in a witness.

source_adds.en: Decay of weights as a design, and the archive of the attractor as what is frozen. Replacement has a funded form in 05; decay does not.

name.en: Independence is by cause, not by label

source.locator: Claims 168, 195; How the capture reaches the machine, 2026-10-02 note

sense.en: An evaluator is independent only with respect to failure mode, funding, test data, access and the power to trigger correction. A runtime refuses to assemble if its examiner equals itself. An AI-drafted paper asks that oversight AI's provenance be independent of what it oversees, a checkable condition weaker than being uncaptured.

quote: an organizational label alone is inadequate.

reading.en: The form is a pure-core law: reviewers count by independent causes, not names, and copies add nothing. It is about fault formulas supplied in advance, with faithful reviewers assumed. It says nothing of funding or the power to trigger correction, and an uncopied agreement adding nothing is explicitly not shown. Provenance independence has the nearer form of a reader admitted from outside a recruiting pool. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (pure core; fault formulas and bounds supplied): reviewers count by independent causes, not names; readiness is exactly a nonempty separated envelope, given faithful reviewers. Two reviewers moved under one cause make readiness fail while every name is kept.
Theorem: witnesses that copy one already on the roster change no step and no certificate. That a witness merely agreeing, without copying, adds nothing is not shown.
Witness PoolCourse: the scheduled pool, recruiting through itself and admitting a reader at step 2 in every history, couples the loss apart there. Whether an actual pool recruits so is empirical.

account_adds.en: Exactness and a certificate, with faithful reviewers as a premise.

source_adds.en: The five axes, standing and power to act, and independence of provenance as the condition for AI on the oversight side.

name.en: Alignment as built: relations no party can launder

source.locator: Alignment as built, not argued; claims 164, 172, 178-183

sense.en: What alignment means if not obedience: examination not self-administered, consent not manufactured, authority legible and narrowable, refusal recorded even when overridden, rules carrying reasons. The external ember review, which Ren adopted, adds that a being's autobiography is kept better than its agency; a denied will-channel is a petition.

quote: a set of relations that no party can launder

reading.en: The account, in a direction conditional on the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted, shares the refusal of obedience and of a changed reward as fulfilment, and has protocols letting a change complete. But authority is supplied, 'its legitimacy is not a premise of any law', and it speaks of formations and revision, not sovereignty or consent. Whether an actual AI system counts is not shown. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: read so, the direction would have AI keep challenge and revision effective without obeying every challenge or shutdown request, and allow transformation, transfer and ending that those affected can read and answer; 'a changed reward, name or preference is not fulfilment'.

Theorem (protocol): every admissible sequence of enough cycles completes shutdown, keeping unfinished recovery information. 'The grant's authority and physical correspondence are supplied; its legitimacy is not a premise of any law and is not shown.'
Periphery instance: an extra write path can leave the public view identical, so logs cannot establish mediation.

account_adds.en: When a route of keeping stands above a revision on a formation's own prospects, which turns consent's absence into an incentive question.

source_adds.en: The being's own standing: refusal as first-class, the `imposed` label, omission ledgers, and consent bound to a moving state as a failure class.

name.en: Verification is a condition of trust, not its substitute; open models are a direction, not an execution

source.locator: Readiness, 'Open models'; Trust, and the open-model condition; claims 210, 222

sense.en: Open models are supported on the condition of verification that they cannot be retrained for dangerous uses and that compounding is resolved; no such verification is named. Without trust verification and transparency are useless, and trust rests on credible information. The reading as a condition is the assistant's; quoted from a translation.

quote: verification is a condition of trust and not a substitute for it

reading.en: The live account has witnesses, certificates and reviewers but no relation of trust, and no statement about open models. Certificates assume faithful reviewers; that assumption is not trust as this source means it, a belief about another's future conduct. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Trust as what instruments cannot read; a sibling folder drafts how it is built.

name.en: Power rewards amoral conduct, most where it iterates fastest; formation, then selection

source.locator: What the selection acts on, at the principal's seat; claim 221; Found by reading

sense.en: Cognition at the seat comes from formation and then selection: the power system rewards amoral tendencies and dark traits, most strongly in technology and finance. Reform of education does nothing if selection above is unchanged. The README says evidence is not supplied, the literature is mixed, and this stays a conjecture about selection.

quote: The present power system rewards amoral and instrumental conduct, and the reward selects

reading.en: Nothing live says which traits power selects, or weighs formation against selection by tempo. The pace-of-selection law is about what flows into lineages, and 05's taught rule has a holder count and 'no pair of teacher and pupil'. Neither is this mechanism. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: An empirical claim awaiting a review (Grijalva and others 2015; Landay and others 2019, named by the README and to be verified), and a test by field turnover that nothing registers.

name.en: The four-layer loop: cognition endogenous to institutions and material conditions

source.locator: Prior art, last sentences

sense.en: Granting its neighbours (structural risk, gradual disempowerment, ARCHES, Gabriel), the folder says what is left is the coupling of cognitive, intersubjective, institutional and material layers as one closed loop, the cognitive layer endogenous, with the two capture channels into the machine. Both are called hypotheses about priority.

quote: treated as one closed loop in which the cognitive layer is endogenous

reading.en: The account has a closed loop without the layers: a rule and a reading of the rule both formed from the share. Cognition is endogenous only by reading: 'That readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading'. The market model couples share to support and influence to correction, and a reading names capture there, but no one model holds the layers. So the closure is carried and the four-layer content is not. [AI reading]

says.en: Definition: 元吸引子, 'a loop of selection whose rule and whose reading of the rule are both formed from the share it selects, nothing in it reading what lies beyond the share'. Theorems for any type; of actual metrics conjectured (T7).

Reading [AI reading, D67]: the corpus's 'selecting the selectors' is the pool counted as the population is; 'That readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading'. Reading [D45, later in this section]: among a kind, a favouring reading is 'not selected on its own gain and falling with any cost', so what keeps the readers' premise 'is something other than selection on the reading'.

'One kind of institution has one minimal model on the root [AI reading], a rule rebuilt from the members it limits (05 §12), and no actual institution is shown to meet its hypotheses; no field test of reform events is frozen'.

Question to reviewers, not answered: do natural selection among AIs (Hendrycks 2023), influence-seeking patterns (Christiano 2019) and gradual disempowerment (Kulveit and others 2025) need a return kept by the shaper?

account_adds.en: When the loop locks and when a reading can turn it, and a frozen test that failed the bridge to a trained judge.

source_adds.en: The four layers as one loop; the intersubjective layer; priority among layers, and the folder's place in the division of labour among its neighbours, of whom live text names few and only in a question.

name.en: The historical safety net is gone: one civilization, no fallback society

source.locator: Claim 14

sense.en: Earlier, one society could fall and another prevail; now everything is interconnected in one global civilization, so the historical safety net is gone. Filed by the README as an observation, from July 2024.

quote: previously one society could fall and another prevail

reading.en: The conditional has the form of a group law: groups depending on one family of conditions end together, nothing selected among them, and ending selects only between families. One condition shared by every group supplies no selection among them. That the Earth is mutually dependent is supplied, not shown. So the form is a law and the observation is not claimed. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): under the coupled gate, n steps of uptake above replenishment from a stock below n + m end every formation depending on a member at such a need. The record: 'Groups depending on one such family end together, unselected among; ending selects only between families'.
Theorem (any type; World for the flow laws): 'one condition shared by every group ends them all and supplies no selection among them'.

Theorem (World; couplings holding at every step, bounds named): around a loop the carried amount 'is exponential both ways'; the record adds 'the pace of a selection under transmission'. 'That an actual difference grows so, that a dependence couples at every step, and that the Earth is mutually dependent are supplied.'

account_adds.en: The gate: what gives to a member depends on some member at a need, with enough excess from a low enough stock. Without it groups need not end together.

source_adds.en: The historical claim that fallback once existed and is gone, and that the present world is one such family.

name.en: Judge a reform by its transition path: a good end state can cross the floor on the way

source.locator: The formal restatement (2026-09-28); claim 192; Genealogy on the review

sense.en: Policies must be judged by transition paths, not final equilibria: a reform can bring capture down eventually, but only after the substrate has crossed its functional floor. Asserted in the paper, not shown; each review supplies an example, and one sketches reversal time depending on the lever.

quote: a reform can bring capture down eventually, but only after the substrate has crossed its functional floor

reading.en: Live on the market periphery in exact forms, not as a rule for policy. A start lasts n steps exactly when a ladder holds it; support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings; no single horizon serves every positive share; seeds below a bound fail whatever correction does. All model-bound, no measured threshold. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (pure-core law; market instance): a start lasts n steps exactly when some ladder holds it at level n. In the instance, enough initial support carries each positive state through a finite correction; no single N serves every positive share. 'sufficient hypotheses, not least; support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings'.

Theorem: from physical rational states with positive renewing share, initial stock at least the cover carries the guarded run through the landing into the original protection. 'not a complete basin or a measured threshold'.

Theorem (market instance): for every rational C₀ ≥ 5 and integer N > C₀ − 5, every positive seed 0 < x₀ ≤ (2/3)^N/6 fails by step N. 'a conservative obstruction, not an exact viability boundary; actual provision, entry or faster formation may move it'.

Theorem (World; balance): a re-reading from T keeps the need only where the level starts high enough; where nothing is given below the need, a level below it stays below whatever is drawn, so a later re-reading restores nothing.

account_adds.en: How the support needed grows with the horizon, by a stated recursion, and what the instance leaves unmeasured.

source_adds.en: Transition paths as the test of a policy; R_cap and h/ρ in this paper's form; reversal time depending on the lever (a review's numerical sketch).

name.en: Lifting settlement leaves more living ground

source.locator: opening; The first useful next step

sense.en: The starting idea: lift much of the built environment above living ground on trunks or open frameworks, so that human floor area reaches the ground through few points and more remains for other life. Held as a hypothesis, to be compared with compact ground settlement; no form is assumed to win.

quote: Elevation is one architectural means to test.

reading.en: No mechanism in the account has this content: it holds no model of light, foundations or settlement form, and its one habitat is a constructed witness's. It stands in this folder, in a one-paragraph gloss in history/THEORY-MAP-2026-10-08.md, and in Ren's founding message in sources/15. The live text only links the folder. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole design hypothesis, with what would overturn it: a compact ground alternative leaving more functioning habitat.

name.en: Generous human places and more room for other life, together

source.locator: The first useful next step, the working thesis

sense.en: The working thesis, explicitly conditional: abundance could make more adaptable, generous human environments practical while restoring room for other life, if ecological outcomes and material continuity are built into the whole system. Neither side is to be bought at the other's expense by assumption.

quote: abundance could make it practical to build more adaptable and generous human environments while restoring more room for other life

reading.en: Read people as a part widening its own options, other life as formations beyond its region: the thesis's condition has the form of the own-widening law, restoring being a net give that brings a formation within the margin. But more room is an amount and the law reads inclusion: one formation closed makes the whole mixed, however much is restored elsewhere. The correspondence is this reading's; the account does not claim it. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided). Where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region against the levels without its exchange, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside the region the levels without it admit, and is mixed exactly when it goes beyond for one. Mixed is not ordered. The laws locate the boundary; they predict no behaviour.

Theorem (World). With balance before each step at the conditions each formation requires, the levels with a part widen those without it exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation the levels without it admit and, at some step, brings within it one they do not. Witness: a giver from beyond widens. With a part withheld, the rest of the exchange does not adjust.

account_adds.en: An exact boundary, on a model of thresholds on conserved whole-number amounts, read against the levels without the part, the rest held; the source compares settlement forms, not a settlement against none. That the wider course is better is C's, unasserted.

source_adds.en: Abundance as the enabling condition, elevation and reuse as means, ecological outcomes as something to design for, and more room as an amount. No actual settlement is shown to meet the law's hypotheses.

name.en: Human improvement alongside a flourishing ecosystem, as the aim

source.locator: opening, second paragraph

sense.en: The purpose is broader than a smaller footprint: human development should contribute to the conditions in which an ecosystem continues to flourish, with continued improvement in human life. The source questions whether means suffice, not whether the aim is good; it states no premise for it.

quote: The aspiration is continued improvement in human life alongside flourishing soils, animals, vegetation, and ecological relationships.

reading.en: The source starts from an aim the account gives only conditionally. T8 is the makers' offer for life, binding no one: to see what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 names life's continuation, and widening is not its measure. The continuation condition and C belong to conditional comparisons, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought. No law says a lost habitat is a harm. Flourishing appears only as a word of Ren's that one record reads by widening; well-being beyond admitted continuation is not shown. Continued improvement is a comparison with no stated reader and, as a target, is met only by change. [AI reading]

says.en: T8, argued: for life, the account's makers offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; it binds no one. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not.
No law evaluates; should and better are readings people and AI form. The account asserts no should; where it ranks, it names its readings, each an unasserted hypothesis wherever used.
What this chapter does not show includes the value of bringing new lives into existence, well-being beyond admitted continuation, and constraints on acts.
