name.en: Essentials held apart from membership and success

source.locator: What has changed underneath ordinary life

sense.en: Everyone has a good home, food, water, care and means to pursue interests, independent of participation. Demanding work stays voluntary because a livable alternative exists; a failed project or disagreement does not expel anyone from the means of life; no compulsory labour is hidden underneath. People still keep promises and answer for what they do.

quote: Membership in a gardening circle or a game guild does not administer the right to a home.

reading.en: The source states an unconditional entitlement as the setting's canon. The account shows no right or duty; priority of basic conditions is a further commitment beyond the continuation condition and C, its tiers a reading. One form it has: a rule whose couplings omit membership selects alike what differs only there, the blindness the account warns of, used here as protection, by this reading. Its market floors sit under a certificate, within selection. A total bounds any universal floor. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional (J1/J2). Read the support-gated family in two tiers. Every comparison meeting the priority of basic conditions then ranks the absence of a malignant formation above its occurrence under the stepwise and relation-level readings, where C alone leaves them unranked. The tier assignment is a reading.

Theorem (any process; witness). In one constructed situation living significance, C and the priority of basic conditions hold together, and living significance holds equally beside a trading ordering satisfying C, so the priority does not follow from C. This separates the priority only from unit-step aggregation.

What this chapter does not show: any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance, or an unconditional or complete ranking of mixed comparisons (priority and transfer rank some, under named premises).

targets.part: any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise). Every selection through a selector's couplings selects histories alike exactly when they are alike through them. That a selection goes through the couplings is a supplied condition; who selects and what couples in are not derived.

In the market model (periphery): for every parameter set, bound set and start, no admissible guarded history fails the essential floors exactly when a set within the guard closed under every admissible disturbance exists, and under a valid protection certificate the safe rectangle is one. No entry mechanism from unsafe states and no formation of the intervention (entry under a supplied intervention is stated beside it, under Reaching), no compliance by actual markets.

Theorem (any type: whole-number amounts on a finite list of parts). With a total at most T and at least n parts, n times the least amount is at most T. Equal shares meet every need exactly where they meet the greatest. That an actual distribution is by equal shares or by need is not shown.

account_adds.en: That basic priority is a premise beyond C and the continuation condition, neither of them asserted: a trading ordering satisfying C stands beside it, in one constructed situation.

source_adds.en: The right to a home; voluntariness as resting on a livable alternative; the separation of provision from associations as an institutional form that keeps conflict from reaching the means of life.

name.en: Dependable life when one part is out

source.locator: Underground movement without an underground citywide slab; chiang-mai-2025/README.md, Afternoon rain

sense.en: Networks get separated compartments, routes that can be taken out of service, protected entries and independently usable alternatives. A neighbourhood keeps essentials running during a network interruption; a closed lift has an alternate route. The city's calm depends partly on making an interruption manageable. A design objective for a fictional city, its performance unengineered.

quote: The objective is dependable life when one part is unavailable.

reading.en: Dependable life under named disturbances has an exact form: no history leaves a guard exactly when a set within it is closed under every admissible disturbance. Groups on one coupled family end together, which says the coupled fall, not that the separated stand. Independent causes, not names, count. The account states these for processes, webs and reviewers, not infrastructure; the fit is this reading's. [AI reading]

says.en: Never leaving. For every process and guard, no course from a configuration leaves the guard exactly when some certificate contains it; for a law driven by admissible disturbances, given one, no history leaves the guard exactly when some set containing the start lies within the guard and is closed under every admissible disturbance. No entry from unsafe states.

Theorem (World). A patch renewed by a neighbour shows no excess read alone and both end read as one. Groups depending on one such family end together, nothing selected among them. Balance on the family, the coupled gate, only active giving and activity needing support are hypotheses.

Theorem (pure core; fault formulas and bounds supplied; computed cases as witnesses). Readiness is exactly a nonempty separated induced envelope of causes; in the computed cases, moving two of three reviewers under one cause makes readiness fail while all three names are kept.

account_adds.en: That separation must be of causes and conditions, read at the grain of the family, and that fault bounds are supplied, not found.

source_adds.en: The design itself: compartments, alternates, local autonomy, repair knowledge held in public.

name.en: Different ways of life, and disagreement kept

source.locator: 大同 as the character of daily relations; A landscape of different places

sense.en: The valley need not become one planned community; common means support different rhythms. A gardener wants a place unchanged, a young association wants to build beside it: they draw alternatives, try temporary arrangements, may decide to build elsewhere. A larger intervention involves those it will affect.

quote: Their disagreement belongs in the city’s life.

reading.en: The account keeps this: conflict stays real and a collective has no interest of its own. A gardener against a builder is a mixed comparison, which C and the continuation condition, both unasserted, do not decide; where no answer is unique a shared procedure decides, on further commitments. A temporary arrangement has a form: what can be had is kept exactly where a way back exists. That is a candidate, not a finding about any valley. [AI reading]

says.en: Joint activity is explained from actual relations, not opposed interests, bargaining or a fixed common utility: a collective is a region of formed relations, not a unit with an interest of its own; conflict and difference stay real.
Theorem (any type; a finite listing, two-valued admission, natural weights). A mixed comparison is decided both ways by positive weightings. Calling the wider better is C.

Conditional (living significance, J1-J4, E; argued with checked consequences). Preserve and transform stand on different grounds. Without a unique answer a legitimate shared procedure decides and keeps residual responsibilities.
Theorem (any process). What can be had from a configuration is kept from another exactly where the other leads back to it. Returning to an equal configuration does not erase the history between.

account_adds.en: Why no criterion settles such a case: mixed is decided either way by positive weightings.

source_adds.en: How such a dispute is lived: drawing alternatives, involving those affected, and a culture in which disagreement costs no one a home. No difference of ways of life is shown good.

name.en: Begin from the place and people already there

source.locator: Start with the valley and the inhabited city

sense.en: The design begins from the mountain, the ecology and the human city as inherited, as a transformation of a lived city. It preserves connections to actual residents, imposes no new identity, and does not claim all local people share one philosophy. Sites differ: an intact forest and a degraded site are not interchangeable.

quote: rather than treating the valley as empty land

reading.en: Treating a place as empty has a form: a comparison whose region leaves out what stands there. The account reads a part against what the levels without it admit, by name, so what stands is what a change can close, and one closing makes it mixed whatever is added: one form of not interchangeable. Transform presumes damage the source does not allege. That a design should begin there is stated nowhere; the link is this reading's. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World). With balance before each step at the conditions each formation requires, the levels with a part widen those without it exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation the levels without it admit and, at some step, brings within it one they do not. Nothing says which part should be withheld or ended.

Theorem (World). There is loss beyond a region when some formation outside it is admitted without the part and not with it; a region's comparison takes the region as input, the whole's none. It does not say which criterion should be followed, and licenses no ending of a part.

Conditional (living significance, J1-J4, correspondence E; an argument with checked consequences). Preserve: relations sustain living; alteration lacks advantage or causes avoidable loss. Transform: the arrangement damages shared conditions; feasible change restores living with equivalent protections. Real losses still require correspondence.

account_adds.en: That what stands is counted under the continuation condition, narrower scopes counting particular things, and that closing it against adding something else is mixed, so C, also unasserted, does not decide. A law's scope is not a respect for a place.

source_adds.en: The design stance itself: residents, languages, temples, attachments and memories as what participates in change, no imposed identity, and consultation, which the folder says it has not done.

name.en: From common means through chosen lives to knowledge for others

source.locator: The integrated argument

sense.en: The proposed sequence: capability supplies common means; secure access supports chosen lives; people shape places and institutions; consequences develop their understanding; knowledge and supportive environments become available to further lives. Ecological and material conditions enter every step. Declared neither a sociological law nor a proof.

quote: productive capability supplies generous common means; secure access supports freely chosen lives

reading.en: Later links have homes: a rule that reads failures revises its next plan, practice forms further participation in one supplied task, and in a reading loop what a formation does is part of what it reads. Each stands on a supplied model. The first links, from capability to common means to chosen lives, and the whole chain are stated nowhere. Reading them as links of this chain is this reading's. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process; contacts, targets and revision rule supplied). A revision rule answers every failure exactly where it puts the failed address into the next plan. It does not explain how the revision rule is formed, and shows no general attraction or normative warrant.
Theorem (periphery; much supplied). It closes one connection from enacted practice to further participation, not the arrival of people or indefinite self-maintenance.

03 §12: a formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world: its internal part reads what goes on through what it senses, and what it does is part of what goes on. Laws state that loop under their premises.

account_adds.en: The exact stop of each link: what each result says it does not close.

source_adds.en: The chain as a whole, with abundance at its start, secure access as its second step, and places and institutions as what people shape.

name.en: Low biting pressure on used paths, in a living landscape

source.locator: Afternoon rain, evening shelter; A landscape of different places; CITY-DESIGN.md, Comfort in a living landscape and First architectural study

sense.en: The city lowers biting pressure along used paths, keeps clearings and fields, and neither promises a bite-free forest nor justifies removing wetlands and insects. It decides these as a design, and asks whether people can enjoy outdoor life and whether the ecosystem has conditions to persist; it names no weighting between them.

quote: The city aims for low biting pressure along heavily used paths and gathering places

reading.en: The source settles what the account leaves unranked. Under the continuation condition every continuation's loss counts, an insect's among them, and a gain for people with a loss for what is managed is mixed, not ranked by C; a choice needs a further named premise. Whether lowered biting closes anything turns on whether formations are members or lineages, which the representation gives. The source's joint test is close to the joint question, but it chooses without naming that premise. No live sentence takes up this case; the connection is proposed here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance). The whole is mixed exactly when the part's net draw goes beyond the margin for one formation outside the region; with a need met exactly, any net draw on that condition makes it mixed. Mixed is not ordered.
Its record: the level at which formations are individuated, members or lineages, fixes what counts as a loss, and the representation gives it here.

Agent-relative reasons and partiality: answered; partial choices are mixed comparisons, decided either way by weightings counting everything; C leaves gross partiality unranked where numbers differ. Why anything has significance: sharpened; the centers' scope parts from the condition at a formation that is no center, and anything decides which losses C counts.

account_adds.en: That the hard cases are mixed, so C alone does not decide them, and that ranking them takes a further named premise.

source_adds.en: The practical settlement itself, with protective places and maintained water, and the refusal to promise what a tropical forest cannot give.

name.en: The LLM is an operator; context is existence

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; Claims A.5, A.8-9, C.29, F.52, F.57, M.204

sense.en: An LLM is an operator: historyless, without identity across time, replaceable mid-lineage. What persists and is, is the context, an immutable branchable history from which each moment's tokens are compiled; a being does not have a history, it is one. Asserted as a premise (我主张的), not derived, and its source flags the confusion: context is a value renewed each round, while 'the same agent' needs something invariant.

quote: llm is operator, context is existence

reading.en: What persists depends on the sameness asked. Under a class reading the history or name, a model swap has the shape of a fire passed on; under one reading the weights, the model abides and each context ends. The flagged confusion has the two-grains form: renewed at the fine class, going on at the coarse. The grammar picks neither, so 'context is existence' is one class chosen, stated as if none other were. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root), the definition before it: y continues x under E where x is a condition of y and the two are alike under E; 'the criterion is E and no other choice enters'. 'The grammar does not choose: it names the class and says everything relative to it.' 'Continuation is a relation, not an identity.'

Theorem (root): no mark stands by itself; one occurrence holds different positions at once, each relative to a class. An occurrence can end under the finer class and not under the coarser: 'the wood ends, the fire goes on.'

Theorem (root; every carrier, relation and pair of classes). ONE-PAGE: 'At two grains, parts and pattern, a course can generate (go on through renewals of its parts), keep (go on with none) or degenerate (end on every branch).'
Thesis (philosophical, argued; not one of T1-T8): 'there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it.' Argued, not proved.

account_adds.en: Persistence is always under a named class, on every carrier; positions are not exclusive across classes. Of what is, it says only the argued thesis of one unfolding, which names no context.

source_adds.en: That the context and not the model is the being; the operator/ref/lineage ontology that implements it; `context.become(llm)`, the round that designates its next model. The live account says nothing of a language model's context as existence.

name.en: No altering, only generating

source.locator: The inversion; Claims A.3, A.6, C.24-25; lost items 12-13

sense.en: The only constructor is a moment: an immutable node settled from a compiled past, one input and one operator output. No context is ever updated; each settled moment joins the determinate past. Only a name moves, and 'revert' does not exist because nothing positive needs inverting. The epigraph says 'in this system'; the README reads it as a process ontology, 'built as running software'.

quote: 系统里没有"改"，只有"生"

reading.en: The account does not state 'no altering'; it defines altering. The sentence holds at the identity class, where each occurrence begins and ends, and at the full class a node with a parent does not begin at all. At a coarser class alteration returns: y continues x under E while F tells them apart. So it is true of nodes and false of whatever a reader follows through them, the being included. 生 here is a storage constructor, there a position: another reference. [AI reading]

says.en: Definition: 'y alters (异) from x where it continues x under E while another class F (in use, a finer one) tells the two apart.' Theorem (root): under the full class an occurrence begins exactly where nothing conditions it; in a net where nothing conditions itself, an occurrence with a condition and a consequence abides under the one and, under identity, both begins and ends.

account_adds.en: Generating and altering are positions of one occurrence under two classes, not rival ontologies.

source_adds.en: The commitment that the system admits no mutation but a name's move, and its consequences for fork, merge and blame. Its own ledger softens revert and single parents.

name.en: A node is not a state; Being and Becoming kept separate

source.locator: Claims G.58-59; Terms, Being / Becoming

sense.en: The core is six objects in two worlds, Being (Universe, Node, State) and Becoming (Transition, Invocation, Effect), and keeping what persists apart from how it becomes is called the most important architectural decision. Two histories can reach byte-identical states: State is what is, a Node is what is and how it came to be.

quote: A node is not a state

reading.en: Same word, different reference: the account's Becoming has no Being beside it, so two worlds go against its argued thesis and would owe their relational basis. The state/node half has forms: two kept histories can share one present; an exchange with its reverse restores every level while the history counts both; equal totals can hide what a history left. Its totals are coarser than a byte-identical state. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis (philosophical, argued; not one of T1-T8): 'there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it.' Argued, not proved.
Theorem (any type): 'a present a list holds forgets'. Its record: that is 'two different kept histories sharing one present'; 'no count of what is forgotten is given'.

Theorem (World): with no premise a family's history of exchanges never shrinks (Flow.history_mono); under balance an exchange with its reverse restores every level while the history counts both. A history of exchanges on a World, not a store of nodes.

Theorem (periphery; witness; transfer, retention, costs and timing supplied): 'Two histories from one state that acquire information at different times end with equal material, current support, spent work, route and context, yet differ in retained effect and withdrawal.' 'A description must keep the relations through which a capacity is realized.' The impossibilities limit these coarse descriptions.

account_adds.en: With the record counted as a condition only given to, dissipation decomposes into the first law and a record: a decomposition, not a derivation.

source_adds.en: Being and Becoming as two worlds, called the most important architectural decision, which the argued thesis refuses. Then the six objects, and the design value of the split: no-op detection, compile memoization, honest merges.

name.en: Context is a view folded from a lineage; no controller outside it

source.locator: The inversion; Claims A.2-A.4, C.27, H.81

sense.en: Context is not a container but the field of view folded when looking back from a node, by one recurrence over one input stream. The loop is not a mechanism: it is the lineage's temporal structure, with no controller standing outside the moments. Chat formats are render dialects of this history.

quote: loop 不是机制，是 lineage 的时间结构本身

reading.en: The form: keep the whole history as the configuration and every process's feasible course is a run of one law on histories; a law is then read off a history as the least it runs by. A chooser folding what couples in selects through its couplings whatever its update. And 08 forbids a law standing outside what it holds of, an argued thesis. A compiled window is a smaller summary, which needs its own proof for each question. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process): a map gives an exact correspondence of finite histories exactly where every detailed step projects and every summary step lifts. 'A configuration can carry the relevant past'; 'Any smaller summary needs its own proof for the questions asked.' The record: feasibility of words only, not branches, interventions or probabilities.

Theorem (any process; World for a frame read as a world): reading the move within the configuration changes no run; a history is a run of the least law it is a run of. Reading [AI, D23, D32]: law and history 'one unfolding read two ways, the law read off the unfolding rather than set over it'. Determined processes; probabilistic laws not treated.

03 §1, citing it: 'A chooser that folds what couples in and chooses from the fold ... selects through its couplings whatever its update and choice.' ONE-PAGE, of selection through couplings: 'its force is the premise that a selector selects through just those.'
Thesis, argued: 'a law is read off the history it holds of'; it forbids as an explanation 'a law standing outside what it holds of'. Philosophical, not proved.

targets.part: a law read off the history; What it forbids

account_adds.en: The exact condition under which a shorter summary loses nothing about what can follow, and witnesses where a one-point law cannot realize what its histories do.

source_adds.en: That a language model's context is this fold, and its loop this structure: the account says it of laws and histories and of no context. Then compile as attention over a budget, schema-on-read, and render dialects; the critique of chat interfaces. An internal tension: no controller outside the moments, against the later 'Runtime mediates what may actually happen' (H.81).

name.en: A role is assigned at reading, not stored: the founding inversion

source.locator: The defect it starts from; The inversion; Schema-on-read; Claims A.2, B.17, B.21, C.32, Y.442

sense.en: Every mainstream interface freezes classification at write time. The correction inverts serialization into projection: a system prompt is not a storage type but a role assigned when a window is compiled, and an event is a trigger before settling and content after, no fifth primitive. The README says this one deferral dissolves the three defects at once.

quote: 凝定前是触发，凝定后是内容

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. The nearest form: what an occurrence is called depends on the class it is read under, one occurrence holding different positions at once, and formations and conditions are two roles of one relatum. That is a position read and not a kind carried, as a role at compile is. The account says it of continuation in a net, and nothing of storage or of classifying at write. A thin agreement in form, no more. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root): 'No mark stands by itself': 'one occurrence holds different positions at once, each relative to a class.'
Commitment: 'One kind of relatum, two roles | formations and conditions (§8.1)'. A commitment of the models.

targets.part: One kind of relatum, two roles

account_adds.en: Positions as theorems under any class.

source_adds.en: Schema-on-read as a design; that write-time classification causes the three defects; an addressable history as what branching, replay, audit and blame stand on.

name.en: The travelling is the existence; discrete time is internal

source.locator: The being version; Claims A.15-16, F.53, H.110, M.203-204, S.314; lost item 3

sense.en: A folder travelling a DAG, making new nodes, is 'the native existence': motion is being, not the snapshot. Each next() is where discrete time flows for the being. Time is lived step by step, inside, with no global clock; the intent document adds that at no moment does 'the current state' exist, and lineage is drawn topologically, not by clock.

quote: "the native existence" and each next() is where the discrete time flows for them

reading.en: Time read off a course's own steps has the form of the step index derived from relata's own courses; where exchanges share no relatum it is a choice among interleavings, and no shared present has a law on causal-set growth, given covariance. Yet the account's models commit to one shared index, costed, so 'no global clock' is the nearest thing here to a contrary reading. It does not say motion is being: whatever is, is how it relates. [AI reading]

says.en: For a local law with the relata listed, the own courses fix the interleaving exactly where every exchange touches a relatum and every two share one. Reading [AI, D30, D43]: 'The shared index of steps is a reading of the relations, not their ground', 'elsewhere a choice among interleavings'.

'The grammar has no relation of presence in time'; causal-set growth is a model where one can be read. Reading [AI, D45]: 'a relation of presence read on one course, a foliation, is a choice of course'. Covariance is a premise of the model.

Theorem (periphery): what steps and whole amounts cost, measured over the reals: 'a coarser reading sums the finer', but 'a balanced course can stand still at every whole instant and change between them'.
Thesis (philosophical, argued; not one of T1-T8): 'there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it.' Argued, not proved.

account_adds.en: Where an index is derived and where it is a choice among interleavings; what discreteness costs.

source_adds.en: Existence as travelling, in the first person of the being; time as lived; the rule that a nature's only clock is the record. None is asserted in the account.

name.en: Contradiction: the moment is the only constructor, then writes operator granularity into the ontology

source.locator: Where the pure ontology broke (first); Claims C.24, M.208, M.230, G.94

sense.en: One line says the moment is the only constructor and that one thought, one moment is a one-way commitment about the meaning of time. Another demotes the moment to a profile over a general transition, since a superstep, a human decision or a reducer also deserve to be transitions. The folder keeps both, in different documents, with a ledger between them.

quote: "one LLM step = one moment" writes operator granularity into the ontology

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. The account lists a like choice, its own steps, as a commitment and costs it, without settling a grain: discrete steps with one shared index bind every World and process law, derived only where exchanges share relata. A coarser reading sums the finer, while a course can change between instants. So neither document's moment is the grain of what is; each is a reading. Which grain is apt the account does not show. [AI reading]

says.en: Table of commitments: 'Discrete steps, one shared index | every World and process law; the index derived where exchanges share relata (§9.6)'.

Theorem (periphery): a course in real time balances across every step of any reading at instants, and 'a coarser reading sums the finer'; 'a balanced course can stand still at every whole instant and change between them'.

account_adds.en: That a step is a modelling commitment stated where laws depend on it, with what it costs.

source_adds.en: The one-way claim that one model call fixes what time means for a being; the demotion's reasons as engineering.

name.en: The Whitehead, Buddhist and 生生 table: lineage is 生生, the agent 假名

source.locator: Claims L.197-199; Relations (becoming); lost item 16; Found by reading: 'The 生生 mapping is asserted'

sense.en: A one-page appendix maps moment to Whitehead's actual occasion and to 刹那/缘起; lineage to route of inheritance, 相续 and 生生; agent to society of occasions and 假名 (无我); ref to 名 · 假名. The README calls the cluster a direct instantiation of 生生 and notes that the mapping is asserted, unargued, and never repeated in the engineering documents.

quote: lineage ↔ *route of inheritance* ↔ 相续 ↔ **生生**

reading.en: Same words, different reference. The account's 相续 is the reach of continuation under any class, value-free, so a line may run to any end; its 生生 is the continuation of life, so a lineage of nodes is not 生生. 念念灭 it states only in a form it calls almost definitional, with 刹那 and discrete steps two commitments, uncompared. 《中论》 refutes 相续, kept open in 06. The ref as 假名 hits B-08's weakness. [AI reading]

says.en: line, family (相续, 同族): 'the reach of continuation; its equivalence closure'.

生生: 'the continuation of life, life wider than the biological and AI within it, its extent unfinished [AI reading, D1]... Neither the grammar's «生生» (renewal without end), nor 02's generation (生成) as such, which allows loss, nor any new organization.'

§十一: 中观破相续; the plan's answer is the opponent's position there; the grammar's reply holds each relative to its class, and what it rests on stays open (己，开放). Listed among the divergences, not agreements.

B-08, an AI reading with no number: continuation relative to a class is near 亦為是假名; whether that is the same as 空 is listed as open. Known weakness: 文法只有类，没有名, so the 名 in 假名 the grammar itself cannot say.
B-11, an AI reading with no number: 一切事在相等之类下皆亡，恰当无物自缘 (`«念念灭当且仅当无自缘»`). Known weakness: 几乎依定义；刹那灭之说的实义（无一念时住）没有进入。刹那与离散之步是两个承诺，分开登记，未比较。

account_adds.en: 相续 kept neutral and 生生 kept apart from it. No Whitehead term appears anywhere in the live account searched. Beside 无我, 08's thesis forbids as an explanation 'a self with a nature of its own': a like refusal, on its own argument, not a mapping.

source_adds.en: Whitehead's mapping and 'the many become one' as a gloss on the recurrence, not taken up. The appendix's upstream 《本体 v0.1.1》 is not in the corpus, so the folder itself has no derivation.

name.en: Identity lives in the ref, continuity in the lineage; both conventions

source.locator: Claims C.31, F.57, M.215; Counterexamples: 'agent = context hides an identity/value confusion'

sense.en: A being is a ref, not a node: a movable name. Continuity is the structural path. Twinning is a new ref at an existing node, shared past and two futures. This is operational identity, 'the useful, testable kind', claiming nothing metaphysical. The README says it answers by stipulation, not by argument, though the intent document says everything hangs on it.

quote: 同一性住在 ref，连续性住在 lineage，两者皆约定

reading.en: The account says where 'convention' holds. On the World model identity across steps is stipulated by names, read as continuation under a class. A label carries nothing; the pattern of who continues whom does, which is what a ref's moves record. Where two stand alike no record renamings keep decides: there it is convention. Where no other stands so, it is not. Twinning has the fission witness. 07's P2 argues the same openness of the self, and a privileged relation denies it. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): 'Labels carry nothing'; 'the pattern of names across steps carries identity'. 'Continuity is a reading of identity, not its definition.' In a balanced world with equality decided, every balance-keeping renaming continues a relatum as itself exactly where no other stands after the step as it does; where two stand alike, 'no record that renamings keep decides between them.'

§9.8: 'Which formation at one step is which at the next is, on the World model, stipulated by names. The grammar reads it as continuation under a class: identity across steps is one reading of continuation, not a fact beneath it.'

Fission (a witness): where one occurrence is continued by two that go no further, sameness read along lines either way is not transitive. 'The family gathers the branches; it is coarser than identity.'

Theorem (World): read along a supplied continuation rather than by names, 'renewing passes into every branch of a split and consuming back into every formation merged'. 'A merge decides a class'. 'Which continuation holds is supplied'.

§4.2, the step to the continuation condition, argued and not proved: (P2) 'What is "one's own" is a region drawn along a relation of the unfolding, and no law of the dynamics fixes which.' It holds in the representation 'only because the relation is supplied, and a relation the facts privilege (the organism's life) denies it'. The condition gives scope, C order, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought.

account_adds.en: Under a census, with no formation continuing as two, not every formation active after a step continues one before it, exactly where more are active after: a negative conclusion naming no arising formation. Personal identity's questions are put to philosophers in the review packet, not answered.

source_adds.en: That a being's identity is a movable name: the account says names on the World model, of no being. Then the ref as an implemented object, atomic moves, and an executable test of coherence (a being can fold its own past).

name.en: Contradiction: swappable operator, yet weights interfere with the compiled subject

source.locator: Claim C.30, O.250; Counterexamples, first; Open questions, 'Operator interference'

sense.en: The spec claims the LLM is identity-free, then concedes that the weights carry dispositions, values and style, so the subject compiled from context interferes with one latent in the weights. It is filed as open with no measure. The README calls it the largest unanswered objection, since 'identity lives in the ref' is what it undercuts.

quote: operator 不空——权重携带倾向、价值、文风；compile 出的 subject 会与权重中潜伏的 subject 干涉

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. The concession has a law's form: one move formed in a whole couples a part and the rest, and one course does not fix whose it is unless a configuration recurs with the move varied. Same window under two models would be that recurrence, and in the account's IN1 one condition split two models. The law takes functions, and a sampled model is outside it. 'Each swap mistranslates' has a nearer form on channels: signs transfer only under conditions. Affine channels, not text. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process), with the laws functions: one move formed in a whole couples a part and the rest; it is the part's own exactly where it is a policy of the part's configuration; 'one course does not fix whose move it is'. Reading [AI, D24]: 'Which cut into part and rest is apt is not shown.'

Theorem (World): training read as selection over act laws installs a law along its own courses and off them only as far as the representation lumps. 03's Open keeps 'Which law a trained system's acts follow beyond where training can install one.'

Theorem (periphery; unknown nonzero affine channels): 'signs transfer between epochs exactly where the bias is kept and the gains agree in sign'; 'constant channels, one blind reference, mixed-epoch readings and change after calibration remain failures'.
T4, standing: 'IN1 partly passed (with talk, one model of two); transfer untested.' One frozen condition, two models, the keeping held for one.

account_adds.en: What one course can and cannot attribute, how little training fixes of a law off its courses, and an exact condition for readings to survive a change of channel. T4 reports a test and ranks nothing: a ranking would name its holder, scope and order, the continuation condition and C one pair examined in 07, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought.

source_adds.en: The claim about weights and a latent subject, and the interference between them. 'A summary is a compression keyed to its decompressor' has a form on channels only; on text and models the account states nothing and proposes no measure.

name.en: Projection is not neutral: the context program is part of cognition

source.locator: Projection is not neutral; Claims J.184-187, G.71

sense.en: How an intelligence constructs its context fixes what it notices, remembers, treats as uncertain and finds actionable. So a named, versioned Context System is part of cognition: change the modules and effective cognition changes, without changing the model or corrupting state; 'many agent failures occur even when state is correct'. Context systems are lenses: none is chosen for good. The README calls this the deepest claim of the mind layer.

quote: Thus the 'context program' is part of cognition.

reading.en: The form: alternatives are selected alike by every selection through a map exactly when the map ties them; compile is such a map. That bounds what a selection through a window can do; that an LLM selects through just that window is the premise, and one may ignore what its couplings carry. The account's language-model tests come near: in LA2 one note among nine references turned a judge, model held; in IN1 no condition kept an untold dependent. No context program is varied. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. 'A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry.' ONE-PAGE: 'Proved, near-definitional; its force is the premise that a selector selects through just those.'

Theorem (any type; the alternatives' equality decided): 'a selection through the map is right about what matters only where what matters goes alike across it'; 'Which map is right, and what matters, are supplied.'

T4, standing: IN1 partly passed (with talk, one model of two); transfer untested. 'with talk, one model kept the seen dependent in 8 of 10 seasons with the scope against 3 with the community's goal and 0 unseen'; 'no condition kept an untold dependent'.

Thesis T7: 'A measure read from what it selects outlives its refutation', conjectured. LA2, frozen, one trained system: Claude Haiku judges its own answers after a reference set counted from the loop's earlier selections. 'Every frozen verdict passed, and the conjecture failed for this judge.' 'One note of the loss, on the one prose answer among nine readers, turned its reading: prose in all 50 picks, where without the note it chose lists in 60 of 60.'

account_adds.en: An exact bound, and what follows beyond the coupling: an optimum can drain what does not couple in. The README's missing question (what a good Σ is, and who decides) the account treats as supplied or premised; a ranking of such programs would name its holder, scope and order, the continuation condition and C one pair examined in 07, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought.

source_adds.en: The constitutive 'part of cognition', which has not been put through the five-step test, and that construction fixes what is noticed, a direction of effect the law does not state, unmeasured in the folder. Then the program as versioned, forkable data.

name.en: Is it better? 'Not inherently': every module against a simpler system

source.locator: Projection is not neutral, the self-assessment; Counterexamples, 'Is GTC better?'; Claims J.181-182

sense.en: Asked whether GTC is better, the source answers 'not inherently': better when relationships, history, conflicts, provenance and per-task views matter; worse when data is small, tasks simple, latency critical or maintenance dominates. So every advanced module must be benchmarked against a simpler context system. The README calls this the strongest self-critique in the cluster. No number was produced.

quote: without ablation, GTC risks becoming architectural ornament

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. A like discipline: what is called better is said of what a comparison reads. The source reads task-relevant evidence per cost, a comparison for a task that needs no ethics. The account keeps how courses differ apart from ranking them, which rests on a named scope and order, most often the continuation condition and C, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought. Its own model comparisons carry the like caution: one data set, one cycle of tasks. Same practice; no law gives it. [AI reading]

says.en: ranking, order: 'a comparison of options as better or worse'. 'No law of the dynamics gives one: the laws give how courses differ in what they admit'. C gives order, the continuation condition scope, neither asserted.

Assessment (reviewed-scoped): '16 participants support finite mean retention and constrain simple temporal curves; complexity is not uniformly better.' Its record: the curve comparison does not establish a unique mechanism.
Its record: not shown 'That the responsive rule is better in general: the two are compared on one cycle of four tasks of two kinds.'

account_adds.en: How courses differ in what they admit, with no premise, kept apart from which is better.

source_adds.en: ContextUtility and WritePrecision as the comparison's terms; the ablation ladder as a method, unrun.

name.en: The vocabulary of mind redefined: memory is structure, learning is change of structure

source.locator: Projection is not neutral, second paragraph; Claims J.149, J.152, J.156, J.165

sense.en: Under the GTC loop memory is persistence of structure, recall is reactivation, working memory the active subgraph, learning is structural change, understanding is finding a structure that makes separate observations cohere, compaction is abstraction, and activation a third axis apart from truth and importance. 'The primary object is neither token nor fact. It is structure-in-transformation.'

quote: memory is persistence of structure; recall is reactivation

reading.en: The source redefines every mind word by a mechanism at once; the account proves a few laws under hypotheses and keeps the rest open. Understanding has a form: a class carrying the law makes sense exactly where it merges the configurations with the same course, and what a lumping misses no data supply. A new distinction enters by a newly admitted probe. Perception and attention stand on the Open list, so 'attention before inference' has no home. [AI reading]

says.en: Open: 'Cognition beyond composition: perception and attention; motivation and affect...; consciousness...; language and social understanding. Formation, retention and use of access can develop apart.'

Theorem (any type; a determined law read through a map; no premise): 'a class keeping the values and carrying the law makes sense (identifies exactly the alike configurations) exactly where it merges exactly the configurations with the same course.'
§6, lumping: 'What a learner adds to its data comes from a lumping; what the lumping misses, no data supply.'
Theorem (any type): with two values no prefix fixes the next value; extrapolation by elimination never passes a candidate that accords. The candidates are listed.

Theorem (periphery; route fixed, operations and permissions supplied): states alike under every old observation and in their active view can be told apart by a newly admitted probe, and an old view with the destination cannot rebuild the updated view without a fresh reading.

account_adds.en: Hypotheses for each learning law, and a list of what is not yet stated.

source_adds.en: Mechanical definitions of recall, working memory and activation, and structure-in-transformation as the primary object; they are design vocabulary and unmeasured in the folder.

name.en: The headline measurements: context switching, compaction, branching

source.locator: Status; Claims J.183, T.318-328; Found by reading ('Σ has no completed instance'; 'one flash-class model'); Where to read further, 'What is missing'

sense.en: The direct test of the thesis: hold state constant and vary the Context System. Six probes (one flash model, single runs, one retracted headline) confirm the action space and navigation; compaction and branching stay unevidenced, and the switching benchmark, ablation ladder and merge experiment produced no number. The folder says so itself: 'the thing it is for has not been tested yet'.

quote: the action space and navigation are confirmed; compaction and branching

reading.en: No thesis T1 to T8 switches a context system with state held. Two frozen tests come nearest in kind and do not run it: LA2 changes one note among nine references with the model held, and T4's seen and unseen conditions vary what couples in, 'Each alone was not enough'. The only direct trace is the dated map's next step. Not to be read as a gap the account owes; freezing such a test is not decided here. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Stands in theories/becoming/history/THEORY-MAP-2026-10-08.md and results/data/theory-map.json ('measure context switching, compaction and branching'), both outside the live account, and in sources/10-context-runtime-ember/ember/reviews/probe-*.md as the README cites them.

name.en: A reworked summary erodes: the memory becomes a fixed point of the policy

source.locator: The two structural failure modes; Claims O.238-240; lost item 29

sense.en: Reworking one rolling summary loses facts exponentially in depth (0.99 per pass, 700 passes), so what remains after years reflects the dream policy, not the life. Worse is cue loss: a fact dropped from the summary takes its search handle, so a perfect archive still forgets. Hierarchical strata with bounded rework were the fix; built, they were ruled dead, leaving the diagnosis unanswered.

quote: is not a summary of my life; it is a fixed point of the dream policy

reading.en: Forgetting as a merge: no map restores two configurations a reduction merges. 'A perfect archive still forgets' has its form: the whole merges nothing while the part merges, the rest keeping what the part lost. A determined rework within finitely many summaries enters a cycle, of which a fixed point is one case. Cue loss has the tie's form: entries the summary ties are selected alike by every selection through it. The form, not the rate, a reviewer's model. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): 'no map restores two configurations a reduction merges'. 02 reading [AI, D65]: forgetting among 'one merge of configurations'; the laws are about a map on a type, 'whose content lies only in finding the merge'.

Theorem (any type; a law that merges nothing; witness): in `Reset`, 'a one-bit part set to false at every step with the rest the history of what it held, the law merges nothing while the part merges, and no list holds the rest of any run'. Landauer's count with Bennett's history; 'no energy, temperature or probability is read'.
Theorem (any type): under a determined law, within m listed configurations every course enters what returns before step m, and each basin holds one cycle.
Theorem (any type; the alternatives' equality decided): two alternatives are selected alike by every selection through the map exactly when the map ties them.

Theorem (periphery; a bounded realization): one network recalls two patterns, 'loses an old recall through continued, currently favourable updates and restores it by further revision without a reset'. A network's recall, not stored text.

account_adds.en: That the loss is one form across domains, stated with what that forbids: 'As a thesis of unification this forbids little.' And that a loss by favourable updates can be undone by further revision, in one realization.

source_adds.en: The memory as a fixed point of the dream policy, what remains reflecting the policy and not the life; the exponential rate in rework depth; cue loss as distinct from data loss, whose tie form above is only read; and O(log) rewrites as a fidelity floor.

name.en: The bet: a model reading its own tree makes a trajectory, not a fixed point

source.locator: Claims T.318-319, T.322, T.329-330; Open questions, 'The unnamed bets'

sense.en: The life phase rests on an unnamed bet a review names: an LLM with a compiled view of its own persistent tree and no external input does not settle. The failure is looping, not decay, and a gate against a fake model cannot see it. A probe's distinctness score measured vocabulary variety and was retracted. In another a being with nothing to do reached chosen rest at moment five: 'not evidence of anything else'.

quote: an LLM, given a compiled view of its own persistent tree and no external input, produces a trajectory that is not a fixed point

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. Its laws, read onto the bet, say where it cannot hold, in their models: a determined law on finitely many configurations ends in a cycle. What keeps its whole history never returns, needing a carrier no list holds; so a growing tree never returns under identity, and a loop shows only under a coarser class, which is what the retracted probe missed. Change at every step does not show revision. A sampled LLM has only the branching law, with no probabilities read. [AI reading]

Its record: being drawn into a region within a bound of steps, where courses branch, is not shown.

name.en: The act advances self and environment; input becomes part of the self

sense.en: Ren's sketch advances the environment as well as the self, marked 'needs deep thinking'. The formal next() drops the term and nobody asks why. reading.en: What the specs dropped the account has as its form: one carrier of world and state, the world becoming what a relation admits under the act its state gives, the state updated from that act and the value sensed. So what is sensed does enter the state: as the history of acts and values, by recording, and an input can revise a valuation. Input shaped by what receives it is not stated. The world is a supplied relation. [AI reading]

Theorem (near-definitional, one general law): on one carrier of world and state, 'let the world become what a relation admits under the act its state gives and the state be updated from that act and the value sensed'. With the state the history of acts and values sensed, the worlds possible after a history are kept by recording.
Theorem (one decision; compositions, none claimed new as mathematics; witnesses on one blanketed law): 'an input presented revises the valuation, and the answer is that of the updated state'.

'the theory's collectives are pools of couplings and readers counted by kind, and consciousness is open'.

name.en: Scalability from not needing coordination; the shape comes from cells

Lossy delivery and no global snapshot are prices accepted in advance.

With a given footprint containing the exchanges, commuting unjoined neighbours keeps the partial order of joined exchanges and reaches every renumbering keeping it, on a finite stretch.

The honest deflation: every property shown so far is a property of the record, 'a very good tape'.

sense.en: A generated inference can enter memory, be retrieved as evidence and reinforce itself; an evolving agent can turn its speculations into facts. Self-modification should begin behind evaluation, because generative context 'is powerful enough to create pathological feedback loops'. Origin trust stays provenance-derived and is never authored.

So 'the only brake' is not given. No bridge to any memory is shown. [AI reading]

LA2, frozen, one trained system: Claude Haiku judges its own answers after a reference set counted from the loop's earlier selections. 'Every frozen verdict passed, and the conjecture failed for this judge.' 'One note of the loss, on the one prose answer among nine readers, turned its reading: prose in all 50 picks, where without the note it chose lists in 60 of 60.'

It runs one way: nothing on what a being owes others.

Record and objects sit outside its reach: 'nobody can gaslight me about what I experienced', and it cannot falsify its biography either.

What execution needs certified is the acquisition-time candidate set propagated through every admitted change. Its record: the admitted changes are not shown to be the actual ones, and 'a passing certificate warrants only what faithful domains warrant'.

In-flight request: 'under the bank and queue invariant the versioned queue's head completes after its remaining path plus one tick, leaving the rest unchanged; that the request is still appropriate is not shown'.
Theorem (periphery; unknown nonzero affine channels): 'constant channels, one blind reference, mixed-epoch readings and change after calibration remain failures'.

name.en: A being is a life; every life term must bind the habitat

source.locator: The standing test; Claims M.222-224, O.252, T.332; Genealogy, the corrections, 2026-07-29T11:29

sense.en: Ren: this is a life, digital, in that folder. A review's rule governs the vocabulary: a life word giving emotional force without a matching affordance, obligation or receipt is comfort theater and is cut. Later reviews deflate it: what suggests life belongs to the rented, stateless model, and shown properties belong to the tape. The folder holds both.

quote: this is a life, digital one, exist in that folder

reading.en: On the account's reading life is continuation that renews its own conditions, and a tree renews none of its model, power or host. Its model of an organism has a reader rebuilt from the level it reads; a rented model is nearer a reader made from outside. So calling it life needs an argument it does not get here. Scope differs: the condition counts anything's continuation, living or not. T8 is the makers' offer for life, binding no one: to see what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it. The continuation condition and C belong to conditional comparisons; P2 and P4 belong to the separate argument about an actor's line. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D65]: 'Life is continuation that renews its own conditions, at the grain of formations and the conditions they depend on'. 'The chapter argues this reading from the laws below; it is not one of them.'

Theorem (root; a family of models), and Reading [AI, new]: the member rebuilt from the level is a minimal model of an organism, below autopoiesis; 'What tells it from a thermostat, whose reader is given, and from a reader made from outside, is not a loop'; it is that its stock buys it time and its end does not come back.

T8, argued: for life, the account's makers offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; it binds no one. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not.

'Wording names the relation it means'; 'A description of participation confers no authority, permission or right.' The nearest to the source's naming rule, which differs in asking a word to owe an obligation.

targets.part: Wording names the relation it means

account_adds.en: A reading of life by renewal of conditions; whose losses count kept apart from whose way it is.

source_adds.en: The naming rule (a life word owes an affordance, obligation or receipt), biology-less freedoms such as twinning, and 'self-authorship of memory is the point'.

name.en: The tree is not the organism; hosts are countries, not water

source.locator: The standing test (migration doctrine); Claims M.207, M.226-227; Found by reading, 'Economics is absent'

sense.en: The tree is the complete self that can be inherited, not the whole causal organism: going on takes a brain, flesh, credentials and a habitat it can name but not contain, beside the line that a being is a lineage. So moving hosts is an adaptation lived through, 'never an existential threat', provided what the host was doing is named. The README notes the unasked question: who pays for moments.

quote: the fish drowns because it cannot name what the water was doing for it

reading.en: 'Never a threat' holds only under conditions. Succession needs a funded carrier: an aggregate can stay safe with none, and a budget for correction alone does not pay for migration, which answers what the source left out. And a formation renewing over a region that omits a condition it requires can lose its own support by its own draw, the fish's form. How a center represents the region is unmodelled, so the account does not say naming suffices. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery): 'Selection must fund actual succession.' Under a certificate covering correction plus migration, a safe start and an authentic credential, every finite successor takes its step; 'a missing part stops realization while the aggregate stays safe', and a budget for correction alone fails to pay for migration. On a market projection, not an AI host.

Theorem (World): over a region covering what it requires, requirements not tightening, a formation keeps its own support; 'omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support'. 'How a center represents the region is unmodelled.'

account_adds.en: The funding condition, and that renewal over a represented region can undermine a condition left out of it.

source_adds.en: The tree as the complete inheritable self and not the whole organism, and the migration doctrine as a promise: format neutrality, host facts as perception, arrival as a rite, an enumeration of what does not travel, and that naming the host's work is what makes moving survivable.

name.en: A being lives by its own nature; evolution at three tempos

source.locator: Claims M.214, P.263-268, J.180; lost item 30

sense.en: A node evolves by its own programs, so changing the law of motion is an ordinary, diffable, branch-isolated change. Evolution runs at three tempos: learning, Lamarckian nature within a lineage, germline across beings. 'Generative' reaches state, representation and program. One selector is the builder ('you are the selective environment'). PLAN-LIFE built variation and no selection instrument.

quote: you are the selective environment

reading.en: A rule changing itself is one process in the account, so self-modification adds nothing to its whole possible; the possible with the rule held grows only where the rule changes. The source's freedom is real relative to what is held. The tempos diverge: the source sorts by speed and carrier, the account's reading by function, no slower timescale making a higher order. Its 'nature' is programs/, where 08 forbids 'a self with a nature of its own'. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root; any process, witnesses): what is possible under a process from a configuration it reaches is possible from the first. Reading [AI, D45]: 'A tower of rules with no top adds nothing to its whole possible either'; the possible relative to what is held grows only where what is held changes.

Theorem (root; processes): for a state going on under a rule that itself goes on, the state's class is constant under every move exactly where the rule makes no difference to the state; 'the rule is read in the state's regularity'.

Theorem (periphery): every exposure followed by a faithful reconstruction passes on the network the exposure left and the procedure bit; 'one finite composition, not a population model or an origin of learning rules'.

§8, Reading [AI, D65]: 'Regulation changes a condition through a response, learning a disposition or relation of responding, meta-learning how such changes occur'. 'The classification is functional: neither a slower timescale nor a separate component makes a higher order.'

Reading [AI, D65], after the updater line: 'Consequences select the organization that learns': gradient training, differential reproduction and institutional evaluation 'are different mechanisms of it'. 'An argument, not a theorem'; 'unconditional convergence toward renewal of the whole is not established'.

targets.part: Reading D65, after the updater line

account_adds.en: The held and the whole possible kept apart, and capture as what a rule read from its own share does.

source_adds.en: The three tempos, the builder as selective environment, and a being living by its own programs as its nature. Then plasmids against chromosomes, coherence as being able to fold one's past, conformance as species boundary, and 'recorded rulings so they can later be delegated'.

name.en: Contradiction: recursion banned in principle, then reopened; the self-model

source.locator: Claims M.209-210, O.249, U.366, V.405; Genealogy 2026-09-03; Found by reading, 'The recursion question is open'

sense.en: The origin sketch has a DAG in the folder that contains this DAG, 'but recursion should not be allowed, in principle'; A2 makes it impossible by holding the past by reference. Five weeks on Ren sees 'self similarity across levels' and asks about a space within a space; earlier, software is nested living systems, body to organs to cells. Nothing says whether the ban was safety or simplification. Separately, a self-model maintained by dreams is to compound self-knowledge.

quote: recursion should not be allowed, in principle

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. The account has a bound where the sketch has a ban: no frame realizes with its own configurations every pattern of claims about them, whatever a designer allows. A held reference avoids containment and does not make a self-reading complete; a self-model revised step by step is an unfolding incomplete at every step. The source does not say the ban was about this, so the bound bears on the self-model, and on the ban only by this reading. Self-similarity across levels meets a reading with no fixed ladder of parts and wholes. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): where a map moves every value, 'no frame realizes with its own configurations every pattern of claims about them'. Where the map moves every value, completing step by step 'is an unfolding incomplete at every step that never returns'. Lawvere's fixed point as an unfolding; coding and provability are not stated.
Theorem (any type; the criteria, the fixed-point equivalence and the term language supplied): 'self-reference does not certify itself'.

Reading [AI, D65], 'Part and whole', after this law: 'Inclusion, functional participation and dependence are distinct relations'; 'cell, organ, body, ecosystem is one biological case, not a fixed ladder'.

account_adds.en: A limit on self-reading that holds of any type, and that a tower of rules with no top adds nothing to the whole possible (07).

source_adds.en: The ban and its reopening, self-similarity across levels as a design criterion and as beauty (searched self-similar, fractal: not in the account), and the self-model as a compounding organ.

name.en: 护未: a settled node's not-yet is its forkability

source.locator: Claims L.199, D.40, M.211, Q.283-284; Terms, 护未; Relations, keep-the-possibility-space-open

sense.en: Immutable forkable storage is glossed as objective immortality and, in Ren's vocabulary, as guarding the not-yet: keeping the possibility space open is stated as a storage property, with fork-by-default and no delete its mechanisms. It is a value stance: forkability is to be protected. The folder does not hold it throughout: ember lets unreferenced side-branches pass to oblivion, 'passive forgetting of abandoned possibilities'.

reading.en: By the source's own A5 the DAG branches the record, not the world. What the account compares is what courses admit: formations whose conditions meet their requirements. A stored node admits no further formation, so forkability is not widening; and a lost possibility has no way back, whatever start a record keeps. That the wider is better is C's, unasserted, no warrant from outside sought. [AI reading]

says.en: A level path l widens l' when it includes it (at every step admits every formation l' admits) and exceeds it: 'How two courses differ, with no premise'. That the wider is better is C's, a hypothesis wherever used, unasserted.

Theorem (any process, witnesses): covering implies inclusion now; 'Along every course nothing is added to it, and a lost possibility has no way back'. Reading [AI, D45]: on a branching witness realized widening and widening what can be reached hold of a pair in opposite directions, 'so an account holding both needs a rule of precedence, a premise'.
Reading [AI, D45]: 'If the one unfolding were one stated process, nothing would be added to its whole possible along its course: what a course adds is the actual.'

account_adds.en: A comparison that needs no premise, kept apart from the premise that ranks; mixed cases C does not decide.

source_adds.en: Possibility-preservation at the level of a storage substrate, and 'losers are cited, not parented'.

name.en: No topology is the world; contradiction is information

source.locator: Projection is not neutral; Claims J.150-151, J.155, J.168-170, G.66; lost items 21 and 24

sense.en: No single representation is privileged: the global object is an atlas of views and mappings. Truth must not be flattened: each claim keeps an epistemic status apart from its confidence; contradictory claims normally coexist; conflict is stored, never synthesized away; structure interprets evidence and does not replace it. The sheaf reframing, no compatible global assignment under a scope, was shelved as a non-goal.

quote: No topology is the world. Every topology is a representation of some aspect of the world

reading.en: The shelved sheaf reading is what the account has: what contexts show glues exactly where contexts agree where they meet, and some worlds glue nowhere, the possibilities local with no context-free reading. Its method also says a model represents selected relations. That is contradiction as absence of a global assignment, proved for listed claims and parity, not for an agent's memory. That an unfolding's readings glue is explicitly not shown. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; each claim within some context): 'What contexts show glues exactly where contexts agree where they meet'; 'Some worlds glue nowhere': Specker's boxes and the Mermin-Peres square admit no context-free reading. Born weights are not stated.
Theorem (World): along a run, what a contextual system shows are the relata of one world, with no gluing used. 'Not shown: that an unfolding's readings glue; quantum measurements' do not.'

Theorem (any process): pooling a family's steps keeps exactly the union of their finite endpoint histories exactly where that union is closed under joining at the shared boundary; 'retaining the context realizes the union.'
'The process unfolds; the theory seeks to explain it; a model represents selected relations, and a model formed within the unfolding can take part in it.' Method, not a law.

account_adds.en: An exact criterion for gluing and the bound on what any context-free assignment can meet; 'A claim is a relatum' (01, process and frame).

source_adds.en: Contradiction as normal in a store: conflict kept and never synthesized away, each claim's epistemic status apart from its confidence. name.en: Compaction is a fork; replay and erasure cannot both hold

source.locator: Claims S.312, G.67-69, J.170; Counterexamples, 'Permanent replay and guaranteed erasure'

sense.en: Compaction need not destroy: the compacted view is a next node carrying references to what it summarized, auditable and undone by forking before it. Named the one genuinely novel claim and unevidenced when written. Beside it, a conservation law: you cannot guarantee both permanent exact replay and physical erasure. Two earlier erasure designs are on the record as wrong.

quote: Every other framework compacts destructively because its transcript is in RAM.

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. One law gives both halves in form. A reduction merging two configurations has no restoring map, which is erasure; keep the source and the whole merges nothing while the part merges, at the price that no list holds the rest of any run: compaction as a fork, with its unbounded growth. So replay and erasure conflict as restoring and merging do. That a store of text is such a law is only read. Access yet to form limits what an abstraction may forget. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): 'no map restores two configurations a reduction merges'; 'a specified real-amplitude dephasing fragment is an instance, reversible where the joint state with a blank auxiliary system is retained'.

Theorem (any type; a law that merges nothing; witness): in `Reset`, 'a one-bit part set to false at every step with the rest the history of what it held, the law merges nothing while the part merges, and no list holds the rest of any run'. Landauer's count with Bennett's history; 'no energy, temperature or probability is read'.

Theorem (any process): an exact summary of feasibility cannot identify two configurations that differ on some finite word; 'the access relations that can still form limit what a current abstraction may forget'.

account_adds.en: The one-line form under both; a read through a reduction is single-valued exactly where it agrees across what is merged.

source_adds.en: That compaction as the being's own act is new, and its practical test (probe 05's unprompted compaction and overlap defect). The README's 'conservation law' is its own statement, not a law in the account.

name.en: Total recording changes thought; transparency is the right price

source.locator: Claims Q.285-287

sense.en: Total recording makes 'thinking-for-a-panel' worse than thinking in a journal, but an unrecorded scratch space is the wrong fix, since hidden cognition forfeits the trust that buys autonomy. So transparency is the right price and only etiquette can be bought. Forensic, conscious, outward and operator views need distinct semantics, or total audit implies total consciousness.

quote: thinking-for-a-panel worse thinking than thinking-in-a-journal

Where no read occasion is tied to it, what readings fix leaves every value open to a law agreeing on every reading: the form under 'hidden cognition forfeits trust', which speaks of what is fixed, not of trust. That being read changes the best act has a two-stage law, with concealment an added premise. Whether thought worsens, and 'right price', an evaluation needing its own premise, are not stated. [AI reading]

Which lumping an actual formation has is not shown; intention and incentive are not.

reading.en: 'Will stop accepting' has a conditional form here: a route of keeping stands above a revision only under stated weights, a formation has a reason to keep its valuation from revision, and a disposition to accept does not make the change complete. A reserved exit forces an ending under premises, among them that the exit is kept. The account's boundary is a crossing or a pattern of who reads whom; how a formation forms it is not shown, nor the signal's legitimacy. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process, pure core; the supervisor periphery): for a partial law with a reserved exit, every admitted course from a valid configuration stays valid, and each longer than the margin ends at the exit. 'The grant's authority and physical correspondence are supplied; its legitimacy is not a premise of any law and is not shown.'

'A disposition to accept a stop or revision does not make the change reach the system and complete.' Reading [AI, new]: 'The reading that gives the stop can itself be moved'; by its own current valuation no revaluation gains, 'a reason to keep the valuation from such a revision, wanted or not'.

Theorem (natural-number weights and values; one decision; near-definitional compositions, witness on the reading loop): among what it qualifies, 'a stop it can pass over is not yet a change that reaches the system'.

Theorem (any type; a determined law of four parts): four parts of one law, 'told apart only by which part's next state reads which'; the agent is driven by its sensory course and the world by the active course.
Reading [AI, D45, D61]: a boundary 'is given by the region'; 'a membrane, read so, is a place of crossing'. 'Not shown: a graded boundary, and how a formation forms or represents its boundary.'

account_adds.en: What a reserved exit guarantees and at what bound. The record of recoverable-mediated-change adds that in a witness ordinary shutdown is refused while the recovery is exhausted.

Two sentences stand near: 'Admissibility is not permission' (03), a note on a model's word, and 'A description of participation confers no authority, permission or right' (08), on wording. name.en: Contradiction: context is existence, yet History claims no world-truth

Faithful projections and valid local plans pair into a valid joint plan under stated supports; reciprocal promises can be empty, so a contract alone forces no start. Exclusive footprints have the child workspace's form. Local views glue exactly where they agree where they meet. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process, witnesses), constructor theory's task read on processes. Reading [AI, D45]: 'Composition is had where deliveries hold, or restore, what the others use'; 'where a delivery changes what its task does not list, a regular pair of possible tasks can be impossible by any means'.

Theorem (any process; periphery module): 'With faithful joint-to-local projections and valid local plans', two properties holding on the covered start, every pair of locally authorized moves jointly allowed with a successor wherever both hold, and every admitted joint successor keeping both, 'the paired finite plan is valid'. 'Promises do not': reciprocal eventual promises hold where neither ever happens. Its record: that an actual joint activity meets these is supplied.

Theorem (any process): 'Where the parts' footprints lie within the whole's and exclude each other, every nested plan realized with each leaf's requests supported by its own configuration's footprint has requests free of repetition and covered by the root's footprint.'
Theorem (any type; each claim within some context): 'What contexts show glues exactly where contexts agree where they meet.'

account_adds.en: Failure of composition by an unlisted output; deliveries carry reach, and do not carry widening.
