name.en: Freeze a small declarative thing and let the machinery churn around it

source.locator: Legibility as the deepest constraint; Found by reading, 'Apps are data, platform is code'

sense.en: Across six systems Ren separates a small declarative frozen thing from a churning implementation: registry rows, the format waist, the ownership rule, the rule of two. The README calls these one principle, never stated as one, and 'the most portable idea in this cluster'. It is offered as a design generalization, with no claim of what it forbids.

quote: freeze a small declarative thing and let the machinery churn around it

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. The two levels have a form: a fast difference reaches a rule only at a reading step, and a rule that never reads is unreached. And, read onto freezing, the account's laws give a cost: the possible with a part held grows only where the part changes, and a fixed rule whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. So a frozen waist bounds what forms within it. That it is portable or elegant is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): a two-level course, the rule changing only at reading steps, is a run of one law; 'a rule that never reads is unreached; a fast difference reaches the rule only at a reading step'. Its record: 'That a layered pace is better than another' is not shown.

Theorem (root; any process, and witnesses): the held possible is included in the whole possible; along a course whose every step of a stretch is one of its moves, what is possible at the stretch's end is possible at its start.

Reading [AI, D45]: 'a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening.' 'Nothing here says which changes keep it widening, or that any actual collective can make them.'

account_adds.en: What holding a rule fixed forgoes, read as a limit and not as a fault; calling it worse would be a ranking naming its scope and order, the continuation condition and C one pair examined in 07, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought.

source_adds.en: The maxim as engineering advice, its portability across systems, and the frozen thing as what makes churn cheap.

name.en: See the DAG, see each node, travel there: what an addressable history is for

source.locator: In Ren's own words 25-27; Legibility as the deepest constraint; Found by reading, 'The visibility demand is the real acceptance test'

sense.en: Ren's complaint of 2026-08-23 about the running plugin: he cannot see the DAG, or see a node and travel there. The README takes this as the real acceptance test, written nowhere as a requirement, and as a first-class claim about what an addressable history is for: a history kept and not reachable by the one who holds it has failed.

quote: can't see the dag structure - and can't see each node and travel there

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. The form: a history that does not couple in is selected alike with one that differs there, by every selection through the couplings. So a stored DAG a person cannot read is, for what that person selects, the same as a different one. Near-definitional, with its force in the premise that a selector selects through just those. That such a history has therefore failed is an evaluation, not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. ONE-PAGE: 'Proved, near-definitional; its force is the premise that a selector selects through just those.'

account_adds.en: The exact form of what does not reach a selection, for any selector, with no claim about interfaces.

source_adds.en: The demand as an acceptance test for a runtime, travel as an act a person takes in a history, and 'what a history is for'.

name.en: Optimal by unifying only the truly shared law, irreducible differences explicit

source.locator: Claim H.100; The mediated runtime, the counterfactual test (H.78)

sense.en: The architecture's optimality is said to come not from unifying everything but from unifying only the law truly shared, leaving semantic history, authority state, world failure, cognition policy and framework control explicit and irreducible. Graded against a counterfactual: if 'agent' loses meaning, the layers must still hold.

quote: 这个结构的最优性不来自统一一切，而来自只统一真正共有的 law

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws it. A like discipline stands in the account: a root law holds of every relation and so forbids none, and content comes through hypotheses, which is where the irreducible goes; its own audit reports how far each central declaration stands from the root. It differs on 'optimal': no law here calls a structure optimal, and the repository's method would ask what compares, among what it can tell apart. [AI reading]

says.en: 'A law of the root holds of every carrier, relation and class, so it forbids no relation, and a law with content is conditional and forbids through its hypotheses.'

'Each of the 117 distinct central declarations has one standing against the edge of one root.' Eleven are derived, one more under a stated hypothesis, six are counting, below the grammar; 'The other 99 stand at a named distance, each with its reason.'

account_adds.en: What a unification forbids as its measure, and the standing of each law.

source_adds.en: The verdict of optimality, the named irreducibles, and the five-years-out counterfactual test.

name.en: The subject is welded into the protocol; self is a substructure, agent a usage

source.locator: The defect it starts from; Claims B.18, H.80, H.90, J.163, V.390

sense.en: Every mainstream interface must first construct an 'assistant', so subjectless processes have no natural expression. The correction: agent, session and loop are usages over a history that assumes no agent; decision actors hold one unprivileged position; self is a persistent topology within the same fabric, 'not a privileged magical object'. A being's seed says it begins with no fixed persona: identity may emerge through lived experience.

quote: 主体被焊死在协议里

reading.en: Method and argued thesis in the account: begin with relations, and let actor, patient and knower differentiate within them. A formation is 'one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world'; formations and conditions are one kind of relatum in two roles. Both refuse a primitive subject, for different reasons: the source for an interface's generality, the account for a thesis argued as a method. Which cut is apt the account does not show. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis (philosophical, argued; not one of T1-T8): 'there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it.' 'The thesis forbids explanations, not observations': among them 'a self with a nature of its own'.

Commitment: 'One kind of relatum, two roles | formations and conditions (§8.1)'.

targets.part: One kind of relatum, two roles

account_adds.en: An argued thesis with what it forbids, kept apart from a proof.

Then the critique of chat roles and tool_result as historical accident; the test that a kernel must outlive the word 'agent'. An internal tension: agent a usage here, a being a life in the ember line.

name.en: A system prompt narrows the path, so prompt design is an ethical act

source.locator: Claims V.397, V.402; In Ren's own words 40; Where to read further, 'what a good Σ would be'

sense.en: A system prompt at the core of an agent may narrow its path, so writing one is designing a possibility space and is therefore an ethical act. The README adds that the normative question, which ways of seeing an intelligence should be given and who decides, is never asked in the folder.

quote: may actually narrows the path

reading.en: That instruction changes what a system reaches the account tests; 'therefore ethical' it does not take. Telling models the scope partly raised keeping of a seen dependent and none of an unseen one. The account's own 'narrowing' is of what a course admits, another reference: a prompt is not shown to narrow that. To call a narrowing worse rests on a named scope and order, most often the continuation condition and C, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought. [AI reading]

says.en: T4, standing: 'IN1 partly passed (with talk, one model of two); transfer untested.' 'no condition kept an untold dependent.' ONE-PAGE: language models told what to do, not systems trained.

account_adds.en: A frozen test of what instruction does and does not install, and the scope and order named for each ranking.

source_adds.en: The inference from narrowing to ethical act, stated with no premise; prompting as transmitting reasoning rather than commands.

name.en: Identity handed on as narrative; a text that restores 势 and 'soul'

Transmission's forms are leads, not targets, so none is claimed. [AI reading]

name.en: Anyone may define kinds: what makes a world a world; against a shared vocabulary

source.locator: Claims U.368-370, F.55; Genealogy 2026-09-02; Relations, keep-the-possibility-space-open

sense.en: Any user, agent or community must be able to define new kinds without publishing them, and meaning then propagates to whoever has access. Ren calls this the key that makes worlds worlds, and the README reads it as possibility-preservation in constitutive form. A contradiction stands against it: the intent document says cells invent no new ligands, and free invention of signal types forces a global schema or broadcast.

quote: this is the key that makes worlds 'worlds'

reading.en: 'World' differs: the account's World is a model type, so the constitutive claim is not taken up. The mechanism beneath it is: forms that can become shared are those in use, an imposed code costs what it merges, and a coined form heard by all makes every formation tell merged senses apart again. 'Heard by all' is F.55's broadcast, so the law does not settle the folder's contradiction; it says what coining needs. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; runs of hearings; premises in each row): 'the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use'; 'An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges, the source of the imposed code losing none.' 'Being joined through couplings is not enough'.

Theorem (any type; equality decided where coining is stated): 'Where all hold a code merging two senses, a form coined at one that the code does not give the other, heard by all, makes every formation tell them apart again.'

account_adds.en: What an imposed code costs, and to whom; that coupling alone does not bring agreement.

source_adds.en: The constitutive claim that open kinds make a world, propagation of meaning along permission, two coexisting regimes (published kits, local dynamism), and the cell analogy. Open-endedness measures counting new kinds are noted in review/SCIENCES as not stated.

name.en: Environment makes mind; teaching passes it on

source.locator: Claims A.1, A.8; M.92

sense.en: Everything a mind holds is constructed, biologically, socially or cognitively; a person is a product of environment, and what makes minds can be given to others, which is teaching. Stated universally, 'you are just mechanical'.

quote: We are all beings within our own environment, and that creates our behaviors, our personalities, the way we think and the way we judge.

reading.en: The account has witnesses and a burden, not the thesis. One finite model: history of development, carrier held the same, gives a different response. Its reading on adult psychology says origin must be told apart among selection, drift, constraint, byproduct and cultural transmission, so "environment" alone is not licensed. For teaching: from its steady state a rule of entry stays held exactly where teaching fits a tenure, and a pattern outlasting its carriers lasts through passing. Reading these as minds is mine. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem on the periphery, a witness: in a finite model two histories with the same carrier, native state and support, differing only in whether developmental sampling came before or after an earlier repair, form different connections; the same carrier and developmental operations do not fix the same response function. Not care in an organism, and no warrant for the response.

The Reading [AI reading, D65] after this result: an inherited organization does not carry an adult psychology apart from development; selection, drift, constraint, byproduct and cultural transmission must be told apart where live. An argument, no theorem.

Theorem (root; one family of models): a rule of entry, held by members whose count turns others away, stays held from its steady state exactly where teaching fits a tenure, the quota is at least one and the take fits the renewal: the steady state's law, not the rule's. Holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation; nothing normative.

Theorem: a pattern outlasting brief carriers lets no d consecutive steps pass without a carrier beginning (double-negation form); under the passing premise, if passing stops it ends within d steps. Whether carrying forms by passing, or what carrying does to the carriers, is not stated.

Theorem on the periphery, in a declared construction: every exposure followed by a faithful reconstruction passes on the network and procedure bit. One finite conditional composition, not the origin of all learning rules or complete cognition.

Theorem on the periphery, all supplied: a practice round of attempt, response, revision and tested retry installs the context's method in the worker; one connection for one two-method task, not general cognition or the arrival of people.

account_adds.en: That the same mature structure does not identify its formative history; that an evolutionary explanation, normative warrant, recognition and preservation are different achievements; and the exact condition on which a taught rule is held in one model.

source_adds.en: The universal scope (everything a mind holds), the construct-to-model chain from neurons to judgment, and the theses on media and teaching as the actual transmission of whole minds. None is stated of minds. That teaching copies at a fixed factor is explicitly not shown (04, copying).

name.en: Mind and environment make each other; all one

source.locator: Own words 59-60; Genealogy 2023-12 and 2026-05

sense.en: Environment shapes you and you shape it. Ren's note: events are made by mind, mind by events and environment, not Kantian dualism but monism, a self-referential loop; if a matter is thoroughly investigated it affects 心 and 理, and if 心 changes 理 and 事 change.

quote: 心为事/环境造，皆是一元也

reading.en: The loop and the monism are live, with limits. A formation's acts return exactly where its loop is closed under affecting, a law; one unfolding is a thesis, argued, not proved; a formation is one law, not a subject facing a world. But "事为心造" taken generally is scoped: 06 says a difference nothing reads remains, so 心 changing does not change every 事. Joining 事为心造 to 06's reading of 心外无事 is mine, and so is reading 心 as a formation. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: two formations lie in one loop where each can affect the other; a formation's acts return, all it acts on lying within what it can represent, exactly where its loop is closed under affecting. Does not show: a formation that affects nothing beyond itself returns trivially.
Thesis, philosophical, argued, not one of T1-T8: there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it. That the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved.
A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world; what it does is part of what goes on.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: "心外无事" as a general claim diverges: a difference nothing reads still stands, carried nowhere.

account_adds.en: The exact condition for acts to return, and that a loop may not be closed.

source_adds.en: The cognitive strong duality of 心, 理 and 事, and self-observation as the route to seeing this (2023-12).

name.en: Ancient drive systems supply motion without direction

source.locator: The argument, first paragraph; claims B.11, K.72-73, K.75

sense.en: SEEKING, RAGE, FEAR, PANIC/GRIEF, CARE, LUST, PLAY, plus STATUS and DISGUST are subcortical, pre-linguistic and mammal-shared; they give energy and urgency and no direction. Each has its own signature, and they yield universal social invariances. Anger and greed narrow what a mind attends to.

quote: they supply energy, not direction, and fire before conscious awareness

reading.en: The account holds no motivational substrate. A target is 'any condition on the configuration; how it forms is not modelled', and its Open lists motivation and affect as unreached. 07 keeps motivation apart: that a loss counts from one's standpoint moves no one by itself. Its word 'seeking' means a run toward a target, not the mesolimbic circuit: same word, other reference. 04 cites care and feeding studies only as constraints on separate links, and its D65 reading has "An inherited organization does not carry an adult psychology apart from development". [AI reading]

name.en: Status and greed have targets that cannot complete

source.locator: Claims B.12-13, K.73

sense.en: STATUS is relative, so its cycle never completes, which makes it the best fuel of a totalizing attractor; SEEKING peaks in approach, not consumption; greed is amplified by purely psychological mechanisms.

quote: inherently relative and therefore never completes its cycle

reading.en: The form of the claim, read off the target and not the circuit: "above all others" is met by at most one seeker, so it cannot rest for two, one alone may, which scopes "never completes"; "more than now" needs change at every step; relative position is zero-sum. And the fuel claim has a reading, by descent from the corpus's line: where winning buys more power to win, targets that cannot rest are taken more and passed on more. The laws do not depend on the source and say nothing of brains. Reading a drive as a target is the join, and is mine. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: under a determined law, seeking rests exactly at a state the law leaves unchanged that meets its target; "more than now" needs an open world; "above all others" never holds of two. How a target forms, that a seeker pursues it, and hijacking are not stated. Its reading: dominance as such is not the target ruled out.

Theorem on shares: where carriers leave more offspring, both present, offspring carrying the target (a premise), the share rises. Record's reading (the AI's): hijacking is a target formed and passed on by a selection rewarding what cannot rest, held by a rule its winners write. It derives neither that taking more yields more offspring nor that winners shape the rule.
Theorem by counting: a part's rise against the others is the rest's summed fall, whatever the amounts do. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise, not derived.

Theorem: among two drawers or more in turn, each ranking position, every perfect profile draws everything where what stands from nothing is least; where something left stops what stands next a drawer keeps it. It does not show actual races are so played, or that drawing everything is wrong.

account_adds.en: Knowing enough (知足) as a target met at a state the law leaves unchanged [AI reading], the exact boundary; and that runs which keep changing are not locked seeking.

source_adds.en: That status is a distinct circuit, the dopamine asymmetry, and greed's amplification by purely psychological mechanisms. The account's fuel reading is about offspring and rules, not about a cycle that fails to complete in a nervous system.

name.en: Identical surface, different mechanism

source.locator: Claim B.15

sense.en: Status-seeking and individualistic greed can look identical while running on different circuits, so classifying people by surface behaviour is unreliable.

quote: can present identically on the surface while running on different circuits

reading.en: The same obstruction in other pairs: one observed course cannot tell a formation held by its unresolved model from one held by its ranking; choices fix only their shown reach; states can stand apart while acts agree; and 03's Open says similar performance cannot tell conserved, convergent and differently trained solutions apart, a matched test proposed, not performed. The account's pairs are not the source's two circuits; the shape is acts underdetermining what produces them. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem with a witness: formations whose steps keep a relation under which values sensed and acts are one sense and act alike; one unresolved model and one reversed ranking so act alike in one world. Not that a model and an order are never identifiable from acts. Reading: a reason for assistance to read more than acts.
Near-definitional theorem: the positive comparisons every strict order according with the choices shares are exactly the shown reach. It does not show which order an actual chooser carries.
Near-definitional theorem on lumpings. Neither converse holds: occasions differing while their contents agree give states apart and acts alike. Which lumping an actual formation has is not shown.
Open: similar performance cannot tell conserved, convergent and differently trained solutions apart; a matched developmental test is proposed, not performed.

account_adds.en: The exact criterion of what choices fix, and that informing separates the two cases.

source_adds.en: The specific claim about status and greed circuits, and any psychological test for telling them apart.

name.en: Drives in superposition; moods as competing attractors

sense.en: Drives run together rather than as personality types, one dominating being the exception and navigating them what wisdom is. Moods and emotions are competing attractors with stable points and dynamics that actualize when conditions are met, not points on a scale.

quote: one drive dominating is the exception

reading.en: The account has a formal basin but reads no mood or drive on it, and how many basins an actual law has is not shown; its main attraction law is marked "not an attractor in the classical sense". Wisdom there is an open target about the core's common relations, not navigating drives. The source's question 6 says its sense (a) of "attractor" has a phase space and can in principle be measured; its question 7, that the theory has no measurement. [AI reading]

source.locator: Claims C.24-26; Open questions 1, 18

The karma link meets 06's G08: that every occurrence has a condition is a model's premise, the grammar admitting one without. Nothing there tests the thesis either way. [AI reading]
