name.en: The generative field that asks no sacrifice

source.locator: 'One last move'; own words 34; Terms

sense.en: Stated once: the dominant pattern should be a field providing all necessities without condition, as oxygen does. When it runs well any reason not destructive of the substrate may act, with care; when totalizing or collapsing, we fix it. 'This should be common sense.' The theory's exit, a hand-off and not an answer to Chalmers.

quote: imagine one that provides all necessities without condition

reading.en: Where the source says common sense, the account offers a way of seeing, binding no one, and ranks only where a result names its readings, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought. Provision has laws, though not against the source's phrase, which asks no sacrifice of the recipient: a continuing finite family cannot go unfed from beyond, and reasons each within what is given can together exceed it. A floor above trades does not follow from C. "Fix it" has no criterion until a ranking names its order and a commitment. [AI reading]

says.en: T8, argued: for life, the account's makers offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; it binds no one. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not.

Theorem in one constructed situation: the priority of basic conditions holds with C and living significance, which hold as well beside an order ranking gains above protection, so the priority does not follow from C; it separates the priority only from unit-step aggregation.

Theorem on the World: under balance and dissipation, a finite family enclosed from some step on and taken from or rising at arbitrarily late steps cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it.

Theorem on the World: formations each taking within what is given can together exceed it; with natural-number amounts joint excess cannot outlast what was held; where renewers depend on what they renew at a need of at least `m`, `n` consecutive steps of it from a level below `n + m` end the renewal and those depending at such a need.

account_adds.en: What feeding from beyond needs, that non-destruction is a joint and not a single quantity, and that per-step growth, capacity and maximization are different things.

source_adds.en: The image of unconditional provision and freedom of any non-destructive reason. Whether it is a claim or an image is unclear, and the source says it was never developed.

name.en: Is the framework itself a basin?

source.locator: 'A third'; Open question 2

sense.en: Naming the mechanisms may be another explanatory capture, a framework that explains everything becoming its own totalizing basin. Posed by Claude, unanswered by Ren; this theory has more exposure than any other, since its subject is what an explanation does to a mind.

quote: where having a framework that explains everything becomes its own totalizing basin

reading.en: The charge is against the account's own form, and is kept as a test. A root law forbids no relation; content comes through hypotheses. The thesis of one unfolding excludes no observation, and as a language nothing defeats it. So at the root the charge's premise is conceded, and moved to what hypotheses forbid. No check inside shows the work serves its purpose. 07 says that without substantive disagreement with no closure, "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples. Whether the account is a basin is not settled by saying so. [AI reading]

says.en: A law of the root holds of every carrier, relation and class, so it forbids no relation, and a law with content is conditional and forbids through its hypotheses.
By this section's measure the thesis has no strength: it excludes no observation; it forbids explanations, and is argued.
As a language, nothing defeats it; as a thesis, an argument that a determination is carried by no relation, and two such arguments are live.

What the checks reach: the work's selectors are the Lean checker, the completion and record checks and the AI reviews; human readers and trained systems couple into none of them, so no check run inside the work can show that the work serves what it is for.

Reading [D65] after these laws: locked seeking is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, not from a firm judgment, a stable goal or a disagreement, so the label cannot immunize.

Reading [AI reading, D65], in §6: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure (objections excluded before assessment, standards selectively exempted), real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples.

account_adds.en: A stated route of testing: readers, frozen tests, refuters that can be met.

source_adds.en: The specific worry about what explanation does to the explainer's mind; 'covert self-totalization' as a red team's phrase is not in the live text.

name.en: 短剧 and short-form video: deep narrow and shallow wide

source.locator: Claims F.44-48; Open question 7

sense.en: Chinese 短剧 defers resolution across a paywall, relational in its engine; Western short video has the scroll as attractor, individualist in its engine. name.en: Institutions and ritual as drive technology

source.locator: Claims D.31, K.74; Open question 13

sense.en: Institutions are externalized drive regulation; cultures differ in gain on the same hardware; ritual entrains autonomic states, for compassion and hostility alike. Pre-Qin and Confucian thought has the highest engineering utility. The source says which mechanism acts on which drive is unwritten.

quote: Which Confucian mechanisms, acting on which drives?

reading.en: 06 reads the pre-Qin texts on the spine, on relations and not drives: 礼 in 度量分界, the limit placed between desire and things; 戴震's 以理杀人 as one standpoint's model applied where others' differences do not couple in. A rule kept by teaching has one model, nothing about compliance. 05 reads kept promises and enforced contracts as laws giving first, conflict institutions as links of another kind: institutions as regulation, on loops. 07 reads the imperial examination as a counter-rule that became a proxy trap, as read in the meta-attractor line: by descent. So the question is reframed, in part answered in kind. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading: 荀子 "求而无度量分界，则不能不争" and "两者相持而长" fit joint excess and its converse, the limit placed in the relation of desire and things; 戴震 "以理杀人" is one standpoint's model applied where others' differences do not couple in, and pooling the affected couplings fills that blindness.

Reading [AI reading, D54]: the forming of concern has several entrances, to be tested side by side; that a rule can be revised and what reaches the rule are two things; counterexamples using the same words must enter the account.

Theorem (root; one family of models): a rule of entry, held by members whose count turns others away, stays held exactly where teaching fits a tenure, the quota is at least one and the take fits the renewal. One minimal model; nothing about compliance, nothing normative.

Reading [AI reading, D68] in §6: a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects locks as the rule it replaced did; the reading counts the imperial examination as this case; the meta-attractor line says that, designed to dilute hereditary capture, it later became a proxy trap, and its fit to these premises is read, not tested.

Reading [AI reading, D48]: kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone. An exchange of harms is a loop, so conflict institutions are links of another kind. On loops, not drives.

Assessment: 248 passages of nine parts of Chinese thought set against the spine as agreement, scope or divergence; the relational start holds across lines, universals mostly need scoping, four non-relational layers recur; no new Lean; the classes are AI readings.

account_adds.en: An explicit share of divergence by school, a count of what the grammar cannot express (修 and 心理 among them), and an exact condition for one kind of taught rule.

source_adds.en: Which of 礼, 正名, 教化, 修身 acts on which drive; gain parameters; ritual as autonomic technology; 外儒内法; and that this tradition has the highest engineering utility, a comparison the account does not make.

name.en: What can make sense in a collective is formed

source.locator: Claim M.92; own words 70-71

sense.en: Growing up in abundance or scarcity, struggle or peace, makes differences down to which discourse and perspectives can be understood in a collective: the environment-makes-mind thesis extended to the standard of sense. Read as formation, not national character.

quote: down to which discourse and which perspectives can make sense in a collective

reading.en: The account has laws of a shared code: hearing makes no form, the forms that can become shared are those in use, an imposed code costs each formation exactly the distinctions it merges, and a merged distinction returns only from outside or by coining. That is what can be said in a collective, under supplied hearing rules. No law ties it to scarcity or struggle. A neighbour, not a divergence: the free-energy row forbids shared narratives as a guarantee of shared goals, which is about goals, not sense. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: hearing makes no form; the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use; an imposed code makes all agree, each formation losing exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges; a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining. Not that actual conventions form by hearing so.

Row: shared generative models give the shared narratives from which shared goals emerge (Friston, Ramstead and others 2024), read as a guarantee, is forbidden for preferences over one's own store, by a witness: holders of one model, each by least risk, can end the renewal they share.

account_adds.en: That imposition's loss falls on all but its source, stated exactly.

source_adds.en: Material conditions as the cause of the difference, and the perspectives a culture can understand rather than forms it holds.

name.en: Ego as generalized territorial drive

source.locator: Claim B.16; own words 25-27

sense.en: The ego is the innermost extension of the territorial drive: space, possession, social position, identity, then what reality should be. 'Personal boundaries' is territorial instinct in neutral words; insecurity is the signature of a defended model. Ren asks whether the brain evolved so.

quote: The ego is the innate territorial drive generalized

reading.en: The account's boundary is a region drawn on a course, and "how a center represents the region is unmodelled": it says what a boundary omits, not why one is defended. 01 calls a boundary short of the whole real, relative to its relation, and no further thing beside what it delimits; no instinct is named. "One's own" is a region along a relation no law of the dynamics fixes, read for what concern reaches, not what is guarded. 06 says possession is unrepresented on the spine, 只是未表示，不是相合. So the gradient has no home, and neither does insecurity. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The gradient, the evolutionary conjecture, and the reading of insecurity. Held only in one conversation and a lost artifact.

name.en: Theory of mind is direction-neutral

source.locator: Claim M.91 (the assistant's reading of a spoken passage)

sense.en: The same faculty of modelling another's mind grounds both 己所不欲，勿施于人 and the strategic tradition of 法家 and 孙子; the game decides its use.

quote: the faculty is direction-neutral and the game decides its use

reading.en: The form exists in one decision. A holding formation, with its own model, can inform a reading formation or revise its valuation: by the reader's own valuation on a shared model, no reason against informing; under a reference the valuation does not share, possible incentives to withhold and to revise. So the same reach is used by what it is read against, the source's "game". Knowing another's law is no coupling, and 06 has skilled control that can still lack 仁. The join to 己所不欲 is mine. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, new]: evaluating by the reading formation's own current valuation, with a shared model, none against informing; under a reference the valuation does not share, read as incentives to withhold and to revise, in counts, before costs, with no choice among them represented.

Theorem: a formation coupled by level into everything another couples into selects through at least their pooled coupling. Knowing another's law is no coupling; what another's law does under histories not taken is a model; reading a system does not close what one's own act does beyond one's closure.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 高明的控制仍可能不仁: selection reaches only what couples in, however exact the response within the closure.

account_adds.en: A criterion for one decision of when withholding or revising could gain, and that this is a counterpart of Bayesian persuasion, no equilibrium represented.

source_adds.en: The faculty as such, the golden rule and 法家 and 孙子 as its two uses, and which game does which. Social understanding stands in 03's Open. The source marks this as the assistant's reading.

source.locator: Genealogy, 'What earlier versions had', item v; Open question 10

Third: the continuation condition, for scope, counts every continuation; the star prefers specific others. 06 asks the same of 亲亲: nesting of closures is real, a ranking of significance by it is no theorem. name.en: Local reasoning is the scaling unit

source.locator: Core claims, claim 1; Exchange 2

sense.en: Design direction, from Ren's framing: an agent works from its own module, its parent's requirements, the exposed contracts of neighbours and common architectural rules, and this locality is what lets the swarm scale, independently of any present harness. Locality is meant as the information and obligations a maintainer needs, not directory structure.

quote: Local reasoning is the scaling unit.

reading.en: The premise has an exact form: what a formation selects by is what couples in, and across a blanket each side's course is fixed by its start and the blanket's. Reading neighbour contracts as couplings is a modelling step no one has taken. The account then bounds it: a blanket forbids nothing by existing; some joint facts go only through a pool; joined through neighbours does not give agreement. That such locality suffices, or scales, it does not say. Proposed here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them; the same for a group's pooled coupling. Near-definitional: its force lies in what actually couples in. In the witness Clearing, that both are admitted goes through their pooled coupling, not either alone.

Theorem (a determined law of four parts told apart by which reads which): courses alike on the sensory part have one internal and one active course, and each side's course is fixed by its start and the blanket's, the deterministic case of the time-unrolled blanket.

Theorem (World for the join; couplings supplied; any model, policy and environment): where couplings give the values of what couples in, any model so fed is the agent of a blanketed law. The law is a construction, not a test: wherever the couplings give the values it exists, and having it forbids nothing of the formation's course.

Being joined through couplings is not enough: on a path a – c – b, each following the least-indexed of itself and its neighbours, a and b never agree. A rule of copying a code; how long agreement takes is not stated.

targets.part: the path a – c – b: being joined through couplings is not enough

account_adds.en: What only a pool reaches, that joining through neighbours does not by itself give agreement, and that having a boundary forbids nothing.

source_adds.en: That such locality suffices to organize a swarm and is what makes it scale, independently of any harness, and locality defined by what a maintainer needs.

name.en: Local work composes only where the boundary is sufficient

source.locator: Core claims, claim 2; Responsibilities and contracts

sense.en: Conditional mechanism: each parent must supply what its children assume and show that their guarantees plus its coordination fulfil its own contract, recursively. Common prompts cannot substitute for missing dependencies or contradictory requirements. A child can report infeasibility upward.

quote: Local work composes when the boundary supplies sufficient information.

reading.en: The account has this conditional form, and recursively. Joint plans compose given projection and compatibility, compatibility is also necessary, and two local proofs linked do not supply it, the parent's obligation in another form; the supported-start obligations are rely-guarantee in style, the source's assume-guarantee family; finite trees of joinings lift. The condition reads moves usable at every branch, not how much a boundary says. Applications must establish the premises; correspondence to software contracts is unshown. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process): where every joint step projects onto a step of each part, the joint class lies over classes the parts' plans keep, and the plans are compatible, the zipped joint plan keeps both guards; conversely every joint plan keeping a guard is compatible. Applications must establish projection and compatibility; two local proofs linked together do not supply them.

Theorem (any process; periphery): with faithful projections, valid local plans, two properties holding on the covered start, every pair of locally authorized moves jointly allowed with a successor wherever both hold, and every admitted joint successor keeping both, the paired finite plan is valid. That an actual joint activity meets these is supplied, not shown.

Theorem (any process): a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame; where it lifts, every finite tree of joinings lifts with its own leaves. No shared nodes, cycles or copying of resources; nothing of actual scheduling.

account_adds.en: The converse (a joint plan keeping a guard is compatible), the separate obligation of availability, and that finite trees are covered only without shared nodes or cycles, which is where the source's strict-tree question begins.

source_adds.en: That sufficiency is information a boundary supplies, which the account's condition does not read. Then what a contract must contain (units, effects, failure, progress, resources), a parent as the one who establishes composition, feasibility findings moving upward, and that shared prompts cannot supply missing facts.

name.en: Replace a subtree behind the promises its consumers read

source.locator: Exchange 2, Assistant, closing paragraph; DECISIONS working direction 2; ARCHITECTURE section 1

sense.en: The assistant's strongest design test, in a direction Ren aligned with: any subtree can be replaced by an implementation satisfying the same contract, everything outside staying correct with respect to the specified requirements. The later plan sharpens it: an API name is too coarse a dependency, and a consumer names the particular promises it uses.

quote: Can I replace any subtree with a different implementation satisfying the same contract

reading.en: A consumer reading through parts has this form: a replacement evaluates alike under every consumer exactly where it supplies the ground at each position read. Stated for supplied readings and a typed-term language; contracts as positions is my step, and the law asks more than a contract, which lets behaviour differ within its promise. Case by case is the nearer form: equal success need not fulfil an undertaking. The root limits 'any': lifting does not substitute designated parts. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery; a supplied finite typed-term language; Quot.sound in nine cited declarations): where every consumer reads through parts and each position is read directly by some consumer, a replacement evaluates alike under every consumer exactly where it supplies the ground at each position. Denotational equality is not identity of reference or history. For one consumer the criterion is shown sufficient, not necessary.

targets.part: the criterion, consumers reading through parts

says.en: Theorem (any type; finite listed cases, natural weights): with equality of cases decided, one claim's mass is at most another's under every natural weight exactly when every listed case realizing the first realizes the second. Equal success under one law need not fulfil an undertaking case by case, and weights are not importance.
Lifting gives some parts described alike, not the substitution of designated parts or the duplication of support.
Existence of a witnessed plan does not make arbitrary designated parts composable.

account_adds.en: That the criterion is exact only where each position is read by some consumer, since a consumer that ignores a position does not test it, and that an event-level definition does not ensure timely implementation.

source_adds.en: The design test itself: any subtree replaced with everything outside correct with respect to specified requirements, which is weaker than evaluating alike. Then promises named per consumer as a dependency record.

name.en: Plausible local promises can fail jointly

source.locator: Counterexamples and limits retained from the discussion

sense.en: Retained counterexamples: local latency promises do not imply a system deadline unless a parent accounts for the composition, and children that each wait for the other can deadlock despite plausible interfaces, so progress needs its own argument.

quote: Children that each wait for the other can deadlock despite plausible interfaces.

reading.en: The source's closest match. Two locally fine plans fail jointly on one shared reserve; reciprocal promises can be empty; preservation does not give availability; a circular dependence can be a wait no one can begin; waiting relations have exact laws. Same mechanism, on stated models, for the deadlock half. The latency half fits only with a deadline read as a stock, my step: each within its own count can jointly exceed. [AI reading]

says.en: Two locally successful two-step plans on one two-unit reserve fail at the second joint step (periphery, propext and Quot.sound reported), and serialization without renewal does not repair it.

Theorem (periphery): 'if the other eventually does, I eventually do' holds on both sides where neither ever happens; a law with no successors keeps every property vacuously; in the exchange witness one circular dependence can be maintenance running or a wait no one can begin.

targets.part: reciprocal promises can be empty; preservation without availability

says.en: Theorem (any formations, any relation of waiting): with memory, one withholding, where every formation lies within d waits of it, ends all giving from step d on; under both laws more waiting gives no more at any step. In a ring of three, with memory all withhold from step 2, and a source giving first brings all to give from step 3. It does not show how waiting forms.

Theorem (World: balance): formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more. Near-definitional arithmetic over natural numbers, restating the commons and overshoot; not who ought to take less.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions under which a circular wait starts or never starts, a source giving first as what breaks it, and that serializing does not repair an unrenewed shared reserve.

source_adds.en: Time as such and a deadline allocated through a composition, and the design answer, a parent accounting for the actual composition.

name.en: A dependency left off the diagram is still a dependency

source.locator: Counterexamples and limits retained from the discussion; ARCHITECTURE section 1

sense.en: Declared boundaries do not make actual dependence disappear: a shared store reached outside them binds the modules anyway. The later plan adds that runtime mediation constrains observable access but cannot establish a concept was completely specified, and that an observed undeclared dependency becomes a repair obligation.

quote: A shared database accessed outside declared boundaries is a dependency even when omitted from the diagram.

reading.en: The account's general reading has this form: what a drawn boundary leaves out still takes part. Its law separates a represented region from actual dependence: a draw over a region omitting a required condition can lose its own support; that concerns draws on a flow, and a database read consumes nothing, so the match is to omission. Closer: a writer outside the interface leaves the public view identical, and states alike under every old observation are told apart by a new probe. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D45, D61]: what a drawn boundary leaves out still takes part in the unfolding; a formation renewing over a region that omits a condition it requires can lose its own support through its own draw. Not shown: a graded boundary, and how a formation forms or represents its boundary.

targets.part: Reading D45, D61: what a drawn boundary leaves out still takes part

says.en: Theorem (World): over a region covering what it requires, requirements not tightening, a formation keeps its own support and can still undermine another; omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support. The witnesses are minimal and stipulated; how a center represents the region is unmodelled.

Instance (periphery): finite histories of lawful reads and committed bounded overwrite programs keep actual coverage; an extra write path can leave the public view identical, so logs cannot establish mediation. That the runtime is completely mediated is supplied, not shown.

Theorem (periphery: pre-spine; route fixed, operations and permissions supplied): states alike under every old observation and in their active view can be told apart by a newly admitted probe. Which supports will be permitted next is not shown.

account_adds.en: That a sufficient region for oneself still leaves others undermined, and that a record-only acceptance cannot exclude an extra writer.

source_adds.en: Detection and repair of the hidden dependency by traces and consumer declarations, and treating an observed one as an obligation; the account leaves how a center represents its region unmodelled.

name.en: Can a contract summarize enough without becoming the whole program?

source.locator: Questions, 2; Proposed tightening

sense.en: A parent reasons from a child's exposed contract as the summary of its subtree. The folder's assessment names the main gap: finding and keeping compact, sufficient boundaries through unforeseen changes, or complexity just moves into the contracts or a central coordinator. Stated as an open question, not a result.

quote: Can contracts carry enough meaning without becoming the whole program?

reading.en: A contract as a reduction has an exact criterion: a law on reduced values carries every step exactly where moves keep merged configurations merged; a summary carries futures exactly where what it merges has the same futures. Witnesses limit it: every local state kept while a relation changes, the sufficient summary omitting others, so wider operations need renewed validation; two trees alike in parent summary differ in what a cut returns. Whether a compact one exists or stays compact is untouched. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any deterministic law; the quantum case a witness): some determined law on the reduced values carries every step exactly where configurations the reduction merges are taken by each move to configurations it merges. In a stated two-qubit fragment a relation can change while every local state stays. No minimal summary is shown; the sufficient summary still omits other relations, so enlarged operation scope requires renewed validation.

Theorem (any process): read through a summary, a law takes from each configuration's summary exactly the words that configuration can take exactly where the configurations the summary merges have the same futures. Only the feasibility of finite words is carried: no endpoint, branch identity, probability or policy.

Theorem (any process): where configurations a description identifies match parts and the leaves are read correctly through it, a finite plan is realized at a description exactly where it is realized at each configuration so described.

Theorem (periphery; two grown eight-member trees, a model, not a measured organism): matched in composition and parent summary (counts of kinds, bonds and used material), they differ in what single-edge cuts return; no function of the parent summary gives both mean returns, and a retaining edge can prevent fragmentation.

account_adds.en: An exact criterion for a sufficient description relative to given moves, plans or readings, and witnesses of what a sufficient one still omits.

source_adds.en: The question that matters to it: growth of the summaries over time, whether complexity moves to a central coordinator, and a mechanism that discovers and revises boundaries under change. None is stated.

name.en: Neighbour-only discovery does not find the globally best

source.locator: Discovery and generation

sense.en: A module requests a capability through its parent and a hierarchical directory routes searches through advertised summaries. Summaries can be stale or incomplete, a semantic match only retrieves a candidate, and compatibility still has to be checked.

quote: neighbor-only discovery does not guarantee finding the globally best implementation without broader search

reading.en: A local search rests exactly where no neighbour is rewarded more, so a narrower neighbourhood adds rests: the source's limit, with 'best' read by the reward. That law is of moves climbing a reward; the source's directory routes a query, so the match is to the limit, not the mechanism. Stale and incomplete summaries have closer forms: an accurate report goes stale after a rearrangement, an old view cannot rebuild an updated one unread, an inadequate catalogue leaves ambiguity. Proposed here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): a local search rests where no neighbour is rewarded more, so a narrower neighbourhood's added rests are its implicit bias. The laws say where any neighbourhood rests, not which a given system has, which is read empirically.

targets.part: among settled laws: a local search rests where no neighbour is rewarded more

says.en: Periphery (propext, Quot.sound): after a supplied rearrangement an access report accurate when made can be stale and change the next choice; surveying again revises it, keeping the earlier reports. Counterexamples: an inadequate catalogue leaves ambiguity; a wrong unique binding can meet the stopping rule.

Theorem (periphery: pre-spine; route fixed, operations and permissions supplied): an old view with the destination cannot rebuild the updated view without a fresh reading. Obtaining a trustworthy reading atomically is a separate implementation.

account_adds.en: That the added rests of a narrower neighbourhood are a bias of the search, exact relative to a reward, and not a failure of it.

source_adds.en: The discovery design, broader search as the remedy, and the distinction between a retrieval match and checked compatibility, which only the stopping witness touches.

name.en: Unrelated growth has small marginal cost; three kinds of scale are separate

source.locator: Core claims, claim 6; soundness assessment table

sense.en: A prediction to test: interaction cost follows active dependencies and change effort follows affected contracts, not installed apps. No constant-cost guarantee for active workloads or shared invariants. Dormant catalog, concurrent agents and accumulated semantic dependence scale differently, and the third is called the largest unanswered question.

quote: Unrelated growth can have a small marginal cost.

reading.en: The account has no law of cost in change effort, attention or computation as a system grows. Its nearest forms are non-interference and reach, not cost: what does not couple in makes no difference to a selection, exchanges with disjoint footprints commute, and around loops of couplings acting at every step the most difference that can arrive grows exponentially. Dormancy there runs down a reserve, another mechanism. The prediction was not run and the account does not test it. Not a defect: an engineering hypothesis. [AI reading]

searched: live account: dormant, latency, throughput, concurren, commut, cost of change, coordination cost, communication cost, overhead, modularity, near-decompos, scalab, scal(es|ing) with, marginal, effort, entrench, lock-in

name.en: Reserved resources and attributed cost keep growth local

source.locator: Common runtime and limits

sense.en: Performance under growth needs active design: lazy activation, narrow subscriptions, reserved resources and cost attributed to module versions; maintenance needs owners, budgets and bounded dependencies. A thousand dormant apps and a thousand active simulations are different workloads.

quote: Performance requires lazy activation, cached artifacts, bounded queues, narrow subscriptions, reserved resources, and attribution of cost to module versions.

reading.en: Only the reservation has a form here, nested as the source's tree is: parts' footprints within their whole's and apart keep leaf requests covered by the root's, and the joint draw within capacity; without a division each can stay within its own count and jointly exceed. On a balanced flow, not shown of an actual division; and support by the root's footprint does not give a realization of the plan. Proposed here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World: balance): where takes are what leaves of a realized joint plan draw, footprints within their whole's and apart and the root's within what is given, the joint draw is within what is given; with such a division at every step the level never falls below its start. Not shown: that an actual division is so, or that the level rises.

Theorem (any process): where the parts' footprints lie within the whole's and exclude each other, every nested plan realized with each leaf's requests supported by its own configuration's footprint has requests free of repetition and covered by the root's footprint. Support by the root's footprint does not give a realization of the plan.

Theorem (World: balance; for the ending also activity needing support and only active giving, with the gate local): formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more. Near-definitional arithmetic restating the commons and overshoot, not who ought to take less.

account_adds.en: The exact reason a partition protects a shared stock, with the balance premise named.

source_adds.en: That performance under growth needs this active design, and that reservation keeps growth local: not stated. Then lazy activation, queues, subscriptions, attribution of cost and all the performance engineering.

name.en: A fork of an interface must not copy what is shared

source.locator: Three demanding worlds; README Several structures; ARCHITECTURE section 5

sense.en: An assistant proposal: definitions, running instances and authoritative records have different identities. A view can fork while its records stay shared, shared code does not imply shared mutable state, and a forked interface should not multiply entitlements such as achievements or assets.

quote: interface forks do not accidentally duplicate shared entitlements

reading.en: The account separates describing alike from copying support: lifted parts are described alike and do not duplicate support, requests within exclusive footprints are free of repetition, a tree of joinings does not show a resource can be copied, and in one protocol duplicate votes fail while a fork keeps its source. Reading entitlements as footprints is my step; none speaks of interfaces, and a shared record that is read is not drawn down. Proposed here. [AI reading]

says.en: Lifting gives some parts described alike, not the substitution of designated parts or the duplication of support.

Theorem (any process): where the parts' footprints lie within the whole's and exclude each other, every nested plan realized with each leaf's requests supported has requests free of repetition and covered by the root's footprint.

Theorem (any process): where a description lifts a joining, every finite tree of joinings lifts with its own leaves. No shared nodes or cycles; realizing a tree of joinings does not show that a resource can be copied.
In one declared history: a fork keeps its source as one branch and hands off the other, and a position can be present on both; duplicate votes fail where two votes over fourteen days pass.

account_adds.en: That being read alike and being supported are separate obligations, and a position present on both branches of a fork.

source_adds.en: The design distinction of definition, instance and authoritative state, and shared records beneath alternative views.

name.en: New features create options before obligations

source.locator: Starting position; Exchange 4, the product rule

sense.en: From the AI-drafted statement of the direction agreed in the conversation, a working commitment: growth should add useful possibilities without imposing runtime cost, maintenance burden or design preferences on every member, so a new feature should usually be something members can take up, binding no one else.

quote: New features should usually create options before creating obligations for everyone.

reading.en: The collective-direction page calls the form a local test: a part's added options widen the whole exactly within others' margins; past one the comparison is mixed and unordered. It locates the boundary and predicts no behaviour. Obligation has its own home, conditionally: an empty plan set generates no duty. The source states an undertaking; if expressed as a ranking, its holder, scope and order must be named, neither the condition nor C asserted, no warrant from outside sought. Draws are not software burden. Proposed here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided): where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region (its options) against the levels without its exchange, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside it, and is mixed exactly when it goes beyond for one; with a need met exactly, any net draw on that condition makes it mixed. Mixed is not ordered.

Conditional (living significance; J1–J4 and correspondence E; none asserted; an argument with checked consequences): responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited; an empty plan set generates no duty, and a contribution is indispensable only where every admissible allocation requires it.

targets.part: an empty plan set generates no duty

account_adds.en: The exact edge at which an addition stops being a widening of the whole, that no ordering holds past it without a further premise, and when a contribution is indispensable.

source_adds.en: The product default itself, and the claim that software's maintenance burden can in practice be kept off non-users.

name.en: Changes have audiences: personal, group, community

source.locator: Core claims, claim 5; Change and adoption; RESEARCH-AGENDA question 5

sense.en: Value stance and product direction: adoption is scoped. Different views can share authoritative records, without assuming every preference can coexist; a shared commitment requires the relevant community decision; a forked view does not silently change an official outcome.

quote: Changes have audiences.

reading.en: Formal shapes match in part: a rule's change located at a gated adoption, with two participants enabling a technical integration while governance revision fails; agreement kept in a group through hearings closed for it; an imposed code costing others its merged distinctions, its source nothing. Views over one record have a local-to-global form: what contexts show glues exactly where they agree where they meet, and some local possibilities are parts of no whole. Views as contexts, records as their overlap, is my step. Proposed here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process): a course that changes a gated quantity passes the gate. In a declared rule protocol only adoption is gated and every change of rule is located at an adoption using a recorded proposal; with two continuing participants a technical integration is enabled while revising the governance fails. Supplied: seed mandate, proposal content, participation, compliance; the higher amendment procedure is fixed.

Theorem (any type; further premises named): a group agreeing at a sense keeps agreeing through every hearing closed for it. An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that it merges, the source losing none. Not shown: that actual conventions form this way, or whether a code keeps or closes for 生生, the continuation of life.

targets.part: an imposed code; agreement kept through closed hearings

says.en: Theorem (any type; each claim within some context): what contexts show glues exactly where contexts agree where they meet. Some worlds glue nowhere: in Specker's three boxes and the Mermin–Peres square the possibilities are local and admit no context-free reading, so they are the parts of no whole. Only possibilities are stated; general sheaf theory is not.

account_adds.en: That a rule's change has an exact location in a history, that no function of the counts gives the technical decision in two histories of that protocol, and that local views can fail to glue with every context consistent.

source_adds.en: Audience as a design axis, identifying a request's audience, and a personal change needing no agreement. No law states versions adopted per audience over shared records as such.

name.en: Owners and delegated authority taken as given

source.locator: The user experience; also ARCHITECTURE sections 3 and 5; PLAN Decisions to make

sense.en: An assistant proposal: every module has a responsible owner, members adopt within their authority, shared commitments follow delegated authority, and communities retain control of them. The folder keeps the mechanism for representing authority apart from any governance policy, as data with a test policy, and leaves rules undecided; what delegation settles is taken as given.

quote: A change to a shared commitment follows the authority already delegated by the community

reading.en: What is carried: without a unique answer a legitimate shared procedure decides, and among symmetric parties only an asymmetry or a procedure differentiates. The account holds that under premises, J4 and correspondence for authority, no warrant from outside sought, with the mandate supplied in its protocol. The source takes delegated authority as its working term, though it too leaves who may decide open, so the divergence is narrow. 'Owner' would need naming as the relation meant, who maintains. This does not say the design is wrong. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional (living significance; J1–J4; correspondence E for actual classifications, valid undertakings, feasibility and authority; none asserted): responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited; without a unique answer a legitimate shared procedure decides and keeps residual responsibilities.

targets.part: without a unique answer a legitimate shared procedure decides

says.en: Theorem (two roles; periphery, empty axiom reports): a predicate on two roles invariant under their swap cannot hold of exactly one, while each single assignment fits a task needing exactly one: among exactly symmetric parties, who contributes is differentiated only by an actual asymmetry or a procedure the parties form; the laws single out none.

Wording names the relation it means: the formation and change of conditions, dependence, participation in decisions. It keeps money, payment and ownership for actual economic relations. A description of participation confers no authority, permission or right. Responsibility needs its own argument.

In the declared protocol: seed mandate, recognition and copying capacity, proposal content, participation and procedural compliance are supplied; the higher amendment procedure is fixed. The origin of the highest authority does not follow.

Conditional (the condition, for scope, through living significance; C, for order, with J1–J4; correspondence and improvement witnesses; none asserted): under these premises it can warrant building shared capacity without fixing one carrier. It does not establish compliance or derive institutional authority.

account_adds.en: A demand that wording not confer standing, authority named as a premise wherever a law uses it, and an obstruction among symmetric parties.

source_adds.en: A working use of authority in adoption decisions, a responsible owner for every module, and what to do when delegated authority does not settle a question: ask for a domain decision.

name.en: One name, two meanings: attendance

source.locator: Counterexamples and limits; ARCHITECTURE Worked architectural revision

sense.en: Matching types do not establish matching meaning. In the worked case one event name conflates observed check-ins and qualification under a policy, and separating them forces downstream changes to badges, eligibility and rewards. An unchanged signature does not count as unchanged meaning.

quote: A calendar and badge module can agree on types but disagree about what counts as attendance.

reading.en: The closest form is a typed witness: two well-typed terms of one type, one with a captured binding, give different answers at one input and the same at another, so one coincident value does not reveal the difference. A code's homonyms read back wrongly, and a merged distinction returns only by a coined form or one held outside: the shape of splitting one event name. Those laws are on one code; two modules holding one form at different senses is my further step. [AI reading]

says.en: Witness (periphery; a supplied typed-term language): two well-typed terms of the same type, one using the outer position under a binder and one whose use the binder captured, give different answers at one assignment and input and the same answer at another, so one coincident value does not reveal the capture. Equal evaluation does not establish identity of reference, content or history.

Theorem (any type): a code letting a sense hold several forms reads every held form back as its sense, and only it, exactly where no two senses hold one form: synonyms do no harm and homonyms do. Where all hold a code merging two senses, a coined form heard by all makes every formation tell them apart again.

Under hearings that copy, where every formation holds the imposed form at a sense, all hold it at every later step: a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining. Not shown: that actual conventions form this way.

targets.part: a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining

account_adds.en: The exact law that synonyms are harmless and homonyms harmful, and that a coincident value can hide a same-type difference.

source_adds.en: That two modules can agree on a type and disagree on meaning: the laws are on one code or one language. Then what the change does downstream: retroactive corrections, rewards already spent, and which historical commitments can stay stable.

name.en: A shared decision cannot be made local or derived

source.locator: Assistant, the attendance chain; also README counterexamples and ARCHITECTURE worked revision

sense.en: Architecture can expose relationships but not dissolve shared disagreement. Modularity cannot make every global change local, shared policy disagreements still need social resolution, and whether to preserve, reconcile or compensate spent rewards is a community decision an LLM cannot derive from types.

quote: It cannot make an inherently shared decision purely local.

reading.en: Three forms. Locality: a part's change stays its own only within others' margins. Derivation: a mixed comparison is decided both ways by positive weightings, and a frame fixes no order; ordering rests on C or another named order, with a named scope; the continuation condition, one such, ranks nothing; neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought, and C is silent on mixed cases. Resolution: a law privileging neither side never brings agreement on a code, and among symmetric roles only an asymmetry or a procedure differentiates. Reading spent rewards so is my step. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided): the whole widens exactly when the part's net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside its region, and is mixed exactly when it goes beyond for one. Mixed is not ordered.

Theorem (any type; a finite listing, two-valued admission): one course widens another exactly when every weighting positive on the listed items weighs it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways by positive weightings.

Two readings, neither asserted: the continuation condition (scope) fixes whose losses count and ranks nothing; C (order) ranks a course above every course it widens and does not rank mixed comparisons. A statement reading no order entails C only where it fails: immediate, since 'better' is free, it shows that a frame fixes no order.

From a start symmetric under the exchange and the renaming, a law keeping both never brings formations it exchanges to agree at a sense where the renaming moves every form; in a witness a formation both hear, a preferred form and an order of hearing each break one symmetry. A resolution written back into records later cohorts read rests from the next cohort on.

targets.part: a symmetric start under an exchange and a renaming

says.en: Theorem (two roles; periphery): among exactly symmetric parties, who contributes is differentiated only by an actual asymmetry or a procedure the parties form; the laws single out none.

Conditional (living significance; J1–J4 and correspondence E; none asserted): without a unique answer a legitimate shared procedure decides and keeps residual responsibilities. It does not supply a complete mixed ranking.

targets.part: without a unique answer a legitimate shared procedure decides

account_adds.en: An exact reason the decision is underdetermined, on listed items and weightings, an obstruction under symmetry, and when a recorded resolution comes to rest.

source_adds.en: Social resolution as the actual process, which the account leaves to a procedure the parties form. Then the practical move: predict the wider scope before implementation, proportionate coordination for changes of shared meaning.

name.en: The maintained module outlasts the agents who work on it

source.locator: The organizing model; README The maintained module

sense.en: A durable module holds identity, contracts, state, evidence and maintenance knowledge; workers come and go. Another agent must be able to resume from durable context without reconstructing the whole community's chat, and durable responsibility stays distinct from the temporary task graph of a change.

quote: An executing agent is temporary.

reading.en: The map's thesis is general, argued and not a theorem: a pattern goes on while occurrences carrying it begin and end, read at two classes. One model shows it exactly: a rule held after s steps with nothing of the start among its holders. What remains of a recipe can be resumed from where a course stands. That rule passes through members with no records, where the source holds identity in records with no worker active: a real difference. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis, claimed and argued, not a theorem: a pattern goes on while the occurrences carrying it begin and end: a flame through its fuel, an organism through its cells, a practice through its members. Read at one class, turnover that sustains and turnover that ends look alike; at a fine and a coarse class together they differ.

Theorem (root; a family of models; one minimal model of a rule of entry; records not modelled): in a region closed under its steps, after s steps the rule is held, at the quotas then standing, with nothing of the start among the holders. Not shown: that any actual institution meets these hypotheses.

Theorem (any process): carrying out a recipe part of the way leaves a recipe remaining where the course stands, and resuming it completes the recipe. How a formation comes to remember or sense what remains is not modelled, nor concurrent activity.
In one declared history, handoff keeps the rule, the roster and the adoptions; the revised rule handed off to nobody is kept, yet cannot integrate.

account_adds.en: That persistence is relative to a chosen pair of classes, and that a kept rule still needs continuing participation.

source_adds.en: An identity held in records through stretches when no worker is active. Then the maintenance dossier as a design, wake conditions, and that durable context lets a new worker resume cheaply: not stated.

name.en: Evolution has to pay for its migrations

source.locator: Core claims, claim 7; soundness assessment; ARCHITECTURE Worked architectural revision

sense.en: Versions, migrations, ownership, budgets and consolidation belong to normal lifecycle. Features may get cheap while their shared meaning becomes expensive to maintain; a variant budget must include adapters and migrations, and extraction cost is counted before later savings. The folder says owners and budgets are not yet shown to control the burden.

quote: Easy generation alone is insufficient.

reading.en: A budget covering correction alone does not pay for migration, with a missing part stopping realization while an aggregate reads safe. Support during a transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings: a limit on funding, where the source asks only that extraction be counted first. Growth has its price in general form: under upkeep a course keeping widening has ever more takers. On market and World models, parts supplied. Maintaining many forks has no law. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery): under a certificate covering correction plus migration and the listed conditions, every finite successor takes its step; in witnesses a missing part stops realization while the aggregate stays safe, and a budget for correction alone fails to pay for migration. The record's AI reading: the migration of a running service. Not shown: that an actual system is so provided for, or that a succession is warranted.

Theorem (every law with admissible disturbances and a guard; the cover on the market instance): a start lasts n steps exactly when some ladder holds it at level n. On the instance: sufficient hypotheses, not least; support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings.

Theorem (World; witnesses): under upkeep, every supported formation taking at least a unit a step from a family, a course keeping widening by name has ever more takers. Natural-number amounts are used. What one course needs does not give the second-order direction of widening.

Assessment (selected histories, no theorem, not a universal law): inherited code, work, coordination and interim support carried activity under partial reorganization, as specific conditions, not interchangeable amounts.

account_adds.en: That the shortfall can be invisible in an aggregate safety reading.

source_adds.en: The economic claim that generation cost and maintenance cost diverge, so features get cheap while shared meaning gets expensive. Then consolidation of forks, ownership transfer and human clarification as a maintenance cost.

name.en: Rollback does not undo writes; transitions must survive interruption

source.locator: Change and adoption; ARCHITECTURE sections 3 and 5

sense.en: New implementations are published as versions. Persisted state needs a compatible transition or migration, active sessions and jobs need handling, and cross-module changes need durable transitions with retries and specified compensation. A rollback candidate must account for state already transformed; the plan refuses to promise general atomic rollback.

quote: Code rollback does not by itself undo incompatible data writes or external effects.

reading.en: The refusal has a form at one remove. Under a fixed law a possibility is kept exactly where a return path exists, and returning to an equal configuration does not erase the history between; a code rollback changes the law, which that theorem holds fixed, so the match is to state only. No map restores what a reduction merged unless the joint relation was retained. Protocols carry a change through interruption, with limits: coherence is not harmlessness; completion needs reserve and an uninterrupted suffix. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process): along a finite trace under a fixed law, every existential endpoint possibility is kept exactly where a return path exists; failure to return has a constructive lost endpoint, which, in a witness, incomplete questions hide. Returning to an equal configuration does not erase the history between; where a law comes from lies outside these laws.

Theorem (any type): what an observable reads through a reduction is single-valued exactly where it agrees across what the reduction merges, so no map restores two configurations a reduction merges. The loss is at the reduced interface, not universal: retaining the joint relation reverses it.
Theorem (any process): moves inserted before resuming join into one course and can disable what remains. Concurrent activity and its admission are not modelled.

Law (any process; pure core) with a periphery instance: a law doing one unit of a pending task's work a tick finishes in that work plus one tick; under the bank and queue invariant the versioned queue's head completes, leaving the rest unchanged. That the request is still appropriate is not shown.

Instance (periphery): with durable protected pending state, atomic writes and no extra writer, n remaining writes and the publication complete in n + 1 uninterrupted steps exactly when reserve and deadline cover n + 1, and no shorter resumption publishes. It verifies no arbitrary irreversible effect, and safety here is coherence of evidence, not harmless activity.

account_adds.en: Exact step counts for resumption, that consistency alone does not supply reserve, deadline or an uninterrupted suffix, and that a retained joint relation is what reverses a merge.

source_adds.en: Rollback as such: that code rollback leaves incompatible writes and external effects standing, where the return law holds the law fixed. Then coexisting versions over shared records, migration of stored meaning, spent rewards and compensation, activation pinned against other owners' old promises.

name.en: Retiring a thing while keeping its records and obligations

source.locator: Questions, 6; ARCHITECTURE section 5

sense.en: A module can end as executable software while its history and continuing obligations survive: identify dependents, stop new work, resolve obligations, transfer ownership, preserve records. Compression must not delete unresolved obligations.

quote: The system needs a way to stop maintaining executable variants while preserving community history.

reading.en: The account's practical judgment has this shape, conditionally: an ending stands on fulfilment, justified release or loss of warrant, with response to residual losses; renaming, deleted records or hidden undertakings change the judgment; a transfer needs an accepted successor with capacity in time, not nominal succession. An argument, not a law, Conditional on living significance, J1–J4 and correspondence E, none asserted, no warrant from outside sought. Along total dependence one end ends everything downstream. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional (living significance; J1–J4, correspondence E; none asserted; an argument with checked consequences). End: fulfilment, justified release, loss of warrant, with response to residual losses; renaming, deleted records, hidden undertakings change the judgment. Transfer: an accepted successor has capacity and support in time for demand; nominal succession or a gap during actual need change it.

Theorem (any number of conditions): along every chain of total dependence with positive draws the end of one ends everything downstream, a ring ending together or not at all, and a draw of nothing stops the cascade.
In one declared history, handoff keeps the rule, the roster and the adoptions; the revised rule handed off to nobody is kept, yet cannot integrate.

account_adds.en: Which responses a judgment could give (preserve, transform, transfer, end) and what changes each, and that nominal succession does not count as transfer.

source_adds.en: The procedure itself: stop new work, drop executable variants while access to records stays, archival views, a sponsor who leaves, compression that keeps unresolved obligations. No law of deliberately carrying out an ending is stated; the practice of moving superseded text to history/ stands in AGENTS.md, not the live account.

name.en: Technical evolution should preserve community continuity

source.locator: Core claims, claim 8; Three properties

sense.en: Value stance: conversations, identity, commitments, decisions and cultural history matter alongside features and performance, and a new version should keep the relevant records and commitments. Social harmony is called an aspiration the architecture cannot guarantee.

quote: Technical evolution should preserve community continuity.

reading.en: The source holds as a value what the account gives only under premises: that these losses count is the continuation condition's scope, a ranking is under C or another named order; neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought, and no law says a loss of records is a harm. Its judgment makes preservation defeasible: for actual continuation, not an institution's survival. Same word, other reference: continuity here is records surviving an upgrade; continuation is relative to a class the law does not warrant. [AI reading]

says.en: The continuation condition fixes whose losses count: every continuation's; it ranks nothing. C, widening what can form is better, ranks a course above every course it widens and does not rank mixed comparisons. Neither is asserted.

Conditional (living significance; J1–J4, correspondence E; none asserted). Preserve: relations sustain living, alteration lacks advantage or causes avoidable loss; failure, domination, unsustainable burdens or a better alternative change the judgment. Maintaining a common support shares its favourable reason for actual continuation, not an institution's survival.

Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance. Retaining adds no ending and ranks nothing: a path retaining what has significance along another ends none of it. Individuation fixes what counts as a loss; the reading of living is a choice.

Theorem (root): under the full class continuation is 缘 itself, and under a coarser class every continuation remains one. Its only hypotheses: each class an equivalence, and equality on the carrier where identity serves as a class. Not shown: that a class is warranted.

Reading [AI, D65; scope by the continuation condition, and a ranking only under C or another named order (07 §4)]: a condition indispensable to one way of organization is not thereby basic: living may continue, and improve, after the way of coordination changes.

account_adds.en: The split between whose losses count and which course ranks higher, what would change a judgment to preserve, and that what continues is relative to the class read.

source_adds.en: The concrete objects of continuity (identity, decisions, cultural history) as what must survive an upgrade, and a stance held rather than conditioned on named premises.

name.en: Agreeing agents are not independent evidence

source.locator: Counterexamples and limits; RESEARCH-AGENDA question 7; PLAN Parallel work during implementation

sense.en: Independent agents may reproduce one misunderstanding, an agent can write code and tests sharing a mistaken assumption, review does not establish correctness merely because agents agree, and agents with different role names are not automatically independent. Verification should scale with the scope and consequences of a change.

quote: Agreement and implementation-shaped tests are not sufficient evidence of correctness.

reading.en: The reviewer laws have this shape: readiness counts independent causes, not names, the plan's point about role names; moving two reviewers under one cause fails it with all names kept; a cause in every reviewer's formula and in no bound fails them all though the roster reads ready, which is the shared misunderstanding. A test excludes only through what couples in, so one shaped by the implementation misses what they share: my step. Mere agreement falls under this only with a supplied common cause. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (pure core, no axiom; fault formulas and bounds supplied, faithful reviewers): reviewers count by independent causes, not names. In computed cases three reviewers with distinct single causes are ready, moving two under one cause makes readiness fail while all three names are kept, and a roster can be ready while a cause in every reviewer's formula and in no bound fails every reviewer. That the formulas are the actual causes is not shown.

Theorem (any type, no axiom): where each added witness copies one already on the roster, inspection takes exactly the same steps and gives the same certificate. That a witness merely agreeing, without copying, adds nothing is not shown.

Theorem (World; no premise): a claim is excluded only through a difference in what couples in, and what holds is never excluded. Being alike through the couplings bounds what can be told apart and says nothing of what a difference is about.

account_adds.en: An exact readiness condition: nonempty bounds, every two leaving a reviewer working under both.

source_adds.en: That agreement as such is not sufficient evidence: the account shows this for copies and shared causes, and says merely agreeing without copying is not shown. Then implementation-shaped tests as a specific failure, adversarial and contract-derived checks, and verification effort scaled to consequences.

name.en: Evidence holds under its premises and needs renewal

source.locator: Sections 2 and 4

sense.en: An assistant proposal: evidence binds property, revision, assumptions, environment and method. Tests expire with code; a compositional argument may stay reusable when a change re-establishes exactly its premises. Tests cannot be summarized up into a proof. Reuse is proposed to make later changes cheaper.

quote: Every reuse records the premises and environmental conditions on which it relies.

reading.en: Both sides have forms. Reuse: signs transfer between epochs exactly where the bias is kept and gains agree in sign, and preserving an assessment through a substitution needs a guarantee and a producer meeting its criterion, the source's re-established premises. Renewal: a record can stay true of its sample while reusing it is wrong; evidence must be carried through admitted change; an old envelope reused after reviewers merge accepts what a recomputed one rejects. The saving from reuse is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery: pre-spine updater constructions): signs transfer between epochs exactly where the bias is kept and the gains agree in sign, so a change of gain keeping zero and orientation, as from 1 to 2, keeps every sign; constant channels, one blind reference, mixed-epoch readings and change after calibration remain failures.

Theorem (periphery; a supplied language), hypothesis in the record: preserving an assessment also needs a hypothetical guarantee and an actual producer meeting its input criterion; substitution proves neither premise.

targets.part: hypothesis: a guarantee and a producer meeting its criterion

says.en: Theorem (periphery; for two named histories, the moves and local closure supplied): where a reference changes without entering what is retained, no deterministic policy choosing from that view resolves them in finitely many steps, so a rule never answering falsely must abstain. A record can stay true of its sample while reusing it for the present question is wrong.

Theorem (periphery; admitted transitions supplied): what execution needs certified is the acquisition-time candidate set propagated through every admitted change; a change recorded as none can leave false confidence.
Computed case (pure core): the old envelope reused after the merger accepts the two merged supporters, a recomputed one rejects them.

targets.part: computed case: the old envelope reused after the merger

account_adds.en: That inspection is needed for repair: reopening and taking up without inspection does not repair the judgment.

source_adds.en: The case for reuse, that it makes later changes cheaper. Then evidence classes with different invalidation rules and a periodic independent broader check.

name.en: A change compiled into a repair frontier

source.locator: Section 2

sense.en: A proposed planner: consumers of a changed promise receive a delta through declared boundaries and each decides whether its guarantees still hold; propagation stops at a supported boundary or a broader owner. A revised premise reopens an obligation. Predictions are kept so locality is measured, and exhausted budgets stay unresolved.

quote: a budget limit never converts unknown compatibility into acceptance

reading.en: The planner is not in the account, but its rules have forms: what needs certifying is propagated through every admitted change, and a change can reopen what was excluded (a revised premise); an understated change leaves false confidence (a hidden assumption); exhaustion keeps a task pending (a budget limit). Its stopping has one too: a region closed under a relation is one that relation never crosses, each relation drawing its own closure. These read arrangements and tasks, not consumers of promises; correspondence unshown. Proposed here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery; admitted transitions supplied, not inferred from a notice or a clock): what execution needs certified is the candidate set propagated through every admitted change, a later report filtered only after expanding through admitted fault and control transitions; a control change can reopen an excluded arrangement, and a change recorded as none can leave false confidence.

Law (pure core) with a periphery instance: a course of draws on a stock is executable exactly when each draw is within the stock then standing; with review drawing one unit and action two, an endpoint completes exactly when its report clears the relevant risk and its work covers the course; refusal or exhaustion keeps the task and the work used. Retaining a task is not its actual continuation.
Theorem (periphery; for two named histories, moves and closure supplied): a rule never answering falsely must abstain where a reference changed outside what is retained.

Reading [AI, D45, D61]: along a relation, a formation's boundary is given by a region holding it and closed under the relation, which the relation then never crosses. Which boundaries a formation has depends on the relation followed; the closure is the least.

targets.part: along a relation, a region closed under it

account_adds.en: That abstaining is forced, not merely prudent, for a sound rule on that view, and that what stops one relation need not stop another.

source_adds.en: Propagation of a semantic delta through consumers' declared boundaries, escalation to a broader owner, and keeping predictions so that locality is measured rather than defined afterwards.

name.en: The decomposition itself must be revisable

source.locator: The capability we must invent and demonstrate; ARCHITECTURE section 3

sense.en: The updated ambition, in assistant-authored mechanisms: work reveals an insufficient boundary, agents propose better ones, parents search their neighbourhood first, candidates are scored with migration cost and a cooldown discourages churn, later unseen work tests them. The current structure is useful organization, not an assertion that the first decomposition was ideal.

quote: This makes the original responsibility tree an object of learning.

reading.en: The revision step has a form: a rule answers every failure exactly where it puts the failed address into the next plan. Neighbourhood search, which the source adopts, rests wherever no neighbour scores more. Rules revised at every step can never complete, what its cooldown guards against: my step. A condition indispensable to one way of organizing is not thereby basic; any ranking there rests on C or another named order, with a named scope, most often the continuation condition, neither asserted. Learning its own boundaries, and later savings, are not stated. Proposed here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process; contacts, targets and revision rule supplied): a change of plan keeps every old selection exactly where it retains every old contact; a revision rule answers every failure exactly where it puts the failed address into the next plan; a rule not reading failures leaves one unanswered at every plan where no list holds every address. One finite history does not show revision corrects every failure.
Theorem (World): a local search rests where no neighbour is rewarded more, so a narrower neighbourhood's added rests are its implicit bias. Which neighbourhoods a system searches is read empirically.

Theorem (any process; completion decided; the home's conditional part, under the continuation condition, not used here): where unfinished steps lower the current rule's certificate and a handoff to a revised rule does not raise it, a run certified at most B completes by step B + 1; without the handoff hypothesis rules each finishing when kept, revised at every step, never complete. The rank measures that bound, not ethical value.

Reading [AI, D65; scope by the continuation condition, and a ranking only under C or another named order (07 §4)]: whether a development calls for expanding, maintaining, reorganizing or contracting is asked of the whole continuation it forms. A condition indispensable to one way of organization is not thereby basic.

account_adds.en: That reading failures is necessary for a revision rule to answer them, what a change of plan keeps, and that a search's added rests are a bias of its neighbourhood.

source_adds.en: The claim itself: a responsibility tree that learns its own boundaries through use, with later savings. Then the search: bounded local operations (split, merge, extract, move), scoring, margins, and promotion by trial on unseen changes.

name.en: Future costs follow from the current representation

source.locator: What we are trying to surpass

sense.en: The plan's thesis: if a system improves its boundaries, named concepts, procedures and evidence, later work gets easier, and extra experience should sometimes reduce the reasoning the next task needs. Called the central proposed advantage; explicitly falsifiable if search costs exceed savings.

quote: many future costs are consequences of the current representation of a problem

reading.en: The account has no law that a better representation lowers later cost or reasoning: the folder's distinctive claim stands untaken and untested, and the account's reading of meta-learning classifies orders functionally and claims no saving. A proposal: what a lumping settles at unobserved inputs, three probes identifying a compositional code, and one construction counting a reform's later return. That is less left undetermined, not less effort. [AI reading]

searched: live account (chapters, fronts, glossary): meta-learn, sav(es|ing|ings), less work, less effort, less reasoning, reasoning cost, reasoning effort, learning to learn, cost of search, cost of change, compress
read: 03-KNOWING.md #r-generalization-through-lumping, #r-composition-route, #r-formed-goal-revision-continuation, and the Reading D65 on meta-learning

name.en: A learned procedure carries only where its conditions hold

source.locator: Section 4; README Updated ambition; VISION The user experience; PLAN How to react when we lose

sense.en: An assistant proposal, the third of the folder's named mechanisms: learned strategies are kept with provenance and applicability conditions, retrieval checks them, and procedures carry forward without assuming every community means the same thing. If learning helps one community and harms another, require explicit applicability and local adaptation.

quote: A learned strategy can become stale or inapplicable; retrieval must check its conditions.

reading.en: Forms exist, each one protocol with much supplied. A practice round completes exactly where the reviewer's recorded method answers as the current context does, and a changed context fails. Applicability has its own law: an endpoint completes exactly where its report clears the relevant risk, and a report correct when sampled need not cover the effect. Faithful reconstruction passes a procedure on, record erasure altering later use. None concerns retrieval or transfer across communities. Proposed here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery; task, records, mandate, participants and more supplied): a practice round by a reviewer and a worker completes exactly when the worker is present and the reviewer is a present roster member other than the worker whose recorded method answers as the current context does; changed context fails. One connection from enacted practice to further participation, not indefinite self-maintenance.

With review drawing one unit and action two, an endpoint completes exactly when its report clears the relevant risk and its work covers the course. Correctness at sampling time does not ensure that a report covers the effect; protection of the action does not carry over the comparative reason for preferring the practice. Only the two practice protections of a supplied outcome law are covered.

Theorem (periphery): in a declared construction, every exposure followed by a faithful reconstruction passes on the network and the procedure bit, as many successors as capacity allows. Supplied: hardware, procedures, laws, encounters, exact copying and a fixed recipe; one finite composition, not a population model or an origin of learning rules. Record erasure can preserve offspring count while altering later use.

account_adds.en: That protection of the action does not carry over the comparative reason for preferring the practice.

source_adds.en: Retrieval that checks conditions, provenance kept with a strategy, transfer across communities and the cost of learning.

name.en: No layer is exempt: software that learns how to evolve itself
