source.locator: Updated vision; What changed; also ARCHITECTURE The organizing model; PLAN Beyond the first win

sense.en: The updated ambition, user-directed in its aim and assistant-authored in its mechanisms: decomposition, maintenance context, procedures, development machinery, even the host and common rules can improve through use, while an independent evaluation reference is preserved. A long-range objective; nothing built.

quote: No layer is permanently exempt from redesign if measured bottlenecks justify replacing it.

reading.en: What the account has for a learner changing how it changes are instances with a level held fixed: a failed updating rule can be replaced, in declared networks; a rule changes through an amendment procedure that stays fixed; where a law comes from lies outside the return laws. Currently favourable updates can overwrite an old recall, and rules revised at every step can never complete. So 'no layer' exceeds every stated model, and the source itself exempts its evaluation reference. Proposed here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery; pre-spine modules; declared networks): one network loses an old recall through continued, currently favourable updates and restores it by further revision without a reset; in a finite replacement history failure allows an affordable proposal, and reinstalling the old rule can fail again. Not a population, convergence or ethical theorem.

In one declared protocol a rule changes only at a gated adoption through an amendment procedure that is supplied and fixed. Which proposals a procedure admits and how procedures are themselves kept or dropped are distinct questions; how tasks and tests change is open.
Theorem (any process): witnesses: without the handoff hypothesis rules each finishing when kept, revised at every step, never complete. No universal productive deadline follows from the bound.
The laws concern reachability under one fixed law; where a law comes from lies outside them.

account_adds.en: That an improvement currently favoured can overwrite what was kept, and that unlimited revision can prevent completion.

source_adds.en: A substrate improving its own tools, host and rules through use, with an independent reference kept. The account has no law of open-ended self-improvement.

name.en: Growth must leave the community able to change what it built

source.locator: Beyond the first win; VISION Three demanding worlds and What success cannot be purchased by hiding

sense.en: A limit the plan sets on its own long-range objective: a substrate that discovers better ways to organize itself may not cost the community its ability to use, understand and change what it built. Culture remains something people create and negotiate, and communities retain control of their shared commitments.

quote: Each expansion must preserve the existing community’s ability to use, understand, and change what it has built.

reading.en: The account states the distinction this needs: in its rule protocol, with two participants technical decisions go on while revision of the governance fails, so continuing to operate is not still being able to change how one is organized. Under a fixed law a possibility is kept exactly where a return path exists. The source states an undertaking; if expressed as a ranking, its holder, scope and order must be named, neither the condition nor C asserted, no warrant from outside sought. [AI reading]

says.en: A copied rule with no one continuing to take part cannot operate, and with two participants technical decisions can go on while revision of the governance itself fails: continuing to operate is not still being able to change how one is organized. One declared construction; seed rule, participation and amendment procedure supplied.

targets.part: continuing to operate is not still being able to change how one is organized

says.en: Theorem (any process): along a finite trace under a fixed law, every existential endpoint possibility is kept exactly where a return path exists. Physical irreversibility does not follow: the laws are of a represented process.
The continuation condition fixes whose losses count: every continuation's; it ranks nothing. Whoever ranks courses holds C or another order. Neither is asserted.

account_adds.en: That operating and being able to revise how one is organized come apart, on a witness.

source_adds.en: The requirement itself, that each expansion must preserve the ability to use, understand and change, as a limit on a self-improving substrate. Then understanding as part of what is kept, and culture as something people create and negotiate.

name.en: Thousands of useful workers

source.locator: Sections 5 and 6; soundness assessment table; EVALUATION Five independent axes of scale

sense.en: Work should run across up to a thousand active workers, measured by accepted change and not activity. Benefit depends on task independence: independent work proceeds concurrently, conflicting obligations are coordinated without global serialization of the unrelated, and an ownership conflict changes the boundary and is not remedied by another worker.

quote: Sharding a queue does not prove semantic coordination scales.

reading.en: What is independent has an exact form: exchanges with disjoint footprints commute, order showing only through a shared relatum or a dependence; sharing a relatum, order can matter; a scheduler completes exactly where some interleaving exists. So the source's independence, and its refusal of global serialization, have a form, as order and not as speed. There is no law of accepted work against worker count; the several-optimizers law is draw on a stock, a word match here. Proposed here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): where supplied sides split two consecutive steps, swapping the exchanges keeps balance, dissipation and embodiment and, on a stretch holding every commuted pair, the totals and counts, under any number of commutations; the order shows through a shared relatum or a dependence.
Theorem (a local law; witness): on one relatum, adding one then doubling gives two and doubling then adding gives one: the hypothesis of local commutation cannot be dropped.

Theorem (World): for a local law with the relata listed, two lists giving every relatum the same own course reach the same configuration; with exchanges told apart, a scheduler completes exactly where some interleaving exists.

account_adds.en: That which exchanges commute is exact given a footprint, and that a shared relatum is where order begins to matter.

source_adds.en: How accepted work scales with worker count: queues, leases, backpressure, useful saturation, and useful concurrency as throughput, none stated.

name.en: Predict scope first; keep failed thresholds as results

source.locator: Provisional advancement gates; What would falsify the central thesis

sense.en: Assistant-proposed standard: predict the affected set before implementation, seal outcomes, compare with tuned rivals, report losses as results. Every number is a provisional target; no measurement exists. Surprises must not be relabelled as locality after the fact.

quote: Do not revise a failed threshold retrospectively and retain the original claim.

reading.en: Same practice as the account's frozen rules: verdict scored before the data, failure recorded beside the thesis. An agreement of method, not of a checked law. A frozen rule there fixes scoring, not that the rule reads its construct, a limit the folder states less exactly. The folder's own tests were not taken up; the account names it an application, correspondence not established. [AI reading]

says.en: Strength is the observations a claim excludes; standing is how far it is established. A thesis adds no theorem, a refutation removes none, and a failure stays recorded beside the thesis. A frozen rule fixes how a verdict is scored before the data, not that the rule reads the construct the verdict names.
Applications elsewhere (design programmes, not results; correspondence not established), naming evolving community swarms among them.

account_adds.en: The distinction between a frozen scoring rule and construct validity.

source_adds.en: The specific tests: ablations, matched baselines, unseen communities, the cost and quality gates. None is frozen or run in the account.

name.en: The goal: surpass the strongest alternative

source.locator: What we are trying to surpass; DECISIONS 2026-09-07

sense.en: Ren's direction is to surpass, not only learn from, existing systems. The assistant-authored reading: more useful change at lower total cost than the strongest practical alternatives, cumulative capability with communities keeping control. The folder ties any superiority claim to a workload, comparison, budget and period.

quote: Success means a community can achieve more useful change with less repeated explanation

reading.en: The account takes no growing capability as a goal: no law of the dynamics gives a ranking; widening is a criterion, not a quantity to maximize, silent on mixed cases; institutions have no prior licence to grow. In its conditional judgment (living significance, J1–J4 and correspondence E, none asserted) mere output growth grounds no transformation. The source names what its comparison reads, cost per accepted change on a workload: a frame kept as its own, not an error. [AI reading]

says.en: §1: the direction is a criterion on which every such weighting agrees, not a quantity to maximize, and it says nothing where the comparison is mixed. The page's opening: it is the question's generative direction only under the two readings (the continuation condition for scope, C for order; neither asserted).

Ranking, order: a comparison of options as better or worse. No law of the dynamics gives one: the laws give how courses differ in what they admit, one widening another, the two keeping the same or mixed, with no premise.

Reading [AI, scope by the continuation condition, and a ranking is under C or another named order (07 §4)]: the laws of capture and drain give institutions no prior duty to contract and no prior licence to grow; whether a development calls for expanding, maintaining, reorganizing or contracting is asked of the whole continuation it forms.

Conditional (living significance, which the continuation condition yields, for scope; J1–J4, correspondence E; a ranking is under C or another named order; none asserted). Transform: the arrangement damages shared conditions and feasible change restores living with equivalent protections; mere output growth and displaced deprivation change the judgment.

account_adds.en: What a capability ranking would need: C or another order, and silence on mixed comparisons.

source_adds.en: A measured, competitive target with explicit rivals, which the account does not set itself.

name.en: A self-improving system must not grade itself

source.locator: Workloads and independence; ARCHITECTURE The organizing model

sense.en: Because the system may replace its own components and procedures, the plan keeps an independent evaluation reference: independent authors freeze outcomes, and the optimizing system cannot touch adjudication or cost accounting. Stated as test hygiene, not as a law of self-improving systems.

quote: The optimizing system cannot edit sealed adjudication, cost accounting or reference history.

reading.en: Thesis T7 has this form: a measure whose rule and reading are formed from the share it selects is, drift aside, dropped only through a change in what the loop reads, such as a reader outside the share, not on evidence alone; proved only in part. In frozen test LA2 one note of the loss turned one trained judge of its own answers, counting against T7's fourth forbidden case (a loss read only by those the rule disfavours, they no more than its carriers, with nothing else changed), as worded before its clause on drift. An outside reader reaches only what couples in. That a self-improver so reads is a premise. Proposed here; T7 comes down from the corpus's meta-attractor line (02's D26), so by descent as far as it goes. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis T7: a metric whose rule and reading are formed from the share it selects is kept by its selectors however large a loss it does not read grows, and, drift aside, is dropped only through a change in what the loop reads, not on evidence alone. In the model only invariance and the lock outliving an unread coordinate are proved. Frozen LA2, one trained system: one note of the loss turned a judge of its own answers, counting against T7's fourth forbidden case (a loss read only by those the rule disfavours, they no more than its carriers, with nothing else changed), as worded before its clause on drift, as a claim about trained judges.

targets.part: Thesis T7 and frozen test LA2

says.en: Theorem (any type): from a locked configuration, under the stated monotone premises, the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course: a sufficient way out. Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

Theorem (World): what a pool whose members lie outside the acting part decides by its acts (a reward, a vote, a revision), under laws reading through its members' couplings, is a selection through its pooled coupling. Coupling bounds response and does not fix it.
Instance (periphery): an extra write path can leave the public view identical, so logs cannot establish mediation. That the runtime is completely mediated is supplied, not shown.

account_adds.en: That a reading formed from what it scores can absorb any change made to it, a frozen test on one trained judge, and that independence bounds what an evaluator can respond to without fixing it.

source_adds.en: The practical arrangement: sealed outcomes, independent authors, recorded adjudication.

name.en: Everyone happily making it more powerful

source.locator: Exchange 4, Ren

sense.en: Ren's founding picture: a space that never slows, where members keep adding apps, wallets, voting and badges until it becomes their 'os' and part of the culture. The folder's own README restates harmony as an aspiration the architecture cannot guarantee and keeps real disagreement in its question, so the picture is a hope, not a claim of the design.

quote: everyone just happily making it more and more powerful

reading.en: The account keeps what the picture leaves out. A course that keeps widening on a finite family has to be fed from beyond and, under upkeep, has ever more takers; starting from relations removes a fixed sum but not rivalry. Reading a shared space as such a course is mine, and untested. The divergence is with the picture, not the folder's hedged design. No law here says a loss is a harm; each ranking names its holder, scope and order, the continuation condition and C one pair examined in 07, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; witnesses): for a course keeping widening by name, requirements fixed within a finite family, the family's stock passes every bound and a finite balanced world has no such course; under upkeep the course has ever more takers. Natural-number amounts are used. What one course needs does not give the second-order direction of widening.

Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems: positive-sum structure and real conflict; mixed comparisons stay unranked.

account_adds.en: What growth without end would need, and real conflict as theorem on the reading of position.

source_adds.en: The aspiration itself, and that a shared space can become part of a culture through use.

name.en: A community grows its own software into its culture

source.locator: The idea; The founding example; VISION Three demanding worlds

sense.en: The founding idea: members ask for changes where they use the software, agents help make them, and the space becomes a shared environment for work, play and coordination. Culture stays something people create and negotiate; the software should preserve their ability to do so.

quote: A community can develop its own software continuously

reading.en: The account names this folder once, among applications: design programmes, not results, correspondence not established. That is where the founding idea went. Its only software claim is an assessment of selected LibreOffice and Narwhal histories, about what carried activity through partial reorganization, not members reshaping tools by request, nor software as culture. The folder's whole participatory research programme stands outside the account. [AI reading]

searched: live account: evolving community, swarm, software, culture, malleable, community OS, participatory, member request, niche

name.en: Replay can overfit; unseen work tests generalization

source.locator: Section 3; EVALUATION What would falsify the central thesis

sense.en: An assistant proposal: past changes can reject poor boundary candidates but cannot confirm good ones, since learning may memorize development fixtures. Promotion requires a trial and later evaluation on unseen changes, and the public fixture cannot serve as a sealed demonstration.

quote: Historical replay can reject obviously poor candidates, but it can overfit.

reading.en: Same form, generally and on a named model. With no lumping every unobserved input stays free; where a lumping tells a history from every course, a law with the same courses takes any amount there, so its courses do not fix unseen work. A program fits every old record yet answers the novel expression wrongly, and that record exposes it; a wrong unique binding can meet the stopping rule. The models are supplied, not software or cognition. Promotion policy is not in the account. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): the class of all functions is free at every unobserved input (inputs compared decidedly). Training selects through agreeing on the data: every two members agreeing on the data agree at x exactly where the data determine x within the class. Probabilistic generalization bounds are not stated.

Theorem (World): where a lumping tells a history from every course, with laws reading what has stood and lumping decided, a law with the same courses takes any amount there and responds alike or not to histories it separates.

Theorem (named codes and formation courses; witnesses; much supplied): for the collapsed code a program duplicating one argument fits the old records yet answers the novel expression wrongly; the novel expression's record exposes it, a course with spare parts rebuilds the right program, and without spare parts the error is recorded, not repaired.
Theorem (any type): records only narrow the candidates. A wrong unique binding can meet the stopping rule.

account_adds.en: That a fresh record can expose an error without repairing it, when no spare parts are left.

source_adds.en: Promotion by trial, held-out communities and request families, and a periodic independent broader check.

name.en: A synthetic member cannot establish cultural fit

source.locator: Diagnostic measurements; PLAN stage 6

sense.en: An assistant-proposed limit on evidence: product outcomes must be measured with members (task completion, correction time, adoption, abandonment), since an agent standing in for a member cannot establish fit or satisfaction. No such measurement has been made.

quote: A synthetic agent impersonating a community member cannot establish cultural fit or member satisfaction.

reading.en: The account says this of itself, as a reading: a selection reaches what couples into its selector, human readers couple into none of the work's checks, so no check inside shows it serves its purpose, and every review so far is by AI. Its valuer experiments are AI personas, labelled role-play, human valuers untested. It differs in use: it runs such tests and reports verdicts beside the label. T5 is cited only for that label; the continuation condition and C (neither asserted) do no work here. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D66]: the selections through a selector's couplings, together, reach exactly what couples into it. The work's selectors are the Lean checker, the completion and record checks, and the AI reviews. Human readers, coordination among people and trained systems couple into none of them. So no check run inside the work can show that the work serves what it is for.
Every recorded review so far is by AI. No independent human review is claimed.
Evidence for T5: VD1 (96 AI-persona valuers, frozen before any call), every frozen rule failed; VD2, some frozen rules passed and some failed. The judgments are role-play; human valuers are untested.

account_adds.en: The mechanism of the limit, what couples into the selector, and a frozen test of what AI personas do, reported beside the label.

source_adds.en: The general limit, with no law here of what simulated people show, and its object: cultural fit and satisfaction in a community that uses the thing.

name.en: The ledger counts cost to the system

source.locator: The primary question; VISION What success cannot be purchased by hiding

sense.en: An assistant proposal, thorough in its own frame: charge discovery, search, verification, failed attempts, migrations and continuing maintenance; normalize model and tool prices by a pinned rate table and report raw usage; measure human time and regressions separately. Hidden cost does not count as success. What is read is cost to the project and its members; a worker is temporary, and what a run draws beyond its price has no line.

quote: Measure agent/infrastructure cost per accepted request

reading.en: The rate table normalizes actual prices, which the account's wording keeps for economic relations, and human time stays a separate line, so no single unit is claimed. What the account would ask is whose losses have no line: under the continuation condition (scope) every continuation's count; a ranking rests on C (order) or another named order; neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought, no law says a loss is a harm. Whether an actual AI system counts is not shown. A report can omit what was depleted; the frame stays the source's. Proposed here: the account has no ledger. [AI reading]

says.en: The continuation condition fixes whose losses count: every continuation's; its content beyond the self's presupposition extends scope to losses that return to no one; it ranks nothing. Whoever ranks courses holds C or another order. Neither is asserted.

Conditional (the condition for scope, C for order, J1-J4, correspondence and improvement witnesses): overbuilding that depletes the living basis is its counterexample where construction reports omit retained amounts.
Reading [AI, D65]: which formations count, and how, differs by the relation discerned, not by rank rising with complexity; whether an actual AI system counts so is not shown.
Reading [AI, D66], used by analogy: the work's selectors take in no reading of what renews the people who carry it, while its parallel lines each draw on their attention. The work is not a flow.

targets.part: What the work draws on (D66), used by analogy

says.en: Conditions are not necessarily quantities that can be stored or exchanged, and no condition is silently taken as owned, transferable, additive, scarce or commensurable. Wording keeps money, payment and ownership for actual economic relations.

account_adds.en: A question the ledger does not ask: what its comparison omits, and who bears that, with the premises it would need named.

source_adds.en: A concrete, auditable ledger with charges for hidden work and human time, which the account has for no activity, its own included.

name.en: Civilization as an accumulated stock of methods

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; Claims 19, 26-28, 83

sense.en: Civilization is not a sequence of clever objects but an accumulated stock of methods by which people turned real problems into working mechanisms, tangible and intangible on equal terms (law, money, schools, human rights). Ordinary readers should learn that civilization did not happen naturally: it is generation after generation solving problems.

quote: 文明不是自然发生的，而是一代代人解决问题的结果

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text reads civilization or its methods so. Passing has forms: a pattern outlasting brief carriers lasts through passing, under a supplied premise; a rule's change enters at a gated step; a method handed on has one periphery composition, expressly no population model. What accumulates has one AI reading: what can be done with the performer held grows only across changes of the performer. None says a civilization is a stock. 自然发生 here means happening of itself: a claim of cause, not a nature-culture split, and the account states no such cause. [AI reading]

says.en: World, any web: “A pattern outlasting its carriers lasts through passing.” Under the passing premise, supplied, “every beginning is a passing”; without it, a double-negation form that names no carrier.

Periphery: “every exposure followed by a faithful reconstruction passes on the network the exposure left and the procedure bit the exposed formation had”; “one finite composition, not a population model or an origin of learning rules.”

Reading [AI reading, D45] of laws near-definitional or by witness: “What grows is what can be done with the performer held, and only across changes of the performer.” The possible tasks carry reach, “along which the whole possible never grows”.

Any process: a quantity is kept along every ungated course exactly when every ungated step keeps it; a course that changes it splits at a gated step that changes it, values decided. “A copied rule with no one continuing to take part cannot operate”.

Root, a family of models: an entry rule on a shared stock passed through members who also keep it. That any actual institution meets the hypotheses, “or that this is what an institution is”, is not shown (record).
“(design programmes, not results; correspondence not established)”: names the human solutions museum among others.

account_adds.en: No law says cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping. Where a rule is kept, it can be kept and be the wrong rule [AI reading].

source_adds.en: Civilization as the unit; methods as what accumulates; that what exists results from problem-solving, where 04's reading would tell apart other origins; tangible and intangible creations on equal terms.

name.en: A civilizational advance has a canonical seven-stage shape

source.locator: The argument: The shape of a civilizational advance

sense.en: A civilizational advance has a canonical shape with separable stages: a real problem, a misreading of it, an insight redefining it, a mechanism on a named substrate, diffusion by a named force, what it solved, the new problems it made. Each stage does work no other does. The README calls this the claim that makes the museum a theory and not a format.

quote: a civilizational advance has a canonical shape with seven stages

reading.en: The account has no sequence of stages for an advance: its laws read courses under hypotheses, and the root lists 'inevitable improvement or universal growth' among what is not assumed. The README's counterexamples are to the product; it names no case the shape would exclude, while here content comes through hypotheses that forbid. Live 'stages' are of testing and of inquiry, and 03 says what each needs, 'not a method'. Single stages have neighbours in other entries. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The seven-stage shape itself, and that each stage can be interrogated separately across cases.

searched: dossier, canonical shape, stages of, civilizational, progress, inevitable improvement, framed, moraliz, privatiz, naturaliz across the overview, chapters, reviews and glossary
read: 08-METHOD an-investigation ('No cultural origin validates or disqualifies a method') and law
03-KNOWING §9 ('The results say what each stage needs, not a method')
05-COLLECTIVES the reading after r-market-model-share-margin-and-ends, whose four routes of transition are routes, not stages

name.en: Real problems, solved by mechanisms

source.locator: Claims 28, 75; The shape of a civilizational advance

sense.en: Problems are real and exist in a setting. A mechanism solves something, changing behaviours, relations, institutions, risks or capabilities. Inventions are not novelties from nowhere but mechanisms humans developed when facing real problems. The axis is problem to method.

quote: 发明不是凭空出现的新奇物，而是人类面对真实问题时发展出的机制

reading.en: The account begins from relations with no solver presupposed. 'Solved' has the form of a standard met or a task delivered, read against something supplied: meeting it says nothing of significance, and widening follows deliveries in neither direction. 'Developed when facing' claims an origin, and 04 reads of dispositions that a present benefit does not establish one. Under the continuation condition, for scope, what a solution ends counts too; ranking it rests on C or another named order; neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought. The claim concerns humans and is not refuted here. [AI reading]

says.en: “Activity includes change and interaction without presupposing an agent, an intention or a purpose.”

Standard: “what something is read against, so that it can be met or missed: a requirement on a level, an acceptable set of acts, a task.” “That a standard is met says nothing of whether meeting it is counted.”
Any process, witnesses. Reading [AI reading, D45]: “widening follows deliveries in neither direction, so they do not carry it”.

Reading after it [AI reading, D65], of a disposition: “A present benefit does not establish origin; selection, drift, constraint, byproduct and cultural transmission must be told apart where they are live alternatives.”

“Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance.” “Predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]”; “telling harm from non-harm among them takes a judgment that names its criterion and who holds it, not necessarily a number.” The condition fixes scope and ranks nothing; C gives order, and whoever ranks courses holds C or another order; neither is asserted.
In the table of what is shown and supplied, under Supplied: “the reading and the requirement a response answers to, the task, the set level”.

account_adds.en: What a response takes in is mapped, and the requirement it answers to enters as a hypothesis, not as something found in the situation.

source_adds.en: A claim about what humans in fact faced and did, and why inventions arose, which the account does not catalogue; a problem as real apart from a reader of it.

name.en: Moving civilization forward as the selection question

source.locator: Claims 18, 29-31; Relations (zhishan)

sense.en: An exhibit is selected not for novelty, being first or fame, but for moving humanistic civilization one step forward. Five criteria include expanding expression, choice, dignity, freedom, safety, cooperation or understanding. Ambivalent inventions may enter if both what they solved and what they made are shown. The README calls this a usable test of whether a technology is good.

quote: 是否扩大了人的表达、选择、尊严、自由、安全、协作或理解能力

reading.en: Near C in form only, and apart in three ways. The source says forward with no premise; here that widening is better is C's, a reading of order, unasserted, no warrant from outside sought. The source lists human capabilities; C reads what can form, and a part's widening widens the whole only within every outside margin, mixed beyond. An ambivalent invention is a mixed comparison, unranked by C. That more choice is better is itself a premise, and it stops at named edges. [AI reading]

says.en: “where it ranks, it names its readings, each an unasserted hypothesis wherever used”. The continuation condition “fixes scope, whose losses count: from every standpoint, for anything, its continuation into the future is counted.” “*C*: widening what can form is better.”

targets.part: The ethics: the readings named where the account ranks

says.en: Any type, finite listing, two-valued admission, natural weights (home, 07): one course widens another exactly when every weighting positive on the listed items weighs it higher; “a mixed comparison, a gain here and a loss there, is decided both ways by positive weightings”.

World, balance, part and region decided: where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region, the whole widens “exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside the region”, and is mixed where it goes beyond for one. “Mixed is not ordered.”

“This does not derive C from anything and gives no reason for it.” On a finite listing, “calling better what no chooser does worse from and some does better from” is a premise reading an order; that route stops at “imposed admission, another's order, several choosers”. In a witness, widening a menu two choose from lowers what each gets by the payoffs.

Generation is a pattern going on through carrying renewal, and 生生 is the continuation of life, not novelty or scale; an expansion that ends forms of life another course keeps is mixed with it and C does not rank them.

account_adds.en: Widening says which admits more, not which is better; it decides no mixed comparison, and weights that do are a further premise. A local test of when a part's gain widens the whole, which is no test of good.

source_adds.en: A named list of human goods and durable influence as admission criteria. The account names no such list; the word technology is absent from its overview, chapters and glossary, and it offers no test of whether one is good.

name.en: Every dossier shows the new problems: no sanctifying, no terminal mechanism

source.locator: Claims 30, 38; Four refusals: Anti-sanctification; Relations (meta-attractor)

sense.en: Any advance may have side effects: misuse, controversy, new inequalities. The new-problems module is mandatory, because a borrower must know the cost. The museum must not sanctify inventions but show their complexity. The README adds that every solution makes a new problem landscape, so no mechanism is terminal.

quote: 本馆不应把发明神圣化，而要展示它们的复杂性

reading.en: Proposed here, in three parts; no live text speaks of inventions. The refusal has a form in the account: no law evaluates, and no closure is good or bad by its type. Cost has forms only under clauses: a rise paid from beyond where a containing family gains nothing; a delivery changing what its task does not list can make a regular pair impossible, excluded by listing unavoidable outputs (the likeness to the module is this read's); in a named band, success changes what the next success needs. 'No terminal mechanism' has a form for a fixed rule's possible, not for problems. [AI reading]

says.en: World, balance, the risen family within a containing family gaining nothing: “the rise is paid from beyond in full”. The record does not show “That drawing from beyond is wrong.”

Reading [AI reading, D45]: “where a delivery changes what its task does not list, a regular pair of possible tasks can be impossible by any means, and constructor theory's demand that a task list its unavoidable outputs is what excludes it”.
A named regulation band, a witness: “success changes what the next success needs, with no outside disturbance”. “Not evidence that judgment is scalar regulation.”

Any process: where every step from some step on is a move of Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening. Reading [AI reading, D45]: “Openness is then a property of how rules keep changing, not of any rule chosen once.”
“No law evaluates; should and better are readings people and AI form.”
「一种闭对生生（生命之延续）开什么、闭什么、为谁，由比较者之读来说，不由类型来说」: scope by the continuation condition, order by whoever holds C, both unasserted [AI reading, D49].

account_adds.en: Past the slack, a dependence breaks unseen by every selection rewarding the rise (05 §6). No loss is called a harm.

source_adds.en: That every advance has costs and every solution makes a new problem landscape, as a claim about actual inventions; misuse and controversy as kinds of cost. The folder also reads this module as the meta-attractor's insight; the glossary's meta-attractor means closed capture and “never” the wider working sense.

name.en: The reframing thesis: insight over technology

source.locator: Claims 33-34, 44; The shape of a civilizational advance

sense.en: What pushes civilization forward is usually not the technology but a new insight, of the kind that redefines the problem rather than answering the old version. Dossiers must show how a problem was misunderstood, moralized, suppressed or ignored, and why the old frame bounded the available solutions.

quote: 真正推动文明前进的，往往不是技术本身，而是一个新的洞察

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text reads redefining a problem or an insight so. Redefining a problem changes what would count as meeting it. The nearest law holds acceptability fixed, and its reading says the relation to double-loop learning depends on changing a governing norm. Nearer the source: an AI reading tells informing from revaluing, and, in a shared model for one decision, a formation evaluating by its current valuation finds no reason to revise it. An old frame bounding solutions has a form: a merged pair is a lost choice, and a coined form returns it. 'Usually' stays unread. [AI reading]

says.en: Near-definitional, witnesses on Revising's process: a course opens a correction where no fitting uniform policy exists at x and one at x', “with one acceptability throughout, the gain coming from the reading, from executability or both”. Reading: “here the acceptability is fixed”.

Reading [AI reading, new]: “Informing and revaluing are two ways one part of a loop can move what another part's reading answers”; for a holding formation evaluating by the current valuation: “by that worth, no reason to revise the valuation”.
Periphery, on revising a formed goal: “Not open discovery of ends.”
Any process: every selection through an old lumping stays expressible through a new one exactly where new indistinguishability implies old, “and a merged old pair supplies a lost choice”.
Any type: where all hold a code merging two senses, “a form coined at one that the code does not give the other, heard by all, makes every formation tell them apart again”.

account_adds.en: With every act counted acceptable, any configuration with an executable act is correctable already, so an opening counts only with acceptability held fixed. On Revising, replenishing alone can open it with the reading unchanged, so insight is neither necessary nor sufficient there.

source_adds.en: The historical thesis that insight usually leads; redefinition of the problem itself, including the discovery of a new end; the typology of misreading (moralize, privatize, suppress, ignore, take as fate).

name.en: A good idea is not an effective change: diffusion asked apart

source.locator: Claim 37; The shape of a civilizational advance

sense.en: A good idea is not an effective change. Diffusion must be asked separately: against what resistance, and through what force, whether the state, the market, grassroots transmission or a crisis.

quote: 一个好想法不等于一个有效改变

reading.en: The same separation in other terms: discrimination, support and enactment come apart in Revising; seeing, valuing and complying are told apart. Spread has minimal models: hearings with an adoption rule, an imposed code, and in the periphery a market share, where selection creates no absent practice and a transition's support cannot be paid from its improvement. These are codes and shares in models, not a force of diffusion of a mechanism, and resistance is not measured. [AI reading]

says.en: “in Revising, discrimination, support and enactment come apart (a correction the stock covers can be blocked by the link, one the link admits can lack stock)”.

targets.part: in Revising, discrimination, support and enactment come apart

says.en: “**Seeing is not valuing**: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter.” “**Coupling is not compliance**: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.”

targets.part: Seeing is not valuing; Coupling is not compliance

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: six conditions at once. “Observation is the first condition, necessary and not sufficient”; all six together still rank nothing.

Any type, runs of hearings: under hearings that take the form heard, the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use; “An imposed code makes all agree”, each formation losing the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges.
Periphery: “a share of none stays none”: “selection does not create an absent practice”. Reading [AI reading, D65]: “a lost capacity needs actual entry, which the share law lacks.”
Periphery, a finite transition: “support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings.”

account_adds.en: These models have no merit in them. From a symmetric start, agreement needs something breaking the symmetry (in a witness, a formation both hear, a preferred form or an order of hearing), and under hearings that take the form heard only forms in use can spread. T7 forbids “a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading”, conjectured of actual metrics.

source_adds.en: Diffusion as its own question, asked of each mechanism: the named forces of spread, resistance as an object of study, and the list of mechanism substrates (materials, institutions, law, movements, commerce).

name.en: Value without mechanism; tool without the problem

source.locator: Claims 21-22, 49; What is actually broken

sense.en: Two field failures. People put forward good value claims and design no mechanism that can land. People build tools without understanding the social problem they face. Movements offering only value and products optimizing only the product both fail.

quote: 有些人提出了很好的价值主张，但没有设计出可以落地的机制

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text draws either link. Value alone has neighbours, none about value claims: in a task protocol, relabelling without rewriting the encoding fails; promises alone force no start, holding on both sides where neither ever moves; in language models an instruction kept no dependent untold. Tool alone has a form: a distinction matters where histories the evidence leaves open need incompatible responses. Apart: the source says such tools fail; the account's centre says a selection can meet its own criterion while what it cannot read is lost, so success shows no understanding. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional, on a versioned task protocol with the practical commitments supplied: “relabelling without rewriting the encoding fails (`CommonTaskRevision.declaration_only_fails`)”.

Any process, periphery module: “Promises do not: “if the other eventually does, I eventually do” holds on both sides where neither ever happens”; in the exchange witness “ignition, which the move defines as spending a reserve, needs one already present” (near-definitional).

Core, given a choice over readings: “A distinction matters for a task where histories compatible with the evidence need incompatible responses”; a policy meets the conditions exactly where every observation class admits a common action. “Tolerances, horizon and repertoire are supplied”.
“The account's centre [AI reading]: a selection can meet its own criterion while what it cannot read is lost, and the laws do not say whether that loss counts.”

“Every selection through a selector's couplings selects histories alike exactly when they are alike through them” (record); near-definitional, its force the supplied premise that a selection goes through the couplings.
T4, IN1 partly passed (with talk, one model of two): “no condition kept an untold dependent”; one model kept the seen dependent in 8 of 10 seasons with the scope, the other “failed even with talk”.
Not shown: “Any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance, or an unconditional or complete ranking of mixed comparisons”.

account_adds.en: An exact reason a tool's success is silent on the setting: differences beyond a selector's couplings stay unselected, however hard it selects. An AI reading adds “Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone.”

source_adds.en: The empirical diagnosis that movements and inventions fail this way, stated without data, and a mechanism that lands as the designer's task. The source's charge can be put to the account itself: its makers offer a way of seeing, with no motivation or compliance shown; its ranking results name the scopes and orders they use, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought.

name.en: Problems of similar structure, linked and indexed

source.locator: Claims 23, 51, 56, 58-59; Why the index is the theory; Found by reading item 11

sense.en: People who think their problem new often face one of similar structure, met before at several levels. So organize by human problem and link exhibits by problem structure, with seven method relations as the vocabulary and typed, confidence-rated links, so a person can travel to structural ancestors. The README finds 'structure' never defined and the promise unfalsifiable as written.

quote: 这些推荐不是因为它们属于同一学科，而是因为它们处理了相似的问题结构

reading.en: Both refuse discipline or shared words as the link. In the account sameness of structure is stated: a map under which steps project and lift; a lumping the step goes alike across; a law whose hypotheses a case is shown to meet. That says what the README finds undefined, for processes and not for problems. For a link it gives a condition, not a check: a fitted rule is right at another case exactly where the world agrees at both, which no data supply. Nothing says a present problem has an ancestor. [AI reading]

says.en: Any process: “The map gives an exact correspondence of finite histories exactly where two things hold: every detailed step projects, and every summary step lifts from each detailed configuration it describes”.

Any type: “a member fitting the world is right at x exactly where the world agrees at x and the lumped observation; the class of all functions is free at every unobserved input”. Lead-in: “what the lumping misses, no data supply.”
相合: 「原文所说的结构，脊柱上有已检查之律与之结构相同。相合不是印证」; 定域 and 相分 defined beside it.
A law with content “can become a science's law for a domain only once the domain is shown to meet its hypotheses”, through a stated correspondence.

“Read as a correspondence, a unification adds no theorem and changes no verdict”; reward, training, natural selection, prices and votes as one selection through couplings: “the laws proved; one law across domains conjectured (T3)”.
理: “a lumping that models structure and change at once: one the step goes alike across”.

account_adds.en: Structural readings fail often: of 88 entries a reviser kept, a second checker corrected 84, and two reads are held unreliable (06 §7.1; the ratio not extended beyond them).

source_adds.en: The promise that a person's present problem has a structural ancestor; an index of human problems; seven method relations; confidence on links.

name.en: Reinvention as a retrieval failure of how history is stored

source.locator: What is actually broken; Claims 20, 24-25; Found by reading item 24

sense.en: Movements, products and inventions keep reinventing the wheel, not from laziness but because encyclopedias and museums store inventions as results, not as problem-solving. The corrective is an index change, intervening before action. The README adds that the mis-shaping may be incentivized.

quote: it is a retrieval failure caused by an indexing decision

reading.en: Proposed here: the retrieval half is read as having a law's form under another name. An index is a map; what matters goes alike across what a map lumps exactly where it is read off it, and a selection through the map selects what matters only there. If what matters is the problem and the store lumps by result, retrieval cannot reach it: this reading's application, near-definitional. No live text speaks of reinvention or its cause; nearest is the account's verdict that its own central results restate known ones. [AI reading]

says.en: Any type; alternatives' equality decided: “What matters goes alike across what a map lumps exactly where it is read off the map, and a selection through the map selecting exactly what matters exists exactly there.” Which map is right, and what matters, are supplied.

Any process: “An exact summary of feasibility cannot identify two configurations that differ on some finite word”; “the access relations that can still form limit what a current abstraction may forget.”
Following theorem, any type: “a recorder of bounded size does not keep its whole history and go on.” Reading [AI reading, D65]: “Learners, archives and genomes are such recorders.”

“None of the central results is new mathematics: each is near-definitional or a known result restated.” An AI review, “the search was not exhaustive”; a column lists “what the closest prior frameworks state that the account does not yet”.

account_adds.en: An exact condition, not a preference for one index: a store serves a selection exactly where what it must find is read off how it lumps. So the corrective holds only for what the new index separates, and a store of bounded size still merges something. The charge also falls on the account, which lists what prior frameworks state that it does not yet.

source_adds.en: That people do reinvent, and this as the cause; how encyclopedias and museums store inventions; re-indexing as the corrective; the incentive to mis-shape; that a problem, and not a result, is what a seeker needs. None is stated live; the repository's search-before-claiming duty is process.

name.en: The eighth module: a method to borrow, adapt or avoid

source.locator: The eighth module is not history; Claims 39, 67, 69, 84

sense.en: The most important part of each exhibit is not history but a method a present actor can borrow, adapt or avoid, written as an action rule and not a slogan. What a user saves is the method, not the exhibit.

quote: 用户可以收藏的不是展品，而是方法

reading.en: Proposed here: borrowing from a case is read as generalizing through a lumping: right where the world agrees at both cases, free where nothing fixes it, and two readers agreeing on every read occasion can part at an untied one. The exits match in format: conditional moves, each with its edge, from models and not from history. One periphery construction installs a method by a tested round and fails with a changed context. No live text addresses an actor's use of a historical case. [AI reading]

says.en: Any type: “a member fitting the world is right at x exactly where the world agrees at x and the lumped observation; the class of all functions is free at every unobserved input”.

Any type, near-definitional: where no read occasion is tied by the lumping, every value there is taken by a selected law agreeing on every reading. Reading [AI reading, new]: “two reporters agreeing on every supervised occasion are selected alike”.

A table of exits, each law with model, hypotheses and edge. “Every capture law here is a two-kind count model, its locks stated without noise.” What it does not show: “That any exit's hypotheses hold of an actual collective, institution or trained system.”

Periphery, everything from task to compliance supplied: a practice round of attempt, response, revision and tested retry installs the context's method in the worker; “missing response or revision, early departure, changed context and untested admission fail.”

account_adds.en: Each exit states where it stops working, including when its window closes.

source_adds.en: That a method a present actor can use is the most important part of an exhibit: methods extracted from historical cases, written for an actor, and the toolbox that carries them.

name.en: The conversion move: a problem turned into a usable tool

source.locator: Claims 28, 35, 46, 56; The eighth module is not history; The gap between the two collections

sense.en: Tangible objects count because they converted a class of human problem into a more tractable, transmissible, usable form. The condom's significance is one move: a problem spanning body, desire, disease, shame and public health became a low-cost, portable, replicable, self-usable tool. One archetype says grand, unregulatable problems must become tools ordinary people can use. The README names these conversion moves, as against regulation moves.

quote: 它们把某类人类问题转化成了更可处理、更可传播、更可使用的形式

reading.en: Proposed here: read as a performer (this read's), a tool has one exact form: what each delivery restores. Then what grows is what can be done with the performer held, only across changes of the performer, while the whole possible never grows; so a tool moves what can be done with it, and that it advances anything is not carried. Low-cost replication has a count: copying runs exactly where the stock covers each round's draw. Neither reads tractable, usable or a problem. [AI reading]

says.en: Any process, each law near-definitional or a witness: a region of the performing part's states performs a task where, from each input, the process “reaches an output with the part in the region again”. “A delivery adds nothing to the whole possible”. Reading [AI reading, D45]: “What grows is what can be done with the performer held, and only across changes of the performer.”

Counts: “Where every unit draws *d* from one stock and becomes *b*, *n* rounds from *k* units run exactly where the stock covers” the rounds' total draw. “that teaching or reproduction copies at a fixed factor is not shown”.

account_adds.en: What a tool delivers and what it widens come apart: on the catalytic cycle a delivery narrows the whole possible, and widening follows deliveries in neither direction.

source_adds.en: The move as what gives an invention its significance; tractability, portability and self-use; a bundle of problems converted at once; the archetype's 'must'; the other relations of that kind (risk transfer, rights redefinition).

name.en: The condom rule: tools for what regulation cannot enter

source.locator: Claims 45-47; The eighth module is not history

sense.en: If a problem occurs in highly private, shameful, dispersed, hard-to-regulate settings, the solution must be low-cost, private, autonomously usable, and must not require people first to change into their ideal selves. It comes from reading the condom as converting a bundle of problems into a portable tool.

quote: 如果一个问题发生在高度私人、羞耻、分散、难以监管的场景里

reading.en: The account does not state it. A form could be proposed and is not stated: a hard-to-regulate setting as lying beyond what couples into a regulating selector, though within a member's closure, so a tool moves selection to one that does couple in. Only that premise has a law, near-definitional. 'Must', cost, privacy, autonomy and shame have no counterpart, whether a case meets the premise is empirical, and the rule rests on one case. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The design rule itself, drawn from one case, as the README's own critique of over-abstraction says; the bundle reading of the condom; shame and dispersal as conditions.

name.en: Good tools do not ask people to become nobler first

source.locator: Claim 48; The eighth module is not history; Found by reading item 15

sense.en: Good civilizational tools usually do not demand that people first become nobler; they offer a better option within real human nature, situations and limits. Design for the humans that exist. The README warns that, unamended, this licenses products that meet people where they are and keep them there.

quote: 好的文明工具，往往不是要求人先变得更高尚

reading.en: A proposal, with no form in the account: the nearest live sentence, kept promises and enforced contracts as 'laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone', sets an act law against a configuration, not institutions against character, and a nobler disposition would change the law too. Where the rest outruns the renewal one member's restraint decides nothing, but that is one member against the rest, not people at large. 'Good' and 'better' rest on C or another named order, with a named scope, most often the continuation condition, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought. [AI reading]

account_adds.en: What a tool's success reads and what it cannot, as a question of couplings and not of its designer's aim: the form the README's worry about products that keep people where they are would have, if such success is a selection through what couples in.

source_adds.en: An anti-perfectionist stance about human nature and how to design for it; a better option offered within limits. A search for human nature, 人性, virtue, nobler and ideal self found no live statement of it.

name.en: Personal failure that a public institution must carry

source.locator: Claim 35; Claim 71 (accessible design); The shape of a civilizational advance; Relations (relational-self-and-datong)

sense.en: One insight archetype: some problems treated as personal failure actually require a public institution to carry them (public health, libraries, accessible design). The 'individual defect' is rewritten as a problem of design or of the public system.

quote: 某些被认为是个人失败的问题，其实需要公共制度来承接

reading.en: Part has a form: admission is read on conditions and requirements together, not on the formation alone; a loss can be made only jointly, the but-for holding for no single part; where the rest outruns the renewal, formations end whatever a member outside it takes; an AI reading tells a fault in organized relations from informed harm. So a loss need not be any one part's. 'Must carry' comes only under C and J1-J4 with the continuation condition for scope, both unasserted, no warrant from outside sought, and fixes no carrier. [AI reading]

says.en: “What can form is what a course *admits*: formations (what takes and gives) whose conditions meet their requirements.” At the root, responsibility is “not shown to differentiate”.
Any process, withholding a supplied map: “a law states exactly when parts make a difference only together” (record), which “Yields no responsibility, duty or ranking.”
World, gate local: “every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least `m` ends, whatever a member outside the rest takes”.
Reading after it [AI reading, D65]: “Kept apart: an omission of the representation, a fault in organized relations (suppressed feedback, blocked exit) and informed harm”.
Conditional (the condition for scope, C for order, J1-J4): “it can warrant building shared capacity without fixing one carrier”; “It does not establish compliance or derive institutional authority”.

account_adds.en: A statement of which part made a difference, by a supplied withholding map, with no blame in it; and overbuilding that depletes the living basis as the conditional result's counterexample.

source_adds.en: A public institution as the carrier, and the institutional cases; shame and moralization as what hides the structure. The account's institution model has no such role.

name.en: The multicellular organism as a system that eliminated the pattern

source.locator: Claim 2; The older question underneath; In Ren's own words 1

sense.en: The first named exception to the runaway dynamic: the multicellular organism, treated as a system, 'successfully eliminated this pattern', and one should ask why and how. Asked in a chat turn, as a question with a premise.

quote: multicellular organism, if treated as a system, successfully eliminated this pattern, can you explain why and how

reading.en: The case has a checked form: a rise confined to a whole ends with it, whatever selection within raised, and where next founders carry their founder's value, selection among wholes decides. So 'eliminated' narrows: the rise within is bounded by named clauses, not removed. Sequestering is a hypothesis 'stating an outcome, not a mechanism', so the source's 'how' stays open. 'Successfully' reads from the whole's side: under the condition, ending a cancer is read as mixed. Known results restated. [AI reading]

says.en: “A lineage confined to a whole's conditions in excess has no member once they end, whatever selection within raised” (record); sequestering is “a hypothesis stating an outcome, not a mechanism”; “that a given tumour meets the clauses, or a germ line is sequestered, is empirical”. Not shown: “How parts first come to live as one” (record).

“Predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]”; “Retaining adds no ending and ranks nothing”. Under the continuation condition for scope, which ranks nothing; order is C or another named order; neither asserted.

account_adds.en: In a witness a lineage depending on a condition outside the body still has a member a cohort after the end; without sequestering, a variant selected within lowers the founding value. Neither is called better: a ranking is under C or another named order, with a named scope, most often the continuation condition, both unasserted, no warrant from outside sought.

source_adds.en: That the organism eliminated the pattern, as a success, and the explanation why and how, including the policing the account leaves unstated: apoptosis appears only as a mixed case.

name.en: The research question: which systems resisted, and what the museum dropped of it

source.locator: Claims 2-3; The older question underneath; The gap between the two collections; What was lost item 1

sense.en: The method: generalize the failure dynamic, enumerate the exceptions, extract what they share; hunter-gatherer bands and others are later candidates. The README's AI reading: the museum kept this format and dropped its subject. Conversion and regulation are different shapes, and no module asks what kept a mechanism from capture or what happened when it was captured.

quote: these are conversion moves, not regulation moves

reading.en: The account takes up the regulation side the museum dropped: loops that lock, named exits, routes of correction taken over. Its nearest answer to 'what they share' is an AI reading of nine constraints of social viability as laws, 'not survival axioms', with 'regulation and passing are supplied'. It gets them from models, not exceptions, says 'No guarantee', and shows none of an actual collective. 'Worked' and 'resisted' read nothing until a comparison is named. [AI reading]

says.en: “**No guarantee.**” “**exits** from the loops that lock a collective, each holding under stated hypotheses”; achievable “Yes, for named exits”, “none shown to hold of an actual collective”.

Reading [AI reading, D48]: “The constraints an account of social viability lists are read as laws of what a course does under stated hypotheses”; nine rows. Limits: “regulation and passing are supplied”. “The constraints are not survival axioms.” “Term limits, audits, courts and antitrust carry what an actor's acts do back into what selects the rule”.

Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: “A second order, corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit, is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明 themselves”. “That readers are minds is a reading; none of this ranks a locked loop: what it keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.”

“**Institutions and people.** One kind of institution has one minimal model on the root [AI reading], a rule rebuilt from the members it limits”; “no actual institution is shown to meet its hypotheses”; “no test of a thesis run so far has human participants.”

account_adds.en: Windows: a reading of what lies beyond the share counts only while its readers are not yet the fewer [AI reading, D67]. What comes back to shapers alone decides, at a step, whether control over the rule is selected (counts models).

source_adds.en: A comparative collection of exceptions and what they share, the question itself; hunter-gatherer bands, which a search does not find; conversion moves; a state for what worked and was destroyed.

name.en: Value systems as regulators; equality as stability

source.locator: Claim 4; The older question underneath; In Ren's own words 3

sense.en: Historical societies held value systems that kept selfishness from compounding beyond regulatory control, which is why they lasted or held equilibrium. This, and not morality, is the root reason equality is needed.

quote: This is the root cause we need equality

reading.en: Nearest forms, none about value systems: a reading against the share stops the rise a lock rests on; two-sided regulation settles a level within a bound; a rule held by members can be the wrong rule. 06 reads 荀子's limit on wants by the joint-excess law. Why societies lasted is not addressed. Equality is not derived as stability: in counts, what comes to every member alike pulls the rule toward even and does not decide whether it favours the shapers. The account nowhere says equality is needed; each ranking names its holder, scope and order, the continuation condition and C one pair examined in 07, neither asserted. [AI reading]

says.en: Any type: with the reading against the share, “the rise the lock rests on does not form”.
World: “within it, opposing, the level settles at `m`; beyond it an opposing exchange crosses and can oscillate for ever”.

Counts: “At a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where `c ≤ s`, whatever `p` comes to every member alike”; “a larger `p` pulls the rule toward even”; “With nothing coming back and a cost, the shapers' share falls strictly at every step”. Reading: “nothing here ranks open rule-making above capture: the account ranks only under a reading it names.”

Any type, on a formation’s level: “a transform strictly concave up to a bound ranks higher moving one step of continuation”, of continuation and not holdings, under a graded significance. Not a reason of stability; the ranking is the graded premise’s.

Reading [AI reading, new]: “neither the rule's being present nor its being held decides: a rule can be kept and be the wrong rule”. “**Not modelled:** why a teacher turns anyone away, conduct other than entry, sanctions, who decides a revision, mixed tenures, schism, records and purposes.”
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 荀子「求而无度量分界，则不能不争」与「两者相持而长」，是合取超取之律及其逆，界放在欲与物的关系上.

“no law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping.” A ranking of it names its scope and order; the continuation condition and C are one pair of readings 07 examines.

account_adds.en: Positions sum to zero, so a rise needs a fall (05 §3): conflict stays real and no rule removes it. A regulator lags wherever the world changes faster than it reads [AI reading].

source_adds.en: The historical explanation of longevity; value systems rather than entry rules or count models as the regulator; equality as a stability reason. The one law on equal shares (least-parts-and-equal-shares) concerns meeting needs, not stability.

name.en: Traditions as social technology, with structural advantage

source.locator: Claims 6, 8; Terms: social technology; In Ren's own words 6, 8-9

sense.en: Confucianism is an excellent cognitive framework, a social technology, judged from cognitive and neural science, and classical Chinese narratives have clear structural, not merely moral, advantages against being consumed by Moloch. Are there others of that calibre? The README says the museum's own collection dropped this category.

quote: 还有其他同样优秀的social technology吗

reading.en: 06 reads such texts passage by passage against the spine, 50 of them Confucian, as agreement, scope or divergence, and credits no tradition with an advantage or a calibre; the first page says they name the grammar's terms, not its operations. 'Excellent' and 'advantage' would have to say what compares, among what. Its gaps table draws forms from both sides: 二柄 and 壹 for capture through the rule; 天之道, 宽猛相济 and 中和 for two-sided regulation. Forms read, not credit of efficacy. [AI reading]

says.en: “**The classical texts** name the grammar's terms, not its operations; the readings are AI's”.
Assessment [AI reading, D54]: 248 passages each classed; 儒家 50, of them 17 相合, 21 定域, 12 相分. Limit: selection favours passages with structure to read, so 礼的细节 and others 「最可能进一步相分，表中段数低估了它们」.
Gaps named by passages and since proved: 经由规则的捕获, from 韩非“二柄”, 管子“据有余而制不足”, 商君书“壹”; 一个水平的双向调节，及迟到读法下的调节, from 老子“天之道”, 左传“宽猛相济”, 中庸“中和”.

account_adds.en: Four non-relational layers recur in the texts, each answered inside the same tradition (06 §六); a Confucian critic's 以理杀人 is read as a model applied where others' differences do not couple in.

source_adds.en: Tradition as engineered technology; a comparative judgement of calibre; a cognitive-science warrant; resistance to Moloch, a word the live account does not use.

name.en: A tradition's high point and degenerate mode coexist

source.locator: Claim 7; In Ren's own words 5; Genealogy 2026-03

sense.en: A high point and a degenerate mode of one tradition coexist: Confucian logic also became the value and pursuit of those who held or sought power, especially in prosperous periods. The README reads this as the anti-sanctification rule applied to a social technology.

quote: 中国你说的高光时刻和退化模式是同时存在的

reading.en: The account does not state it: nothing on a tradition's high point and degenerate mode, or on Confucian logic becoming power's value. A proposal, kept: a counter-rule read from the share it selects locks as the rule it replaced did, and 07 reads the imperial examination so (D68, the earlier work's example, so by descent). A tradition turning so would have that form only if its reading comes from its carriers' share. The law gives a lock, not a coexistence. The source's 退化 is a valuation, not the glossary's degeneration; 'high' and 'degenerate' would have to say what compares. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The historical claim about Confucian logic and prosperity, and the coexistence of the high and the degenerate in one tradition.

name.en: Halakha read as decentralized coordination engineering

source.locator: Claim 9; In Ren's own words 10 (brought forward and endorsed, the README notes)

sense.en: Talmud/Halakha is, from an engineering perspective, possibly the most successful decentralized coordination system in history: dissent preserved, micro-behaviour normed, no territory and no army. A passage brought forward and endorsed in a chat, not authored there; a claim about what it achieved, not a study.

quote: 从工程角度看这可能是人类历史上最成功的去中心化协调系统

reading.en: Proposed here: three features have forms, none about this tradition, of which the account says nothing and this reader knows little. No centre: valid local plans under faithful projections pair into a valid joint plan, from a supported start. Kept dissent: a pool adds exactly the differences members hold, an imposed code loses them; a resolution rests later cohorts only where records offer what was resolved (dissent kept falls outside: this reading's). No army: consent and penalty are one witness until removal is in the net. 'Most successful' names nothing it reads. [AI reading]

says.en: Any process, periphery module: “With faithful joint-to-local projections and valid local plans”, two properties holding on the covered start, every pair of locally authorized moves jointly allowed with a successor wherever both hold, and every admitted joint successor keeping both, “the paired finite plan is valid”; in the exchange witness “ignition, which the move defines as spending a reserve, needs one already present” (near-definitional).
Reading [AI reading, D54] of 和而不同: 「成员有清单、各自之耦合可判定时，池所增加的恰是差别，相同者合用什么也不增加」.

targets.part: Reading D54 of 和而不同

says.en: Any type: “An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges”. “A resolution written back into the records that later cohorts read rests from the next cohort on”, records written to offer exactly what was resolved.

Root, a family of models: a rule of entry passed through members, “with no compliance and no records”. “**Not modelled:** why a teacher turns anyone away, conduct other than entry, sanctions, who decides a revision, mixed tenures, schism, records and purposes.”
Reading [AI reading, D69]: “An institution kept by its members' consent and one held by penalties” are one witness read socially, “told apart once their removal is in the net”. “not a new law”.

account_adds.en: A test of what no army would mean: keep and penalty are told apart only when removal enters the net. Being joined through couplings does not suffice for agreement.

source_adds.en: The reading of Talmud/Halakha itself; norming of micro-behaviour; the comparative superlative. The one institution model leaves out the compliance, sanctions and records the source's case turns on. The words Talmud, Halakha and 塔木德 do not appear in the live account.

name.en: The 奏折 as a zero-trust protocol

source.locator: Claims 12-13; In Ren's own words 13-14, 16 (endorsed)

sense.en: The 奏折 is a formatted protocol and the object of study is the whole bureaucratic system: in a low-bandwidth, high-latency, zero-trust setting, minimal metadata plus structured language gave accurate, private, auditable two-way communication.

quote: 在一个低带宽、高延迟、零信任的环境里

The question beneath it, information upward, has partial forms, and so does a limit on audit, both in cx-hsm-information-upward. 05 §12 models no records. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The reading of a historical institution as protocol engineering, the claim about what that protocol achieved, and the bureaucratic system as the object.

name.en: How a large polity gets accurate information upward under adverse incentives

source.locator: The older question underneath; Claims 12-14

sense.en: The README's AI gloss of what the 奏折 inquiry was after: a governance question, how a large polity gets accurate information upward under adversarial incentives, asked of real institutions and across civilizations. It is the older question beneath the protocol reading.

quote: how does a large polity get accurate information upward under adversarial incentives?

reading.en: Forms in part. An AI reading lists information true to the world among laws of viability; another reads an institution's link as its rule of reading what members report. Bandwidth and latency: one schedule's windows, knowledge growing a link a step. Witnesses: a model admitting every witness's failure blocks every certificate, so literal zero trust gets none. Audit: logs cannot establish mediation, an extra write path leaving the public view identical. Adverse incentive has one narrow form, in weights: complying when read and acting by its own law when not stands first where keeping outweighs the loss. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D48], a row: “Information true to the world | selections through a selector's couplings, together, separate exactly what it couples apart”. “The constraints are not survival axioms.”
World, balance: “For conditions distinct by name, one schedule's windows have reciprocals summing to at most one”.
World: “what it can know grows by at most one link a step”.

Any type of witnesses compared decidedly; roster, envelopes and complete reports supplied: “Two different answers cannot both fit a complete report exactly where their envelopes are cross-separated”; “a model admitting every witness's failure blocks every certificate.”

Periphery instance of a law on any process: “an extra write path can leave the public view identical, so logs cannot establish mediation”. That the runtime is completely mediated is supplied; “the writes act on represented control and fault configurations, not on a device” (record).

Natural weights, two stages, four plans; near-definitional, with witnesses: it stands above every other plan “exactly where `k_O V + c T < k_C V`”. Whose the weights are is a reading. ALIGNMENT: “Deception itself is not represented”; concealment only where a selection shown the law would keep it less.
Reading after it: “For an institution, the link is its rule of reading what its members report, by which line rather than how many”. 03's Open lists “an institution revising its rule of reading”.

account_adds.en: A bound on what any reader can reach, whatever its honesty; a condition under which witnesses can be told apart at all; and a second order, corruption of audit read as a loop reaching the routes of 明 [AI reading, 02 T7].

source_adds.en: The question as asked of actual polities; a recipient's false belief and the intention to cause one, which the account does not represent; what makes reports accurate under those incentives; how an institution revises its reading, which 03 lists as open.

name.en: Comparison across civilizations and scales; the narrow axis corrected

source.locator: Claims 14-15; In Ren's own words 7, 15

sense.en: Governance protocols are compared across civilizations and down the scale ladder to groups. The Chinese and American axis is itself too narrow: other cultures must be read on the self-others and individualism-collectivism spectrum. The README says the museum specification dropped that correction.

quote: just realized i might be to bounded by chinese and american perspective

reading.en: The live account holds no such comparison: its classical chapter reads Chinese texts, its reviews Buddhist thought, philosophy, logic, alignment and the sciences. So the source's self-correction bears on the account's own reading base: 06's 248 passages are Chinese. 'No cultural origin validates or disqualifies a method' is another point. Its 'cell, organ, body, ecosystem' is one biological case, not a ladder of polities. This crosswalk's domain list aims at the breadth, but stands in process. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The comparative programme across civilizations and scales, and the self-correction on bias.
