name.en: Cultures read at collective cognitive dynamics, living cases included

source.locator: Claims 10-11; In Ren's own words 11-12

sense.en: Cultures must be read at the level of collective cognitive dynamics, not customs; the surface is the wrong resolution. The search includes living cases: a culture still of high harmony, cooperation and openness, one not organized by collective trauma.

quote: Too surface, I want to know what cognitive dynamics, thought dynamics are at play collectively

reading.en: The account's collective reading is thinner and exact: codes formed by hearing, and readers counted by kind inside a selection. That those readers are minds, institutions or a culture is itself marked a reading, its collectives are said to be pools, consciousness open, and the one test of a judge as a pool of readers read by kind failed. So a culture's 'cognitive dynamics' is reachable only as who reads what, and no culture is read. Harmony and trauma have no counterpart. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D67]: the scorecard is read from the share because those it selects are, in growing number, its readers. “That readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading, kept from D58.”
T7, on actual metrics, conjectured: “in one trained system the lock formed, and the bridge, that its judge is a pool of readers read by kind, failed”.
Not shown: anything of a collective of consciousness: “the theory's collectives are pools of couplings and readers counted by kind, and consciousness is open”.
Any type: a code is a formation's map from senses to forms; a group agreeing at a sense keeps agreeing through every hearing closed for it. How long agreement takes is not stated.

account_adds.en: A conditional: where a culture's readers are drawn from what its rule selects, what it reads can lock. A reading, shown of no culture; the mechanism would be selection forming its own readers, not a mentality.

source_adds.en: Collective cognition as a level of study, the demand for a living culture as evidence, and harmony and collective trauma as what is read.

name.en: No unreviewed content in the voice of a factual archive

source.locator: Four refusals: Anti-authority-laundering, Anti-fake-governance; Claims 86-91

sense.en: Content without sources, review and licensing is prototype copy and must not be published in the voice of a formal archive. The guard is machine-enforced: public mode against unready content fails the build, and public release needs two reliable sources and approved fact and sensitivity review. A form must not imply a review pipeline that does not exist.

quote: 没有来源和审核的内容只能作为原型文案，不应以正式事实档案口吻公开

reading.en: Same concern, another mechanism, and they part at publishing. The account labels what each statement is and says on its first page who checked what, so it implies no review that has not happened. It does not withhold text with no recorded review by a person; it says so. The museum's rule would hold such text back. Its own reading adds that no check inside the work can show it serves its purpose. Practice on both sides, not a law. [AI reading]

says.en: “the proofs are checked by machine and the rest by AI review, the person who directs the work has read its important parts, and no independent human review is recorded yet”.

targets.part: no independent human review is recorded yet

says.en: “Every result statement in the chapters opens with one bold label, and a proved result names its base.” Theorem, conditional, assessment, reading and open are told apart.
Reading [AI reading, D66]: “no check run inside the work can show that the work serves what it is for”; “Only coupling those in widens what the work's selection reaches”.

account_adds.en: Standings beyond true or false, and the rule that a frozen rule fixes the scoring, not that it measures what the thesis names.

source_adds.en: Refusal to publish below a floor: a build that fails rather than a label that warns. Also a publication state machine, a source table, sensitivity review and image licensing.

name.en: AI may only propose structural links; a person writes them back

source.locator: Claim 115; The counterexamples: 'Structural similarity is a soft claim'

sense.en: Future AI recommendation is admitted only under constraint: AI may generate candidate relations only, each with type, dimension, confidence and reason; low-confidence ones are not shown publicly; a human review writes them back into the data.

quote: future AI-generated relations may only be candidates

reading.en: The account meets the same risk differently. Its structural readings are made, revised and checked by AI and stand published with an AI label, no person's review of them recorded; it answers unreliability with more AI reads and stated counts, not a person's gate. Under the museum's rule 06's correspondences would stay candidates, and so would this file. The source's rule is a design, and the account does not say it is wrong: review by people is what it says is missing. [AI reading]

says.en: “The corpus was classified sentence by sentence in two frozen rounds by AI, and no person's review of the classification is recorded; which sentence reads as which theorem is AI reconstruction”.
「修订者原样保留的 88 条，第二位检查者读后 84 条要改正」; 「只经两读的条目不可靠；三读之后仍可能有错」. Classes, readings and names are AI's [AI reading, D62].
Reading [AI reading, D66]: “Only coupling those in widens what the work's selection reaches: review by people”, tests on trained systems, models of the test systems.

account_adds.en: A measured rate of error in structural reading, and that three reads are not enough to be sure.

source_adds.en: A human write-back gate and a confidence floor for what may be shown.

name.en: Against slogans and survivorship: conditions and failures on each method

source.locator: Claims 84, 98-100; What was lost item 7; Found by reading items 13-14

sense.en: Methods must not become slogans: each reserves steps, antiPatterns, notApplicableWhen and failureSignals, and a core method should rest on exhibits from several domains. The concept wants failed mechanisms marked; the README warns that a method library with no failure record is a survivorship machine, and that ten seeds are pretty examples.

quote: 它们是避免方法库口号化的长期接口

reading.en: The account's statements carry the same slots, and fills them: hypotheses, what is not shown, what would show it wrong, failed tests reported. 08 gives the anti-slogan point a form: a law with content forbids through its hypotheses. The museum's fields are all empty, by its README. Survivorship itself has no law: a finite record not certifying renewal is a neighbour, and a repertoire omitting the actual rule can answer falsely. 06 names the same bias in its mapping. [AI reading]

says.en: A column on what would show each wrong; T1 “passed in two simulations and on held-out yeast regimes the analyst had seen, failed in four settings”.

targets.part: the column on what would show each wrong

says.en: “a law of the root holds of every carrier, relation and class, so it forbids no relation, and a law with content is conditional and forbids through its hypotheses”.

The renewable process: for every horizon, two runs agree before it and then one renews and one consumes, so a reading fixed by h steps that includes every renewing run includes a consuming one. The home says the force lies in the words every renewing run, “which overdraws before `h`”.
Any type of questions, candidate rules listed, observations supplied: “a repertoire omitting the actual rule can answer confidently and falsely.”
Limit [AI reading, D54]: 「映射偏向有结构可读的段落」; those left out 「最可能进一步相分，表中段数低估了它们」.

account_adds.en: A failure reported where a thesis's frozen test failed, and the wording changed to say so: failure entered into the text, not left in a separate wing.

source_adds.en: A place for failed historical mechanisms and 'do not reuse', a wing for the unsolved, a rule of support across domains, and survivorship as a bias of a collection of methods.

name.en: Open with a threshold: nomination, curators, two sources

source.locator: Claims 79-81, 89; Found by reading item 16

sense.en: The museum is never finished and open to nomination, but openness is not no threshold: candidates answer the dossier's questions, curators review, discussion and revision go on; public release needs two reliable sources. It would be neither rigid authority nor arbitrary platform. The README finds who curates, appeal and withdrawal undefined.

quote: 但开放不等于无门槛

reading.en: Proposed here: two sources counted by type can share a cause. In the account reviewers count by independent causes: two moved under one cause fail while every name is kept, with faithful reviewers assumed; a copied witness adds nothing, and whether mere agreement does is not shown. Readers drawn from the selected can lock a rule, and a pool recruiting only through itself couples into a loss only as its course without the loss would, and a pool comes to couple into what it does not yet couple into only through an admission not made through it or through members its course would hold anyway (each a witness). These laws locate the README's gap on curators; they do not speak of museums. [AI reading]

says.en: Pure core, fault formulas and bounds supplied, faithful reviewers: “Reviewers count by independent causes, not names.” Not shown: “That the formulas are the actual causes of failure: they are supplied bounds” (record).
Any type, finite roster: a witness copying one already on it changes no certificate. “That a witness merely agreeing with another, without copying it, adds nothing is not shown”.
Assessment: “shared inquiry adds checks only where they are differently vulnerable”.
Any type: read the rule as the pool of its readers' readings; the rule read is then a monotone function of the share exactly where the others' reading is not above the carriers'.

“a pool recruiting only through itself couples into a loss only as its course without the loss would”; “a pool comes to couple into what it does not yet couple into only through an admission not made through it” (witness) or “through members its course would hold anyway” (witness).

account_adds.en: Independence of causes as the count, where the source counts sources by type; and differently vulnerable as what a further check must be.

source_adds.en: The governance loop of open nomination, public discussion, curatorial review and revision, and the honest refusal to simulate it in v0.1.

name.en: 活博物馆 as 生生 applied to knowledge

source.locator: Relations (becoming); Terms: living museum

sense.en: The folder relates itself to the account this way: the living museum is 生生 applied to knowledge, a system that goes on generating and is never finished, rather than a finished archive.

quote: 活博物馆 is 生生 applied to knowledge

reading.en: The account's 生生 is the continuation of life, and 'nor any new organization': a growing knowledge system is not a case of it by name. What the source means is nearer another law: under a fixed rule the possible does not keep widening, so openness is in how rules keep changing, which is enough for neither. The sentence that an account of an unfolding is not finished by sealing it uses a law by analogy, and says so. [AI reading]

says.en: 生生: “the continuation of life, life wider than the biological and AI within it, its extent unfinished [AI reading, D1].” “Neither the grammar's `«生生»` (renewal without end), nor 02's generation (生成) as such, which allows loss, nor any new organization.” T8 offers it, for life, as a way of seeing, binding no one.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: “Keeping it widening needs the rule held to change without end, and its changing without end is not enough.” “Nothing here says which changes keep it widening, or that any actual collective can make them.”
“The work is not a flow, and the law is used here only by analogy: an account of an unfolding that keeps generating is not finished by sealing it.”

account_adds.en: Completion read three ways, one an exact statement of what cannot be shown.

source_adds.en: A knowledge institution's revisability as a way of being alive, where how an institution revises its rule of reading is on 03's Open list; a museum built against the museum as dead holding.

name.en: The dropped hall: how humans reduced violence

source.locator: The gap between the two collections; What was lost item 2; Claim 52; Found by reading item 12

sense.en: One of twelve proposed halls, how humans reduced violence, which the README calls the one closest to the original research question. It survives nowhere in the specification, as gallery, method or seed exhibit, and the README takes the silent drop as evidence of drift from regulation to conversion.

quote: 人类如何降低暴力

reading.en: The hall's question has a form only for a loop. An AI reading takes an exchange of harms as a loop: answering in kind keeps the difference, answering more runs away; a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less. 06 reads 止戈 by that law and marks its frame of power as divergence. That humans reduced violence is not stated, no law calls it worse, and the word is absent from the live account. [AI reading]

says.en: Any type; World for the ring read on flows: “a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less”; with whole-number factors a loop closes at once, keeps, or exceeds every bound, “never closing gradually”.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: “An exchange of harms is a loop: answering in kind keeps the difference, answering more runs away, so conflict institutions are links of another kind”.
Reading [AI reading, D48], a row on bounded conflict: a loop closes a difference “only through a link giving back less than it received (compensation, arbitration, absorption)”.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 「力之环只经一个回给少于所受的环节才闭合，一次战胜是截断而不是止息」; 「但其框架是权力之框架（保大、定功、示子孙），记为相分。理论不说武的本义是止戈，也不说止戈否定一切武力。」

account_adds.en: A structural limit on what ending a conflict can mean: where every link gives on at least what it receives, the difference never falls. What a closing keeps or closes for what continues is ranked only under a named scope and order, most often the continuation condition and C, neither asserted.

source_adds.en: The historical claim that humans reduced violence, and how; the hall as a subject of study; the drop read as a drift.

name.en: 文言's grammar is the surface syntax of the ontology

source.locator: The argument, 'The load-bearing novelty'; claims 17-21

sense.en: 实词 are polymorphic primitives dispatched by position (王天下, 天下王, 王道); 虚词 are typed edges carrying relation-kind; a passage's type is inferred as Hindley-Milner infers, and 文气 is that inference. Indo-European is nominal typing, 文言 structural typing: a categorical difference. Marked the project's most novel claim.

quote: 实词 = polymorphic primitives typed structurally; 虚词 = typed edges; 理 = inferred type

reading.en: The account names this scheme and retires it: its grammar is a calculus of relations on a carrier, written from selected sentences, not 文言's own syntax, and 古文 stating this grammar is listed as not shown. Its name table's one concept, one name opposes polymorphism only in form: that is a discipline of its own code, no finding about 文言. No position-dispatch, inference or typing claim about 文言 stands live. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: 「早期以文言为形式语言之方案（九虚词为核、实词按位定型、一原始之“間”）已为根之文法取代，其完备之说未证」.
未示: 「古文陈述了这套文法」, 计划自己举的乙例都需要前提; 语言或传统天然是关系的: 「关系的起点是一条主导线索，在最早一层最强，不是每一体系的性质」.
Definition (convention) [AI reading, D62]: 名表守六条：「一概念一名，一名一概念」; 名锚于现行主干之 Lean 声明. Stated on the World model, not on `Becoming.Grammar`.

account_adds.en: The grammar forbids nothing as a language, and any carrier serves; classical sentences are tested in it, not treated as it.

source_adds.en: The whole linguistic thesis, which the folder itself says would be stronger as a gradient (its critique 48).

name.en: A nine-particle kernel is STLC-complete; 者 is the λ-binder

source.locator: The λ-calculus test; claims 44-46, 50

sense.en: Ren's intuition: grammatical characters are mostly formal-logic operators, and concept characters are built from one root plus operators. The kernel 者 之 非 而 凡 即 也 是 令 is asserted STLC-complete; 者 binds as λ; 古文 is λ plus temporal composition, aspect and effect. Offered as intuition; the evaluators were never designed.

quote: 文言 may be natively STLC-complete.

reading.en: The live text reports the completeness claim as unproved and leaves one thing standing, a test: fix a sub-language and derivation rules, then try them on historical sentences not used in design. The test has not been run, and nothing live maps 者 to a binder. [AI reading]

says.en: 「其完备之说未证；所提“小而可检的文言内核”仍是一项检验：固定子语言与派生规则，以未参与设计的历史句子检验。」 A reading, D54.

account_adds.en: A stated acceptance test on sentences outside the design.

source_adds.en: The λ mapping (之/其/所 as variables, 学而时习之者 as λx), and 而, 也, 矣, 令 as time, aspect and effect beyond λ. Found nowhere live.

name.en: A finite set of operators acting on unbounded atoms

source.locator: Claims 31-32, 46; own words 19, 63

sense.en: 文言 has two layers: a small stable operator kernel supplies topology and a large context-sensitive layer fills content. 而 is sequential composition, ordered and non-commutative (学而时习之), carrying time. 非 negates. Ren endorsed this as exactly his meaning, and redirected the search from names of mathematical objects to operators.

quote: 古文's generative system is extremely simple — close to a finite set of 虚字 operators acting on an infinite set of 实字 atoms.

reading.en: 06 retires the kernel's claim. The form recurs at another object: a few operations on relations, Tarski's relation calculus with four differences, named with characters, and the names do not mean the operations came from the texts. They act on relations, not 实字. Of Ren's nine only 而 and 非 name grammar operations, 则 from the six added; the 中华本's eleven share none of the nine. Claim 46's 而 carries time; the grammar's 而 is composition. [AI reading]

says.en: 「已为根之文法取代，其完备之说未证」. Reading [AI, D54].

Definition. A relation (际) with operations: 而 composition, first R then S; 逆, 合, 非 converse, meet, complement; 则, 谓 inclusion and pointwise equivalence; 一, 静 the full relation and identity; 及 reach. Time's order is the reach of the condition relation.
凡例 fixes one structure for each of eleven 虚词 (若、则、故、必、或、皆、莫、莫不、屡、不、未); 「它还不是以未参与设计之句检验过的文言内核」 [AI reading, D62].
「这些运算是塔斯基关系演算之运算而有四处不同」, 「并以汉字命名：名取自古文，不表示运算出自古文」.

account_adds.en: Lean proves laws of the grammar's operations on every carrier. Separately, the 中华本's 凡例, on the World model, tells 未 from 不 and 故 from 则, which early Lean had merged.

source_adds.en: 者, 之, 也, 即, 凡, 令, 是 as operators, time inside 而, and any claim that the kernel describes 文言 itself.

name.en: 虚词 as logical operators: 凡 ≅ ∀, 或 ≅ ∨, 非(非 X) ≡ X

source.locator: Claims 124, 86, 48

sense.en: Full first-order logic is expressible with 虚词 as typed operators: 凡 ∀, 有 ∃, 莫 ¬∃, 若…则 →, 而 ∧, 或 ∨, 者 λ. Tier −1's meta-laws include 非(非 X) ≡ X. The folder also reads 而 as sequential composition (claim 46), so 而 carries two senses in it.

quote: Full first-order logic is expressible in 文言

reading.en: No live text claims 文言 expresses first-order logic. Particles get one fixed structure in the 中华本, on the World model, constructively: 不 X derives a contradiction from X, 或 must show its branch, 莫不 is weaker than 皆. So 非(非 X) ≡ X is not given: read for every carrier, 有無相生 equals double-negation elimination, and 不俱當 equals weak excluded middle. 而 in the grammar is composition only. Tested on no sentence outside the design. [AI reading]

says.en: 凡例为十一个虚词各定一种结构：「不 X」是由 X 推出矛盾，「未 X」只说到此所读者既不使 X 然、也不排除它；「或」是构造的，须示其为何支；「莫不」弱于「皆」，回到皆须每员定然否.
Definition. 而 composition, first R then S; 非 complement. The grammar imports only Lean's prelude.
Theorem (root), lemmas. 「有無相生」两向成立, 对一切载体与一切标, 恰等于对一切命题 `¬¬Q → Q`; 《墨经》「不俱當，必或不當」对一切谓词成立, 恰等于弱排中: 「它是一个逻辑前提，不是关于物的前提」. 纯核 is constructive.

account_adds.en: The constructive distinctions (未 from 不, 莫不 from 皆), which early Lean had merged.

source_adds.en: A full first-order translation; 凡, 有, 者, 所 as binders; 非(非 X) ≡ X; 而 also as conjunction.

name.en: 墨家 supplies the native minimal logic: 同 is a modern equivalence relation

source.locator: Claims 121-123

sense.en: 体/兼, 同/异, 类, 故 and 法 are a native minimal logical vocabulary. 同，异而俱处于之 is an equivalence relation. 同异交得 grounds information as distinction. 小故/大故 are necessary versus sufficient condition. 故 carries cause and proof at once.

quote: 同，异而俱处于之 — sameness as an alignment relation among distinct co-located items, i.e. a modern equivalence relation

reading.en: Here the account did take its grammar from classical definitions, as AI reconstructions tested in Lean; the operations are Tarski's, only their names from the texts. The form of its one main relation is read from 墨经's 故, the word 缘 alone from Buddhist texts; 化, 成坏, 同, 复, 通 follow, not the folder's 位/际/化/理. Its 同 reads 俱於之一 as belonging to one, which the folder's quotation omits, so 'is an equivalence' is scoped by a counterexample. [AI reading]

says.en: C-01 故：缘之所本. 读法 (AI): 文法读“x 为 y 之缘”为“y 之成，有 x 在其中”，与「所得而後成」同形; 「“缘”字取自佛典」; 「文法之缘只说必要，不说充分」; 小故读为必要而不充分之条件，大故读为充要 (依校本). Known weak: 大故一句有异文.
Theorem (root). 每物恰属一者时，同于是类，一般的所属关系不保证传递（三元之反例，见证）. 「这些读法不是原文自身之义的恢复」. Each reading as a definition is an AI reconstruction following the commentary named.
Reading [AI, D69]: the 墨经 names four samenesses, each a class once the whole, place or respect it relies on is fixed; 類同 need not be transitive until its respect is fixed (`«同于不必传递»`, a witness).
读法 (AI): 一类所分开者，在“一”之类下同、在该类下异 (`«同异交得»`，对一切载体证出). 「此证几乎是定义的重述」.
读法 (AI): 二者以一关系俱属于一; 每物属于一且只属于一时，同于是类. Known weak: 「Lean 只证了充分的一面」; 说之首字作“侗”，读为“同”只依牒字之对齐.

account_adds.en: The counterexample; that 缘 says only necessity, which needs a net of possibilities; that the 通 reading needs both directions; and that Lean checks the given derivation, not the ancients' meaning.

source_adds.en: 墨家's vocabulary as a native minimal logic, whole; 故 as cause, proof and program at once (Curry-Howard), 法 as function, 同异交得 as the ground of information, 体/兼 as the native mereology.

name.en: ZFC in 文言 from 体/兼, and pairing and power among the axioms

source.locator: Mathematics as a facet; claims 121, 145, 53, 148

sense.en: 體，分于兼 gives a native mereology, and all eight ZFC axioms are stated in 文言: 偶 for pairing, 体类 for power set (凡兼，立其体之兼). The cumulative hierarchy reads 系含系. The source bounds this: expressive, not proof, equivalence, modulo encoding.

quote: All eight ZFC axioms are stated in 文言

reading.en: The folder and the account read 體 alike, as part of a whole; no live line rejects that. They differ on the standard. The folder writes 偶 and 体类 as new sentences in 文言, showing expressibility. The account asks whether the corpus uses a pair with projections, finds none in the eight books read, and leaves pairing and power, which fix how strong the grammar is, a conjecture with no witness. [AI reading]

says.en: Open: 《墨经》「體，分於兼也」「體，若二之一，尺之端也」说的是部分与整体、度之端; 「要有一处语料用例给出带投影的函数性配对，才能表明它」.
读法 (AI): 不是带投影的函数性配对. Known weak: “语料中没有配对”只据第一轮所读八部书; “體”在墨经中多义，未逐一检.
Open, Pairing and power: 「That the corpus gives the functional projections pairing would need is a conjecture with no corpus witness.」

account_adds.en: The test: a corpus use with projections. Why it matters: it decides how strong the grammar is.

source_adds.en: ZFC, MLTT and category theory written in 文言, with 数 as von Neumann ordinals.

name.en: Recovery of an interrupted lineage, not invention

source.locator: Claims 3-5, 171; own words 7, 46

sense.en: The book articulates 文言 rather than proposing a framework. The pre-Qin thinkers exhausted how names attach to realities; the formal lineage was cut off after Han Confucianism and 焚书坑儒, and the mission is to recover it. Choosing 間 is recognition, not invention.

quote: The work is **recovery (articulation), not invention (proposal)**

reading.en: The account says the reverse of its own classical work: the root's definitions are AI reconstructions, not the recovery of what the texts meant, and 古文 stating this grammar is listed as not shown; of 219 sentences read one by one, 53 it cannot express. The names are a code formed among the theory's users; sources are evidence for word sense, never the ground of a claim, which agrees with the folder's rule against arguing by citation (own words 46). The cut-off history is not assessed. [AI reading]

says.en: 「根之文法的诸定义是从所选古文重构的 AI 读法」; 「原文是词义之证据，引文不是主张之根据」; open: 读法是否合于史义, human review.
「这些读法不是原文自身之义的恢复」.
Assessment: 「名是在理论的使用者之间形成的一份码，受所见之义约束，不是从历史中复原的意义」 [AI reading, D62].
未示: 「古文陈述了这套文法」; 「古典之名复原了文本之义」.
Theorem (root) and counts: 丙一 219 条逐条读过, 128 条入 22 族之律, 归丁者三十三, 表达不了者五十三, 各有其由 (for example 生产与充足, 网无“在”之谓词). 计数是读法之计数.

account_adds.en: A not-shown line: 古典之名复原了文本之义.

source_adds.en: The lineage history and the mission of recovery.

name.en: Two lines: Greek being qua being, Chinese names and realities

source.locator: Claims 1-3, 16; The theory in one paragraph

sense.en: The project is not a Western ontology but the extension of 名实之辨 into the digital age. The two lines differ structurally along six axes, and by the third century BCE the pre-Qin thinkers had exhausted how names attach to realities. The framework is said not to be cross-culturally universal.

quote: the Greek line asks

reading.en: The live account draws no such line and locates itself in no tradition. It reads 荀子·正名 for one thing and one kind, states laws for every carrier, names neighbours by result (08: ontic structural realism, process philosophy, dependent arising, identity of indiscernibles), and its rule on names is a discipline, not a self-location. 06 lists a tradition's being relational by nature as not shown. A chapter on classical texts is a region of it, not its descent. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The Greek/Chinese contrast and self-location stand in the folder and in sources/08-jian-wen-language/jian-repo/WENYAN_FOUNDATION_NOTE_v1.0.md §0.1. history/PRE-QIN-AND-WENYAN.md has 名实 only as a classical topic.

searched: 名实, 名實, 西方, Western, Greek, 希腊, being qua being across the live prose by grep: no occurrence (名实 once in a record's JSON, inside 命名实例, a false match)
正名 in the live files: 06 and review/CLASSICAL-TEXTS, as a source text only
希腊, Greek, 名实 in theories/becoming/history: no Greek line; 名实 in PRE-QIN-AND-WENYAN and WENLI-AND-BECOMING as a topic

name.en: 名 is structure, and 古文 is the framework that Lean verifies

source.locator: The λ-calculus test; claims 38, 47, 57-58; own words 24-25

sense.en: λ-calculus presupposes separating syntax from semantics; 古文 never did. 名 does not refer, it is structure, so 正名 adjusts structure. Curry-Howard is a default here and a discovery in the West. Hence Lean verifies and 古文 is the framework; first search whether Chinese already has the concept.

quote: 名 is not reference — 名 *is* structure

reading.en: Two halves. A code is a convention held between formations: the start and the order fix the form reached, on 荀子's 名无固宜. Yet a description makes sense only where it identifies exactly the alike configurations, and naming each only where alike ones are one, which twins refute. So a name answers to structure and is not it, and labels carry nothing. 06's 名是结构的 is a rule for choosing names, not this claim. Lean's statements are the home. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; runs of hearings, further premises by row). Hearing makes no form; each formation holds the start's form of its origin; the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use.
Reading [AI, D54]: 「由此读出，理论中的单字术语是约定」.

Theorem (any process). A description makes sense where it identifies exactly the alike configurations. Naming the configurations makes sense exactly where alike configurations are one, which fails for twin successors of one move (`identifiesAlike_id_iff`).

Theorem (World). 「Labels carry nothing」: a renaming, one to one at each step, preserves the five readings checked, while the pattern of names across steps carries identity. Bears on claim 38, having an id is to exist.
名表之条: 「名是结构的，不用社会、金融、权利之字」: a rule on which names to take. Same word as the folder's, not its claim.

account_adds.en: Laws of how a code forms, is imposed and loses distinctions, and a criterion for when a description makes sense.

source_adds.en: The syntax/semantics argument, which the folder calls the theory's deepest point, and 心即理 at its limit.

name.en: Every law has two faithful forms, Lean and 文言

source.locator: Claim 52; open question 27

sense.en: Every law, theorem and type signature must have a Lean signature and a 文言 sentence, related 1:1 and faithfully. Totality and faithfulness are listed as unproven, deferred to Phase 7. No Lean in the corpus compiled.

quote: Dual expression invariant

reading.en: The 中华本 has the shape 經/說/證 with Lean anchors, compiled, and is in history, while 06 reports it. It is counted, not proved faithful, and states on the World model, not the grammar, so 06 lists it as to be rewritten. Two name systems differ, and in their clash the grammar's names rule. [AI reading]

says.en: 每一条先立“經”，次“說”，次“證”（Lean 声明与记录）. 449 名中 379 个录有锚. 它陈述在 World 模型上，不在 `Becoming.Grammar` 上. 「中华本不是英文章节的译本」.
同一字可以不同义；「两者不同之处以文法之名为准」.
未决, 中华本之根基: 「它陈述在 World 模型上；规范之章改以根为基后，它须随之改写」.

account_adds.en: Actual anchors to compiled Lean, and a count of fidelity, coded by a language model and provisional.

source_adds.en: A required 1:1 map (the source lists its totality and faithfulness as unproven), and 文言 as the primary form.

name.en: One ontology, many projections: the script is one of them

source.locator: The same argument, told aloud; claim 308, against claims 57-58 and own words 25

sense.en: Spoken, and marked by the folder as a value stance: someone who already understands the ontology does not need the characters, only 'the projection'. So the ontology is shared and the script one projection. It sits against 文言 as primary language and 古文 as the framework itself.

quote: One ontology, many projections

reading.en: Agreement with this strand, against the other one in the folder. The 中华本 is another expression, not a translation and not the source; Lean is the common home for both; and under one discipline controlled English, itself translated from 經 with Lean as the key, introduces no more than 經. The count compares referents, not understanding; the reading test is designed and not run (experiments/wenli-reading-transfer, not live). [AI reading]

says.en: 「中华本不是英文章节的译本，是另一种表达」; 它陈述在 World 模型上.

Assessment, provisional, coded by a language model: 「受控英文是“經”的译文，译时以 Lean 为读法之钥」; controlled English introduces no more than 經 under one coder (+0.023, [−0.010, +0.055]); another family leaves a residual of −0.27 on 60 pairs.

account_adds.en: A measured comparison of two expressions, provisional.

source_adds.en: The ontology as shared beyond any language, as a claim about understanding.

name.en: 文言 is near-globally-optimal for dense relational expression

source.locator: Why the compression claim is made; claims 10, 23-25, 168; critique 49

sense.en: Source-encoding match, density (道德经 needs about ten times the length in English) and polymorphism as minimal description give near-optimality. It is bounded three times: trained receiver, lossy for procedure, loss-function relative. Ren's plain form: the optimal language, for humans and for understanding; yet 如果有更准的语言形式，我们就用那个. Asserted, never computed.

quote: 文言 is information-theoretically near-globally-optimal for the dense expression of relational/processual phenomena

reading.en: The account ran a nearby test, not of compression: referents not in the Lean. 經 introduce fewer than the chapters' English, and under one discipline controlled English introduces no more with the same coder, with one residual. That is the nearest it comes to the folder's own clause on a more exact form. It lists 最好的表达 as not shown and attributes nothing finally to the language. Comparing against one English text is its limit. [AI reading]

says.en: Assessment, provisional, coded by a language model. On 270 條, 經 introduce fewer referents absent from the Lean than the chapters' English (0.09 against 0.81). 「它不表明古汉语是纯核诸陈述最好的表达」.

Assessment, provisional. Under the same discipline controlled English introduces no more than 經: +0.023, 95% interval [−0.010, +0.055]; another coder family leaves a residual of −0.27 on 60 pairs. Discipline and genre are not separated.
未示: 「古汉语是纯核诸陈述最好的表达：受控英文在同一编码模型下不多于“經”，另一模型留有余差；纪律与体裁未分开检验。」

account_adds.en: A number, with its limits, on a neighbouring question. 06's 成文 evaluates the grammar's operations by total description length, of the grammar, not of 文言, and says this proves no universal minimum.

source_adds.en: A compression comparison of 文言 with other languages, which the folder's critique 49 asks for: not found live.

name.en: Grammar alignment does not prove the ontology true

source.locator: Why the compression claim is made; claim 25; critique 7

sense.en: The folder's own limit: alignment between a language's grammar and an ontology shows only that the language suits articulating it, not that the ontology is true. It is called an unusually clean piece of self-limitation.

quote: Grammar alignment does not prove ontological truth

reading.en: The account states a limit of this form, in general and about itself, in other terms: agreement between a text and a law is no confirmation, the law not resting on the text; whether a passage is relational is a demand of method, not a proof of ontology; a language's being relational by nature is listed as not shown. The folder's sentence is about a grammar against an ontology, which the account does not compare. [AI reading]

says.en: 「相合不是印证：律的成立不靠原文，原文的意义也不由律穷尽。」 一段文字是否“关系的”: 「这是方法上的要求」, 「不是本体论的证明，也不是伦理必然性的证明」.
未示: 语言或传统天然是关系的.

source_adds.en: The clause's own objects, a grammar against an ontology, and its positive half, that alignment shows 文言 suits the articulation. The account does not claim it: 06 gives reasons for using classical characters as the AI's argument and lists best expression as not shown.

name.en: Every character has a unique, definite referential structure

source.locator: Where it starts; claims 28-30

sense.en: Every expression in pre-Qin 文言 encodes a process, and every character has a definite dynamic or topological reference. Told this was too strong, Ren restricted it: not all, a subset, and that subset is complete. Disambiguation follows formal rules.

quote: every character has a unique, definite referential structure that is dynamic or topological

reading.en: The script is relational as a reading system, the account says, and form does not encode a relational ontology: most characters are phono-semantic, and the heaviest cosmological graph-readings centre on one controller. A sense stands where every relevant record supplies it, so the theory's own single-character terms are conventions. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: 「文字作为读法系统是关系的，而且很强……但字形本身不编码一种关系本体：多数字是形声」. 耦合入、归并、拓宽 and others have no exact single character.

account_adds.en: `CrossSituational.stands_iff` as the condition for a sense, and a list of terms for which no single character fits.

source_adds.en: Disambiguation by formal rules, and each character's process-encoding as a claim about the language.

name.en: Not all characters: a subset, and that subset is complete

source.locator: Where it starts; claims 30, 40

sense.en: Told the universal claim was too strong, Ren restricted its domain and added a requirement: a subset of characters has definite dynamic or topological reference, and that subset is complete. Purity and completeness are demanded together, minimality found through the attempt at a completeness proof.

quote: 不说所有，至少一个子集字是这样的，并且它们complete

reading.en: The restricted form lives on as an open question, with a stricter test: whether some characters and combinations stably keep relations and operations among concepts within a stated range, judged at four levels on samples not used in design. No range is given, so this is no scope: definiteness and completeness are asserted nowhere. The name table is built by those levels, and is not yet tested on sentences outside its design. [AI reading]

says.en: 未决，汉字之较强假说: 某些字词及其组合，能否在明确的范围内稳定地保留概念之间的关系与操作…; 「按四级验收，须在未参与设计的样本上检验」.
Reading [AI, D54]: 一一映射的验收有四级，逐级加强：命名一致，义项忠实，关系保留，组合可在未参与设计的样本上检验.
「它还不是以未参与设计之句检验过的文言内核」 [AI reading, D62].

account_adds.en: An acceptance test with four rising levels.

source_adds.en: Completeness of the subset as a claim.

name.en: Single characters over compounds and English terms

sense.en: A standing instruction: many English terms and two-character compounds have better single-character counterparts, and many compounds are formal-logic combinations of single characters. The scope is single symbols and their combinations. First search whether Chinese already has the concept.

quote: many English terms and two-character compounds have better single-character counterparts

reading.en: The account keeps the search and limits the preference. It looks for attested early use, pre-Qin first, yet records that for 耦合入, 归并, 拓宽 and others no single character is exact, since one would bring in a sense of entity or of power; compounds stay the exact choice. 105 of its 449 names are new combinations by its own convention. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: 耦合入、归并、拓宽、关口、形成体、前段、扣留没有确切的单字: 「以单字代之会带入其文本中的实体之义（物、体、性）或权力之义（定、功、王），二字之词仍是确切的选择」.
能找到出处者引一句冻结原文，先秦优先; 未录引文的 201 个中，105 个是由古字组成的新组合，是本编的约定.

account_adds.en: A stated cost of the single character, term by term, and a count of what the table left uncited.

source_adds.en: The single-character scope as a method for mathematics and logic.

name.en: A semantic overlay must preserve structure, not just count

source.locator: Claim 294; open question 20

sense.en: The revision notes say eight trigrams and eight atoms are not enough. The mapping must preserve independently meaningful structure: inner and outer trigrams, 错/综/互, 本/征, row and column of the sixteen characters. Otherwise names are attached after the fact.

quote: Semantic overlays may be arbitrary

reading.en: The same test stands live for characters and theory terms, sharper: an arbitrary numbering is also one-to-one, so four rising levels of acceptance are named. Its objects differ: the folder's are a tower's atoms and trigrams, and those overlays have left the account untested rather than passed. 序卦's reasons being talk added to a list is a neighbouring point about an arrangement, not an overlay. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: 「任意编号也能一一对应概念，所以不重名之字不是充分的发现」; four levels: 命名一致，义项忠实，关系保留，组合可在未参与设计的样本上检验.
「序卦在对与对之间给出的理由……是加在清单上的言说，不是构形承载之律」 [AI reading, D55].

account_adds.en: The fourth level, testing on samples not used in design.

source_adds.en: The test applied where the folder asks for it: the trigram-to-atom map, 本/征, and the sixteen characters' row and column. None is tested live.

name.en: 止戈为武 is the tradition's gloss, not the graph's history

source.locator: The same argument, told aloud; open question 63

sense.en: Ren's spoken example reads 武 as stop plus conflict. The synthesis cautions: on most paleographic readings 止 is a foot, so the graph shows marching with a halberd. The gloss evidences how the tradition read its script and a culture of 和, not how the script formed.

quote: On most paleographic readings the 止 in 武 is a foot

reading.en: The account keeps the paleographic half and parts on the other. 止 is a foot and 武 marching with a halberd; components fix no reading (a scoped witness, applied to 武 only by analogy). Where the folder lets the gloss support a culture of 和, 06 records the speech's frame as power (保大、定功、示子孙), a divergence. Ren's spoken form is not kept. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: 「止为足形，武是持戈而行」; “止戈为武” is a value reading in 楚庄王's speech; 「理论不说武的本义是止戈，也不说止戈否定一切武力」. `CodeAcquisition.primitives_no_exact` is used by analogy.

account_adds.en: The witness on reading components, and the recorded divergence of the speech's frame of power.

source_adds.en: The gloss as the tradition's self-reading that supports a culture of 和 (open question 63); the rule that such readings are constructive, evidence of how Ren reads the language (question 64).

name.en: Pre-Qin theories describe social dynamics with no I-other opposition

source.locator: The grammar claim, said again in Chinese; claims 307, 309; own words 83-84

sense.en: Spoken, from a translation: some pre-Qin theories describe a universal social dynamics with no I-other opposition, unlike a Western dualistic structure of language and thought; the grammar often lacks subject-object differentiation and tense. The folder flags one word at 13:40 as unsettled by ear.

quote: 里面没有“我—他”的那种对立

reading.en: The source says 'some' pre-Qin theories, and at that scope the account does not contradict it: relation as start is strongest in the earliest layer and divergence lowest there (13%), which it says proves no trend. What it refuses is the step to every system: contest and rank recur, not at the margin (二柄, 贵贱有等), as directions within relations. By domain, divergence runs 1% in 名辩 to 33% in 法. No contrast with the West is drawn. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: 论题分三层: 在起点与观察上，它成立; 在全称形式上，它常需要定域; 「作为每一体系的性质，它不成立」; 四种非关系之层反复出现，不在边缘.
争胜与等级: 不战而屈人之兵；二柄；民弱国强；贵贱有等；亲亲之杀. 后两层立的是关系中的方向，不是先于关系之物.
「关系的起点是一条主导线索，在最早一层最强」.
Assessment: 按脉络之域，相分在已对应者中所占：名辩 1%……墨 28%，法 33%；合计 19%. 「先秦条目中相分占 13%，秦汉以后各层在 15% 到 46% 之间。后者不是历史趋势的证明」. 比例是此语料的.

account_adds.en: Counts by domain and by layer, and each tradition's own internal reply.

source_adds.en: The absence of an I-other opposition as such: 06 speaks of relation as a start, not of this. Also the contrast with Western dualism, and grammar lacking tense and subject-object as evidence.

name.en: The Klein four-group is forced on the hexagram and universal

source.locator: Claims 258-260

sense.en: A hexagram is a map from six positions to F2 with two symmetry axes, 错 and 综; the group is exactly Z/2×Z/2, and larger candidates break something. 道 as identity is a structural correspondence. Any minimal system carrying meaning has a V4 subgroup: Pauli, CPT, logic, Greimas.

quote: $V_4$ is forced, not chosen

reading.en: The account keeps the bare group as a finite fact: 錯, 綜 and their composite compose as a group, with 不变, not 道, as its identity. Forcedness, universality and 'largest invertible symmetric group' are not claimed: two-valued lines are a named modelling choice. The record cites the 生生不息 review's laws; that repository held the R-Family line, so the route likely runs through it, though nothing live says so. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (the hexagram world; no added premise). 不变、錯、綜、錯而綜成一四元群. Correspondence: Laws H1 to H5 of the review of the earlier 生生不息 repository, whose own proofs used native_decide and Mathlib, proved again in the pure core. Reading [AI, D51]: 錯、綜之名依后世注家（明来知德），经文「錯綜其數」说的是数，记为定域.
基与标: 「卦之世界以离散之步与二值之爻为建模之选择」.
Reading [AI, D54]: 理论从不把道等同于任何脊柱之词.

account_adds.en: 互 goes alike across the classes, and 錯 keeps runs apart: the group is related to named laws. Discrete steps and two-valued lines are named modelling choices.

source_adds.en: The forcing argument, the V4 Atlas across nine domains, and the genealogy of partial discoveries (Günther, Spencer-Brown, Greimas).

name.en: How many V4-orbits do the sixty-four hexagrams form?

source.locator: Open question 32; loss 39

sense.en: The V4 note poses a checkable calculation, says it belongs in the implementation, and no later document reports the number. The note floats 16 if every orbit had size 4, and flags the symmetric hexagrams as the thing to check.

quote: how many $V_4$-orbits do the sixty-four hexagrams form?

reading.en: The account answers the folder's open question, though it does not say so: twenty classes, eight of two and twelve of four, so not 16 (`class_census`). By descent, not independently: the classes entered the account as H4 of the SSBX repository review, and the 生生不息 repository's v0.3 of the same V4 note already gives the Burnside count 20 (sources/07-shengsheng-buxi/ssbx-repo/docs-next/v4-foundation.md, §10.4), which the folder's 'no later document reports the number' misses. Nothing live cites the question. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (the hexagram world). 「二十类，八类各二卦、十二类各四卦」; the classes are a lumping 互 goes alike across and not one 消息 goes alike across.

account_adds.en: Which laws carry these classes.

name.en: Only {e, 错综} preserves structure, so 错综 is primary

sense.en: 错 and 综 are each anti-homomorphisms by De Morgan, and their composite a homomorphism; 错综 is the contrapositive's algebraic form. A second argument, on functionals and the annihilator with preserved dimension 8 − dim H, reaches the same subgroup. Classical logic avoids 综. The folder rates this the corpus's best mathematics.

quote: Therefore 错综 should be promoted to a primary concept, not derived.

reading.en: The source asks what preserves ∧ and ∨; the account asks what a law carries, and promotes nothing: 錯 pairs go with 消息, 錯綜 classes with 互. Hand check, not Lean: §7.3 never defines `Hexagram.meet`; read pointwise with §1.1's reversal, reversal preserves ∧ and 錯綜 does not (錯綜(乾∧坤)=乾, 錯綜(乾)∧錯綜(坤)=坤), so `cuozong_preserves_meet` fails there; §5.2's table needs another 綜, and §5.4 acts on A→B, a second action. [AI reading]

says.en: 「哪一种归并承载律，依律而定，所失较多的归并有时反而承载」. Table: 錯卦之对 is carried by 消息; 錯綜之二十类 is not carried by 消息 and is carried by 互.
Theorem (the hexagram world). 诸类是互所同行的归并，不是消息之律所同行的，因为倒转使后者逆行 (`classes_goAlike`, `classes_not_goAlike_waxWane`).

Theorem (the hexagram world). 「凡重排诸位再加掩码之律都与錯交换，所以无一运行它」 (`rearrange_not_runsOrder`). 阳爻之数的奇偶: 消息之律与一爻之变都同行于此归并，互之律不同行 (`yangOdd_goAlike`). The nearest live thing to the source's surviving functionals, not named as one.

account_adds.en: The relativity of a lumping to a law, with the table across five lumpings and four laws.

source_adds.en: The De Morgan claim, the Information Preservation Theorem, the {道, 今} parity argument (a separate, mask-level argument; the SSBX review calls 道/已/今/未 a relabelled two bits, process not live), and the hypothesis on why intuitionistic, linear and quantum logics arose.

name.en: 互卦 is not in V4 and iterates to a fixed point

source.locator: Claim 266

sense.en: 互 is not bijective, has no natural inverse and iterates to a fixed point rather than a cycle, so it must be modelled orthogonally to V4, perhaps as an idempotent or partial morphism on the hexagram lattice.

quote: not bijective, no natural inverse, iterating to a fixed point rather than a cycle

reading.en: The account confirms it merges, which puts it outside the group though 06 does not say so in those words, and corrects the rest. Runs end in 乾, in 坤, or in the alternation of 既濟 and 未濟, a two-cycle. So iteration does not always reach a fixed point, and the law is not idempotent. Basins are counted. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (the hexagram world). 互: 合并；每一运行自第二步起在乾、坤与既濟、未濟之相代中，不再离开; 十六卦归乾，十六卦归坤，三十二卦入相代. Reading [AI, D51]: 互读作律而迭用，传统多只取一步.

account_adds.en: The counted basins, the third form beside waxing and waning and absorbing, and that this iteration is not the text's own use.

source_adds.en: The modelling proposal as an idempotent or partial morphism.

name.en: The R-Family algebra: F2 tower, bilinear layers, Hom-as-content, even ranks

source.locator: The third track; claims 241-257, 284-293

sense.en: Seven properties are claimed to force R_N = F2^N: direct sum, three bilinear layers, a squaring tower, Hom-as-content. Only even ranks are interfaces, since only they conserve in both senses; 64 = V4³, so three Klein coordinates, not six lines, are the unit. The biggest hole, in its own words: why two values lead to the F2 family at all.

quote: Seven necessary properties are claimed to force R-Family rather than select it

reading.en: This is the algebra the account dropped. Live hexagram modules use two-valued lines and finite laws with no vector space, form or tower, and six lines stay the unit. Rearranging places with a mask, and parity, are F2-affine facts left unnamed. 'Why two values' is met by naming them a modelling choice. The 生生不息 review did not take the R-family encoding and calls the tower a packaging of cardinality bijections (§5; process, not live). [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The algebra stands in sources/08-jian-wen-language/downloads-2026-05 and, developed, in theories/becoming/history/lineage/shengsheng-buxi/synthesis-c-ssbx-yili-and-formal-doctrine.md; the study _process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/DEEPER-ROOT-GENEALOGY.md weighs its claims.

searched: R-Family, R_N, Arf, symplectic, Hom-as-content, 𝔽, F_2, annihilator, Burnside, bilinear, vector space across the live files: no occurrence
V_4, V4, Klein across every live file: only the alias on hexagram-world-laws and false matches; 四元群 in 06
R-Family and Klein in theories/becoming/history and _process: synthesis-b, synthesis-c, DEEPER-ROOT-GENEALOGY, SSBX review

name.en: Claim Z: formal means R-Family-articulable

source.locator: The third track; claims 241, 253-254, 285-287; critiques 38-39

sense.en: Formality and R-Family articulability are co-extensive by definition, and later one minimal universal normal form with a Z-Principle and a falsifiable Z-Conjecture. It is delimited to formality, not reality. The folder notes this contradicts its own refusal of a totalizing paradigm.

quote: co-extensive

reading.en: The account takes up the same place, what any structure can be stated in, and answers otherwise: no alphabet, only a relation on any carrier, a language that forbids nothing. Its own universal is an open representation question, already failing on the World's amounts. A rival universal claim is not stated against R-Family; the account does not mention it, and only the process review names Claim Z, as a packaging. [AI reading]

says.en: The grammar has one kind of symbol, a relation between occurrences; 「every theorem is stated for every carrier and relation, so no frame or kind of thing is chosen before the relations」.
「As a language, nothing: any carrier, relation and class will do」.
Open: faithful representation in the grammar of every becoming; the World's not faithful on its amounts.

account_adds.en: A universality stated as open, with where it already fails.

source_adds.en: Claim Z, the six universal claims (grammar, cognition, phenomenology and others) and the minimal normal form.

name.en: 无极 = R0, 太极 = R1 … the 易 sequence coincides with the tower

source.locator: Claim 244, 252

sense.en: The family coincides layer by layer with 无极, 太极, 四象, 八卦, spacetime, 六十四卦, 字/文, 万物, offered as discovered alignment, not forced correspondence. Hom-as-content is the precise sense of 道法自然. The revision notes later downgrade the physics.

reading.en: A live sentence refuses a move of this form, on 老子's 无, 一, 二, 三, not on this tower: they do not become the empty set, a bit or an operation by comparison. A narrow trace stands in one record: adding one reads the divisions of 太極 as digits, labelled the AI's reading on a counter, with no cosmology. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: 「旧的形式桥接以一个证人定义两边，只建立了所给定义之间的对应，本章只用已入脊柱之律；“无”“一”“二”“三”不因比较就是空集、比特或运算。」
Correspondence, reading (the AI's, D51): adding one reads the divisions of 太極 as digits.

account_adds.en: The explicit limit on old formal bridges.

source_adds.en: The layer-by-layer identification, and 道法自然 given four precise mechanisms.

name.en: Conservation and loss of information are a structural property of operators

sense.en: Isomorphisms conserve, projections lose a factor of known fibre size, and a collapse is irreversible. So what is lost is readable from the operator; whether a projection is lossless is decidable from the family's structure. This is the shared foundation of five fields. Only on this axis does Wen go beyond existing languages.

quote: Every basic operator's information behaviour is intrinsic and visible in its type signature

reading.en: The account has laws of this form and names the unifying claim. A determined law on a list merges nothing exactly where every configuration returns; a part's merge is kept by the rest; irreversibility in computation, heat, extinction and forgetting is read as one merge, a correspondence, kept as a law since as a thesis it forbids little. These are laws of a map, not a type discipline: no operator's loss is read from a signature. [AI reading]

says.en: Landauer's and Bennett's irreversibility: one merge across computation, heat, extinction and forgetting. Standing: the law proved for determined maps on finitely many listed configurations; its reading across those fields a correspondence; kept as a law, since as a thesis it forbids little.

Theorem (any type; a law that merges nothing). Narrowing the part to one configuration spreads the rest over at least `k`. Landauer's (1961) count with Bennett's (1973) history; no energy, temperature or probability is read, so kT ln 2 is not derived.
Theorem (the hexagram world). 对六十四卦上的每一个确定之律，每一构形皆复返，恰当此律不合并 (`every_returns_iff`, an instance of `Law.lossless_iff_returns`).

account_adds.en: Return, not reversibility as a type, as what no merging gives; and that no merging guarantees return, not reach.

source_adds.en: The type-level language, ⊠ as a fourth value, no-cloning by construction, decidability from the family's structure, and the five-field list with power budgets (no energy is read live).

name.en: The language articulates itself: R8, and the ontology of 文言 in 文言

sense.en: Writing 文言's ontology in 文言 makes instrument and object one. Operations on R-Family are members of it, so it needs no external scaffolding, and R-Family alone is self-following. The classification satisfies the structure it describes: a theory is an instance of what it describes. Ren asked that the text itself be proof: 文字即是证明，自指.

quote: writing the ontology of 文言 in 文言 is self-referential

reading.en: One clause is shared: the theory stands inside what it describes (06: knowing within the unfolding). The conclusion is not. Self-reference certifies nothing by itself, and a family of readings within what it reads is complete only where nothing differs; completing it is an unfolding incomplete at each step. That bears on any claim to closure in one's own terms, not on the algebra as a theorem. Live 文 is a course through a map, not this level. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; the criteria, the fixed-point equivalence and the term language supplied; pre-spine Lean). 「So self-reference does not certify itself, and the reference back of a bound use is stipulated rather than derived.」 A metalogic without presuppositions remains open.

Theorem (any type). With equality of values decided and both types inhabited, some family is complete exactly where all values are equal. Where a map moves every value, completing it step by step is an unfolding incomplete at every step that never returns.
Reading [AI, D63]: 「本理论把知放在展开之内」.
文 (wén): the course of a run's states through a map.

account_adds.en: The diagonal limit as a checked law.

source_adds.en: R8 as the self-articulating level and the project's name, the Hom-as-content closure, and the demand that text be proof.

name.en: Alignment derived: the virtues as invariants R-Family can preserve

source.locator: Claim 255; Relations, keep-the-possibility-space-open

sense.en: If AI cognition is R-Family operations, alignment is a constraint on them: keeping possibility space open means operations preserve information rather than collapse, with 仁 as symplectic, 义 orthogonal, 礼 lattice, 智 mode, 信 information. Its authors mark it a v0.1 attempt.

quote: These are not arbitrary virtues

reading.en: The account refuses this form. A statement reading no order entails C only where it fails, so an invariant that reads no order gives no ranking. Where a ranking is made it names its scope and order, most often the continuation condition and C, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought. No merging is one form, not a good: closure as form is no loss. Alignment with no premise (07 §6) is what selections reach, not which is right. [AI reading]

says.en: Neither is asserted. Whoever ranks courses holds C or another order; a statement reading no order entails C only where it fails (`ReadsNoOrder.not_entails`).
「闭就其形式而言不是损失」; 一种闭对生生（生命之延续）开什么、闭什么、为谁，由比较者之读来说：延续之条件定范围，持以广为愈（C）者定拓宽与收窄之序，两种读法都不断言 [AI reading, D49].

account_adds.en: Why what reads no order orders no courses.

source_adds.en: The mapping of virtues to algebraic invariants, and cognition as R-Family operations.

name.en: Eight comes from 2³: the doubling scaffold is renounced

The folder calls this demotion the series' most valuable moment, while the R-Family track returns to doubling.

quote: 基数 8 来自 2³，不来自存在论必然

Live trigrams are three two-valued lines, so eight is 2³ there too, unargued; that is no taking-up of the point. The record's reading of 太极 divisions as digits sits oddly with the folder's refusal. name.en: Claim strength exceeded proof strength

source.locator: The third track, last paragraph; claims 284, 292

Same discipline, no descent shown; 08 applies it to the account's own results. The folder's own Lean compiled nowhere; this account's does. [AI reading]

name.en: One primitive, 間 then 系 then 一, whose content is that it contains itself

source.locator: One primitive, and why the number is one; claims 59-73; own words 32-36

sense.en: Several relational primitives presuppose one another, which 'proves' they are perspectives on one. Hence one primitive: 間 (v0.3-v0.8), 系 (v0.9), finally 一 identified with system. 系含系 is definitional, formally W-types, V_α and μX.F(X). Being definitional, it needs no creation verb.

quote: 系含系 — recursion is the definitional content of 系, not an operator applied to it

reading.en: 'One' stands as one kind of symbol, 际, a two-place relation on a carrier, nearest to the folder's own counterfactual of 际 as Layer 1 (claim 72), though its 际 had any arity; 06 names the 間 primitive among what the grammar replaced. Self-containment is not claimed or denied: the carrier is a parameter. 无环, nothing reaching itself, is a hypothesis a net may meet, not well-foundedness: an infinite descent has no cycle. 一 survives as the full relation, not a root. [AI reading]

says.en: The grammar has one kind of symbol, a relation between occurrences. Definition: «际» α := α → α → Prop. The carrier is a parameter of the statements, not a claim that its elements exist apart from their relations. Equality on the carrier is a commitment of the model. Without cycles is a condition a net may meet.
Self-changing conditions: a rule that changes by a fixed law is stated in the grammar by taking the rule into the occurrence, the carrier being a parameter.
The explanatory reading is a thesis, argued. What it forbids: as a language, nothing; any carrier, relation and class will do. As an explanation, no observation.
Reading [AI, D54]: 「早期以文言为形式语言之方案（九虚词为核、实词按位定型、一原始之“間”）已为根之文法取代，其完备之说未证」.

account_adds.en: An explicit statement that the one-symbol language has no empirical bite on its own.

source_adds.en: 系含系 and its W-type identification, the choice among 間, 系 and 一 with the ma image, and the circularity argument as proof.

name.en: Things manifest in 間, and 間 is constituted in their relations

source.locator: The second track; claims 169, 176-177

sense.en: One sentence is the whole system. No actor exists outside a 間, since existence is relational; no single-actor 間 exists, since relation needs two ends; co-being is the default and solitude derived. A cosmic 間 gathers all as the coherence pattern 理, not a super-container.

quote: 事物在间中显现，间在事物的关系中成立

reading.en: The account holds the relation-first form as an argued thesis, shown for what is represented, and says it does not show reality has no independent entity. It keeps 'a pair is the least split, not the least relation'. It differs on claim 177: the grammar does not assume that nothing conditions itself, so a one-ended relation is admitted. No cosmic 間. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis (philosophical, argued). There is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it. Configurations, laws and parts, as represented, need no determination beyond relations; that the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved. Neither shows that reality has none.

targets.part: the thesis as stated, with its close: argued, not proved; neither shows that reality has none

says.en: Theorem (any type). Describing two parts separately gives back the whole exactly where the whole is rectangular. Reading [AI, D33]: two are a pair by relation; a pair is the least split, not the least relation.
「文法不设不自缘：自缘者在每一类下皆住（`«自缘则常»`）」.

account_adds.en: What would defeat the thesis: relata with natures of their own, or what an experience is like. Equality on the carrier is named as its nearest case.

source_adds.en: The strong existence claim (no 間, no existence), relation needing two ends, the cosmic 間, 間/事/機 as three faces.

name.en: Monism is chosen, and every formalism is a finger pointing at the moon

sense.en: Each primitive is a convention, each axiom a choice, each idiom a tool. A framework is judged by 功用, not 真值. Monism cannot be proved; its warrant is how many deep problems it handles. 一元 is not cardinality: the differentia among monisms is which root. Taking 际 as Layer 1 instead would build a similar ontology.

quote: Monism cannot be proved, only chosen

reading.en: Agreement on status, not on the act: the source chooses, the account argues. The one-unfolding thesis is argued, not proved, and by the section's measure has no strength against observation. Against a rival it may tie, and a tie leaves the word adding nothing. Laws differ: 功用 does not replace 真值 where a proof claim is checked in Lean. Modelling choices are named as choices, near own words 43 on axiom against design choice. [AI reading]

says.en: 「By this section's measure the thesis has no strength: it excludes no observation」, and that the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved.

targets.part: the thesis's standing by the section's measure

says.en: 「A tie does not make the reading false. It means the pattern explains, if it does, under either name, and the word adds nothing.」

account_adds.en: Named live arguments that could defeat the thesis, and its nearest internal case.

source_adds.en: 功用 over 真值 as the general criterion of a framework; which root as what tells monisms apart (claim 74); 一生万物即是真理，乃多元 as a truth claim about pluralism.

name.en: All frames cross-applicable: the one ultimate claim

source.locator: Claims 118-119; own words 44

sense.en: Ren's statement of the framework's one ultimate claim: truth is universal, frames are articulations, and all articulations are cross-applicable, derivations transferable, so the 理 derived in any frame applies in the others. A second-order question follows on regularity between frames.

quote: 所有 articulations cross-applicable

reading.en: Proposed here: no live text joins these to the folder's claim. A lumping carries a law exactly where the law goes alike across it, and which one carries depends on the law: 錯綜 classes carry 互, not 消息. Each model's shared law is proved from the grammar's. What contexts show glues only where contexts agree, and some worlds glue nowhere; those frames are of claims, not the folder's articulations. Transfer runs along a carrying map, not between any two. [AI reading]

says.en: 一种归并承载一律，恰当此律在其上同行. 「哪一种归并承载律，依律而定，所失较多的归并有时反而承载」.
Theorem (root). The five shared laws hold for every carrier and relation, and 「each model's law is proved from the grammar's in its own module」.
Open: 「That every becoming, and the whole theory, has a faithful representation in the grammar.」 The World's is not faithful on its amounts.
Theorem (any type; each claim within some context). A frame of context-free claims fits exactly where it glues everywhere. Some worlds glue nowhere: Specker's three boxes, the Mermin-Peres square.

account_adds.en: The exact condition for a law to pass through a map, and witnesses where no common frame exists.

source_adds.en: Truth as universal across frames, cross-applicability of all articulations as a claim, and the open question of regularity in the transformations between frames.

name.en: A locus is exhausted by its relations: Yoneda in 文言

source.locator: Claims 80, 147

sense.en: 位 is a position with no intrinsic essence: a locus is what it is entirely by the totality of its 际. The text calls this the Yoneda lemma stated in 文言 and refuses to soften it: not a metaphor, the same structure.

quote: 凡位之是其位，由其际之凡然定

reading.en: The mechanism is bisimulation and the two-way core, not Yoneda: configurations matching step for step are alike, and a position under the two-way core is fixed by its relations before and after. As represented, a configuration is how it relates. The account gives where this stops: telling occurrences alike in every relation apart takes equality on the carrier, a commitment of the model, not a finding. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process). Configurations related by a bisimulation are alike. Naming the configurations makes sense exactly where alike configurations are one, which fails for twin successors of one move (`identifiesAlike_id_iff`).

Definition: the core read both ways (位核). Theorem (root): what shares a position under the two-way core shares beginning, abiding and ending. 「A position is fixed by all its relations, before as well as after.」
「a configuration is how it relates」 (`identifiesAlike_iff`), as represented.
Time and the four positions 「tell two occurrences alike in every relation apart only by equality on the carrier, a commitment of the model」.

account_adds.en: The witnessed exceptions: twins, a past no claim tells apart, equality as a commitment of the model.

source_adds.en: The identification with Yoneda and the category-theory reading; the word Yoneda is not in the live account.

name.en: 位⟷际 and 化⟷理 span the ontology, minimum-complete

source.locator: Two duals; claims 79-85

sense.en: Four names, mutually defining but not reducible, span everything: 位/际 lacks time, 化/理 lacks sites. 化 is a trajectory and 理 its time-invariant attractor, one phenomenon under two views. `term : type` is `化 : 理`. The interdefinition is admitted to be slightly circular.

quote: Two duals jointly span the ontology

reading.en: The characters stay and their senses move. 化 becomes alteration under a class, its live sense read from 「化，徵易也」 and 荀子, not the folder's trajectory; 理 becomes a lumping the step goes alike across; the root's marks are beginning, abiding, altering and ending. 06 says the older 理 and the live 理 are not one sense. A likeness remains: 理 models structure and change as one notion. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D1, D5]: 「“理”在语料之化／理对偶中是轨迹之不变量，与本理论“建模结构与变化之律”二义不并。」
「“化”在本章只有一义，即 Lean 之 `«化»`：`y` 在物之类下续 `x`，而另一类分开二者；它就是文法之异」. 「化，徵易也」（墨经）.
理, the modeling of the laws of structure and change, is one notion, because a model of change is a lumping the step goes alike across, which is a model of structure.

account_adds.en: Theorems of 理 under named premises: where the successor is fixed the core is a 理, and with a successor everywhere the coarsest.

source_adds.en: The minimum-completeness argument, and the attractor reading of 理.

name.en: 势 as the derivative of change, natively a gradient

source.locator: Claims 94, 130

sense.en: 势 is d化/d时, whose shape is 理(化), so at once differential and structural. 孙子's 转圆石于千仞之山者，势也 corresponds to the modern gradient natively, not metaphorically.

quote: 势 ≡ d化/d时

reading.en: The 中华本's name table, in history and reported by 06, takes 勢 as a basin: courses that meet, each basin holding one cycle. That keeps the folder's alias 'attractor' and drops its identity with a rate of change. It is a discrete structure of a determined law, and a name-table sense with no declaration in the grammar. No live text claims the gradient identity. [AI reading]

says.en: 「勢在名表是吸引之域，度是给诸选项之数，二者在文法中尚无声明。」
Theorem (any type). Under any determined law, courses meeting is an equivalence whose classes are basins; a course reaches every returning configuration of its basin; each basin holds one cycle.

account_adds.en: Basin laws on listed configurations, with a bound on entry.

source_adds.en: 势 as a rate of change, and the priority claim for 孙子.

name.en: 几工程: detect the small rising attractor before the threshold

source.locator: The domain sweep; claims 132-133

sense.en: Observe the spectrum of 势, find small but rising attractors and intervene before manifestation. This is early-warning detection plus pre-emption, stated by 中医's 治未病 long before the modern literature, against the Western break-alert-fix model.

quote: 几工程 (incipience engineering) is the distinctive Eastern engineering signature

reading.en: The account takes up both halves. Detection is thesis T6: a break is seen coming only through what couples into what breaks; warning statistics read a condition's own return rate, not a dependent's need. Intervention is the juncture laws: a choice matters only at a juncture, and to turn a reader there a source must reach it before. 06 sets 知几其神乎 and 为之于未有 beside them. 其未兆易谋 is scoped. A civilization's signature is not taken up. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process; every configuration listed, steps decided, `s` returning). At a configuration with a step keeping `s` that is no juncture, no step can be refuted to keep it: 「a choice matters only at a juncture」.
Theorem (World, with a process; premises stated there). 「to turn a reader at a juncture, a source must reach it before」. Finding the reaching outright needs reaching decided.
Table rows: 机之前后 | 系辞「知几其神乎」；孙子「其勢險，其節短」；韩非扁鹊; 为之于未有 | 苏辙注老子「為之于未有者上也」 | 机之前到达之来源.

Thesis T6. Invisible half proved on the World model; seen half periphery (linearized and logistic models); that the split is one law across domains is conjectured. Three frozen seabird tests did not reject it, none establishing conditional independence.

Theorem (periphery, Mathlib; discrete steps, one variable linearized about a rest): a rises to one as the margin shrinks at a fold, so the margin to a condition's own end couples into its fluctuations. A dependent's need enters neither statistic.
Reading [AI, D54]: “其安易持，其未兆易谋”定域：对每一过程找出每一失去之机即给出 LPO，「所以易于改变者难于发现，除非读其耦合」.

account_adds.en: Theorems of what can and cannot be detected and when a move can count, each under its premises, and a stated way to refute the thesis.

source_adds.en: Pre-emption as a design signature, a spectrum of 势, 治未病 as early-warning theory (no live occurrence), and the priority claim.

name.en: Time is not a second primitive

source.locator: Claim 70

sense.en: Inside a 系, one process is conventionally designated the standard (sundial, oscillation, heartbeat) and others measure pace against it. That designated process is 时: a coinductive stream and a Lamport clock, not Newton's t. This lets two duals, not three, span the ontology.

quote: 时 is not a parallel primitive but a periodic anchoring inside 系

reading.en: Shared: time is no second primitive. The mechanism differs: the order is the reach of the condition relation, strict only where no cycle holds. Nothing live makes a designated periodic process what time is; clocks occur only as a model's named laws. The nearest is 'rates being relative to the reading's unit': idle steps inserted leave the laws of one step, totals, counts and recurrence unchanged. [AI reading]

says.en: 「Nor is a time: its order is the reach of the condition relation, a strict order where that relation has no cycle」.

With equality of relata decided and each relatum listed once at each step, a world read through a supplied stuttering, idle steps inserted, meets each premise exactly where the world does; the laws of one step, the totals over a stretch, the counts of arising and ceasing (activity decided) and recurrence are unchanged.

account_adds.en: Reach is a strict order exactly without cycles, a hypothesis a net may meet, and feedback is read as a line returning to a class.

source_adds.en: The conventionally designated clock as what 时 is, the coinductive stream, and the Lamport identification.

name.en: History is a DAG with no canonical linearization

sense.en: In the Jian Calculus any linear order of events is a topological sort, a projection. Two observers can disagree about which of two events came first and both be right. No privileged current exists; causal order is reliable and linear time order is not.

quote: Prehension makes history a DAG, not a timeline

reading.en: The mechanism has a checked form on causal-set growth: births of unrelated elements commute, and only they, an instance of the core's theorem of Mazurkiewicz, and no order of birth of unrelated elements is common to all courses. With a footprint given, a World stretch's reorderings are such courses. These are courses, not observers disagreeing. A definite global causal order at every interface is listed as not assumed. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (causal-set growth, and witnesses). Natural labellings are exactly the orders of birth; births of unrelated elements commute, and only they (an instance of the core's theorem of Mazurkiewicz); with precedence weakly decided, no order of birth of unrelated elements is common to all courses (`Presence.either_order`). Labels carrying no physical meaning is a premise of the model.

With a given footprint containing the exchanges, the exchanges of a finite stretch from the first step form a causal set under the order of joined exchanges, and a renumbering of the stretch is the numbering of some reordering exactly where it numbers them by a course of causal-set growth.
Not assumed: 「a definite global causal order at every interface」.

account_adds.en: Each reading of 'present' answered exactly, with the decision principle each needs.

source_adds.en: Two observers disagreeing and both right; prehension as content-carrying; the audit-free reconstruction of a decision; the claim as an engineering commitment.

name.en: Events are the truth and state is derived

sense.en: Changing state does not exist ontologically: only a new event occurs and derived state changes. Caveat, visibility, legitimacy and boundary are predicates over configurations, never stored. Event sourcing is an ontological commitment, and a reification error is near impossible to repair. State and event are two registers of one reality (動靜不二).

quote: Events are the source of truth and state is a cache

reading.en: A general form stands: states and law can be read off a course of values, two moments alike where everything after them agrees. And the grammar's relation holds between occurrences; what comes round is the class; states as occurrences are one model's choice; 静 is the change that stays in place, near claim 181. It gives no rule against storing and no ontological claim about events. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; a determined law read through a map; no premise). Every history of values is a determined law read through a map, two moments alike exactly where everything after them agrees.
A relation between occurrences; 静, identity, 「the change that stays in place」. 「What comes round is the class」. 「Where a model takes states as its occurrences」 is one case.
Assessment: 「两个时刻自此起逐步之值皆同，即是一状……所以文不须先给状，也不须文外的立法者。」

account_adds.en: The exact criterion, with a list needed to name the classes.

source_adds.en: Event sourcing as an ontological commitment, the derived-not-stored rule as a design law, and the default against reifying.

name.en: No view from outside: every observer's view is partial

sense.en: A configuration holds no global state. An observer's view is always a strict subset; bisimulation is relativized and does not transfer between observers. Any monitor is itself a 間 observing from its own place, and the same message is information in one 間 and not in another.

quote: bisimulation is relativized and does **not** transfer across observers

reading.en: Stated in form: knowing is within the unfolding; what a formation can select is bounded by its couplings; histories alike through one may differ through another; a pool separates what some member separates. That is relativized likeness, and claim 184's jian-relative information. Not stated: 'always a strict subset'. No law bars a formation from coupling into everything, so the bound is exact, not a fixed shortfall. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis. 「Knowing is a relation within the unfolding, not a mirror beside it.」

Theorem (World; no premise). Two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them; the same for a group's pooled coupling. A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry.

Theorem (World; balance for the gap). With a list holding exactly the members and each member's coupling of two histories decided, a pooled selection separates them exactly when some member does not couple them alike.

Theorem (any type; each claim within some context). What contexts show glues exactly where contexts agree where they meet, and a frame of context-free claims fits exactly where it glues everywhere. Some worlds glue nowhere: Specker's three boxes, the Mermin-Peres square.

account_adds.en: Pooling as the exact form of what a second observer adds, and the condition under which a context-free frame exists, with witnesses from quantum contextuality.

source_adds.en: 'Always a strict subset'; relativized bisimulation as a semantics; 'no ambient observer' as a design rule; a 間 as an active detector of what counts as informative.

name.en: Map and territory constitute each other; the map can capture its incompleteness

source.locator: Claims 237-238; loss 40

sense.en: Map ⇄ territory is mutual constitution, fully dual and self-aware, not a map approximating a territory, and deeper than Korzybski. 体 is only ever truncated by some 用, so the map can capture its own incompleteness. The folder lists this among what the conversations hold and the drafts do not.

quote: so the map can capture its own incompleteness

reading.en: The account puts knowing inside the unfolding, not beside it. On incompleteness the law is exact and partial: a revising family says its last gap and is incomplete at every step, so it can state each gap, not all. It does not say the two constitute each other, and models stay answerable to tests. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis. 「Knowing is a relation within the unfolding, not a mirror beside it.」
Reading [AI, D63]: 文理生生把观与证放在模型之外作为元层，「本理论把知放在展开之内」.
Where a map moves every value, completing it step by step, each revision keeping every earlier reading and saying the last gap, is an unfolding incomplete at every step that never returns.

account_adds.en: How far a map can state its own gaps, as a theorem.

source_adds.en: Mutual constitution as the relation of map and territory; the mediation triangle of 理, 心, 事.

name.en: Always leave an unclassified space outside every metric and type

source.locator: The domain sweep; claim 126; Relations, keep-the-possibility-space-open

sense.en: 庄子 is the framework's interface to its own limits: 言无言 is the Liar/Russell/Gödel family, 得意忘言 tool-theory, 彼/是 frame-dependence. The engineering consequence is a design rule: always leave an unclassified space outside every metric, type and pattern.

quote: always leave an *unclassified* space outside every metric, type and pattern

reading.en: Proposed here: no live text joins them.
