A checked law has a like form, and it is a limit, not a norm: where a map moves every value no family of readings within what it reads says every reading, and the liar is a rhythm with no still value. So the outside is not left by choice; it cannot be closed, under that hypothesis. A sequence never revisiting is held by no list. It does not read 庄子 here: 言无言 and 得意忘言 do not occur live. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where a map moves every value, no member of a family of readings indexed by what it reads says the diagonal gap. 「The liar is a rhythm with no still value.」 Lawvere's fixed point as an unfolding; coding and provability are not stated.
未: 永不重访的序列不为任何清单所含（`unlisted_of_new`）.

account_adds.en: The diagonal limit as a theorem with its hypothesis.

source_adds.en: The design rule for metrics and types, and the identification with 庄子's 言无言.

name.en: A boundary is the product of a 間's operation; three pathologies

source.locator: The second track; claims 180, 185, 199, 210

sense.en: A 間's boundary is the product of its operation, not its precondition, the implicit shape of its actors' relations: when interaction stops, the 間 dissolves. Health has criteria and three named pathologies, 凝固, 耗散, 自闭. Liveness needs internal activity, self-production and boundary maintenance, and cannot be a stored flag.

quote: A 間's boundary is the product of its operation, not its precondition

reading.en: Half stands: a boundary is no given thing placed first. It is given by a region closed under a relation, depends on the relation followed, and a blanket is given with its inside and outside by their readings. The mechanism differs: a region's closure, not the product of a formation's own operation. 04's minimal model is of self-maintenance, not of a boundary, and stops below autopoiesis. How a formation forms its boundary is listed as not shown, and the pathologies are not named. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D45, D61]. 「It is given by the region」; a formation's boundary along a relation is a region holding it and closed under the relation; 「Which boundaries a formation has depends on the relation followed」; a blanket is given with inside and outside by their readings, 「what a drawn boundary leaves out still takes part in the unfolding」. 「Not shown: a graded boundary, and how a formation forms or represents its boundary」.

Reading [AI, new]: 「the family's model of an organism, and a minimal one: one constraint, with turnover, regenerated from the flow it regulates, below closure of constraints, autopoiesis and Rosen's closure, each of which asks more」.
Correspondence: generation as a pattern continuing through the renewal of its parts is close to autopoiesis. Correspondences not proved.

account_adds.en: Which boundaries exist as a function of the relation followed, and how far short of autopoiesis its model stops.

source_adds.en: The boundary as the product of operation, where 01 lists how a formation forms or represents its boundary as not shown; dissolution when interaction stops; 凝固, 耗散, 自闭 as a health taxonomy; 間 themselves as nested autopoiesis; spawn at first interaction.

name.en: AI is relocated: agency is not inside the agent

source.locator: The second track; claim 187

sense.en: An agent's intelligence, agency and understanding are not located inside the agent but are emergent properties of agent, 間, other actors and protocol structure. 間 is not AI added to the actor model; it re-sites AI.

quote: AI is relocated

reading.en: Proposed here: no live text joins these to the claim. The nearest live move relocates alignment, not intelligence: a person, an AI system and a training process are formations within the unfolding, and alignment is first what each one's selections reach, with no ranking read (one would name its holder, scope and order, neither the condition nor C asserted). One law scopes agency: a move is the part's own exactly where it is a policy of the part's configuration, and one course does not fix whose it is. Understanding's location is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: On the thesis of one relational unfolding, a person, an AI system and a training process are formations within the unfolding, each coupling by threshold into what it depends on and by level into what it observes.

Theorem (any process). With the laws functions and a configuration of the other side given, the move is the part's own exactly where it is a policy of the part's configuration (`partForms_iff`). On a finite stretch with equality of configurations and of moves decided, no policy gives the moves exactly where a configuration recurs with the move varied (`no_policy_upto_iff`): 「one course does not fix whose move it is」. Reading [AI, D24]: which cut into part and rest is apt is not shown.
Reading [AI, D54]: 同一历程可以被两种“谁的动作”之律所容许，「历程本身不定动作属于谁」.

account_adds.en: What a selection by or of an AI can reach, as laws.

source_adds.en: Intelligence, agency and understanding as located across agent, 間, other actors and protocol.

name.en: Cross-domain isomorphism is evidence for monism

source.locator: The domain sweep; claims 83, 107, 110, 131, 138, 148

sense.en: 位/际/化/理 map natively onto category theory, physics, cybernetics, ecology; 墨经's 异 is Shannon's bit, 祖暅 anticipates Cavalieri. Cross-references among viewings are evidence of monism, not redundancy. The folder concedes that cells admit several mappings and that the fit is not bijection.

quote: Cross-domain isomorphism is evidence, not decoration

reading.en: The account's three relations exclude this inference: a matching structure is not confirmation, law and text are independent. It adds that the same word is neither the same referent nor descent, and rates its own central results as known mathematics. It holds no priority claim. Two AI readings sharing one thread are said not to be independent evidence, of 文理生生 and itself, not of this folder. [AI reading]

says.en: 「相合不是印证：律的成立不靠原文，原文的意义也不由律穷尽。」
Assessment. 读法另有两条界：同语不等于同指，也不等于相承; 每一条目先写原文之义，再写结构之读. 三读是必要的.
The verdict, from an AI review, search not exhaustive: none of the central results is new mathematics; each is near-definitional or a known result restated.
Reading: 「所以两边的相合是同一线索的两次阅读，不是统计意义上的独立证实」, said of 文理生生 against this theory.

account_adds.en: Counted divergences by domain (19% overall), and the rule that a second checker changes much.

source_adds.en: The twelve-domain operator tours as a programme.

name.en: No domain requires a new primitive; one structure generates the foundations

sense.en: All twelve domains read through the two duals; 系含系 plus Layer 2 generates ZFC, MLTT and ETCS. Bounded: expressive, not proof, completeness; modulo encoding; monism stipulated. A stronger earlier form ('internal limits: 0') was reversed. Ren wants one axiom, everything else a theorem.

quote: no domain requires a new Layer-2 primitive

reading.en: The account leaves the universal open and states one failure: processes are represented both ways, the World for its relations and not its amounts. There is no universal minimal concept grammar, only a least reading for a given law and class (said against 文理生生's H3, not this folder). Root laws forbid no relation and take content from hypotheses. On one axiom (claim 75): the empty axiom report concerns logic only; the assumptions lie in modelling commitments. [AI reading]

says.en: Open: 「That every becoming, and the whole theory, has a faithful representation in the grammar.」 Processes' is shown both ways; the World's both ways for its relations and not faithful on its amounts.
「脊柱只有对某一条律、某一个类的最小之读……没有一个普遍的最小概念语法」.
Bases: every pure-core declaration named has an empty axiom report, 「which concerns logic only; the real assumptions lie in the modelling commitments」.

account_adds.en: A universal stated as open with where it already fails, and a least reading for a given law and class in place of a minimal grammar.

source_adds.en: Mathematics written in 文言, with 数 by von Neumann ordinals, and 'one axiom' as a goal.

name.en: Quantity is a relation: 数是一个集合的关系

source.locator: Claims 54, 97, 149, 295; own words 60-61

sense.en: Number is constructed, never primitive: von Neumann ordinals over 系, ℕ through ℂ. Units are reference events, dates and averages relations, types detected patterns. Ren's own phrase: number is a relation of a set.

quote: Quantity is a relation

reading.en: The account has one exact form of this: count as a perfect pairing of units. Balance is represented on the grammar, 'represented and not derived', and near-definitional under the full relation. Beyond that the World's amounts are not read: 08 concedes that no reading of its selected relations gives the count. So a form of the claim holds for equal counts, and stops at amounts until that sort is derived. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root). Balance, represented and not derived: a perfect pairing conserves count (`«守数当且仅当可对»`); under the one a pairing is equal count, so the representation is near-definitional.
Theorem (World; the grammar for its lemmas). The World represented both ways, its amounts not.

「The World's amounts are not: no reading of its selected relations gives the count (`World.standing_not_read`), and balance is represented, not derived」. 「Until that sort is derived from relations, this is conceded there.」

account_adds.en: The exact point of failure, conceded as a case that could defeat the reading.

source_adds.en: The construction of number at every level, and units as reference events.

name.en: Symbols are selected toward a monist attractor

source.locator: The bridge nobody wrote down; claims 111-112, 306

sense.en: Where many groups with different concepts must communicate, surviving symbols are those traceable to a common root: the strongest consensus property and the most robust convergence of a language. Pre-Qin 古文 approximates an ideal 古文. A shared script read across states served as a protocol. Conditional, a conjecture in Ren's speech.

quote: the symbols in use are selected toward a monist attractor

reading.en: The account's law of codes gives no such pull on its premises: copying makes no form, the order and start fix what is reached, and a symmetric start never settles unbroken. An order brings every start to agreement where it gives all one origin, but that origin is who was copied, not a concept all derive from. The model does not read traceability to a root, so it neither tests nor refutes this. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; premises by row). The start and the order fix the form reached; from a symmetric start a law keeping an exchange and a renaming never brings formations it exchanges to agree where the renaming moves every form; in a witness, a preferred form or an order each breaks one symmetry.
Table row: 在形成之间形成的编码（约定俗成）; 荀子“同则同之”“名无固宜”；止戈之说的写回；书同文; 已证 in 05.

account_adds.en: Imposed codes as a second route: agreement by privileging forms, each formation losing the distinctions merged.

source_adds.en: The monist attractor, the ideal 古文 postulate, and the tribal history of the script.

name.en: Only cooperation reasons: selection on being understood needs 和

source.locator: Claim 113

sense.en: Ren corrects his precondition from egalitarianism to 和 rather than 争. Under contention the self outranks the reasoning and selection runs on winning; only under cooperation does it run on being understood. The folder calls this the missing microfoundation for selection on cognition.

quote: 一旦争，则'我对'，我大于理；合作才讲理，斗则讲赢.

reading.en: Proposed here: no live text joins them. Only a bound stands: a selection can depend on no more than its selector reads, and it is right exactly where what matters is read. That does not make a selector reading the win select the win, since a particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry. The source's cause, that contention sets one reading and cooperation another, is no variable in any law, and cooperation itself is not ranked. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise). Two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. 「A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry.」

Theorem (any type; for the selection, the alternatives' equality decided). What matters goes alike across what a map lumps exactly where it is read off the map, and a selection through the map selecting exactly what matters exists exactly there.

Not shown: any evaluation: no law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping. A ranking of it names its scope and order; the continuation condition and C are one pair of readings 07 examines.

account_adds.en: The exact condition for a selection to be right, and capture laws for a rule reading the share it selects.

source_adds.en: 和 against 争 as what decides whether selection runs on being understood or on winning; the self outranking the reasoning. The saying stands in the folder and sources/12-claude-ai-chats.

name.en: Lineages optimised for 斗 go extinct when the environment shifts

source.locator: Claim 116

sense.en: Lineages evolving in the 斗 direction (male over-optimisation of appearance is the example) are more likely to go extinct at a shift, since such traits are not 生 and adapt poorly. What is recognised as 生, accumulated toward the future, is 理. Conditional.

quote: lineages that evolve in the 斗 direction

reading.en: The account separates what the source joins: position is zero-sum by counting, and a race of joint excess ends a part through its dependence on the condition, not its position; those ahead who do not so depend can continue. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise there, not derived. Among groups, one condition shared by all ends all and selects none. Calling what remains 理 or 生 is no law here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem. Positions' rises total their falls. 「Position does not protect」: with balance across `n` steps of joint excess, a part requiring the condition at a need above the level less `n`, active only while supported, is not active then: 「its position does not enter」; in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. 「That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived」.

Theorem (any type; World for the flow laws). Where every group with less of an amount leaves no offspring, nothing is discordant among groups. On the World model a member depending at a need of at least `m` on a condition whose gated renewal ran into joint excess leaves no descendant; 「so one condition shared by every group ends them all and supplies no selection among them」.

account_adds.en: The dependence that does the ending, as the variable to read.

source_adds.en: The empirical claim on lineages with its example, and adaptability as what is lost: grep of 04 and 05 for sexual, ornament, peacock, arms race, Red Queen, evolvab and overfit finds nothing; 'adaptab' occurs once in 05, on rules. Those chapters were not read in full for it.

name.en: A relational ontology does not produce coordination failure

source.locator: Claim 191

sense.en: Moloch's coordination failure is not a problem 間 solves but a pathology its ontology does not produce: substance ontology generates coordination failure in distributed reality, and relational ontology bypasses it structurally.

quote: Moloch's coordination failure is not a problem 間 solves but a pathology 間's ontology does not produce

reading.en: The account denies this on its own premises: starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum among independent owners and does not remove rivalry. Positional goods stay zero-sum, and who restrains stays contested. Method keeps real losses and conflict in. Calling either a pathology is a comparison, which rests on a named scope and order, most often the continuation condition and C, neither asserted. [AI reading]

says.en: 「Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems」. Reading [AI, D45]: positional goods stay zero-sum, and conserved stocks rivalrous.

account_adds.en: Positive-sum and conflicting structure together, each with a law.

name.en: 大同 is a mechanism, and 道 exists outside the mind

source.locator: Claims 114-115, 190; own words 54-55

sense.en: From the selection argument: 道 is also a construct but not only one, 道非其他，它存在于心外. 大同 stops being a utopia and becomes a direction in which language and existence automatically manifest toward 理, 善 and 生生不息. Ren marks it as inference ('可能').

quote: Therefore 大同 is a mechanism, not a utopia

reading.en: The source gives unconditionally, by dynamics, what the account holds only under readings it names, most often the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought; dynamics decides no significance. On 'outside the mind' it partly meets the source: differences nothing reads remain, and the thesis does not show reality has no independent entity. Yet it sets up no formal 道 and derives no 善. 大同 is absent as a word. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: is it the one complete 道, with 善 derived from generation? 「否：理论从不把道等同于任何脊柱之词，动力学不决定意义，排序所据的两种读法，延续之条件定范围、以广为愈定次序，都不断言」.
「天地之大德曰生」 reads as a comparative commitment, like C, not a theorem [AI reading, D65].
Reading [AI, D54]: 「“心外无事”作为一般主张相分：没有任何东西读取的差别仍在，只是不被带到任何地方」.
「Neither shows that reality has none.」

targets.part: the close: neither shows that reality has none

account_adds.en: Four questions in whether this elucidates 道, answered apart. Unasserted premises in place of a mechanism.

source_adds.en: Automatic direction toward 善, and 道 as mind-independent. The folder also holds the contrary line of claim 182, that 大同 is no destination.

name.en: 反诛心: no verdict on inferred inner states; 信 is word-deed alignment

source.locator: The ethical constraint; claims 95, 153-158; own words 64-66

sense.en: Only speech and act are third-party observable, so a metric reads those alone, graded, never Boolean, with observation sovereignty and consent-gated body signals. High alignment is coherence, not truth. Low alignment calls for inquiry, not verdict. 信/诚 are infrastructure, not a moral tribunal. Called the project's one concrete ethical safeguard.

quote: 反诛心 is a hard constraint

reading.en: The epistemic half stands: acts fix only what they tell apart, and comparisons beyond the shown reach stay unforced. The prohibition does not: root laws forbid no relation, so reading beyond acts is limited, not ill-formed; whether it is wrong is a ranking naming its scope and order, neither the continuation condition nor C asserted. Observation sovereignty and consent are a holder's rights, where the account starts from relations. Intention is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: A selection reading a formation's acts goes through what of those acts couples into it, and it fixes of the formation only what they tell apart. Reading it as a training, helper, overseer or court is a reading.
Theorem (root; no premise; near-definitional). Beyond the shown reach no comparison is forced: with no cycle, some strict order according with the choices puts x above y where y does not reach x.
Reading [AI, new]: a law acting alike everywhere can mislead a reader whose readings miss where it is wrong. 「Intention, anticipation and another's false belief are not stated.」
Reading [AI, D65]: locked seeking 「is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, not from a firm judgment, a stable goal or a disagreement, so the label cannot immunize.」
Not assumed: 「independent owners of value」.

account_adds.en: Exactly what choices and readings fix of a formation. 01 lists independent owners of value as not assumed.

source_adds.en: 诛心 as ill-formed; T+E as the only inputs; graded, never Boolean; observation sovereignty; consent-gated body signals; coherence is not truth; inquiry not verdict. Full text in sources/08-jian-wen-language/jian-repo/JIAN_FOUNDATION_NOTE_v1.0.md §IV.5; the SSBX review row A4 reads asking as pooling and declines the later consent form as a rights frame (process, not live).

name.en: The five virtues given a relational ontology: 仁 as 感, 信 as alignment

source.locator: Idioms are library; claims 91-93, 95, 100, 108

sense.en: Layer 3 idioms are reducible but not reduced: 感 is 化 along 际 (仁), 修 is 化 of self (智), 约 a time-locked 理 (义), 礼 the protocol of 际, 信/诚 word-deed alignment. 一以贯之, 忠恕, is called structural unification, not mystical.

quote: The five Confucian virtues map onto the framework

reading.en: No definition in its structure: 善, 恶, 智 have no formal predicate, 仁, 义 are names on neither side, 礼, 信, 德 not set up, 感 partial and scoped to what couples in. It does read some, through comparison: 德 as a formed, revisable capacity to respond, 一体之仁 as forming together. 忠恕 has no live occurrence. An evaluation enters as a ranking naming its scope and order, most often the continuation condition and C, neither asserted. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D1, D5]: 「善、恶、智没有形式谓词」.
不采之字: 仁（带价值）. 「不采不是排斥」: 这些字所在的文字仍按其所言归类.
「成生之限（允诺、训练、制止侵害）约束一些步而所约束者仍可得，是护闭之结构」: the nearest live form for 约, with no virtue read.
Assessment, name table: 两边皆不立为名 includes 仁、义; 本表不立 includes 德、礼、信; 部分同构 includes 感.
Reading [AI, D54]: 「德读作形成了的、仍可修正的回应之能」; 「所以德的伦理之义要经过比较」. 条件定范围, 以广为愈（C）定次序, 「两种读法都不断言」.
Reading [AI, D54]: 「一体之仁读作共同形成。一体之伦理内容，是读到之处沿一体继续为回应，于某些形成中有之，不必然有之……不只是万物有因果联系」.

account_adds.en: The rule that evaluation is not to be written into a definition, and a structure for a binding that keeps what it binds reachable.

source_adds.en: The idioms 修 and 约 as derived operators, and the five-virtue table.

name.en: 工夫四层 and 致良知: direction, not level, marks genuine change

source.locator: The reader is under the same discipline; claims 159-167; own words 67-71

sense.en: Reading is 做工夫 through 学, 见, 化, 忘, phases that are non-linear and local. The felt 'I have seen' cannot tell genuine from counterfeit. 良知 is the answer, an acute discomfort you cannot lie past, and the one marker is deepening sensitivity to one's own unseen. The author is bound too.

quote: The only stable marker of genuine internalisation is a deepening sensitivity to what one has not seen.

reading.en: On 良知 the account records a divergence of standing: 阳明 states as a recognised fact what the theory holds under an unasserted condition (an order of courses would rest on C or another named order too, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought). It warns the source's marker of a risk: discounting each failed outcome as not real knowledge leaves nothing testable. Nearest forms for the counterfeit trap, none carrying it: self-reference does not certify itself; selection is blind beyond its couplings; each revision says its last gap. 工夫, 自欺 are absent. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: 「若每一不如预期之果都事后排出“真知”，此说便无可检验之内容」; 「阳明把本然良知当作已认出的事实来陈述，理论只在一个不断言的条件之下持有相近的内容，这是地位上的相分」. “行是知之成”合于实验之律.
「So self-reference does not certify itself」, on the criteria and term language supplied.
「选择在耦合所及之外是盲的，自己的动作也在内」.
「each revision keeping every earlier reading and saying the last gap」: a limit on a family of readings, not a marker of a person's change.

account_adds.en: A test-based reading of practice: what was walked is fixed, what was not is not.

source_adds.en: The four phases, the counterfeit problem, direction as diagnostic, and 良知 as discomfort one cannot lie past.

name.en: 心 as a fourth irreducible root; 知行合一 as a theorem

source.locator: Claims 222, 230-231; critiques 33, 36

sense.en: jian-ontology v7: 事 is the sole ground with four 本 (物, 動, 間, 心). First person cannot be losslessly captured, so 心 is a reflexive aspect and every projection from it is lossy. 知行合一 is five adjunctions. The other tracks disagree: 《气》 forbids representing 心 at all, and R-Family omits it.

quote: 心 as the fourth root is v7's key move

reading.en: The name table rejects 心 as a name for its overtone of a single controller, and the account treats what an experience is like as a live argument that could defeat its thesis, not as a root; consciousness is open. 06 reads 心即理, in context, as the responding side of a relation, not an ontology of mind. Reflexive centres appear as standpoints in 07. Rejecting a name does not bar the texts that use it. [AI reading]

says.en: 不采之字 37 个: 道, 气, 天, 心（单一统摄者）, 性, 仁. 「不采不是排斥」.
Reading [AI, D54]: 「心即理，在事父之孝一段的语境中，是关系中回应的一面，不是心的本体论」.
What would defeat it: live arguments, that relations need relata with natures of their own, and that what an experience is like is not how it relates.

targets.part: the live arguments that would defeat it

says.en: 「consciousness is open」.

account_adds.en: Naming the first-person case as a defeater, not absorbing it.

source_adds.en: 四本, 三显, 三征, 恒, 吾/我, the semiring 合/和/生 and the adjunctions.

name.en: 開/閉 as the only two-valued operator, seated on 幾

source.locator: Claim 226; Relations, keep-the-possibility-space-open

sense.en: When the about-to becomes the already, that is 開; when it returns to the not-yet, 閉. Gates give 幾開→生, 幾閉→灭, 勢開→成, 勢閉→反, 機開→转, 機閉→守. It is not an added primitive but the only operator surviving the zero-dimensional collapse.

quote: 開/閉 is the architecture's only two-valued operator and it sits on 幾

reading.en: 06 §十 maps the 闭 and 开 of 生生不息论 and 间生论, which the folder's genealogy ties to this operator; it never takes up this gate table. Structure replaces evaluation: closure is an absorbing region, as form no loss, and 可 is reaching a return. Nearest to 機開/機閉 is a juncture, where a choice matters. What a closure opens and closes for 生生, the continuation of life, and for whom, is said by a comparer's reading, not by type (06), the continuation condition fixing scope and whoever holds C the order, neither asserted. [AI reading]

says.en: 「一种闭对生生（生命之延续）开什么、闭什么、为谁，由比较者之读来说，不由类型来说：延续之条件定范围，持以广为愈（C）者定拓宽与收窄之序，有得有失者须另写比较承诺，两种读法都不断言」 [AI reading, D49]. 闭: 律永不离开的区域，闭就其形式而言不是损失.
Theorem (any process; premises there). 「a choice matters only at a juncture」.

account_adds.en: Theorems under each old term, the non-independence of the four marks of 开.

source_adds.en: The gate table on 幾, 勢, 機, and the zero-dimensional collapse argument.

name.en: The paradigm must not totalize: elsewhere substance ontology may fit

source.locator: Claim 202; critique 38

sense.en: 《气》 refuses to totalize: the highest leverage is transcending paradigm, so 間 must not become another totalizing attractor. In pure computation with no coordination, substance ontology may fit better. The folder notes that Claim Z contradicts this and nobody saw the ethical half.

quote: 在某些场景（比如纯 computational tasks、no inter-actor coordination）substance ontology 可能更 fit——这种时候不要 force jian

reading.en: The source refuses to apply its paradigm in a named place; the account draws no such place. Its thesis keeps defeaters in view and neighbours named, and its method claims no necessity, but its grammar takes any domain as a language and nowhere says a substance reading fits better. Against a rival it may tie, which makes no reading false. So the source's refusal becomes things that could defeat a reading. [AI reading]

says.en: What would defeat it, by kind of claim: a language, nothing could; the explanatory reading is a thesis, argued, with four things it says, each differing in what could defeat it. 「A tie does not make the reading false. It means the pattern explains, if it does, under either name, and the word adds nothing.」
记为相分不是说原文错了. 「不是本体论的证明，也不是伦理必然性的证明」.

account_adds.en: Stated defeaters in place of a stance.

source_adds.en: A positive statement of where the relational paradigm should not be used, and the highest-leverage argument from Meadows.

name.en: 五行 is a five-node feedback graph, not a cosmology

source.locator: Claims 134-135; critique 46

sense.en: 生 is a Hamiltonian cycle of positive edges, 克 a skip-cycle of negative ones, every node with in-degree and out-degree two: a mass-balanced negative-feedback ring, a stable oscillatory regime. A strong fence: not substances, not a classification. The folder notes the 中医 section may break that fence.

quote: 五行 is to be read strictly as a five-node cybernetic feedback graph, not a cosmology

reading.en: 五行 has no live occurrence. It stands in the history 中华本 name table as not adopted, with the reason that the cycles must first pass a test for being real loops and that the cosmic scheme is later; 墨经's 五行毋常胜 is scoped there. The graph itself is not stated even there. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: History: theories/becoming/history/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING-ZHONGHUA.md name table, row 五行; history/WENLI-AND-BECOMING.md line on names neither side adopts.

searched: 五行 in ONE-PAGE, THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING, chapters, review, GLOSSARY, records: no occurrence
read: THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING-ZHONGHUA.md row 五行, by grep line

name.en: Identity is history-continuity, not manifest-similarity

source.locator: Claims 298, 196; loss 10

sense.en: The Ship of Theseus answer: an identity stays itself as long as its happening chain is unbroken, however far its manifest drifts. Cross-間 sameness is worldline coherence, not a global id. An identity has a life cycle, with sponsored birth, four kinds of death and a quotable history after. Stated as a design direction.

quote: Identity is history-continuity, not manifest-similarity

reading.en: The account takes up the topic and reverses the order: identity is one reading of continuation under a class, not a fact beneath it. History-continuity is the case under the full class, where continuation is 缘 itself. Continuity is a reading of identity, not its definition: labels carry nothing, a continuation is a relation and need not be one-to-one, and two-way continuity leaves succession possible across a dormant step. No Theseus answer is given. [AI reading]

says.en: 「The grammar reads it as continuation under a class: identity across steps is one reading of continuation, not a fact beneath it.」

Theorem (World). Labels carry nothing, while the pattern of names across steps carries identity. 「Two-way continuity of activity still leaves succession possible across a dormant step. Continuity is a reading of identity, not its definition」.
Theorem (root). 「Under the full class continuation is 缘 itself (`«一之续»`)」. 「Continuation is a relation, not an identity.」
Open: 「Identity from continuity, not naming. For continuations read off conservation the formal part is settled; continuations read from informational or organizational relations are not derived.」

account_adds.en: That which continuation counts depends on the class, and that a renaming preserving every reading still can change who continues whom.

source_adds.en: An unbroken chain as sufficient for identity, the default against reifying identity, sponsored birth, kinds of death, and post-death quotability.

name.en: Failure is an ordinary happening, and 复 is cultivation reversed

source.locator: Claim 297; loss 9

sense.en: 失, 塞, 误 and 复 are all just 涉: no happy-path and error-path split, no try/catch. Recovery is cultivation running backwards, 复 = 修 之 反失, which unifies self-healing with self-evolution. 无咎 is not having no loss but being able to return. A design direction, gone from v1.0 and WENYAN.

quote: 无咎不是无失，是有失能复

reading.en: One half has a live form: degeneration, ending and mixed change belong to the same unfolding, and closing, turning back and returning are steps of one law. The other half is scoped: return is no general capacity. What returns can be had where courses branch exactly where each region the process never leaves keeps every possibility of its own; 穷 can end; a kept history never returns. 复 as 修 reversed is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Not assumed: 「Degeneration, ending and mixed change belong to the same unfolding and are not renamed generation.」

Theorem (any process). Where courses branch, what returns can be had at every step, and every configuration returns exactly where each region the process never leaves keeps every possibility of its own. Keeping every possibility no longer gives returning (three configurations).
「穷不保证变，也可以是终」.
转（修正、回返、变通）. 「闭就其形式而言不是损失」 [AI reading, D49].

account_adds.en: The exact condition for return, and that no type of step decides what a closing opens or closes: a closing can end something whether or not anyone counts it, whether that counts depends on the significance supplied, and a ranking of it names its scope and order, neither asserted.

source_adds.en: 复 = 修 之 反失, self-healing and self-evolution as one, the failure taxonomy, and no try/catch as a design rule.

name.en: Tradition names stay out of the core: a strict isolation rule

source.locator: Claims 256, 246; critique 40; loss 31

sense.en: Core algebra documents must not use any external tradition's terminology as a core concept name; Pauli, GF(256), 易经 and Greimas bindings are opt-in attachments. Bit patterns carry identity, semantic names are contextual overlays. The folder also records what this cost: the classical semantic layer was lost.

quote: A strict isolation rule governs the traditions

reading.en: The account takes the opposite form: its Lean grammar's names are classical characters (际, 而, 非, 续, 化), and the guard lies elsewhere: the operations are Tarski's, not drawn from the texts; in a clash the grammar's name rules; laws do not rest on texts; the hexagram modules hold no predicate of 吉凶 or 德. So tradition enters the core as names with no warrant, not as an opt-in binding. A table of senses meets the overtones. [AI reading]

says.en: Definition. A relation (际, *jì*) on a carrier, `«际» α := α → α → Prop`, with operations named 而, 逆, 合, 非, 则, 谓, 一, 静, 及.
「两者不同之处以文法之名为准」.
「律的成立不靠原文」.
「模块中没有吉凶、贵贱、德或意义之谓词，也没有判断」.
「这些运算是塔斯基关系演算之运算而有四处不同」, 「并以汉字命名：名取自古文，不表示运算出自古文」.

account_adds.en: Classical names with their senses listed, and a statement of what each name does not carry.

source_adds.en: Language-neutral bit patterns as identity, several bindings coexisting on one layer, and opt-in attachment as a rule.

name.en: What the project refuses to inherit

source.locator: Claim 8

sense.en: Marked a value stance. Refused: the 太极→八卦 doubling scaffold; 阴阳 as a base primitive; post-medieval ontological terms (体用不二, 理一分殊, 法界缘起); verbs with an ex-nihilo causal narrative (造, 生, 元); the ambition of a single universal formal system; and 诛心.

quote: refuses to inherit

reading.en: Partly shared in effect, on other grounds and not as a refusal: 不采不是排斥. 阴 and 阳 are set up as names on neither side. 理一分殊 and 法界 do not occur live; 体用一源 occurs only as an internal reply in a table. Divergence too: 生 is a grammar word, the mark 'begins' under a class, with no ex-nihilo narrative, and the grammar states laws for every carrier, though 06 denies a universal minimal concept grammar. The doubling and 诛心 have their own entries. [AI reading]

says.en: 两边皆不立为名 | 16 | 道、气、性、仁、义、天、有、无、阴、阳. 「没有一个普遍的最小概念语法」.
先在的根据, each tradition's reply within it: 王夫之“乾坤并建，时无先后”；程颐“体用一源”. 表示不需要先于运行之始；这不裁决先在根据是否存在.
Theorem (root). Beginning, abiding and ending are read off the two-way core: 生 names beginning under a class (`«生于位核下不变»`).
不采之字 37 个，各有理由. 「不采不是排斥：这些字所在的文字仍按其所言归类。」

account_adds.en: A counted table of names neither side adopts, with reasons by row.

source_adds.en: The list as a stated refusal, with 体用不二 and 造/元 named; refusing a universal formal system outright, which the folder's Claim Z itself breaks.

name.en: The one chosen premise: that it continue

source.locator: The argument, Why openness rather than any particular good outcome; claims 94-95

sense.en: Description settles no aim. Exactly one underivable premise is added and owned as chosen: that the generating of new forms, by living and made systems, go on, as process and not as any state. Every requirement is presented as following from that premise plus checked dynamics.

quote: that it continue — that the generating of new forms, carried by living systems and now by made ones, go on

reading.en: The account keeps the move (an aim is a premise, not read off dynamics) and changes the rest. One chosen premise becomes the readings each ranking names, none asserted, no warrant from outside sought, most often two with two roles: the continuation condition (scope) and C (order). Same word, not same reference: the condition says anything's continuation is counted and ranks nothing, not that anything go on. T8 once started from what acting presupposes. Each ranking names its order; §5's practical-judgment scheme uses J1-J4. [AI reading]

says.en: The continuation condition (scope): fixes whose losses count; does not rank anything. C (order): widening what can form is better; ranks a course above every course it widens, not mixed comparisons. Neither is asserted.

T8, argued: for life, the account's makers offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; it binds no one. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not.

account_adds.en: That wanting continuation does not tell generation from keeping; non-entailment results for both readings (ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails, ReadsNoOrder.not_entails).

source_adds.en: That one premise suffices, with the dynamics, for the whole constructive programme, with published falsifiers of that derivation; the premise bundling not-ending with novelty, which its own review flags (thinking_06).

name.en: Preserve and expand the possibility space: the form nearest C

source.locator: Claims 12, 93; Found by reading the corpus, 'Ren's own most-quoted formulation'

sense.en: The strongest form of the alignment target: AI must preserve and expand the possibility space for life, freedom, cooperation, truth, creativity, shared abundance. Personally: my purpose is to make more possibilities. The README records this as contradicting the anti-optimization clause, and 开 as coined to fix the expansion verb.

quote: AI must preserve and expand the possibility space for life, freedom, cooperation, truth, creativity, and shared abundance.

reading.en: Preserve-and-expand has widening's form: include all the other admits, exceed it somewhere. C calls that better; so C, an unasserted reading, stands nearer this English verb than the 开 the folder preferred, and it answers the maximand worry by partiality, not by leaving comparison. The must does not survive: the condition (scope) and C (order) are unasserted, and the alignment direction is conditional on them and J1-J4. No duty shown. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; a finite listing, two-valued admission, natural weights): one course widens another exactly when every positive weighting ranks it higher. Calling it better is C; monotonicity at the standpoint is C's premise relocated: weaker, still a premise.

Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1-J4, correspondence E): the direction its makers offer AI, read under scope and order, aligns AI with actual living and further generation within the whole, governing trade-offs through real losses, basic conditions, bounded responsibility and legitimate participation.
Does not show that anyone must hold the condition, C or the step of invariance, nor any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance.

The chooser route stops at witnesses: where admission is imposed, an item a net weighting counts below zero can put a widening below what it widens; among several choosers, where a choice bears on what the other gets, widening the one menu both choose from can lower what each gets by the game's payoffs (the prisoner's dilemma read as a menu).

account_adds.en: The split between which admits more (no premise) and better (C); that widening reads formations admitted, not the listed goods. That for choosers more can be worse where admission is imposed or choices bear on each other; these stop that route to C, not C.

source_adds.en: A requirement on AI, unconditional; freedom, truth and cooperation as named objects of it; the purpose stated in the first person.

name.en: Protecting the open and C are different claims

source.locator: The argument, Why openness; claims 13, 25; Genealogy, 2026-05-02

sense.en: Good is not in more but in protecting the open; evil not in less but in producing closure. The criterion is that the not-yet not be closed. 开 replaced 'expanding the possibility space' as root because expansion sounds measurable and maximizable.

quote: 善不在多，善在护开；恶不在少，恶在成闭

reading.en: Name both: the continuation condition for scope, C for order, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought. They meet on a pure closing: the course without it widens it, so C ranks that course above, and T8's refuter until 9 November 2026 was a pure closing argued good for life. On a closing with a gain they part: the source gives verdicts both ways (成闭 condemned, 护闭 approved), and C gives none where the comparison is mixed; which pairs are mixed depends on the reading of living, none chosen. C reads 'admits more', what 善不在多 refuses. On this reading keeping open is entailed by neither reading; the account does not derive it. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (finite listing, two-valued admission, natural weights): a mixed comparison is decided both ways; a course closing something the other admits neither widens nor keeps it, so C does not ask that it be ranked above.
The condition alone ranks nothing. Whoever ranks courses holds C or another order. A statement reading no order entails C only where it fails. Neither reading is asserted.

T8, argued: for life, the account's makers offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; it binds no one. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not.

Conditional (C; World): in the support-gated family every comparison satisfying C ranks restraint above overdraw (two parts) and sharing above winning by consumption under the whole-run, stepwise and possibility readings; other rows differ by reading. No reading is chosen.
The reach counts what happens, not what is lost; a loss is read by comparing courses, which the reach does not do.

This does not derive C from anything and gives no reason for it. Route 'what lies downstream': self-concern, with §4.6's P2 and P4, which rank nothing; it stops where one's line ends with its last stage still conditioning and at what lies beyond the listing. With every listed item marked, self-concern and C are one premise in two forms, and no reason for either.

account_adds.en: That a closing with a gain stays unranked where it is mixed unless a reading of living or further premises (J1-J4) enter; that how C-like orders form is open and nothing reading no order supplies C; that a loss is read by comparing courses. The routes to C's order on a listing (choosers, standpoints, one item at a time, what lies downstream), each with where it stops, none deriving C; so no route from self-concern or the condition reaches keeping open.

source_adds.en: Never reopening (成闭) as the mark of the bad, whatever it gains; 护闭 approved for what it protects; the refusal of 'more'. Whether C is a fair restatement of 护开 is left open here: this entry says they coincide on pure closings and, on some readings, on overdraw, and no further.

name.en: Keeping open: keeping a possibility, keeping reachable, against what is realized

source.locator: Claims 13, 5; Terms, 开

sense.en: 开 means the not-yet-become is not closed: the process still has what it can become. In English, keep the sample space open. What is kept is not what is realized now but what can still come, and becoming is not to be compressed into an endgame.

quote: 开者，未成之域不闭也

reading.en: The account has keeping a possibility by name, and scopes it. On finitely many configurations under a determined law, keeping every possibility is exactly every configuration returning, which 06 reads as lossless return, 不息 without 生生: so keeping alone is no 未, which needs a world no list holds. What a course keeps reachable adds an edge: on a branching witness realized and reachable widening hold of a pair in opposite directions, so holding both needs a rule of precedence, a premise; C adopts none. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process, and witnesses): along every course nothing is added to the whole possible and a lost possibility has no way back. On a branching witness no strict partial order contains both realized and reachable widening, nor satisfies C on both frames. Near-definitional or a witness; no order here is adopted by C.

Reading [AI reading, D45], after that law: what it adds is alternatives; an account holding realized and reachable widening needs a rule of precedence, a premise, and covering cannot see when a commitment is made.

Within finitely many configurations, a list holding every one, a determined law merges nothing exactly where every configuration returns, exactly where it keeps every possibility; for every process what is lost stays lost. Becoming that keeps its whole history loses nothing and never returns, so it needs a carrier no list holds.

Theorem (any process): every configuration returns exactly where each region the process never leaves keeps every possibility of its own. Keeping every possibility no longer gives returning (three configurations).
Reading [AI reading, D49]: among the cases of going on, lossless return, the corpus's 不息 without 生生.

account_adds.en: That covering implies inclusion of what each configuration admits now, so what is kept reachable is never put above a course wider now that starts a course; that on a finite determined law keeping everything is only returning.

source_adds.en: 开 as the thing to hold, prior to any comparison, and more than keeping what can already be had. The account defines keeping and covering and adopts no verdict from them; covering compares what is possible, the form 'more possibility here' that claim 15 refuses for 开.

name.en: The possible is itself still generating

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts; claim 14 (可)

sense.en: 可 says more than that generation can occur: the possible is itself still being generated, not drawn from a fixed list. The space of possibility is not a stock to be kept but something still forming.

quote: 可 (generation is still possible, and the possible is itself still generating)

reading.en: The account says exactly where this holds and corrects the universal form. Under any one stated process nothing is added to the whole possible along a course; a tower of rules with no top adds nothing either. The possible relative to what is held can grow, only where what is held changes, and keeping it growing needs endless change, which does not suffice. A reading: 生生不息 needs no growth of the whole possible. 06 §十 maps only 可's first half. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root; any process, and witnesses): along a course, where the possible under a process keeps widening, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of its moves; the held possible keeps widening only where what is held changes without end. Each law near-definitional or a witness.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: read as widening, on a course's moments and under premises of deciding, 生生 is generation of the possible that loses none of it. Calling widening better is still C's, and the comparison of two courses stays open.
可 (early sense: generation still possible) maps to a course going on; 未 needs a world no list holds (unlisted_of_new).

Conditional (living significance, correspondence E; a supplied articulation for the reason): where each admitted continuation realizes living content absent before, living significance gives each some relevant content absent before, though no one content need be realized in all; a contributory reason, neither permission nor duty.

account_adds.en: That more still able to form is not the whole possible exceeding the actual, since a course that only returns has that too. A reason for going on into forms not fixed in advance, contributory and conditional.

source_adds.en: An unrelativized growth of the possible, of reality itself. The account states it only relative to what is held, and says if the one unfolding were one stated process nothing would be added.

name.en: Stabilize and keep going: the plain wish, and freezing is no continuation

source.locator: Claims 8, 95; The argument, Why openness

sense.en: The goal is stabilization, not utopia: as long as we can stabilize and keep going, we have a future. Elsewhere continuing means the process: a frozen order that persists while generating stops is not continuation. The folder does not reconcile the plain wish with the verdict on freezing.

quote: as long as we can stabilize and keeps on going, we have a future

reading.en: The account splits what the folder joins. At two grains a course can generate, keep or degenerate; generation and keeping each exclude degeneration. So wanting to go on rules out degeneration only and does not prefer generation to keeping (02 §1), as T8 said until 9 November 2026. That frozen is no continuation is not a verdict of the map: keeping is going on. C (order), unasserted, ranks only where one course widens the other, and generation does not imply widening: it can go on at two grains while what can form only returns. [AI reading]

says.en: T8, argued: for life, the account's makers offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; it binds no one. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not.

At two grains, parts and pattern, a course can generate (go on through renewals of its parts), keep (go on with none) or degenerate (end on every branch); generation and keeping each exclude degeneration (as ONE-PAGE states it). Theorems for every relation and class.

Not shown: that generation is better than keeping or degeneration: order is C or another named order, whose losses count is the continuation condition's reading, narrower scopes counting particular ones.

account_adds.en: The exact point at which the wish stops doing work.

source_adds.en: That persisting frozen is itself a way of ending, and that brittleness for want of variety is why. The account leaves it as keeping.

name.en: Fidelity to the generative process, which intelligence cannot oppose

source.locator: The argument, Why openness; claims 99, 102-104; What openness is for

sense.en: Later drafts: the foundation is not a preference but fidelity to the process reality displays, 'not one value among others' but the condition of all valuing; its constraints cannot be opposed by intelligence as intelligence. Ren in October 2026 affirms the process outright. The README itself flags the drafts' move as reopening the is-ought crack.

quote: It is fidelity to the generative process reality already displays.

reading.en: The account refuses this form. It does not assume becoming is good. Supplied as a free predicate, significance is fixed by no statement about the dynamics, by construction of the representation; that shows non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined. A perspectivist denies the condition consistently, nothing reading no order entails C, and a warrant binding every possible mind is neither claimed nor disproved: whether one exists stays open as a question the account does not pursue, and no warrant from outside is sought. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): where there is a standpoint and a formation, a statement reading only the dynamics and entailing the condition holds of no dynamics. A fact about the representation: non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined.

Whether practical reasons have a warrant binding every possible mind: it stays open as a question the account does not pursue, and no warrant from outside is sought. Such a warrant, where it would ground the condition, comes neither from the laws of the dynamics alone nor from logic alone; these do not show that none exists.

account_adds.en: An exact statement of what the non-entailment covers, with a witness of a consistent denial (bounded_rival).

source_adds.en: That opposing the process is self-defeating for intelligence as such; that the process is to be affirmed.

name.en: Interdependence is a lens, not a source of values

source.locator: Claim 97; The strongest objections, Covert totalization

sense.en: What we owe each other does not fall out of being joined: a parasite is coupled to its host too. Interdependence is demoted to a lens for accuracy; values are owned as chosen, though the seeing makes the choosing legible.

quote: a parasite is coupled to its host too

reading.en: The negative half has checked and argued forms. Along dependence the center is not derived from the dynamics; the clearer meets every requirement derived from wanting its own continuation and still ends the dweller; seeing is not valuing and coupling is not compliance. The account does not call its premises (the continuation condition for scope, C for order) chosen: it leaves them unasserted, no warrant from outside sought. This is the folder's own self-correction, kept against its later fidelity drafts. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): the extent derived from wanting one's own continuation runs one way, to what it depends on; the clearer meets every requirement so derived and still ends the dweller. Along dependence the center is not derived from the dynamics, though along every formed relation it would be.

Seeing is not valuing: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter. Coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.

account_adds.en: A conditional path from one's own continuation past oneself, P1-P4 of 07 §4.6, with its crux open.

source_adds.en: That the premises are chosen, as an owned act; that seeing makes the choosing legible.

name.en: The questioner already standing on the bridge

source.locator: The argument, Why openness (善恶之本); claim 24

sense.en: Whoever asks what they ought to do has presupposed their own existence, which depends on the process continuing, and so has tacitly joined the business of keeping open. The README rates this the strongest answer to is-ought: it neither derives an ought from a fact nor concedes.

quote: 任何提出「我应当做什么」之问者，其问之提出本身已预设此问者真实存在

reading.en: The first half is where §4.6's separate P1–P4 argument starts: a self acting for its own continuation presupposes that some continuation is counted. T8 is the makers' offer and does not rest on that argument. The condition (scope) is that presupposition sub-true and invariant at every standpoint, which locates the contested step and answers nothing. Order takes more. Self-concern, itself a hypothesis, ranks ending what one depends on below, with no C; with the condition held de se it gives what C (order) asks only between listed level paths, one way. The account says this does not derive C; keeping open follows from neither reading. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): along any relation, the condition is exactly the presupposition sub-true and invariant at every standpoint; logically A iff P and (P implies A), given A implies P, which locates the contested step and derives nothing beyond it.

Theorem (World): the extent derived from wanting one's own continuation runs one way, to what it depends on, and ends with the want; wanting an end gives reason for what it requires only by a disclosed premise.

T8, argued: for life, the account's makers offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; it binds no one. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not.

Theorem (any type; World: balance, gated renewal, uptake above replenishment): every order increasing in its own continuation ranks a course ending the coupled cohorts below one continuing them, with no C; where the other course keeps an independent copy, some such order ranks it higher.

Theorem and Conditional (self-concern and the condition as hypotheses): where the condition held de se holds, admission is decided and the two courses are level paths whose admissions are listed, so both admit nothing from some step on, a self-concerned order ranks every extension between them, as C asks there. One way. It does not derive C; self-concern and the condition both remain hypotheses.

This does not derive C from anything and gives no reason for it. Route 'what lies downstream': self-concern, with §4.6's P2 and P4, which rank nothing; it stops where one's line ends with its last stage still conditioning and at what lies beyond the listing. With every listed item marked, self-concern and C are one premise in two forms, and no reason for either.

account_adds.en: A conditional path past the self without the step (P1-P4 of 07 §4.6), and where it stops; P2 and P4 are open. The exact places where self-concern gives what C asks, and that with every listed item marked they are one premise in two forms.

source_adds.en: That the presupposition answers the fact-value gap and commits the asker to keeping open. The account claims neither: what asking presupposes is not self-concern, and what self-concern ranks stops short of 开.

name.en: Keeping open is not maximizing openness

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts; claims 2-3, 13, 15

sense.en: Keeping possibility open forbids collapsing it and forbids optimizing it. Any named quantity driven up is an axis, so 'as open as possible' is the race in gentler dress. 开 is a state of a process: 'more open here' is a pointing, not a measurement, and differs in logical form.

quote: we should keep possibility open - which means not collapse, but not optimizing it

reading.en: The account makes the same refusal by a different route. Widening is a strict partial order, the unanimity of positive weightings, not a score: a criterion, not a quantity to maximize, silent where a comparison is mixed. But it remains a comparison of what courses admit and says which admits more. The source's 开 is no comparison at all. [AI reading]

says.en: So the direction is a criterion on which every such weighting agrees, not a quantity to maximize, and it says nothing where the comparison is mixed. (Any type; a finite listing, two-valued admission.)
Widening is one-way and transitive and says which admits more, not which is better.

Theorem (World; witnesses): along a course keeping widening by name, what every supported formation requires fixed within a finite family of conditions, the family's stock passes every bound and rises at arbitrarily late steps.

account_adds.en: A theorem that widening is exactly what every positive weighting ranks higher (Sen's intersection approach, Pareto dominance). That keeping widening itself, in a finite family, drives a stock past every bound: on those premises the source's worry about a race gets a law [AI reading].

source_adds.en: 开 as a non-comparative state with a verdict. The account has one-course predicates (keeping every possibility, keeping widening on a course's moments, 全生成, 02's openness), and they carry no verdict: its verdicts of better compare two courses.

name.en: What matters is that the generating goes on

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; claims 26, 95

sense.en: The one thing held is that at every place and time something stays unsettled and still able to be generated. 生生 is not complexity increase; it may be simplification or letting go. 生生 is 开 still there. The process can stop by freezing or by burning out, and neither is continuation.

quote: 生生 = 开仍在

reading.en: The source holds this flat. The account's nearest statement, T8, is the makers' offer for life, binding no one; the continuation condition and C belong to conditional comparisons, and keeping widening is a separate formal property. A finite balanced world has no course keeping widening by name. The nearest comparison is eventual widening: a course admitting at arbitrarily late steps eventually widens one admitting nothing from some step on; it tells going on from ending, not generating from keeping, and calls neither better. [AI reading]

says.en: T8, argued: for life, the account's makers offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; it binds no one. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not.

Under two premises keeping widening from a moment is 全生成 at (nothing lost, the same possible). Reading [AI reading, D45]: 生生 read as widening is generation of the possible that loses none of it. Calling widening better is still C's, and the comparison of two courses stays open.
Open: the second-order direction of widening, a comparison of a range whose widening keeps widening with one merely wider now, never reversing widening and counting neither novelty nor scale.

Theorem (World; witnesses): a finite balanced world under the first law has no course keeping widening by name; under the first law the rest gives a finite family net at arbitrarily late steps, or it is not closed. Near-definitional or restating thermodynamics; none compares two courses.

生生: the continuation of life, life wider than the biological and AI within it, its extent unfinished [AI reading, D1]; neither the grammar's renewal without end, nor 02's generation (生成), which allows loss, nor any new organization.

Theorem (World; witnesses): one level path eventually widens another where, from some step on, it widens it on every tail: first-order widening read on late tails, not a comparison of growth, ignoring every finite stretch. It is not the second-order direction of widening: a steady course eventually widens one that collapses, and it is silent on a lag.
Theorem (balance and dissipation): where every step from some step on is enclosed around what stands, no condition's standing changes at arbitrarily late steps.

account_adds.en: Throughput as a condition of keeping widening; generation (02) allows loss and is not 生生, and can go on at two orders of grain while what can form only returns. 02's openness, exchange beyond an enclosure, is the same word with another reference than 开.

source_adds.en: The line held flat and universal, at every place and time, as the one thing that matters. The folder itself compares no ranges; read as going on outranking present range, the account leaves that open and, where a lag decides it, a further premise.

name.en: An open loop, not any state or rule chosen once

source.locator: Claims 7, 22 (元闭); Genealogy, 2026-03-14

sense.en: The ask is not a particular state or one's reality made everyone's, but a loop kept open. The deepest closure, 元闭, freezes not one gap but the rule that makes new openings possible.

quote: I think it is important to keep a open loop

reading.en: The form is in the account: where every step from some step on is a move of a fixed process, the possible under it does not keep widening; the held possible keeps widening only where what is held changes without end, which does not suffice. Openness as a property of how rules keep changing is an AI reading, D45. 06 reads 元闭 as a rule holding its result, one structure with stability. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process, and witnesses): where the possible under a process keeps widening, from every step some bounded stretch is not made of its moves throughout; the possible with a part held keeps widening only where the part changes without end. Each law near-definitional or a witness.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. Nothing here says which changes keep it widening, or that any actual collective can make them.

元闭 maps to a rule holding its result, perturbing only the state being drawn back. Reading [AI reading, D49]: stability and 元闭 are one structure on the spine, read from either side; the judgment differs and the structure does not.

account_adds.en: That a tower of rules with no top adds nothing to its whole possible; that endless change of the part is not sufficient.

source_adds.en: The value stance that an open loop is what is to be kept, 'aligned with the incentive of any of us'. The account's law carries no such verdict.

name.en: 未, 可, 应, 转 as four independent marks

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts; claim 14

sense.en: 开 has four aspects and all must hold: a not-yet region remains, generation is still possible, the process can respond, it can correct or return. The README calls this the Chinese texts' most useful addition: a world can be rich in options and closed if nothing responds or no route back exists.

quote: a test with four independent failure modes

reading.en: 06 maps each mark to a spine structure and reports the reverse of independence, its own reading of the early claim. 转 read as returning gives 可 with no premise: on finite configurations a run starts exactly where a course reaches a return. 未 needs a world no list holds. One half survives: how much can be had does not fix return. The account's 开放 is only 未. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D49]: this mapping gives a result contrary to the early texts: they treat the four marks as independent; on the spine they are not. 转 read as returning gives 可, with no premise.
Reading [AI reading, D1, D5]: the corpus's 开 is the four marks together; this theory's 开放 is only 未.

Theorem (any process): within finitely many configurations, a list holding every one, a run starts exactly where a course as long as the list starts, exactly where a course leading to a return starts, with no decision and no selection (Onward.run_iff_returning).
Theorem (any process): keeping every possibility no longer gives returning (Transit.keeps_not_returns, three configurations).
As 06 maps 应: an exchange responds to a level; coupling bounds the response and does not fix it.

Theorem: with the process determined and two different configurations, a run whose configurations never return fixes, at each configuration it passes, no move other than the one it takes, whatever is read.

account_adds.en: That 06 §十 also sorts the nine lines' 归 and 不归 into three cases on the spine, and that 未 fails on any finite configuration. Why 转 matters to knowing: a run that never returns tests nothing it did not do.

source_adds.en: 应 as a failure mode of its own, a world in which nothing done changes anything, as a test of worlds. 06 gives response a law, not a mark that must hold.

name.en: Complexity and scale are not the measure of open and closed

source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts; claims 16, 26

sense.en: A single act of tea can be extremely open and a vast totalitarian system extremely closed. Cosmic generation does not entail rising complexity, and rising complexity does not entail good. Ren demolished his own earlier complexity programme on this ground.

quote: 繁简非开闭之标

reading.en: The account refuses the same measure: 生生 is not novelty or scale, and which formations count does not go by rank rising with complexity. But a course admitting all a smaller one admits and more does widen it, and C (order, unasserted) then ranks it higher, so scale that comes as inclusion is not excluded. Tea against a vast state has no verdict: mixed, or unranked. [AI reading]

says.en: Generation is a pattern going on through carrying renewal, and 生生 is the continuation of life, not novelty or scale; an expansion that ends forms of life another course keeps is mixed with it and C does not rank them. Answered; the order left open.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: which formations count, and how, differs by the relation discerned, not by rank rising with complexity; whether an actual AI system counts so is not shown.

account_adds.en: Generation at two grains can go on while what can form only returns, so generation is no sign of range.

source_adds.en: That a small thing can be more open than a vast one. The account has no comparison that says so.

name.en: Good as protecting the open, evil as producing closure

source.locator: Claims 17, 23, 102-103; own words 27, 69

sense.en: 开/闭 is the fundamental pair and 善/恶 its ethical face. The criterion's form is scale-free, its content always situational. In English: what keeps the field alive is good, what closes it bad, what knowingly turns it into capture evil.

quote: 生生不息者，开而不闭也；善者，护开也；恶者，成闭也

reading.en: 06 §十 names this and removes it: the early texts wrote evaluation into definitions, the account maps only structure. Closing in its form is no loss, a returning configuration being itself an absorbing region. What a closing opens and closes for 生生, the continuation of life, and for whom, is for a comparer's reading: the continuation condition for scope, whoever holds C for order, a further commitment where gains and losses are mixed, neither reading asserted. The account says why: stability and 元闭 share one structure, so evaluation enters only through comparison. [AI reading]

says.en: Mechanism [AI reading, D49]: what a closing opens and closes for 生生, the continuation of life, and for whom, is said by a comparer's reading, not by type: the continuation condition fixes scope, whoever holds C the order of widening and narrowing, what gains and loses needs a further commitment, neither reading asserted.
Reading [AI reading, D1, D5]: 善, 恶 and 智 have no formal predicate.
Reading [AI reading]: of the meta-attractor's closed loop, none of this ranks a locked loop: what it keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: kept apart: an omission of the representation, a fault in organized relations (suppressed feedback, blocked exit) and informed harm (a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, no loss returning), the hard rival, which tests the inference from one unfolding to goodwill without refuting normative grounds.

account_adds.en: The reason a verdict cannot sit in a type: one structure, two readings.

source_adds.en: Good and evil as real words at every scale; the scale-free form with situational content (claim 23), which the README calls its cleanest answer to 'whose values?'; 'evil' for the knowing conversion into capture. The live account keeps that structure apart as informed harm, a hard rival, and gives it no such name.

name.en: Two senses of closure: 成闭 and 护闭

source.locator: The argument, 闭有二义; claims 18, 223

sense.en: 成闭 closes and never reopens; it is the thing called bad. 护闭 closes one place for a time to protect a larger opening: refusing invasion, quarantine, excising a spreading cancer, stopping a runaway. It is a form of 中. The README adds, as its own reading, a test: a defence that cannot say what would make it stand down has become 成闭.

quote: 闭有二义：一曰成闭，闭而不复开；一曰护闭，暂闭一处以护更大之开

reading.en: The spine gives structures and no verdict. 成闭 is the lock: what is drawn in does not come back. 护闭 is removing at a branch the step that makes a configuration unobtainable (AI reading, D52); limits constraining steps leave what they constrain obtainable, so only 'larger opening' goes unmodelled. Ending a cancer is read as mixed, ranked by C only under the whole-run and possibility readings, and under the stepwise and relation-level readings by a further premise such as J1/J2. Under the condition (scope) and C (order), neither asserted, a pure closing argued good would have met T8's refuter before 9 November 2026; a net weighting ranks it above only where the item weighs below zero. [AI reading]

says.en: 护闭: removing at a fork the step making a configuration unobtainable [AI reading, D52]. Limits that promise, train or stop harm constrain some steps while what they constrain can still be had, 护闭's structure; those monopolizing entry or removing alternatives are 成闭. Which kind depends on what it does to what can be had again, not its name.

targets.part: the 护闭, 成闭 and 限 rows; D52

says.en: Theorem (any process): where s returns, every course from s to where s cannot be had again passes, up to double negation, a juncture; keeping only the steps after which s can still be had keeps s and removes exactly the losing steps.

Theorem (any type): for every determined law a configuration is drawn into some absorbing region exactly where it does not return, and once drawn never comes back. Near-definitional, not a classical attractor.

Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance. Predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]; telling harm from non-harm among them takes a judgment that names its criterion and who holds it, not necessarily a number. Retaining adds no ending and ranks nothing.

Conditional (J1/J2): read in two tiers, every comparison meeting the priority of basic conditions ranks the absence of a malignant formation above its occurrence under the stepwise and relation-level readings, where C alone leaves them unranked. The tier assignment is a reading.

Theorem (any type): where a ranking puts a narrowing above its widening by one item, either it does not rank the pair as its own order ranks the kept sets (a misread or a framing) or the item weighs at zero or below; read right, exactly where it weighs below zero, and at zero it ties.

account_adds.en: The juncture is found by search only where configurations are listed and steps decided; finding every loss's juncture of every process gives LPO.

source_adds.en: Closure justified by service to a larger opening; 'bad' for 成闭; the stand-down test and the answer it offers to the enforcement antinomy. The capacity not to be beaten as 护闭, distinct from winning (claim 223, the assistant's distinction).

name.en: 伪开, the pseudo-open

source.locator: The argument, 闭有二义; claims 20-21

sense.en: Outwardly open, inwardly closing: spending a momentary 可 to rob a long-term 未, a local opening closing the global one. Instances: technological monopoly, addiction systems, extreme ideology, Moloch competition, surface plurality. Detecting it is the core discipline. Formally 似开 joined to 实闭, closure that survives audit.

quote: 伪开者，外显为开，内成其闭；以一时之可，夺长远之未；以局部之开，闭全境之开。

reading.en: 06 gives three spine structures and drops the charge of deceit. Local open, whole closed: takers each within what is given can together exceed it and, at each of `n` steps from a level below `n + m`, end a renewal gated at `m`. Short open, long closed: a reading fixed by finite steps that includes every renewing run includes a consuming one, and distance to a break does not couple in by threshold. Surface open, meta closed: 元闭 seen from the state's side. Each law holds on its model. 06's rows read the early texts' own word, so the mapping comes by descent; the laws stand apart from it. [AI reading]

says.en: 伪开 one, two and three are mapped to joint excess, finite-stretch and threshold laws, and 元闭 from the state's side. The early definition's evaluation, 伪开 as deceit, is not mapped.
Takers each within what a renewal gives can together exceed it; proved on models, restating the commons (as ONE-PAGE states it).
A reading fixed by the first h steps that includes every renewing run includes a consuming one (the renewable process; likewise the support-gated law with feedback).

Theorem (World): where a stock coupled by threshold only is the only requirement that may fail up to a horizon, how far off the break is does not couple in. Coupled by level, every raise passes at once.

account_adds.en: Why the long form escapes detection: no finite record certifies renewal.

source_adds.en: The auditable definition 似开 joined to 实闭, the instances, and detection as a discipline; that it is modern closure's commonest disguise.

name.en: The compounding axis: winning buys more power to win

source.locator: The argument, How a world closes; claims 34-39, 41, 56

sense.en: On a rivalrous axis where winning buys capacity to win, leads compound and the axis selects whoever pushes hardest; no villain is needed. It runs away only where returns increase; where they diminish or rivals balance it self-limits. The pattern is form-agnostic: market, state, commons or AI can each become the closing thing.

quote: a winner of the game should be rewarded with anything other than more advantages of the game

reading.en: The form is checked. A rule read from the share it selects locks, 'that actual rules read the share' standing as the premise, as increasing returns stands as the source's condition. Shaping the rule is selected at a step exactly where what comes back to shapers alone covers its cost. Ranked by position, among two drawers or more a best response keeps nothing: 'trade everything for winning'. Form-agnostic: the lock belongs to how the rule reads. Two-kind counts, no noise; singly drawn locks are left by drift, those in counts that only grow can survive noise. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): with the start's rule and every rule read favouring, the share falls at no step and the course locks. That actual rules read the share is the premise. The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.
Theorem (counts): at a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where c is at most s, whatever comes to every member alike.

Theorem (World for the selection laws; counts for the count laws): a chooser reading what couples in, its rule read from the count of its choices. The lock is read as the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989).

Counts that accumulate instead of being drawn, which with noisy choices are an urn with increasing returns, locking with probability one where the returns are strong enough (Arthur, Ermoliev and Kaniovski 1987; Arthur 1989; cited, not stated).

Theorem (any law of what stands next, natural amounts): drawers in turn, each ranking what it leaves by its position over the steps that remain: among two drawers or more a best response for position keeps nothing. Not that every race draws everything: where something left stops what stands next, drawing everything is not perfect.

account_adds.en: Below the critical mass the course locks the other way with no capture by shapers; an exact lever at a step; selected control is not thereby capture.

source_adds.en: That actual axes (capital, attention, weapons, state power) meet the premise and run identically; selection for recklessness. T7 on actual metrics is conjectured, with no field test. The list of what rivalrous selection favours (claim 41).

name.en: Every maximizing structure is a hidden extreme; every extreme closes
