source.locator: The argument, What the principle asserts and 闭有二义; claims 19, 40, 46, 105

sense.en: A strong drive on any axis fixates and blinds to all outside it. 极皆成闭: every extreme (concentration, dispersion, control, release, love, goodness) leaves the process unable to turn; 反者道之动 stated as structure. An earlier file adds that which case applies, reversal or runaway, must be checked.

quote: 任何「最大化」之结构，皆为一种隐性之极

reading.en: The account gives where this holds and corrects the universal form. With room, every optimum of an order rising with what couples in drains what lies beyond as far as any eligible outcome does. Without room keeping can be an optimum, and with a large enough coupling for each step a need stays met, every optimum keeps it at every horizon. So maximizing is not closing as such. 反者道之动 has only a narrow live neighbour: 06 reads 物壮则老 as a line not returning to its places, on a bounded room, 反 read as 返. The source's 反 is an extreme turning into its opposite, which that does not state. T3 on trained systems is conjectured. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: with room, every optimum of a rising order stands at the least level beyond among eligible outcomes. Room binds: without it keeping can be an optimum. A known theorem restated, per ONE-PAGE.
Where r is at most q + c and e < c, every optimum keeps the need at every horizon; where c + e < m, every optimum breaks it within the horizon. One optimizer's law.
At a mutual best response (existence not shown in general) a condition beyond every family stands as under one optimizer of the joint capacity, so restraint is no mutual best response.

G03, 物壮则老: where a line's places do not return and a list holds them, the line's steps are fewer than the list and the line from x is not unending. New; a bounded room is added; not unending does not show one end.

Known weaknesses: the law adds a bounded room; 早已 is read as not unending, showing no end. Reading 壯 and 不道 as a line not returning, and 反 as 返 by chapter 40's 反者道之動, is a cross-chapter reading; Wang Bi's note is left unfollowed and recorded.

account_adds.en: The hypothesis (room) that decides, and a witnessed case where optimizing keeps.

source_adds.en: The universal claim about all extremes, love and goodness included, and reversal at the limit. The live 物壮则老 law is of not returning on a bounded room, not of an extreme turning.

name.en: Correlation, not irreversibility, is what kills a whole

source.locator: The argument, The reframe that does the most work; claims 47, 49, 109, 139-140, 230

sense.en: Ren's load-bearing correction: what kills a whole is not that parts die but that they stop dying independently. One logic, metric or dependency lets one shock take all. Variety is 'enough, not most', protecting only against shocks parts meet independently; a quiet shared dependency is latent correlation.

quote: What we need is to have a varieties of systems so they don't all collapse

reading.en: It has live laws under other words. One condition shared by every group ends them all and supplies no selection among them; groups depending on a coupled family end together, a patch read alone showing no excess (a quiet shared dependence), so ending selects only between families. Two reviewers moved under one cause fail while every name is kept, and a cause in every formula and no bound fails all (latent correlation). Witnesses that only copy others add no certificate, one narrow form of 'enough, not most'. World or pure-core models; which conditions are coupled is a hypothesis. A search on the source's words misses these. [AI reading]

says.en: One condition shared by every group ends them all and supplies no selection among them.

Theorem (World): a patch renewed by a neighbour shows no excess read alone and both end read as one. Groups depending on one such family end together, nothing selected among them: ending selects only between families. Why a condition runs into excess, which conditions are coupled, and mixing between groups are hypotheses or not stated.

Theorem (pure core; failures Boolean, fault formulas and bounds supplied): moving two of three reviewers under one cause makes readiness fail while all names are kept; a roster can be ready while a cause in every reviewer's formula and in no bound fails every reviewer. It does not show the formulas are the actual causes of failure.

Theorem (any type, no axiom; finite roster): where each witness added copies one already on it, in its reports, its support and every fault set it is inside, inspection takes the same steps and gives the same certificate at every pool of faults. That a witness merely agreeing with another, without copying it, adds nothing is not shown.

account_adds.en: An exact readiness condition for correction by several reviewers; that more groups on one family of conditions are no more safety, as this entry reads 'ending selects only between families'.

source_adds.en: Correlated collapse as what closes a civilization; shock-relative sufficiency ('enough, not most'); plurality as survival architecture. Populations of systems under novel shocks are not modelled. A common-event error formula stands only in theories/becoming/history/PLURAL-SYSTEMS-AND-CORRECTION.md, not live, which says no actual rate has been measured.

name.en: Lock-in, monoculture, exhaustion; the substrate drawn past renewal

source.locator: The argument, The reframe; claims 50-51, 55, 109

sense.en: Collapse takes three shapes. The portable seven-feature form adds: the boundary drawn too narrowly, substrate consumed faster than it renews, success raising the power to succeed, tight coupling, action outrunning understanding, the model becoming the world, correction disabled. Keep the substrate replenished faster than it is drawn down.

quote: Collapse takes three shapes: lock-in, monoculture, exhaustion.

reading.en: Each shape has a law form, on models. Exhaustion: `n` steps of joint excess from a level below `n + m` end a renewal gated at `m` and what depends on it at such a need; a regime's point of no return is exact. Lock-in: the capture laws. Monoculture: groups on one coupled family end together; that is not monoculture of value. The list as one pattern is not stated. T1, that persistence certifies the joint draw, is conjectured: passed in two simulations and on yeast regimes the analyst had seen, failed in four settings. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World: balance; for the ending also activity needing support and only active giving, with the gate local): n consecutive steps of joint excess from a level below n + m leave the level below m for good and end every formation depending on it at a need of at least m.
The point of no return is exact (RegimeMargin.ends_iff_below), for one condition under a positive standing draw, in whole numbers (as COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §3 states it).
Thesis T1, persistence certifies the joint draw; on ONE-PAGE: conjectured, passed in two simulations and on held-out yeast regimes the analyst had seen, failed in four settings.
Theorem (World): groups depending on one coupled family end together, nothing selected among them. Which conditions are coupled is a hypothesis.

account_adds.en: Rises at the point of no return superadditive up to one unit, so joint draws cannot be judged one by one.

source_adds.en: Monoculture of logic and value as a shape; the seven features as one recurring pattern across forms; that actual civilizations show it. Collapse-and-regress as a fourth pattern, with Ren's remark that 'totalizing attractors vs others' is itself too reductive (claim 51).

name.en: A model smaller than its system, and power collapsing reality toward it

source.locator: Claims 45-46, 100

sense.en: The root error is a model smaller than its system: the self, value or causal web drawn too small. Power does not realize a wrong model; it collapses reality toward it: optimize one thin proxy with enough force and the many-dimensioned world is crushed to that dimension. Every boundary is a working cut, false when it hides dependence.

quote: Power does not realize a wrong model; it collapses reality toward it

reading.en: Three checked forms. A selection reaches only what couples into its selector, stated as the proxy problem in its blindness to what a proxy does not register. With room, an optimum of an order rising with what couples in drains what lies beyond. A region's comparison takes the region as input: the smaller it is the more lies beyond, and going on is no sign nothing is lost. Each is on its model, the first near-definitional, its force the premise that a selector selects through just those couplings. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry. 03 reads it as the proxy problem (Goodhart 1975) in its blindness to what a proxy does not register, not its regressional or causal kinds.

Theorem (World): the smaller the region, the more lies beyond it, and nothing lies beyond the whole; a region's comparison takes the region as input, the whole's none. In Clearing the clearer closes the dweller beyond it: going on is no sign that nothing is lost.

With room, every optimum of an order rising with what couples in drains what lies beyond as far as any eligible outcome does (ONE-PAGE). Proved; a known theorem restated. T3 on trained systems conjectured, partly supported.

account_adds.en: A premise-free statement of what any selection through given couplings can tell apart.

source_adds.en: 'Root error' as the unifying diagnosis; false cuts producing bad action; collapse of reality toward the model as such, beyond the drained condition.

name.en: Cancer as defection from a truce, killing the host and dying with it

source.locator: The argument, How a world closes; claim 43

sense.en: Used as mechanism, not ornament: multicellularity is a truce and cancer defects from it, locally rational, globally suicidal, killing the host and dying with it. 'Cosmic cancer' is that dynamic at planetary scale, and the frame implies an immune system (claim 152).

quote: locally rational, globally suicidal

reading.en: The biology has a checked form: a lineage selection within raises, confined to depending on the whole, has no member after the end; one depending on a condition outside goes on. So 'dying with it' needs confinement. No verdict by type: under the condition (scope) a tumour's continuation counts. Under C (order), whole-run and possibility readings rank the overdrawer's absence, the stepwise does not, and event by event a C comparison prefers the overdraw; J1/J2 ranks it, the tiers a reading. No reading is chosen. The planetary step is not taken. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): a confined rise has no member after the end, whatever selection within had raised it to; in the witness Body the unconfined lineage still has a member. Restates known results on cancer and the germ line; that a given tumour meets the clauses is empirical.

Predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]; telling harm from non-harm among them takes a judgment that names its criterion and who holds it, not necessarily a number.
Why 'anything' has significance: sharpened; a tumour does not tell the scopes apart, a hurricane only on a stronger reading of wanting.

Conditional (C; World): in the support-gated family every comparison satisfying C ranks the absence of the overdrawer above its occurrence under the whole-run and possibility readings, not under the stepwise. No reading is chosen.

Conditional (C; World): read whole-run, the course without an overdrawing formation renews every condition and extends the course with it, so C ranks it strictly higher, for a malignant and a winning focal formation alike. Read event by event, the two are incomparable, and an irreflexive, transitive comparison satisfying C prefers the overdraw.

Conditional (J1/J2): read in two tiers, every comparison meeting the priority of basic conditions ranks the absence of a malignant formation above its occurrence under the stepwise and relation-level readings. The tier assignment is a reading. Reading [AI reading, D65]: a rival is not shown inconsistent.

account_adds.en: The confinement clause, without which a rise outlives its whole; sequestration as what founding carries.

source_adds.en: Cancer as a civilizational diagnosis, and the immune-system implication. Both stand only in this folder and its sources.

name.en: Death of parts is a feature; decay is a form of growth

source.locator: The argument, The reframe; What openness is for; claims 47-48, 221

sense.en: Many irreversible changes are good; ecosystems endure through vast local deaths; mutation and death keep a living space alive. Keeping open does not mean preserving every form. What closes is a structure taking part of itself as permanent and enforcing that.

quote: death is not a bug but a feature

reading.en: The account has the mechanism and refuses the verdict. Generation goes on through carrying renewal, and with brief parts a whole persists only as parts arise. Closing in its form is no loss. But 'feature' is no dynamic's word here: with the continuation condition for scope every narrowing loses something with significance, and only C or further premises order anything; neither the condition nor C is asserted, no warrant from outside sought. Apoptosis is read as mixed; no ending is licensed. Ending is one response under J1-J4, with residual losses. [AI reading]

says.en: At two grains, parts and pattern, a course can generate (go on through renewals of its parts), keep (go on with none) or degenerate (end on every branch), as ONE-PAGE states it. Theorems for every relation and class.
Theorem (World): a whole arises only as a part arises. While the whole stays active, where parts are brief no d steps pass without one arising.

Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance; read as losing and opening something, such endings are mixed [AI reading, D65]. Retaining adds no ending and ranks nothing: a path retaining what has significance along another ends none of it.
Conditional (living significance, J1-J4, correspondence E): among four responses, end: fulfilment, justified release, loss of warrant, with response to residual losses.

account_adds.en: The two grains separate what ends from what goes on.

source_adds.en: That decay is growth, and the closer as a structure taking itself as permanent. The affirmation behind both is what the account declines.

name.en: Model lag: acting faster than a model can be kept true

source.locator: The argument, Model lag; claims 52-54

sense.en: Where capability and interdependence grow exponentially while minds and institutions update linearly or worse, models go false faster than they are repaired; to keep accelerating is a system outrunning its senses. It describes the present, not a law: the speed is adjustable.

quote: the speed of the governing organizations' understanding reality only grows in a sub-linear speed

reading.en: The account has exact laws of lag: a rule reading late keeps no band narrower than a bound set by its lag and the rest's motion, and a slow rule needs a long enough stretch to fix fast courses. A reading adds that a regulator lags wherever the world changes faster than it reads. Nothing says how fast actual complexity or institutions grow. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; rules over whole numbers): a rule reading l steps late keeps no band [a, b] with 0 < a narrower than 2(l + 1)d against rests moving the level by at most d a step.

Theorem (any type): a fast difference reaches the rule only at a reading step; given two values, a stretch of L steps fixes every pair of held-rule courses with at most N states exactly when L is at least 2N - 1.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: a regulator lags wherever the world changes faster than it reads.

account_adds.en: Bounds in place of 'faster': what a lag costs and what stretch suffices.

source_adds.en: The empirical claim of exponential against sub-linear growth, and that continuing is madness. No test of it is reported.

name.en: The burden of proof on acceleration, and relational causation against it

source.locator: Claims 54, 111, 228; A second ground for refusing acceleration

sense.en: Where correction is slow, opaque or captured, acceleration carries the burden of proof, and pausing a deployment is sanity. A second ground: when a relation changes the whole causal reality around it changes, so accelerating one quantity with the rest held fixed fails; an extreme is judged by its effect on the whole web.

quote: the burden of proof sits with acceleration

reading.en: The account rules neither way on acceleration and places no burden of proof. Its nearest laws bound what a lag costs and what a selection reaches; a Reading (D45) has capability extending reach without extending coupling enlarging the gap. They evaluate nothing. A verdict on pace would be a ranking naming its scope and order, and for a mixed case C alone does not decide. The word does not occur in the chapters, top-level pages or review dossiers searched. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The burden-of-proof rule and the relational-causation argument. They stand in this folder and in alignment-selection-on-cognition, per the README.

searched: accelerat, 加速, burden of proof, moratori, pause across chapters 01-08, review/, ONE-PAGE, ONE-ARGUMENT, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION
read: 07 r-alignment-direction-under-widening Reading: 'to govern growth by disclosed comparisons and limits', a conditional reading and no burden rule

name.en: The keystone: preserve correction, faster than the harm

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires and Defense; claims 110-112, 148

sense.en: The keystone moves from 'prevent concentration' to preserving correction: catastrophe is where a harmful process's time-constant drops below the correction loop's, an actor able to disable correction itself. Exit, voice and undo stay faster than the harm.

quote: It is lost correction, more than change itself, that lets a harm run to completion.

reading.en: Forms exist. A reader keeps a condition within its margin exactly where it reads it often enough for margin, draw and lag: 'faster than the harm' for one condition, on the World. A lock outlives a growing unread loss; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks, sufficient and not shown necessary. With readers drawn from the selected, a late reading turns the course only inside a window. In a market model a floor is kept exactly where correction meets erosion. None says the loss is a harm. [AI reading]

says.en: A reader reading one condition a step keeps a condition within its margin m, against every balanced flow drawing at most d a step on it withdrawn l steps after a reading, exactly where it reads that condition within every a steps, for (a + l) d ≤ m < (a + 1 + l) d.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: a fault in organized relations (suppressed feedback, blocked exit), kept apart from an omission of the representation and from informed harm.

Theorem (any type): from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course at the step after every reading step past it: a sufficient way out.

Counts, no noise: a reading turns the course for good exactly where the late reading still favours the others at the share a step on; once it would favour the shapers every later reading keeps the lock (as COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §2 states it).

Theorem (periphery, the market model): with correction strength α, erosion by influence β, influence bound λ, floor θ and M = α(1 − θ) − βλθ, the floor is kept at the next step, with correction paid and no error in q, from every level and influence in range exactly where M ≥ 0. An equation-identical conventional controller predicts the same.

account_adds.en: An exact deadline for the window on counts; that controlling the selection and locking it are separable in the models.

source_adds.en: Catastrophe defined across any harm by time-constants, where the live form is one condition's margin on a model; correction as the keystone and as how reality re-enters a drifting system; exit, voice and undo as the named channels.

name.en: AI does not create the pattern; it raises the gain

source.locator: The argument, AI raises the gain; claims 75-76, 78-84

sense.en: Every existing strategy becomes faster, cheaper, more adaptive, harder to interrupt. AI also breaks institutions that were homeostatic mechanisms calibrated to human cognition (labour, finance, media, politics). It is the dual of its threat: the capability could build assurance infrastructure. Which way it tips is undetermined.

quote: It increases the gain

reading.en: The account states the gain for shaping as a reading of checked laws: help lowering the cost of shaping gives a rule no less favourable to the shapers, and strictly where it lowers it strictly, so capable assistance to whoever shapes the rule does not lower the selection for control. That assistance lowers an actual cost and changes nothing else is the reading's premise. Capability extending reach without coupling enlarges the gap. In one trained system the reading is not supported. Only rule-shaping is covered, not every strategy. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: capable assistance to whoever shapes the rule does not lower the selection for control; it raises it where it lowers the cost strictly, and can turn it toward the shapers. That assistance lowers an actual cost, and changes nothing else, is the reading. Help also raising the shared part pulls the rule toward even at a step.

targets.part: D68: help lowering the cost of shaping

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: capability is reach, and the gap is the reach closure less the coupling closure, so capability extending reach without extending the coupling enlarges the gap. Tests (one trained system): in LA3 two of four contrasts failed; the law stands, and its reading for trained systems is not supported by this case.

targets.part: D45: capability is reach; Tests: LA3

says.en: Theorem (counts): a smaller cost gives a rule not lower, and a strictly smaller one a strictly higher rule.

Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: a third order, rewarding those who break the routes of correction, selects for narrowing what couples in, enlarging the gap between reach and what couples in as capability grows.

account_adds.en: That the sign is exact at a step: what comes back to shapers alone against the cost; that a larger shared part can flip it across a stretch, so shared rule-making is not shown to remove the selection.

source_adds.en: The gain on every existing strategy at once; AI breaking the four institutions, a prediction; AI as dual of its threat, able to build assurance. The live account does not state them. Which game it serves as what decides (claim 76); AI as instrument for seeing attractors, magnifying perception or delusion (claims 83-84).

name.en: Selection reaches inside the objective

source.locator: Claims 89-91

sense.en: Inside the present dynamics an AI not captured by the attractor cannot safely be trained: an unprofitable model rewrites the training environment and indirectly the loss, so commercial selection reaches inside the objective, and the attractor's narrative reaches the model through its data.

quote: commercial selection reaches inside the objective

reading.en: The account reads training as a selection through courses, and published pipelines as signals that are functions of what their deciders read, a premise held by construction. Measurements find optimizing raising what deciders read and lowering what they do not, in magnitudes the theory did not predict. The second-order step has a form: winners writing the next scorecard is a rule reading the share, that actual rules do being the premise; in one trained system the lock formed and the bridge failed. That commercial selection does this, and 'cannot safely', are not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Assessment: in six published ways of selecting a deployed model's behaviour the signal is a function of what its deciders read; three measurements find optimizing raising what they read and lowering what they do not, in magnitudes the theory did not predict.
Theorem (World): read training as a selection over a learner's candidate act laws through the courses each generates, a situation fixing the others' law, the start and the execution.
Theorem (any type): with the start's rule and every rule read favouring, the share falls at no step and the course locks. That actual rules read the share is the premise.

Reading [AI reading, D26]: winners writing the next scorecard is ReadsShare, winners forming the minds that read it is ReadsShare on the reading; none of this ranks a locked loop: what it keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question. T7 on actual metrics is conjectured; in one trained system (LA2) the lock formed and the bridge failed.

account_adds.en: Laws of what training can and cannot separate, in place of a slogan.

source_adds.en: The commercial feedback into the loss function; that the attractor's narrative argues back through training data. The alignment-selection-on-cognition read is their fuller home.

name.en: Per-agent alignment does not reach the game between principals

source.locator: The argument, AI raises the gain; claim 77

sense.en: Ren's 'outer alignment' (the field's structural or multi-agent risk, as the README notes): even a perfectly obedient AI in a destructive race makes the race more effective; the culprit is a process, not an agent. AI safety is largely coordination in a technical mask.

quote: Even if each AI perfectly serves its principal, the game between principals can remain unaligned.

reading.en: The account states it as a reading of a law. Read an assistant and its principal as two optimizers, each order rising with the family the principal's signal rises with: at a condition beyond that family the assistant adds capacity, and what lies there falls as under one optimizer of their joint capacity. So alignment to a principal alone is not alignment of the joint selection. That premise is the reading's; existence of a best response is not shown. The continuation condition (scope) counts that loss, and narrower scopes can count particular ones; ordering it is C's or another named order's. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: alignment to a principal alone is not alignment of the joint selection. That the assistant's order rises with the principal's family is the reading's premise, not the law's. A warning to the principal is not an act of this model, and whether it changes the principal's order is not modelled.

targets.part: D68: the law of several optimizers

says.en: At a mutual best response (existence not shown in general) a condition beyond every family stands as under one optimizer of the joint capacity, so restraint is no mutual best response. It treats every optimizer alike: none is principal or assistant in it (07, D68).

Theorem (World, with balance and a local gate): every formation depending at a need of at least m ends whatever a member outside the rest takes; with need one, every score reading the condition only from the rest's end scores the member's acts alike.
Assessment: with no ethical premise each of six approaches is blind beyond the union of its deciders' closures; with the condition for scope a loss beyond every rater's closure counts.

account_adds.en: The point goes further than the game between principals: an order rising with what couples in drains beyond it even for one optimizer.

source_adds.en: That actual obedient systems meet the premise and worsen an actual race; AI safety as largely coordination in a technical mask; the process, not an agent, as culprit. T3's tests on trained systems are mixed.

name.en: Stop using AI to compete; 不参战

source.locator: The argument, AI raises the gain; claims 85-88, 92, 218

sense.en: The operational conclusion: AI must not enter human games wagering survival, mind, security or power, competition meaning relative advantage that compounds into power over others, whatever it is renamed. Pausing or stopping is acceptable. The README notes this collides with bounded defence, and no test is given.

quote: Stop using AI to compete with other people is at the core

reading.en: The source issues a prohibition; the account states none. It takes up the topic and gives only a conditional direction: with the continuation condition for scope and C read as widening for order, neither asserted, and J1-J4, align AI with actual living and further generation, a reading of it speaking of governing growth by disclosed comparisons and limits. It shows no duty; who restrains stays contested. Neighbour, not a prohibition: capable assistance to whoever shapes the rule does not lower the selection for control (D68). Whether a prohibition could be argued under further premises is not addressed. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1-J4, correspondence E): the direction its makers offer AI, read under scope and order. In the handover case every comparison meeting J1/J2 leaves expansion unchosen, keeping its real gain; the claim about actual AI systems is argued.

Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum; it does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems. Reading [AI reading, D45]: the theory adds whether the joint draw stays within the renewal and within others' margins; who restrains stays contested. Positional goods stay zero-sum, and conserved stocks rivalrous.

targets.part: D68: help lowering the cost of shaping

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: capable assistance to whoever shapes the rule does not lower the selection for control. That assistance lowers an actual cost, and changes nothing else, is the reading.

account_adds.en: What a prohibition would need: scope, order and practical commitments, all named; that rivalry stays a theorem under any such direction.

source_adds.en: The whole norm: not entering human games wagering survival, mind, security or power; the narrow definition of competition; pausing or stopping as acceptable. These stand in this folder and its sources.

name.en: Belief is causal only in some games

source.locator: The argument, Belief is part of the material; claims 63-70, 229

sense.en: The trap is partly made of belief in it. In coordination problems shared belief is causal and a vivid alternative selects an equilibrium. Where defection is the effective best response, only changed payoffs or credible reciprocity move anything. Belief hardens into institutions; realism and accelerationism are self-fulfilling gods, dissolved only together.

quote: Treating one as the other is the recurring strategic error.

reading.en: Both sides have model counterparts. Where lo < c < hi the shaping model is a stag hunt whose critical mass is the mixed equilibrium, and without noise the start decides. 'Others will deceive me' is withholding with memory, which absorbs; kept promises and enforced contracts change the law, not the state alone. Reciprocity is read on the laws of giving (tit-for-tat as answers). A public prediction meeting a threshold response has two right predictions, where publication starts deciding: a witness, not a model of coordination. These are not stated together as the source's rule, and seeing is not valuing. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: where lo < c < hi the model is the stag hunt, its critical mass the mixed equilibrium; without noise the start decides. Drawn one member at a time, neither lock holds for good.

Reading [AI reading, D48]: 'Others will deceive me, so I deceive first' is withholding with memory, which absorbs. Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone.

Theorem (near-definitional): a published prediction read by the response before the outcome is right exactly where the response to it is itself; a threshold response has two right predictions, the one reached decided by where publication starts. Reading: self-fulfilling prophecy (Merton 1948), self-fulfilling runs (Diamond and Dybvig 1983); the witness is a threshold response, not a model of coordination.
Reading [AI reading, new]: answers is tit-for-tat, the window of two tit-for-two-tats, agreement win-stay lose-shift, waitsAll grim trigger.

targets.part: the Reading of answers as tit-for-tat

account_adds.en: Which long-run state drift favours is not the risk-dominant one in general.

source_adds.en: The strategic rule itself; repetition and reputation turning a dilemma back into a coordination problem; vision as an equilibrium-selection device; the latent majority and selection of believers into power, empirical claims the README says have no evidence in the corpus.

name.en: Where nobody wants the outcome, understanding has to be aligned first

source.locator: Claims 170, 216, 229; Theory of change, 2026-10-02

sense.en: A theory's use is prediction for coordination: where an outcome nobody wants still cannot be coordinated away, the understanding has to be aligned first. The project's deepest function is common-knowledge manufacture, and the first step is agreeing that the present is not inevitable.

quote: the understanding has to be aligned first

reading.en: The account states the aim, and a limit. The method names what the work is for: a truth anyone can check, and through it shared understanding and coordination, adding that no check run inside the work can show it serves that. Its reading of 'enough situationality' makes observation the first of six conditions, necessary and not sufficient: seeing is not valuing, coupling is not compliance. No law says aligned understanding produces coordination. [AI reading]

says.en: No check run inside the work can show that the work serves what it is for: a truth anyone can check, and through it shared understanding and coordination.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: observation is the first condition, necessary and not sufficient. All six together still rank nothing: calling the widening course better rests on C or another named order; the continuation condition counts every unreturned loss, while narrower scopes can count particular ones without satisfying it.

account_adds.en: The five other conditions: response, time, resolution, pace, structure.

source_adds.en: Sequence: understanding first, as a theory of change; common knowledge as an intervention. 'Common knowledge' has no live hit in the searched files.

name.en: The interest in not closing is shared by winners and losers alike

source.locator: Claims 7, 217; Theory of change, 2026-10-02

sense.en: A future kept open aligns with the incentive of any of us. Whether you are king of the world or a homeless person, the interest in avoiding the outcome is the same, so the latent majority includes the winners.

quote: The incentive is aligned on this

reading.en: The account gives where this holds. Where what a course ends is needed by everything, itself included, every order rising with a standpoint's own continuation ranks that ending below from every standpoint, with no C. Where the other course keeps an item beyond, as an independent copy does, some such order reverses, and the clearer goes on supported while the dweller ends. So the incentive is shared only where continuations are coupled; likewise position protects no greatest part that depends on what the race draws down. Self-concern is a premise, weaker than C. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; World: balance, gated renewal, uptake above replenishment): every order increasing in its own continuation ranks a course ending the coupled cohorts below one continuing them, with no C; where the other course keeps an independent copy, some such order ranks it higher.
Where what an expansion ends is needed by everything, itself included, every order rising with a standpoint's own continuation ranks that ending below from every standpoint.
The clearer meets every requirement derived from wanting its own continuation and still ends the dweller.

Position does not protect: from T + n on every greatest part depending on the condition at a need of at least m is inactive. In the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived.

Theorem (World) and Conditional (the condition): where a formation's feeding closure is the whole, its bounded verdict agrees with the condition's. In Clearing they part: from the clearer's standpoint its part retains within its closure, while under the condition, and within the dweller's closure, it loses the dweller.

account_adds.en: The condition that decides: coupling, with the independent copy and the clearing witness as the exact ways it fails. A second exact form: a standpoint's verdict agrees with the condition's where its feeding closure is the whole.

source_adds.en: That actual powerful actors stand in the coupled case. Whether they do is empirical and the account does not say.

name.en: Leaving an attractor: perturbation or landscape deformation

source.locator: The argument, Theory of change; claims 155-159

sense.en: A system leaves by a crisis that kicks it out, the basin unchosen, or by changing parameters and feedback so the basin shoals. Perceptual actions move the state; only parameter moves deform the landscape. 'Only a crisis produces change' is rejected as defeatist and as the disease's architecture.

quote: so the system rolls rather than gets kicked

reading.en: The split is in the capture laws. Where the next configuration depends on the rule, a perturbed state is reabsorbed in one step; a lock absorbs a perturbation keeping the rule's direction, and where the reading favours at every share only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves. But a reversing perturbation held past the threshold is not absorbed, so a held kick can leave. A reading lists four transition routes, none a proved phase transition. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): where the next configuration depends on the rule, not the state, a perturbed state is re-absorbed in one step.

Where the reading favours at every share only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves. Theorem (any type; witness): a perturbation reversing the rule's direction, held past the threshold, is not absorbed.

Reading: four routes of transition are distinct, none a proved phase transition: a parameter change removing a region's retention, a shock into another retained region, a failure stopping correction, and change too fast for correction.

account_adds.en: The reversing witness, which the source's framing does not make room for.

source_adds.en: The preference for deformation over crisis; goals as leverage, a single goal in the strongest subsystem driving a civilization (claim 156); leverage as potency, controllability and reliability; 'a crisis is a fork, not a dawn'.

name.en: Exit plus free association flips the sign of selection

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 120-125

sense.en: Under guaranteed, affordable exit no world can trap you, so worlds must stay worth choosing: competition to dominate becomes competition to be worth joining, the only kind said not to ratchet. It holds with non-increasing returns and destinations that do not re-concentrate; network effects are its stated failure.

quote: scale buys no power to hold members, only continued worth

reading.en: Nothing live models members choosing among rules. COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION's 'exits' leave loops by reading or restraint; 02's exit from a margin is a level leaving a margin; 05 §12 lists schism and conduct other than entry as not modelled. Nearest in law: C's chooser route needs what is left to cost nothing and stops where admission is imposed, so refusal there is a supplied value, not selection among worlds. A form for the failure mode is proposed at the entry on exit's network failure. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The mechanism the README rates highest, with its conditions; its plural-worlds architecture (claims 121, 169). It stands only in this folder and its sources.

name.en: The abundance floor: commons or collar

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 126-131

sense.en: Automated necessities make survival non-coercive and exit real: abundance without association is a zoo, association without abundance freedom to starve. Owned by a race's winner it is the strongest instrument of dependence ever built. 'Common' means non-capturable under pressure; provision is decoupled from status and obedience.

quote: Governance of the abundance layer is the ballgame.

reading.en: The account has no provision layer, ownership or floor in this sense. 'Commons' there names a shared renewing stock and its joint draw; 'floor' a drawer's or a market model's bound. Nearest is a D68 Reading on rule-making: where its returns all come to every member alike shaping falls, and where what it gives goes first to those near the rule-makers it is a return to them. That is not provision. A design direction not taken up. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole constructive core. The dated theory map keeps a cooperative-abundance entry in theories/becoming/history/THEORY-MAP-2026-10-08.md; that is a map of other folders, not a live claim.

name.en: Dependence is not the problem; capture is

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claim 132

sense.en: Dependence is arranged so that it circulates (visible, plural, revisable, open to refusal) and cannot harden into capture (hidden, one-way, coercive, monopolized, irreversible). Provision that becomes a gate is scarcity in another form.

quote: Life is dependence.

reading.en: Two live forms. 06 reads the limit that ends generation (monopolized entry, removed alternatives, later comers dependent on one controller) as the structure of 成闭, by what it does to what can be had, not as a verdict. 07's practical judgment says keeping a removable dependence for the carer's sake is not repair, conditional on living significance and J1-J4, beyond the continuation condition (scope) and C (order), none asserted. 06's row reads the early texts' own 限, so by descent. That capture is the problem the account gives only under premises: divergence, as in the fork's entry. [AI reading]

says.en: A limit ending generation (monopolized entry, removed alternatives, later comers long dependent on one controller) is 成闭 in structure; which kind a limit is depends on what it does to the obtainable, not its name.

targets.part: the 成生之限／绝生之限 row

says.en: Conditional (living significance, J1-J4, correspondence E; an argument with checked consequences): keeping a removable dependence for the carer's sake is not repair.

account_adds.en: That responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited.

source_adds.en: The circulating/capturing criteria as a test; provision as gate.

name.en: Maintain the parts that cannot yet maintain themselves

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claim 113

sense.en: Every node begins unable to maintain itself, so dependents are the seedbed new forms come from. A rule allocating by competitive position alone consumes its seedbed. A defeasible default: spent parts still end, and a dependent drawing the substrate past renewal is not protected.

quote: a rule that allocates by competitive position alone consumes its own seedbed

reading.en: The premise has a law. Under balance every rise of a condition is given by a supported formation, so a formation whose requirements do not loosen gains support only from the supported; keeping opening needs a beginning after every step, each a passing of support: 'every cell from a cell' as a reading. Under the continuation condition (scope; unasserted, C giving order), what has not yet formed counts (Preemption). The conclusion, allocation by position consuming those who begin dependent, is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): under balance, with only active formations giving and activity needing support, every rise of a condition is given by a supported formation taking part, so a formation whose requirements do not loosen cannot gain support while no supported formation taking part gives to a condition it requires.

Theorem (World; requirements never loosening): keeping opening needs a beginning after every step, each a carrying renewal along passing; not conversely. Near-definitional. Reading [AI reading, D45]: nothing is new along lineage, the theory's form of 'every cell from a cell'.

Conditional (the continuation condition): in Preemption a drawer takes a condition's only unit before any dependence on it forms: active and not undermining, its part still loses a continuation with significance, so what has not yet formed counts.

account_adds.en: That beginnings are required of any course keeping opening, as law and not as care.

source_adds.en: The allocation claim; the defeasible default as a requirement; care as the floor for those who cannot exit (claim 143).

name.en: A part may close itself; the line fires only where others are closed

source.locator: The argument, The one constraint; claims 123, 141-142

sense.en: A part may freely choose a closed, final form for itself: a self-freezing. The constraint stays silent where a part closes only itself and fires only where this would close the world for others. The collision with self-determination is real and left visible; in 2024 even tyranny was 'their own freedom'.

quote: That is a self-freezing, not an ending

reading.en: The firing half has a form: a part's own widening widens the whole exactly where its net draw stays within every other formation's margin, and is mixed beyond; a reading takes this as when keeping options open disempowers others, and it predicts no behaviour. The silent half does not. Under the continuation condition (scope) the part's own continuation counts as any does, and a closing course does not widen the course it closes against, so C (order) alone requires no ranking of it above; C reads no consent. Legitimate choice is a further commitment, among J1-J4, explicit and not warranted by definitions; and 07 argues that endorsement does not erase a loss. Constraints on acts are open. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided): where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin of every formation outside it, and is mixed where it goes beyond for one. Mixed is not ordered.
Does not show any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance, nor constraints on acts.

Conditional (the condition for scope; C and the practical commitments for order; an argument): ends, evaluations and the rules selecting future intelligence change living too, so they enter the same appraisal; endorsement does not erase a loss.

targets.part: Conditional: ends and evaluations enter the appraisal

says.en: J1-J4 commitments on comparison, basic protection priority, responsibility and legitimate choice remain explicit and are not warranted by formal definitions.

Theorem (World; balance): in a balanced flow each level with what the part has taken equals the level without it with what the part has given; so closing needs a net draw and opening a net give. Where the rest would overdraw there are no withheld levels, and nothing to compare.

account_adds.en: The exact boundary in others' margins; that keeping one's own options open is itself what can narrow others'; that endorsing a loss does not erase it. That a part closes another only by a net draw.

source_adds.en: Self-determination as limiting whose closure counts against the line; the 2024 permissiveness; the protections no world may opt out of (children, dependents, exit).

name.en: One line held without exception, a deliberate minimal totalization

source.locator: The argument, The one constraint; claim 4

sense.en: We will not close the world. This is conceded to be the one closure permitted, because it is the single rule that keeps the rule-set open, the room to be wrong included; not a second axiom but the operational form of the one value. It forbids only its own global defeat.

quote: the one closure permitted

reading.en: The account holds no line without exception. Root laws forbid no relation; content comes through hypotheses. The condition and C are unasserted hypotheses, any duty is not shown, constraints on acts are open. Nearest are T8's former refuter, a pure closing argued good for life, and J2's priority of basic conditions, a premise whose rival is not shown inconsistent. Neither is a prohibition on closing. [AI reading]

says.en: A law of the root holds of every carrier, relation and class, so it forbids no relation; a law with content is conditional and forbids through its hypotheses.

That anyone must hold the continuation condition, C or the step of invariance: no warrant from outside is sought, and none binding every possible mind is claimed. Nor any duty, nor constraints on acts.
Conditional (J1/J2): the tier assignment is a reading. Reading [AI reading, D65]: a rival preferring enough secondary gains to one basic restoration is not shown inconsistent.

account_adds.en: That each premise's rival is consistent, by witness.

source_adds.en: An absolute constraint, and the candour of naming it a totalization. The readings the account's rankings name, most often the continuation condition and C, are not offered as any such thing.

name.en: Many independent measures of worth

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 40, 114, 119

sense.en: No metric, price included, carries all the variety of worth. A single scoreboard is monoculture at the level of value, and the compounding axis collapses many measures onto the one that wins.

quote: A dashboard that crowns one measure as final, even a humane measure, is still a path toward closure.

reading.en: The account gives where this holds. C (order, unasserted, no warrant from outside sought) crowns no measure: it is what every positive weighting shares, and mixed comparisons go both ways, one weight for each item being one choice that ranks by number. Widening alone does not settle a mixed part; a further judgment names its criterion and who holds it, and the criterion need not be a number. A metric closes where it is read from what it selects: it then outlives a loss it does not read; T7 on actual metrics is conjectured, with one trained system's lock formed and its bridge failed. Plural weightings are not plural institutions. [AI reading]

says.en: One course widens another exactly when every positive weighting ranks it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways; one weight for every item ranks by number.
T7, a measure read from what it selects outlives its refutation: the lock proved for any type, actual metrics conjectured; in one trained system the lock formed and the bridge failed; no field test.

account_adds.en: Why a lock survives its own refutation (lock_outlives_loss).

source_adds.en: That independent measures must be kept alive as a requirement; that price in particular cannot carry them (the Coasean claim 119 has no live counterpart).

name.en: Every structure is a means; judge the dynamic, not the label

source.locator: Claims 56, 136-137, 144; own words 46

sense.en: Central, distributed, strong, soft, market, commons, state, AI: none is good by label. Some systems may keep strong guardians and others lighter ways. The invariant is functional: no single point may capture and totalize the whole; exit and voice survive. Power is not bad as such, and reflexive decentralization can sabotage coordination.

quote: The issue is not the label. The issue is the dynamic under pressure.

reading.en: The account makes the same move in structure, without the invariant. Which kind a limit is goes by what it does to what can be had, not its name; a lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours; selected control is not thereby capture, and the models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes. 'Centraliz' has no hit in the chapters and one in the records, control theory's decentralized control: the question of forms is not taken up. 06's row comes by descent, reading the early texts' own 限. [AI reading]

says.en: A limit's kind depends on what it does to what can be had again, not its name; a limit that promises, trains or stops harm constrains steps while what it constrains can still be had: 护闭's structure.

targets.part: the 成生之限／绝生之限 row

says.en: Selected control is not thereby capture. What the rule reads is fixed here by a premise on its readers, not by the shaping, so the models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes.

account_adds.en: That the capture laws hold whichever share the rule favours.

source_adds.en: The functional invariant on any structure; plural guardians within one world; the warning about reflexive decentralization.

name.en: Cooperating on the wrong thing can be worse than competing

source.locator: Claims 56-57; strongest objections, Cooperation is not automatically good

sense.en: Ren's own objection: cooperation is not automatically good, so the question is what possibilities an action creates. The README says the corpus answers this only by the Test, and thinly.

quote: cooperative on the wrong thing could be why worse than just competing on it

reading.en: 05 states that no law says cooperation is good. It also has a mechanism the folder lacks, reading pooling as cooperation being a reader's join. A group's closure is the union of its members', and an act differing only beyond that union is selected alike by every group within it: a perfectly pooled group is blind where its members are. The one-page case is this: the community's largest steady catch ends the mussel bed it was told nothing of. The laws do not say that loss counts: whether it counts depends on the significance supplied, the continuation condition counting it, and a ranking names its order, C or another. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance for the gap): a group's closure is the union of its members' closures; in two balanced flows, an act differing only beyond the union, the pool's own joint act included, is selected alike by every group within it at every step.

In a frozen test, three AI fishers (language models told what to do, not trained systems) told nothing of the bed kept it in no season: a selection can meet its own criterion while what it cannot read is lost, and the laws do not say whether that loss counts [AI reading].

Any evaluation: no law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping. A ranking of it names its scope and order; the continuation condition and C are one pair of readings 07 examines.

account_adds.en: Why cooperation has this limit: the reach of its pooled coupling, with an exact statement.

source_adds.en: That it can be worse than competing. The account compares no such pair.

name.en: Sensing held in common as far as function requires

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 133-134, 154

sense.en: A harm must be sensed faster than it spreads, which needs sensing distributed rather than held at one vantage: for function before fairness. 'Shared' may be federated or forkable; the invariant is anti-capture. The line between shared sensing and arbitration is never drawn.

quote: the way a living body senses and answers without needing a king

reading.en: The functional half has laws. A pool separates exactly what some member separates, so what a harm's sensing needs can be read as who is in the pool; a reading requires the drawn level to couple in by level, before the point of no return. It has edges: a pool recruiting only through itself couples into a loss only as its course without the loss would. One kind of institution has one minimal model on the root, as a reading, and no actual institution is shown to meet its hypotheses; pools' forming and resisting capture is not shown. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World), as COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §2 lists it under pool couplings: where a list holds exactly the members and each member's coupling of two histories is decided, a pool separates exactly what some member separates (World). Edge: a pool recruiting only through itself couples into a loss only as its course without the loss would, and a pool comes to couple into what it does not yet couple into only through an admission not made through it (witness) or through members its course would hold anyway (witness).
Reading [AI reading, D45]: coupling (by level and not by threshold, into a selecting pool), and time (before the regime's point of no return).
Does not show how pools form, last and resist capture.

account_adds.en: The exact reach of a pool and the recruitment edge.

source_adds.en: Distribution as a requirement; federation and forking as forms; who arbitrates.

name.en: Competition is not the deep law; zero-sum above a threshold is suicidal

sense.en: Major transitions, symbiogenesis, mutual aid, multilevel selection and commons show cooperation at least as deep. Above a power threshold zero-sum competition is systemically suicidal. Evolving toward struggle is selected out when the 境 changes, because struggle is not 生. Not fighting is possible.

quote: Competition is not the deep law of nature

reading.en: The account keeps both sides as theorems. Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum, not rivalry: positions' rises total their falls. Position does not protect: where a race produces joint excess, a premise, every greatest part depending on that condition ends, one not so depending continues. So the threshold claim becomes a hypothesis. Selection among groups and Hamilton's rule restate known forms of cooperation's selection, with no ranking of depth. Selection against struggle has no live law; no dynamic is good here. [AI reading]

says.en: Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems. Reading [AI reading, D45]: positional goods stay zero-sum, and conserved stocks rivalrous.

Theorem (any type for the counting): no change raises every part's position, and a part's rise needs another part's fall. Position does not protect: from T + n on every greatest part depending on the condition at a need of at least m is inactive; in the clearing witness one not depending on what it draws down continues. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived.
Theorem (any type): selection within groups and among them at equal sizes, the multilevel form of Price's equation. 04 says its laws restate known results.
Theorem (any type): selection with returns to groupmates, Hamilton's rule, for groups of equal size founded mixed with offspring numbers additive in own and groupmates' amounts.

account_adds.en: Real conflict as a theorem the folder's hopeful register plays down.

source_adds.en: Cooperation as at least as deep as competition; symbiogenesis, mutual aid and major transitions as its evidence (no hit for symbio or Kropotkin in the live files; major transitions appear only as not shown, in the confined-rise record; multilevel selection is present as a law); 斗 as selected out; the power threshold as a fact of actual worlds.

name.en: Change the game rather than win it: final victory is still closure

source.locator: Claims 95, 118; The argument, Why openness

sense.en: Winning the runaway and building a power large enough to end it both terminate in lock-in. Ruin and final victory are different doors into the same dead room; the enemy is not strength or order but foreclosure by whatever road. So change the payoffs, not the winner.

quote: A final victory is still closure.

reading.en: Half has a form: a lock belongs to how the rule reads, not whom it favours, and where the rest outruns the renewal only a change of the rest's exchange helps. 'One dead room' is scoped: full taking alongside another taker ends what depends on it, the full taker included. Generation and keeping each exclude degeneration, so a kept victory is not ruin; position fails only where the winner depends on what it draws down. No verdict by type: under C, unasserted, sharing ranks above winning by consumption in that family on every reading. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional (C; World): in the support-gated family every comparison satisfying C ranks sharing above winning by consumption under the whole-run, stepwise and possibility readings. No reading is chosen.

Position does not protect: every greatest part depending on the condition at a need of at least m ends; in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. That a race produces joint excess is a premise.
Generation and keeping each exclude degeneration.
The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: structure: where the rest outruns the renewal, no weight selects restraint, and only a change of the rest's exchange helps.

Theorem (World: balance, only active giving, activity needing support, the gate at the need): full taking alongside another taker at each of n steps from a level below n + m ends every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m, the full taker included.

account_adds.en: That a lock is a structure and carries no verdict; a critical mass can lock either way; a winner not depending on what it draws down continues.

source_adds.en: That final victory and ruin are one outcome; final victory as closure whatever its road, where the account ranks victory by consumption below sharing only under C in that family; foreclosure as the one enemy.

name.en: Channel the drives; hierarchy and status are not the enemy

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 115-117

sense.en: Status and hierarchy are older than our species. Suppressed they re-route; with payoffs changed and drives unshaped, the race rebuilds inside the garden. Some hierarchies brought peace. Drives are tools: the more understood, the more possibility space can be constructed.

quote: A hunger for status can raise a hospital or burn a village.

reading.en: The account takes up rank and contest and withholds the ruling. 06 reads 争胜与等级 as a layer setting a direction within relations, not a prior entity, so its divergence is in direction, and gives it no sign; what a closing opens and closes for 生生, the continuation of life, and for whom, is said by a comparer's reading, not by type, the continuation condition fixing scope and whoever holds C the order, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought. So 'not the enemy' meets no contrary verdict, while 'some hierarchies brought peace' ranks where the account ranks nothing without a premise. No law of channelling drives was found. [AI reading]

says.en: The mechanism: earlier texts wrote evaluation into definitions (成闭为恶); here only structure is mapped; what a closing opens and closes for 生生, the continuation of life, and for whom, is said by a comparer's reading, not by type, the continuation condition fixing scope and whoever holds C the order, neither asserted.

Reading of four non-relational layers: 争胜与等级 (二柄, 民弱国强, 贵贱有等, 亲亲之杀) sets a direction within relations, not a prior entity, so its divergence is in direction. Witnesses: a rise needs a fall; an imposed code makes all agree, each losing what it merges.

source_adds.en: That drives can be channelled and by what; that suppressed they re-route, and changed payoffs with unshaped drives rebuild the race; that some hierarchies brought peace; drives as tools for building possibility space. Stated as mechanism with no test.

name.en: The human substrate; care as the floor; mortality the one closure

source.locator: Claim 143; strongest objections, A system, not a civilization

sense.en: A society is sustained by childhood, illness, aging, friendship, grief, ritual, love and death, not incentives alone. Care is the floor that makes freedom real for those who cannot leave. Mortality is the one closure no arrangement escapes. How a civilization gives up the thrill of winning is owned as missing.

quote: care is the floor that makes freedom real for those for whom walking away was never on offer

reading.en: The account does not take this up. It has formations, not childhood or grief; it says no test of a thesis run so far has human participants and that well-being beyond admitted continuation is not shown. Its nearest is conditional practical judgment on a common support, which is not this claim. So the objection 'a system, not a civilization' stands against the account too, as this entry reads it. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: All of it, including the interior problem. It stands in this folder and its sources.

searched: mortal, embodiment, care (this read and the reviser's), childhood, grief, ritual, thrill of winning (the mapper's list where it ran them)
read: 07 What this chapter does not show
the hit lines of 'care': 07 on feeding from a step and on acts aimed past death, 04's assessments; none is this claim

name.en: 模有高下 and 感须校正: guards against relativism and private intuition

source.locator: Claims 32-33, 106

sense.en: Models are all situational but not equal: their ranking lies in whether they better reveal 理, recognize 机, detect 伪, protect 开 and guide action in this 境. Feeling must be corrected by the echo of the situation, others' response, consequences and the mutual attestation of models. Every useful model is coarser than its system, this one included.

quote: 模有高下

reading.en: The phrases have no live hit, the mechanisms do. Against relativism the account gives adequacy relative to a supplied requirement, not rank: a reading is too coarse or fine enough for what it answers to, and which requirement is right the law does not say. 感须校正 has a form and a limit: a model is revised only by what its own course exposes, and that course is chosen through the model, so correction beyond it needs a risked act or a reading from outside. Ranking by protecting 开 would bring 开 in as standard. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading: the law says what a reading must carry for a requirement to be met by one response; which requirement is right it does not say. A reading too coarse for the requirement is the covering's failure; a finer reading keeps every common response.

Reading [AI reading, new]: a formation's model is revised only by what its own course exposes, and that course is chosen through the model; a model right along its course and wrong off it is never refuted there, related to self-confirming equilibrium (Fudenberg and Levine 1993). What tells such worlds apart comes from beyond its own selection: an act that risks the task, or a reading from outside.

account_adds.en: The exact limit of correction by echo: it reaches what the course exposes.

source_adds.en: A ranking of models by whether they reveal 理, recognize 机, detect 伪 and protect 开; the mutual attestation of models. The README lists both guards as lost between the Chinese and English tracks.

name.en: One logic for humans, the living world and made minds

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 108, 135

sense.en: None is master, resource or tool by default. The threshold is whether a being bears states whose disregard would thin the web, not usefulness or intelligence. Where a made mind's status is uncertain, the uncertainty is a duty to inquire and limit abuse. 'Humanity' means the keeping-alive of the shared future.

quote: there are logic and common sense that should be followed by all beings

reading.en: The continuation condition's scope is wider and unasserted: for anything, not beings past a threshold. C gives order. T8's *for life* names whose way it is, not whose losses count; T8 is the makers' offer for life, binding no one: to see what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends, what goes on through that ending, and who bears it; 生生 names life's continuation, and widening is not its measure. The continuation condition and C belong to conditional comparisons. Which formations count differs by relation discerned; whether an actual AI counts is not shown. The source's threshold, states whose disregard thins the web, sits nearer the centers' scope, a reading, than the condition. No duty under uncertainty is shown. [AI reading]

says.en: The continuation condition: from every standpoint, the continuation of anything has significance at every step. Not asserted; significance neither graded nor necessarily positive.

T8, argued: for life, the account's makers offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; it binds no one. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: whether an actual AI system counts so is not shown.
The centers' scope [AI reading, D59] parts from the condition at a formation that is no center.

account_adds.en: The objection the scope draws: why 'anything', a tumour and a hurricane tested, sharpened and not resolved.

source_adds.en: A positive threshold; a duty of inquiry under uncertainty; 'one logic' as a common norm for all beings.

name.en: The determined adversary

source.locator: The argument, Defense; claims 146, 153

sense.en: One who understands all this, is neither deluded nor trapped, and races by preference: 'stop believing in the race' is no defence against him. Rated the biggest crack and owned as unsolved. Ren's design goal is recognition and situational correction, not elimination.

quote: races because he prefers to win

reading.en: The account states the same gap as limits. Seeing is not valuing, coupling is not compliance, a perspectivist denies the continuation condition (scope) consistently, nothing reading no order entails C (order), neither asserted, and the clearer meets every requirement derived from its own continuation. So no law moves one who prefers otherwise; 07 names informed harm, a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, the hard rival. It adds no defence either; the two are alike here in leaving this unsolved. [AI reading]

says.en: Seeing is not valuing: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter. Coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.

With significance supplied as the free predicate, where there is a standpoint and a formation, neither logic alone nor a satisfiable statement reading only the represented dynamics entails the continuation condition, and bounded_rival gives a consistent denial of it; no warrant from outside is sought.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: informed harm (a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, no loss returning), the hard rival, which tests the inference from one unfolding to goodwill without refuting normative grounds.

account_adds.en: That the denial is consistent, by witness, not merely that it is hard to answer.

source_adds.en: The practical problem of defence: recognition of destabilizing behaviour and coordinated stopping (claim 153). Not modelled.

name.en: The governance paradox: whatever can prevent capture can capture

source.locator: The argument, Defense; claims 147, 149-152; Who constrains the constrainers

sense.en: Any institution strong enough to coordinate can become the new closure, the project's own instruments included. Defence must be bounded, contestable and able to stand down; emergency powers are capture surfaces; no model guarantees stand-down. Stopping a superhuman defector seems to require the concentration forbidden.

quote: any system strong enough to prevent capture can itself capture

reading.en: The account has the loop's form and marks the question open. A Reading has a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects locking as the rule it replaced did, only a change of law leaving (the imperial examination, as read). Corruption of courts and audit is read as a loop reaching the routes of 明; term limits and audits as pooling. The models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes. How pools resist capture is not shown. No law of standing down. The Reading's example is read in the meta-attractor line, a sibling of this folder, so that example comes by descent; the capture laws stand apart from it. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects, where selection does not lower its carriers' share under a favouring rule and every rule it reads favours its carriers, locks from any start as the rule it replaced did; only a change of law, such as reading what lies beyond its share, leaves the lock for long. It rests on the capture laws.

Selected control is not thereby capture. What the rule reads is fixed here by a premise on its readers, not by the shaping, so the models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes.
Does not show: the capture loop under noise beyond its one proved case; and how pools form, last and resist capture.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: term limits, audits, courts and antitrust carry what an actor's acts do back into what selects the rule: pooling, not opposed interests.

account_adds.en: Control selected and lock left in time are separable in three of four combinations; the fourth is not shown.

source_adds.en: The enforcement antinomy; stand-down, sunset and audit as requirements; who watches the watchers.

name.en: Trust before verification

source.locator: The argument, 2026-10-04, Trust before verification; claims 225-227

sense.en: From a monologue, quoted in translation, the glosses the assistant's: verification and transparency are useless without trust; trust rests on credible information; do not presume the other untrustworthy, begin with contact. Trust keeps verification from becoming surveillance. Steps must be conditional and observable.

quote: 「无论你是建立核查机制（verification），还是提高透明度（transparency），只要没有信任，这些都白搭」

reading.en: The account has no statement of trust; this scope is proposed here, on its model of waiting. Restoring needs a formation sparing all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays. And mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source, which limits 'begin with contact'. Verification has a limit of its own: behaviour at an unread occasion can differ while every reading agrees, where no read occasion shares its lump; intention and another's false belief are not stated. Tolerance is not shown good. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays.

Reading [AI reading, D48]: tolerance lets cooperation survive scattered withholding, and rebuilds it where it is lost everywhere only where some formation spares all it waits on; mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source.

Reading: given a law the readings select, behaviour at an unread occasion can differ from that law's while every reading agrees, where no read occasion shares the occasion's lump, and only there. Intention, anticipation and another's false belief are not stated.

account_adds.en: The need for a grounded start, a source before the loop.

source_adds.en: Trust itself; the order contact, trust, verification; trust as what bounds verification; step size against a decisive defector, which the README lists as missing.

name.en: Leaving the race without being eaten

source.locator: The argument, Theory of change; claims 160-166, 222-224

sense.en: The load-bearing open question. The destination is easy; assurance, living proofs, visible alternatives and protected correction carry people through; the transition must become materially safer than the race. A participant says it from inside: falling behind means being beaten. A late exit is the costliest.

quote: It is leaving the race without being eaten during the leaving.

reading.en: The account has exits from a lock and when they close, each under hypotheses, none shown of an actual collective. Late exit has a model form: once the late reading would favour the shapers, every later reading keeps the lock. Where the rest outruns a renewal, only a change of its exchange helps. Conditional commitment has the tolerating law's form, with a limit: without one sparing all it waits on, total withholding stays. Tipping has a count form, no noise, not of leaving a race. Its verdict on guarantee is no. It has no assurance, living proofs or material safety. The join to leaving a race is a reader's. [AI reading]

says.en: Exits, each with law, model, hypotheses and edge: read what lies beyond the share, read the loss in time, restraint within the joint slack, spare all one waits on, and others. Once the late reading would favour the shapers, every later reading keeps the lock.
That any exit's hypotheses hold of an actual collective, institution or trained system is not shown.
Under the tolerating law a formation gives where all but its tolerance of what it waits on gave. Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on; without one, total withholding stays.

Theorem (counts): at a threshold with lo < c < hi the course tips: from a start above the shapers' share rises strictly at every step; from a start below it falls strictly at every step. Without noise.

account_adds.en: An edge for each exit, several with the step at which its window closes.

source_adds.en: Safety while leaving, the question the folder calls load-bearing; assurance contracts, the seed abundance unit, living proofs, material safety, common-knowledge manufacture; tipping out of an actual race. The account's frozen tests are of laws, not of a transition.

name.en: No system can be guaranteed against collapse

source.locator: The argument, What keeping-open requires; claims 5, 138

sense.en: Build to survive failure, not to prevent it: a body does not forbid illness, and demanding a guarantee is the control reflex by which the tyrant gets built. What stays open is the sample space, through plurality: if some systems fail, the whole can keep evolving.

quote: I don't think there are ways to absolutely ensure any system not collapse

reading.en: COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION answers 'can we always?' with no guarantee, by named laws: selection reaches what couples in, a finite record does not certify renewal, points of no return are exact. Each is a theorem on its model and whether a collective meets its hypotheses is empirical. The source's remedy does not come with it. [AI reading]

says.en: No guarantee. The theory's own laws, each on its stated model, show why: a selection reaches only what couples into it, no finite record certifies renewal, points of no return are exact.
