Law (World; a mutual best response, existence not shown in general): each takes its whole capacity wherever something stands.
Theorem. Where an eligible outcome reaches the set point every optimum stands at it, whatever the room; below it, every optimum takes the part's whole capacity beyond.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 荀子 '求而无度量分界，则不能不争': the limit is set on the relation of desires and goods, in neither party.

account_adds.en: That a set-point order still draws its shortfall and can break a dependence beyond it.

source_adds.en: The default direction under sufficiency, and the empirical claim about human repertoires. The folder itself marks this as not following from the ontology.

name.en: 大同 as a memory; agriculture removed the ceilings

source.locator: Claim 18

sense.en: 大同 may be a memory: in abundant environments small mobile groups lived so by default, demand-sharing and the freedom to walk away capping accumulation. Agriculture removed those ceilings, not the disposition, so recovery is architectural, not moral. A historical conjecture, Ren's own, with Sahlins supplied in conversation.

quote: Agriculture removed the ceilings, not the disposition.

reading.en: A historical conjecture with no counterpart. The history dossier, not live, says of the 礼运 passage that the text's telling of 大同 as a way once practised is narrative, not derivation. Taken as architecture, the recovery half goes to the next entry; the history stays here. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole historical claim; the row p-ru-liyun-da-tong-xiao-kang in history/CHINESE-SOURCES-AND-BECOMING.md addresses only the text's own telling.

name.en: Recovery by rebuilding removed negative feedbacks

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; Register one

sense.en: 大同 is reachable by mechanism, not conversion: material sufficiency plus restored negative feedback (real exit, ceilings on accumulation, cheap verifiable trust, coordination not routed through a capturable centre) moves the default toward cooperation.

quote: rebuild the removed negative feedbacks at scale

reading.en: The account's exits have this shape: carrying what acts do back into what selects the rule, reading beyond the share, pooling; suppressed feedback and blocked exit are read as a fault in organized relations. It states them narrower and without promise: no guarantee, each exit under hypotheses, none shown of an actual collective, several with a closing window, and material sufficiency is no exit in its table. 'Reachable by mechanism' becomes achievable under stated conditions. [AI reading]

says.en: Exits from the loops that lock a collective, each with its law, hypotheses and edge; 'Achievable under stated conditions: yes, for named exits, none shown to hold of an actual collective'. Always guaranteed: no.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: term limits, audits, courts and antitrust carry what an actor's acts do back into what selects the rule: pooling, not opposed interests.

Theorem (any type). A reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course after every reading step past it, a sufficient way out; where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of any size is absorbed.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 利出一孔 makes everything hang on one giver, while two suppliers each suffice; what must be looked at is what intervening and not intervening each do to the whole relation.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: kept apart from an omission of the representation and from informed harm is a fault in organized relations (suppressed feedback, blocked exit).

account_adds.en: The edge of each exit, that where the reading is formed from the share a new reading is absorbed, and, for a capturable centre, that a member is needed exactly where it is the only member (07 §4.3).

source_adds.en: 大同 as reachable by mechanism, with material sufficiency as a lever, cheap verifiable trust and ceilings on accumulation: none modelled. Exit has one reading and no law. The folder also notes it has no account of what leaving costs a constituted self.

name.en: The target is the topology of feedback on drives

source.locator: Claim 19; own words 26

sense.en: Ren's self-correction: environment is not the whole story. Unchecked positive feedback on drives (status, dominance, acquisition, hatred) breaks a system regardless of abundance, so the target is the topology of the feedback the drive runs in, not the drive and not the environment alone.

quote: drive如果可以channel到一个和谐幸福的方向，而不是corruption

reading.en: Same form on models: a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less; draws exceeding all earlier draws need a stock of at least 2^n - 1, so abundance only buys steps; 'more than now' and 'above all others' have no rest. Stated of conditions and targets, not of human drives; how targets form is not modelled. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where every link gives on at least what it receives the difference never falls, so a loop closes a difference only through a link giving back less.
Theorem (World: balance, nothing given). Where each step's draw exceeds everything drawn since T, what stood at T is at least 2^n - 1. How fast an actual draw grows is not shown.

Theorem. 'More than now' is met only by change, and at every step needs an open world; 'above all others' is met by at most one seeker, so no unchanged state meets it for two. How a target forms is not modelled.
Theorem. The bound is exactly no overshoot; within it, opposing, the level settles at m; beyond it an opposing exchange crosses and can oscillate for ever.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions for closing, keeping or exceeding every bound, and a limit on negative feedback itself: a late or oversized opposing exchange does not settle.

source_adds.en: Status, dominance and hatred as the drives concerned, and channelling a drive toward happiness rather than removing it.

name.en: Shared symbols selected toward one root

source.locator: Claim 20; Register two; own words 41-43

sense.en: In a communication environment of 和, symbols shared across frameworks are selected toward a monist attractor, concepts traceable to a common root. So 大同 is no utopia but the direction in which language and existence automatically manifest, toward 理, good and 生生不息. Flagged by Ren as hypothesis, both premises.

quote: 乃是一个语言与存在自动向理，向善，向生生不息的方向manifest

reading.en: The account takes up shared codes and says otherwise. Agreement comes from one origin or a broken symmetry, where origin means whose form is heard, not a root of concepts; being joined is not enough; the forms that can become shared are those in use; no law tests a form for reaching 理 or good, imposing a code agrees as well, and no law says a shared code is worth keeping. Joined accounts meet at a common refinement: finer, not one root. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where two forms differ, an order brings every start to agreement exactly where it gives all formations one origin; the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use. Being joined through couplings is not enough: on a path a – c – b, a and b never agree. How long agreement takes is not stated.
Theorem (any type). Imposing one code makes all agree in a step and keeps every exchange of formations: agreement from symmetry without a formation above the others, by privileging forms.
Theorem (any type). Majority adoption makes no form; two holding different forms both rest, so agreement needs a broken symmetry.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: writing as a reading system is strongly relational, but the graph itself encodes no relational ontology.

Theorem (any type). For incidence-connected scopes whose roots a bisimulation of their role frames relates, the matched fragment pairs form a common refinement covering both. A static law; no selection is stated.
No law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping.

account_adds.en: What an agreed code costs, and that free-energy minimization breaks no symmetry.

source_adds.en: An attractor of communicating intelligences, and the joining of existence to language. The folder also says it is joined to register one by nothing yet.

name.en: Cooperation has to reason; struggle only has to win

source.locator: Claim 20; own words 42

sense.en: Once there is contention, 'I am right' and the I becomes greater than 理: cooperation must give reasons, struggle need only prevail. Ren's correction of his own premise, from an egalitarian environment to an environment of 和 rather than 争.

quote: 合作才讲理，斗则讲赢

reading.en: Proposed here, of the second half only; no live text joins them: a rule read from the share it selects outlives a growing loss it does not read. That is only having to win where winners write the reading, proved in the model; on actual metrics T7 is conjectured, and in one trained system the bridge failed, a note of the loss turning the rule. The first half has no law; 07 tells closure from disagreement. 06 records 戴震's 以理杀人, so 理 alone is no safeguard. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where neither the next share nor the rule read reads the beyond, courses alike in share and rule stay alike; from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked.

Thesis T7: a metric whose rule and reading are formed from the share it selects is kept by its selectors however large a loss it does not read grows, and is dropped only through a change in what the loop reads. In the model only invariance and the lock are proved.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 戴震's 以理杀人 is one standpoint's model applied where others' differences do not couple in; pooling the coupling of those affected fills that blind spot.
An account that read every objection as its objector's capture would take in no objection, and by the law of selection nothing an objector says could then reach it.

T7, on actual metrics: conjectured; in one trained system the lock formed, and the bridge, that its judge is a pool of readers read by kind, failed: notes of the loss on the disfavoured readers' answers turned its rule at each reading where they were read, the model's law standing only within its hypotheses.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure, real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, 'closed' shields the theory from counterexamples.

account_adds.en: What turns such a course, T7's frozen test with its own standing, and method's rule that an objection is answered on what it says.

source_adds.en: That contention puts the I above 理 while cooperation must give reasons, and that an environment of 和 makes parties reason at all.

name.en: Evolving toward struggle is selected against

source.locator: Claim 21; own words 44

sense.en: Struggle-optimised traits (his example: males over-optimising appearance) go extinct when the environment changes, because they are not 生 and adapt poorly; accumulating toward the future, the 生 that is recognised, is 理. Marked conditional, Ren's own.

quote: 当境变化的时候，这些就更可能会灭，因为它非生，适应性低

reading.en: The account takes up whether struggle ends the struggler, by another mechanism: the source has low adaptability when an environment changes, the laws an end through a drawn condition. Position does not protect a part depending on what the race draws down: it ends with the rest; a confined rise has no member after the end, known results restated. But in the clearing witness a greatest part not so depending continues, and in the witness Body an unconfined rise has a member later, so struggle is not selected against in general. That a race produces joint excess is a premise; selection has no tie to 生. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type for the counting; World for the race). Position does not protect a part requiring a condition past the joint excess. In a witness race the part rising in position ends with every other; in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived.

Theorem (World). A confined rise has no member after the end, whatever selection within had raised it to; in the witness Body the lineage depending on a condition outside the body still has a member. These restate known results on cancer and the germ line; that a given tumour meets the clauses is empirical.

account_adds.en: The condition under which a position-winner ends and the witness where it does not.

source_adds.en: Selection across environmental change and the low adaptability of struggle traits, the source's own mechanism, and accumulation toward the future as 理.

name.en: 一元 as return to one root, and plural

source.locator: Claim 22; own words 45

sense.en: 一元 is not cardinality but all concepts returning to one root. Many traditions do this and differ in which root: god, emptiness, struggle, extinction. 一生万物 is itself pluralism: monism at the root and plurality in the world are one claim.

quote: 我说的一元当然不是基数，是所有概念回归同一root

reading.en: The grammar has this shape: one kind of symbol, a relation read as condition, sameness relative to a plural class. The word is not the source's: this root is a model's choice, not a ground concepts return to, and 06 lists a prior ground among non-relational layers. The account counts its own return: a few central results are cases of the root, more use its laws, most use none. Against a rival dropping the reading, a first count ties. [AI reading]

says.en: The chapter takes one relation, read as condition, and one class, read as sameness, and shows what their meet, continuation, carries.
Definition: a class is a reflexive, symmetric, transitive relation. Reading [AI reading, D69]: the class is plural; the grammar names the class and says everything relative to it.
Of the central results a few are cases of the root, more use its laws in their proofs and most use none.
Each of the 117 distinct central declarations has one standing against the edge of one root; eleven are derived, each a case of grammar laws.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: the theory never identifies 道 with any spine term; 无, 一, 二, 三 do not by comparison become the empty set, a bit or an operation.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: among the non-relational layers recurring in the lines, the first is a prior ground (先在的根据).

Thesis (philosophical, argued): reading a subject as continuation relative to a class explains how it goes on. A rival keeping every model and theorem and dropping the word loses no exclusion; on a first count there is a tie.

account_adds.en: A count of how far the return goes, and what would defeat the reading (08 §9).

source_adds.en: All concepts returning to one root, the comparative claim about what different religions return to, 一生万物 as truth, and monism at the root and plurality in the world as one claim.

name.en: Scale self-similarity: we are the collective

source.locator: Claim 23; own words 27, 46

sense.en: We are in the system and are the system, so the 理 between us and the cells in our bodies is the same at that level. We may be individual but cannot disregard the collective, because we are it; all should behave as if part of the whole. Hence 人类命运共同体. Ren's own.

quote: 我们可以"个人"，但不能不管集体，因为我们即是集

reading.en: The account refuses this form where it would matter: a shared process implies no cosmic subject and no aggregate interest, a collective is no unit with an interest, and part-whole is three relations, with no fixed ladder of scales. Nonduality is a requirement of method and proves no ethical necessity, so from 'we are the system' no 'should' follows; a ranking is under C or another named order, with a named scope, most often the continuation condition, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought. [AI reading]

says.en: Nonduality erases no difference in experience, history, access, control, consent or consequence. A shared process implies no cosmic subject, no aggregate interest and no administrator entitled to speak for everything.
Thesis: a collective is a region of formed relations, not a unit with an interest of its own; conflict and difference stay real.
Reading [AI reading, D65], Part and whole: inclusion, functional participation and dependence are distinct relations; cell, organ, body, ecosystem is one biological case, not a fixed ladder.
Classified by AI as a divergence of standing: 程颢's 仁者以天地万物为一体 is stated as a recognized fact, what the theory holds as an unasserted condition plus the step of invariance.
Nonduality is a requirement of method; it proves neither the ontology nor an ethical necessity.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: in 《维摩诘所说经》 care need not first take the other as one's own part, nor can it be inferred only from one shared substance.

account_adds.en: That a law across scales needs its own relation, and that an intervention on a whole needs an admissible realization.

source_adds.en: One 理 across scales, and behaving as part of the whole as what follows.

name.en: One civilisation, one global system

source.locator: Claim 44; own words 60

sense.en: There is one civilisation and one global system, societies its subsystems, and the us-against-others stance ('I'm the biggest ... those shall be mine') has to go. Spoken, from an automatic transcript, Ren provisionally Speaker B.

quote: We only have one global system that we are subsystems of that system.

reading.en: The factual half is the account's, as a reading of what is empirical: human beings plausibly lie in one another's feeding closures, and that the Earth is mutually dependent is supplied, not shown. That scope reaches nothing after the step it is read up to. 'Has to go' is not said: rivalry stays, positional goods stay zero-sum, and an order is C or another named order, with a named scope, neither the condition nor C asserted, no warrant from outside sought. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D64]: through one atmosphere, biosphere and economy, human beings plausibly lie within one another's feeding closures; if so, every human being's self-concern, held de se and drawn along what carries it, has one scope there. Whether they do is empirical.

Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems. Reading: positional goods stay zero-sum, conserved stocks rivalrous.
Theorem (World). A web's closures can be the whole in three ways: sharing conditions throughout, mutual dependence, mutual feeding. That the Earth is mutually dependent is supplied.

account_adds.en: What 'one system' can and cannot give self-concern, read with time.

source_adds.en: That the us-against-others stance has to go, and cultures' common teaching of limits on desire (claim 45).

name.en: 修齐治平 as capacity-responsibility matching

source.locator: Claims 24, 49; The argument

sense.en: 修身齐家治国平天下 is not sequence but whether I have the capacity and standing to act: an ordering by causal radius, responsibility lying where capacity reaches. Bounded: blaming the powerless yields only self-reproach; pleading weakness to refuse feasible good is evasion. Weight in deciding grows with capacity.

quote: 力之所及，责之所在

reading.en: Bounded responsibility is a further premise beyond the condition (scope) and C (order), neither asserted and no warrant from outside sought, from named, limited sources, not from capacity as such; responsibility is not shown to differentiate within relations. Reach, whose losses count and answerability stay apart. Two forms match: an empty plan set generates no duty; 06's proposed answer to 差等, attention divided by reach, survives the step of invariance, with no law. 大学's necessary direction stays a condition chain where the source denies sequence. [AI reading]

says.en: Argument, reviewed and scoped. Responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited; an empty plan set generates no duty, a contribution is indispensable only where every admissible allocation requires it. Bounded responsibility is among J1 to J4, further premises proposed by the AI (as COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §4 lists them).
One unfolding is a thesis, argued: within relations, as far as shown, taker and drawn-on are two roles of one relatum and knower and known one loop, and responsibility is not shown to differentiate.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: capability is reach, and the gap is the reach closure less the coupling closure, so capability extending reach without extending the coupling enlarges the gap.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 大学 '其本乱而末治者否矣', the necessary side holds; '身修而后家齐', the sufficient side does not generally hold.
Responsibility needs its own argument: historical contribution alone does not prove it, and its absence does not prove that there is no reason to respond.

Row 差等 (孟子 亲亲而仁民; 中庸 亲亲之杀): no law. Reading [AI reading, D54]: closures nest in fact; read as a ranking of significance that is not a theorem. Proposed answer: attention divided by what one reaches survives the step of invariance; a measure of significance set by standpoint does not.
Nor does P4 say what one answers for.

account_adds.en: The separation of reach, whose losses count, and answerability, and the reason (RP) an answerable actor has for repair. 'Capacity' in 02 is what can still be realized together, another sense.

source_adds.en: Responsibility scaling with causal radius as such, and evasion by pleading weakness. The form of 'blaming the powerless' is the empty plan set; the form of evasion has none.

name.en: 王道 and 天子: the largest owes most

source.locator: Claims 25 and 57

sense.en: The scaling rule for power inverts the usual one: those of largest causal radius owe most. Even the largest is 天子, whose being should make the relations of 天下 harmonious and prosperous. The folder keeps it as a ledger the largest is judged by, not a guardian to be trusted, an obligation and not a mechanism.

quote: 王道者，非权利之最大化，责任之最大化也

reading.en: The account takes up responsibility and power and says otherwise. Responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited, so 'maximisation of responsibility' has no form; a description of participation confers no authority, and responsibility needs its own argument. 06 records a single ruler, and 王 as linking heaven, earth and human, as a non-relational layer. The folder's own reading, a ledger held by the governed, is nearest what carries acts back into what selects the rule: term limits, audits, courts, read as pooling. [AI reading]

says.en: Argument, reviewed and scoped: responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited; an empty plan set generates no duty.
A description of participation confers no authority, permission or right. Responsibility needs its own argument.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: a will or single ruler is one layer recurring across the lines (天志；王一贯三；利出一孔), with responses within the tradition such as 黄宗羲 '天下为主，君为客'.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: the character-reading carrying most cosmological weight (王 as linking heaven, earth and human) takes one ruler as basis.
Reading [AI reading, D48]: term limits, audits, courts and antitrust carry what an actor's acts do back into what selects the rule: pooling, not opposed interests.

account_adds.en: RP, a further premise beyond the condition (scope) and C (order), neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought, gives an answerable actor a reason for repair, from deprivation, not size.

source_adds.en: The scaling rule itself with 天子 as its name, and the ledger the largest is judged by. The folder's critique: without those governed holding the ledger, it is the better-guardian answer.

name.en: A ledger of meaning changes what consolidated power is rewarded for

source.locator: Claim 47; own words 62

sense.en: Where meaning rests on moving history in a better direction rather than on dominance, the reward system changes when power is consolidated. So a civilisation's ledger of meaning decides which self-model selection favours at the top: the 大同 mechanism stated as selection. Spoken, conditional.

quote: A civilisation's ledger of meaning decides what consolidated power is rewarded for

reading.en: Proposed here, reading a ledger as what the rule reads; no live text does. It holds where the reading is not formed from the share: a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks; one formed monotonically from the share absorbs any change. So on these count models a ledger kept by those it rewards does not turn the lock, and the others must read it in time; in one trained system a note of the loss did turn the rule. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). A reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course; where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

Theorem (counts). At a step the rule favours the shapers exactly where c ≤ s, whatever p comes to every member alike. With nothing coming back and a cost, the shapers' share falls strictly at every step (`RuleShaping.nothing_back_falls`).

Theorem (counts). The others read a loss once it reaches a bound; at a reading step where the loss has reached it and the rule in force favours the shapers, the course is locked in their favour for good from the next step exactly under the stated condition. COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §2: once the late reading would favour the shapers, every later reading keeps the lock.

T7, on actual metrics: conjectured; in one trained system the lock formed, and the bridge failed: notes of the loss on the disfavoured readers' answers turned its rule at each reading where they were read.

account_adds.en: Why a good narrative alone does not turn the lock, and the window for reading. All on two-kind count models, without noise.

source_adds.en: Meaning as what sets reward, the ledger itself, and the civilisational scale.

name.en: 仁义礼智信 as one layered structure

source.locator: Claims 26 and 54; The argument

sense.en: The five are layers of cooperative existence, fractal not sequential: 仁 the relational root (人+二), 义 fittingness asking at whose cost, 礼 transmissible form, 智 situational discernment, 信 temporal consistency at the centre. Each degrades when cut from 仁. Inherited structure; Ren's the question. They also answer a relational agent's practical questions.

quote: 仁以成我，义以安位，礼以共行，智以辨向，信以守真

reading.en: Mostly absent, and the account declines two of the five as names. 06 omits 仁 as carrying value and sets 仁 and 义 as names on neither side of its table; 礼 and 信 stand only as interfaces in 文理生生. Not adopting is not excluding: their texts are still classified. 06 lists relational roots (郑玄 on 仁, 荀子 on 礼) and warns that skilled control may be 不仁. The layering and 信 at the centre are absent. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D54]: every line has a relational root, among them 郑玄 reading 仁者人也 as the 人 of 相人偶, and 荀子's 礼起于度量分界.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 德 read as a formed, still revisable capacity of response; reliable execution can reliably harm, so its ethical sense passes through comparison.
善, 恶 and 智 have no formal predicate; 足 is nearest to the rest of seeking (`Law.rests_iff`).

Its names omit 37 characters, each for a reason, among them 道 (as origin, a prior ground), 心 (a single ruler), 性 (a preset nature), 仁 (carries value). Not adopting is not excluding: the texts they stand in are still classified by what they say.
Table: set as names on neither side (16): 道、气、性、仁、义、天、有、无、阴、阳. Not set here, set in 文理生生 as an interface (7): 易、德、礼、信、虚、反、人.
Reading [AI reading]: even skilled control may be 不仁: selection reaches only what couples in.

account_adds.en: That no virtue's goodness is given by its reliability.

source_adds.en: The five as one layered structure, 信 as time and centre, each one's degradation, and the folder's question of whether they are description, prescription or scaffold.

name.en: 大道废，有仁义: named virtues as scaffolding

source.locator: Claim 28; The argument

sense.en: Read constructively: civilisation compresses the Great Way into named virtues once it stops being visible in shared life. They can repair a civilisation and cannot replace the Way, and degenerate if cut from it. This explains why moral vocabulary proliferates as moral reality thins. From the AI-drafted book.

quote: 支架者，大道之局部压缩，可以修补文明，不可代大道

reading.en: The passage has no row in the live account, nor in the history dossier by either written form. Its form needs a 'Way' prior to named norms, near what 06 records as a non-relational layer. Nearest, and not this claim: method's step of telling a change in the actual condition from one in its report, label or proxy; that a changed reward, name or preference is not fulfilment; a rule read from the share outliving what it was for. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole reading.

name.en: The convergence across traditions names one object

source.locator: Claim 27; own words 36, 49

sense.en: Confucian, Ubuntu, Buddhist, Indigenous, cybernetic and ecological traditions converge on one object, which Ren names the structure of cooperative existence for finite beings; 'today we are so mad we lost it collectively'.

quote: the structure of cooperative existence for finite beings

reading.en: For the Chinese lines checked, the account says less and otherwise: a relational root in every line, its universal form often needing scope, and as a property of each system false, with four non-relational layers recurring, each answered within its tradition. It names no convergent object: 相合不是印证, agreement is no confirmation, and shared form is not shared meaning. review/BUDDHIST-THOUGHT compares passages under its own recorded weaknesses; Ubuntu and Indigenous lines are not compared. [AI reading]

says.en: Assessment; the classes and readings are AI's [AI reading, D54]: relational ontology is a leading thread in these traditions and a position within each; it is not a property of every system nor the consensus of the commentaries. Scope slightly exceeds agreement, 98 to 91.

Reading [AI reading, D54]: structural agreement with classical 道 texts, checked by passage, is no confirmation (相合不是印证): the law does not stand on the text, and neither of these judgments can testify that the theory is the one complete 道.
Not shown: that language or tradition is relational by nature: the relational start is a leading thread, strongest in the earliest layer, not a property of every system.

account_adds.en: Counted relations by passage, and the non-relational layers: a prior ground, a preset nature or value, a will or single ruler, contention and rank.

source_adds.en: The naming of the object, and Ubuntu, Indigenous and other lines as partners in one convergence.

name.en: A community needing no shared definition of the good

source.locator: Claim 29; own words 14-15, 18

sense.en: 人类命运共同体 requires no transfer of sovereignty, only mutual trust and consensus, at every scale, and no shared definition of the good future: cultures differ, and helping one another beats contending to be king. Its core is 家国天下, and it must absorb markets and technology. Ren's value stance.

quote: 真正的命运共同体不需要主权让渡，需要的是彼此信任共识

reading.en: One clause has a form: differing valuers need no common utility, since every positive weighting shares widening. Exactly this much: they share no verdict on mixed cases, the hard ones, and valuing positively is C's premise relocated, unasserted, no warrant from outside sought. 'Better than contending' is unranked if contending is mixed. Trust and consensus as sufficient are not said: coupling is not compliance, and all six conditions of situationality still rank nothing. Sovereignty is not taken up. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem. The order shared by standpoints whose orders increase in admission is exactly widening, and calling it better is C. A mixed comparison is decided both ways. Monotonicity at the standpoint is C's premise relocated.
Thesis: joint activity is explained from actual relations, not opposed interests, bargaining or a fixed common utility.
Seeing is not valuing, and coupling is not compliance; all six conditions together still rank nothing.

account_adds.en: The exact limit of agreement among differing valuers, and evidence (T5) with frozen rules passed and failed.

source_adds.en: Trust and consensus as sufficient, no sovereignty transfer, 家国天下, and markets and technology to be absorbed.

name.en: 共开 ∧ 共续 ∧ ¬夺共续, a checked characterisation

source.locator: Claims 31-32; The argument

sense.en: 人类命运共同体 is three independent Boolean axes, with an iff over eight states and three counterexamples: 245 lines of Lean, 0 sorry, 0 new axioms, in the SSBX development. 命, 运, 体 are re-expressed from existing roots, not admitted as primitives. Its own report: not a political manifesto formalised. The folder warns it proves less than its placement suggests.

quote: three independent axes, all three or nothing

reading.en: The formalism is not on the spine, and the account says why two of its terms are not mapped: openness indexed to a focus hands openness to owners, against starting from one relational unfolding, and 夺 is stated through such openness; capture carries that content instead. The theory sets up no formal 道, so TrueDao and 道 ⊕ 人类 have no counterpart. The discipline against importing primitives survives as method. [AI reading]

says.en: Mechanism: two early items are not mapped, openness indexed by a focus, which allots openness to owners against the method, and 夺, stated through each focus's openness; as capture of a selection it is at target capture.
Theorem (any type). Where target carriers each leave at least a offspring and others at most b < a, the carriers' offspring stand to the others' strictly more than the carriers to the others.
This theory sets up no formal 道; 善, 恶 and 智 have no formal predicate.

account_adds.en: Comparison instead of definition: what a closing opens and closes for 生生, the continuation of life, and for whom, comes through a comparer's reading, with the condition for scope and whoever holds C for order, both unasserted.

source_adds.en: The community's three-axis model, kept outside the account; `Renlei` has no hit in the live text.

name.en: Dualism as root of the totalising dynamic

source.locator: Claim 33; own words 63

sense.en: The metaphysical root of the totalising dynamic is the subject-object split and treating 'the subject wants good for itself' as definitionally rational, a tradition-specific commitment mistaking itself for universal. The folder also records the objection that selection would act on relational cognition too. Ren's value stance.

quote: The metaphysical root of the totalising dynamic is dualism

reading.en: The account makes no causal claim from ontology to harm. Its capture and drain laws hold of any type and selection, so they need no dualism; 06 finds a relational method with a contending direction in 兵家 and 法家; starting from relations removes one frame, not rivalry. It will not use the charge as an answer: that an objection presupposes separate entities must be shown in the case, and nonduality proves neither the ontology nor an ethical necessity. [AI reading]

says.en: Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems.
AI classification: 兵家 and 法家 have the highest share of divergence, 8 of 13; the method is relational, the direction contending.
An objection is answered on what it says. That it presupposes separate entities, or follows a tradition or a thinker, is a claim to be shown in the case, not an answer to it.
Subject and object, actor and patient, fact and value are each drawn within the unfolding, along relations, together with what they leave out.
Nonduality is a requirement of method; it proves neither the ontology nor an ethical necessity.
08 marks a field's frame where it cites one: Frank's race, over-allocation being that field's frame.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: without substantive disagreement with no closure, 'closed' shields the theory from counterexamples.

account_adds.en: Mechanism without a metaphysical cause: what selects, what couples in, what the rule reads.

source_adds.en: A causal claim from ontology to the dynamic, and the historical critique of rational self-interest.

name.en: Institutional codification as the totalising step

source.locator: Claim 34; Counterexamples

sense.en: Dualism is necessary but not sufficient: dualistic medieval Christendom did not generate Moloch at scale, partly non-dualistic dynastic China extracted at scale, and the totalising step is codification: property and inheritance, money as universal equivalent, corporate personhood. AI pushback adopted.

quote: the totalising step is the *institutional codification* of dualism's implications

reading.en: No such historical claim, and not because the topic is missing. Money and ownership are kept for actual economic relations; a periphery model takes joint activity selected through payments; capture through a rule is proved, with 韩非's 二柄 beside it; and 07 reads the imperial examination as a case that became a proxy trap of its own. None says codification is the totalising step, or compares Christendom with dynastic China. Personhood and inheritance have no place. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The historical comparison and the named institutions.

name.en: Asymmetric scrutiny of non-Western vocabulary

source.locator: Claim 35; critiques

sense.en: Western political vocabulary travels as unmarked universal while non-Western terms are flagged 'from culture X': a standing reading error, first caught on 命运共同体. The folder adds that it cuts both ways: a culture label on a dynamic is its mirror image, and 大同 carries state associations for outside readers.

quote: if a flag is warranted for one it is warranted for the other, or for neither

reading.en: The symmetry stands as a rule of method, narrower than the source's: no cultural origin validates or disqualifies a method, an objection is answered on what it says, and 08 marks a field's frame as that field's where it cites one. Nothing rules on political vocabulary, and no law is involved. Its practice cuts both ways, as the folder asks: 06 records divergence by passage and reads no tradition as relational by nature. [AI reading]

says.en: No cultural origin validates or disqualifies a method. An objection is answered on what it says. That it presupposes separate entities, or follows a tradition or a thinker, is a claim to be shown in the case, not an answer to it.
08 marks a field's frame where it cites one: Frank's race, over-allocation being that field's frame.
Not shown: that language or tradition is relational by nature: the relational start is a leading thread, not a property of every system.

source_adds.en: The rule stated for political vocabulary (liberalism, democracy, market, social contract), its first catch on 命运共同体, and that 大同 carries state associations for outside readers.

name.en: AI must not be used for struggle

source.locator: Claim 36; own words 52-53

sense.en: The root position of the 智善 organisation: AI must not be used for struggle; intelligence belongs to all humanity, for building 大同世界 and everyone's welfare. Stated flatly as a stance.

quote: 人工智能不能被用于斗争，智能用于所有人类

reading.en: The account takes up AI and contest and gives only a conditional direction, under the continuation condition (scope), C read as widening (order), J1 to J4 and correspondence E, all unasserted, no warrant from outside sought. It forbids no use by itself: who restrains stays contested, positional goods stay zero-sum. Pooling couplings across intelligences is a route to alignment for all, not the whole of it. The source's flat root position, no AI in struggle, is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1–J4, correspondence E). The direction its makers offer AI, read under scope and order: align AI formation, learning, action and revision with actual living and further generation within the whole, governing trade-offs through real losses, basic living conditions, bounded responsibility and legitimate participation.

Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum and does not remove rivalry. Reading [AI reading, D45]: the theory adds to who wins more whether the joint draw stays within the renewal and others' margins; who restrains stays contested.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: pooling couplings across intelligences, so that what a member's acts do beyond its closure couples into a member able to respond, is a route to alignment for all, not the whole of it.

targets.part: D68: the law of several optimizers

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: alignment to a principal alone is not alignment of the joint selection; that the assistant's order rises with the principal's family is the reading's premise, not the law's.

account_adds.en: What holds with no premise: what a selection reaches, and that several optimizers drain by their joint capacity.

source_adds.en: The refusal of contest uses as a root position, and intelligence as belonging to all.

name.en: 大同 as ontological implication; alignment isomorphic to it

source.locator: Claims 37-38

sense.en: Alignment and 大同 are isomorphic at three levels: floor, not oriented toward the bad; middle, the field within [平, 和]; upper, flourishing across AI, humans and ecosphere. And 大同 is the ontological implication of 間: actors with interwoven worldlines in a shared 間 are already in a community of destiny.

quote: 「大同」不是间的远期愿景，「大同」是间的本体论 implication

reading.en: Ontology implies no such thing in the account: being joined gives mutual dependence, which is not mutual benefit, and no law or premise entails a community from a net. Nonduality proves neither the ontology nor an ethical necessity. 間 as a primitive has been replaced by the grammar of the root. A direction for alignment stands only under premises, the condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought. No isomorphism is stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Section heading text: read the closures of the map as the whole; mutual dependence is not mutual benefit.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: the early scheme of 文言 as formal language, with an original 間, has been replaced by the grammar of the root, and its claim of completeness was not proved.
Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1–J4, correspondence E): the direction its makers offer AI, read under scope and order.
Nonduality is a requirement of method; it proves neither the ontology nor an ethical necessity.

account_adds.en: A condition on the net for each sense of being joined, and why any ought is added apart.

source_adds.en: The three-level isomorphism and the spacetime reading of 命运.

name.en: The relational self does not entail the 大同 mechanism

source.locator: Open questions, 'New, from this reading'; Status

sense.en: The folder's own critique: nothing in relational constitution entails that abundance moves a society toward cooperation; that is an empirical claim about drives and feedback. The two registers, behaviour and symbols, are never joined, and the document reads as though the second follows from the first. Written by the assistant reading the folder.

quote: Nothing in the ontology of relational constitution entails that abundance moves a society toward cooperation

reading.en: The account states the general form of this concession. Its thesis of one unfolding excludes no observation, a root law holds of every relation, and content comes through hypotheses; mutual dependence is not mutual benefit; and informed harm tests the inference from one unfolding to goodwill. So what the folder concedes at one joint holds at each: no empirical direction follows from the ontology. Nothing here speaks of abundance. [AI reading]

says.en: By this section's measure the thesis has no strength: it excludes no observation, and the argument is that none could refute it. That is argued, not proved.
A law of the theory is a statement that holds of every relation, carrier or model its hypotheses admit; it is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it.
The section's opening: mutual dependence is not mutual benefit.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: informed harm, a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, no loss returning, is the hard rival, which tests the inference from one unfolding to goodwill without refuting normative grounds.

account_adds.en: That the relational form, by its own measure, has no strength; what can fail stands in named theses.

source_adds.en: The proposal that joining the two registers, selection on behaviour and on the symbols that coordinate it, is the most valuable work here.

name.en: The bounded self as the disease: cancer logic

source.locator: Claims 41, 43; 2026-10-02 passage

sense.en: The disease is a self-model: a you caring only for what you perceive as you, modelling 'even more', pursued without seeing what you and your world are; compounding, this is cancer logic. Humans can develop such an alienated, cancerous or evil ego, a capacity and no fixed nature. Selection, molochlization, rewards it. Spoken; automatic transcript.

quote: there is a you that you only you cares about what you perceive as you

reading.en: Mechanism carried, evaluation and interior not. A selection reaches only what couples in; omitting a required condition, a draw can lose its own support; a confined rise ends. The source's 'without seeing' is omission; 07 keeps informed harm apart as the hard rival, and seeing is not valuing. The position is not a defect, how a center represents its region is unmodelled, and no law says a loss is a harm. On acts or interior: choices show only their reach of an order. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis T3: a selection through couplings reaches only what couples into its selector, and with room its optima drain what lies beyond as far as any eligible outcome does, where it ranks outcomes by an order rising with what couples in. The law for optima is proved; the clause on trained systems is conjectured, partly supported.

Theorem (World). Omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support; over a region covering what it requires it keeps its own and can still undermine another. How a center represents the region is unmodelled.
Reading [AI reading, D26]: the position is not a defect; 无明 is the seeking it leaves locked.

targets.part: D26: the position is no defect

says.en: Theorem (root; near-definitional). The positive comparisons every strict order according with the choices shares are exactly the reach of what they show. Which order an actual chooser carries, or whether it chooses by one, is not shown.
Reading [AI reading, D65]. Kept apart: an omission of the representation, a fault in organized relations, and informed harm (a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, no loss returning), the hard rival.
Seeing is not valuing: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter.

Theorem (World). A confined rise has no member after the end, whatever selection within had raised it to. These restate known results on cancer and the germ line; that a given tumour meets the clauses is empirical.

account_adds.en: A narrower self-model can keep its own support and still undermine another, so own loss does not decide the case.

source_adds.en: The ego as cognitive structure, greed and anger as the moments it takes over, and the word disease.

name.en: Deciding from relations, not from a target

source.locator: Claims 49, 51; 2026-10-04 passage

sense.en: A relational decision begins from present relations, constraints and what can be done, not from optimising a target around one value. A target-first decision draws a boundary round what it counts; where winning compounds, selection favours it, while a relations-first decider bears the costs. The joining is the assistant's reading, citing a formal proposition in a paper.

quote: 而不是围绕某一个价值，去优化一个既定的目标

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text joins them. The target-first half matches T3's law, and an act beyond one's closure is selected by no member. Extending the coupling is necessary, not sufficient: where the rest outruns the renewal no weight selects a member's restraint. The relations-first half is not a law: the account has no such procedure, though its further premises, added to the condition (scope) and C (order), neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought, begin from feasible plans, and a model and an order can act alike where no selection tells them apart. An objective is a selector and an order, not a scope. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World). An act whose difference stays beyond the actor's coupling closure is selected alike by every selection through the coupling of any member of the closure, the actor among them.
Theorem (any types; a witness). Two blanketed laws related so that values sensed and acts are one give the same values and acts at every step, so no selection through those tells the two apart.
AI reading: an objective is a selector and an order, not a scope; read as a correspondence not shown, an optimizer's objective resembles the intended self.
Conditional (living significance, J1 to J4, correspondence E): responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited; an empty plan set generates no duty.

Necessary, not sufficient. Extending the coupling is necessary for a consequence beyond the actor's closure to be selected, but where the rest outruns the renewal no weight of a later reading selects a member's restraint.

account_adds.en: The folder's own point sharpened: a frame alone changes no selection.

source_adds.en: The procedure itself, its starting questions, and that relational reasoning's costs lose under compounding.

name.en: Ordinary competition is not the disease: the wolf

source.locator: Claim 42; own words 59

sense.en: Asked if all competition is bad, Ren narrows the target to a cognitive structure. The wolf's existence is not just about the wolf, and it does not eat to get bigger: ecological competition is part of an ecosystem. Spoken; automatic transcript.

quote: the existence of the wolf is not just about the wolf

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text joins them. The line the source draws by what the eating is for has a form in the shape of an order: a set-point optimum stands at enough, whatever the room; a rising order takes its whole capacity; 'more than now' has no rest. That is of orders and optima, not wolves or interiors, and below its point a set-point order can break a dependence. Predation stays mixed; the whole-run reading under C, unasserted, no warrant from outside sought, ranks malignant and winning alike. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem. Where an eligible outcome reaches the set point every optimum stands at it, whatever the room; below it, every optimum takes the part's whole capacity beyond. What protects what lies beyond at the set point is the choice among equal optima, which no law here models.
Theorem. 'More than now' is met only by change, and at every step needs an open world. How a target forms is not modelled.
足 is nearest to the rest of seeking (`Law.rests_iff`).

Under the condition every narrowing loses something with significance. Predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]; telling harm from non-harm among them takes a judgment that names its criterion and who holds it, not necessarily a number. Retaining adds no ending and ranks nothing.

Conditional (C; World). Read whole-run, the course without an overdrawing formation extends the course with it, so every comparison satisfying C ranks it higher, for a malignant and a winning focal formation alike; read event by event the two are incomparable.

account_adds.en: That the ranking turns on the reading, whole-run or event by event, and on C; that telling harm from non-harm among such endings takes a judgment naming its criterion, not necessarily a number.

source_adds.en: A difference in kind between the wolf and the ego, by what the eating is for, and the word disease for one side only.

name.en: 心 and 理 as one dynamic in the person

source.locator: Claim 52; 2026-10-04 passage, The interior

sense.en: Feeling and reason are not opposed: they form one dynamic, 心理, in which 理 keeps 心's positive feedback from running away. The good side is innate and has to be shaped. A constructive reading of the compound, from a monologue quoted through a translation; supplied by Ren as his own, not confirmed by ear.

quote: 感受和理性也不是二分的

reading.en: One record reads this very sentence, so by descent: reason regulating the heart's runaway becomes a loop blind to its own margin, avoided by measurement, a model (理) or another formation's couplings. That is regulation by what the loop lacks, and need not be inside. The account has no interior of a person, and feeling is no term of it; 理 in 03 is lumping. 'Innate good' meets 06's layer of a preset nature. [AI reading]

targets.part: the record's reading, in its provenance

says.en: Theorem (World): how far off the break is does not couple in. The record's readings (the AI's, on delegation): a runaway is a loop through whose own couplings, before the break, the world is alike with one holding as much more stock as one likes; avoiding it needs measurement, a model (理) or another formation's couplings; this reads Ren's words of 4 October that reason must regulate the heart.
Theorem. The bound is exactly no overshoot; within it, opposing, the level settles at m; beyond it an opposing exchange crosses and can oscillate for ever.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: 心即理, in context, is the responsive side within a relation, not an ontology of 心.

source_adds.en: Feeling and reason as one dynamic inside the person, the reading of 心理 as 心 and 理, and the good side as innate. It stands in this folder and `drives-narrative-attractors-and-mind`, by the folder's own Relations.

name.en: 逍遥: no independent self when the model fits

source.locator: Claim 53; own words 64-66; What fit is like

sense.en: When one's model fits reality one is nearer 逍遥; self and environment are one, there is no independent self, only forces in motion. The folder's epistemic reading, marked the assistant's: the separate self belongs to a model drawing a boundary the world does not have. Quoted through a translation.

quote: 因此，也就没有一个独立的“自我”。

reading.en: The account forbids explaining by a self with a nature of its own, yet keeps boundaries: one short of the whole is real, relative to its relation. So a fitted model keeps its boundary. The folder's test, no cost returning through an ignored coupling, has a law's form and its limit: a region covering what it requires keeps its own support and can still undermine another, so passing shows fit only to one's own needs. What fit is like meets a named defeater. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45, D61]: a boundary short of the whole is real, since its relation never crosses it, and relative to that relation.

Thesis, argued: forbids an explanation needing a determination no relation carries, such as a self with a nature of its own. Two live arguments would defeat it: that relations need relata with natures of their own, and that what an experience is like is not how it relates.
Nonduality erases no difference in experience, history, access, control, consent or consequence.

Theorem (World). Over a region covering what it requires a center keeps its own support and can still undermine another (`Clearing`); omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support (`Omitted.loses_own`). How a center represents the region is unmodelled.

With no condition, a 'should' is a reading a center forms and holds, real in what it conditions; where its represented boundary matches what it depends on, that reading is one condition of a response retaining what lies within its closure, and it does not produce the response (route (b) [AI reading, D17]).

account_adds.en: The several closures, nested or pointing opposite ways, each drawing a boundary of its own.

source_adds.en: What fit is like from inside, mind and body one, only forces in motion, and 逍遥 as its name, which has no live hit.

name.en: 己所不欲 from knowing others' minds resemble one's own

source.locator: Claim 55; own words 71

sense.en: The golden rule follows from knowing that one's own 心理 resembles others': a route through theory of mind, beside a route in 生生不息论 through what returns via the system. From the translated monologue.

quote: 你也知道，自己的心理与其他人的心理很相似

reading.en: A spine reading of the verse exists only in the history dossier: 恕 selects through a model lumping the other with oneself, so it is right exactly where the other's likes vary as one's own, and blind to difference elsewhere. So the source's premise is the rule's scope, not its proof. Live 03 states the law with no verse: a selection through a map is right about what matters only where what matters goes alike across it. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Stands at history/CHINESE-SOURCES-AND-BECOMING.md, rows p-ru-lunyu-shu and p-lunyu-shu-ji-suo-bu-yu, the first citing `Learning.selects_right_through`; a theory-of-mind derivation is not stated there.

name.en: The tradition's two engineerings, and needing to win

source.locator: Claim 56; The tradition's two tracks; critiques

sense.en: The tradition holds a social engineering for relations (儒) and, for struggle, 法家 and 《孙子兵法》, grounded in theory of mind, knowing conflict escalates and so not pursuing extremes; in the present order 'we really do need to win'. The folder records this against Ren's own self-critique of 外儒内法.

quote: 在这个过程中，我们确实需要赢

reading.en: The account keeps the relational method and registers the direction as divergence: reading a situation relationally, pointed at one standpoint's advantage. Capture through the rule is proved, with 韩非's 二柄 beside it, which in another form is the folder's split of Legalism as evidence for mechanism and as a programme. Two seekers of 'above all others' cannot rest together, so refusing extremes has a law's form. 'Need to win' is not said: rise needs fall, and no order is read from that. [AI reading]

says.en: AI classification: 兵家 and 法家 have the highest share of divergence, 8 of 13: 势 is configuration and 参 a joint use of channels, the method relational, the direction contending.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: one victory cuts and does not stop the loop; 犹有晋在 is 两个以“高于其余一切”为目标的寻求者, unable to rest together. Its frame is power's, recorded as divergence.
Row, capture through a rule: 韩非 二柄; 管子 据有余而制不足; 商君书 壹. Proved, at 02's capture through the rule.

account_adds.en: Which parts of those texts match laws, passage by passage.

source_adds.en: The judgement about the present order, that we really do need to win; the two tracks as complementary competences; and the folder's recorded tension: 外儒内法 elsewhere listed as a degeneration.

name.en: The kernel's own degenerations

source.locator: Counterexamples, 'The Chinese kernel has its own degenerations'; own words 11-12

sense.en: Ren raises against himself: 外儒内法, extreme pragmatism, the weight of face and position, and that Confucian logic historically became the value system of whoever held power, especially in prosperous periods. He does not resolve this and holds high points and degenerate modes as coexisting.

quote: the tradition supplies the vocabulary and the failure modes together

reading.en: The account names no degenerations of a kernel, and nothing on Confucian logic becoming power's value. A proposal only: 06 holds that same-word counterexamples must enter an explanation (韩非以德为庆赏，不能删成“没谈真正的道”). 07 reads the imperial examination as designed against hereditary capture and later a proxy trap of its own, resting on the capture laws: D68, the meta-attractor line's example, so by descent. A tradition turning so would have that form only if its reading comes from its carriers' share. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole: that Confucian logic became the value system of whoever held power, 外儒内法 and face as this kernel's failure modes, and holding high points and degenerate modes as coexisting. It stands in this folder and `human-solutions-museum`.

searched: degenerat and 退化 (hits are the glossary's sense, ending on every branch)

source.locator: Claims 30, 58; own words 16, 73

Marked contested; the folder proposes one standard for all polities and notes the official sequence is Ren's reading.

quote: 我认可这个叙事本身，不论隐藏动机，它是我们现在需要的一条出路

reading.en: The account judges no polity's narrative and names no state. The folder's own ruling, that theory texts argue about the dynamic and not about a pair of states, is what the account does. Nearest to accepting a narrative whatever its sponsor: an objection is answered on what it says, no cultural origin validates or disqualifies a method, and a description of participation confers no authority. A quotation in 06 is evidence of a word's sense, no ground of a claim. [AI reading]

name.en: Shaping a people's expectations as most legitimate

source.locator: Claim 59; own words 74; state's narratives

sense.en: Shaping a society's expectations, language and political expression, which the West calls propaganda, carries values leading a people as a whole and has the most legitimacy and historical height. Recorded by the folder as a value stance in tension with claim 30, not a result, with legitimacy proposed to come from contestability instead.

quote: 这类东西才最具有正当性（legitimacy）和历史高度。

reading.en: The account's pieces run against the claim and with the folder's answer: later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it, endorsement does not erase a loss, readers drawn from what a rule selects lock it, and no criterion of legitimate change is supplied. Its conditional direction, under the condition (scope), C (order) and further premises, all unasserted, no warrant from outside sought, asks for effective chances to challenge and revise. It speaks of formation generally and judges no polity. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it.
Conditional (the condition, C read as widening, J1 to J4, correspondence E): legitimate participation, with effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise.

Theorem (counts). The rule after shaping read as the pool of its readers' readings: it reads the share monotonically exactly where lo ≤ hi, and against it where hi ≤ lo. The premise of the loop is moved to who reads, not removed.

Conditional (the condition for scope; C and the practical commitments for order; an argument): ends, evaluations and the rules selecting future intelligence enter the same appraisal; endorsement does not erase a loss.

targets.part: Conditional: ends and evaluations enter the appraisal

says.en: Reading [AI reading, new]: no criterion of legitimate, desired or autonomous change is supplied here. A revision deciding a listed cell against its strict weighted preference counts as a loss, wanted or not.

targets.part: the reading: no criterion of legitimate change

account_adds.en: Mechanism for why shaped endorsement certifies little.

name.en: The struggle comes with scale, not with a people

source.locator: Claim 62; What is generic, and what is his

sense.en: The struggle is neither the West's nature nor humanity's; the possibility arises once very large societies with many dynamic processes exist. Offered by the monologue as its own correction of its East-West framing; the folder follows it and argues about the dynamic.

quote: 这种斗争并不是西方的本色，更不是人类的本色。

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text joins them. The laws of race and position hold of any drawers with no culture in them, which is the form of the correction: among two or more, a best response for position keeps nothing, not shown of actual races. 06 finds a contending direction inside Chinese lines too, so it goes by no people. The tie to a society's size is not stated: number enters, size as such does not. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem. Among two drawers or more a best response for position keeps nothing. With one drawer every profile is perfect. It does not show that actual races are so played, or that drawing everything is wrong.
AI classification: 兵家 and 法家 have the highest share of divergence, 8 of 13; the method is relational, the direction contending.

account_adds.en: That with one drawer the race law has no force: number enters, size as such does not.

source_adds.en: Scale as the historical cause, which is the correction itself.

name.en: Characters record inter-tribal convergence

source.locator: Claim 48; 2026-10-02 passage

sense.en: Chinese characters record inter-tribal communication through symbols that converged on agreed denotations, evolving as memes; 止戈为武 is an example. Marked conjecture; the folder itself says the etymology is contested, and that the example should not be offered as evidence. Conjecture 2 of the SSBX README is related.

quote: The conjecture stays tiered as conjecture, and the etymology should not be offered as evidence for it.

reading.en: The folder's caution is the account's reading: 武's graph-history and the 左传 line are two layers, and the graph encodes no relational ontology. What holds is narrower: a code forms between formations by hearings, under conditions, proved of any type, with 约定俗成 and 书同文 listed beside it; a resolution written back into records later cohorts read rests from the next cohort on. The history of negotiating tribes is neither taken up nor denied. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D54]: 止 is a foot, 武 holding a halberd and walking; 止戈为武 is 楚庄王's value interpretation. The theory does not say 武 originally means stopping halberds.
Reading [AI reading, D54]: most characters are phonetic compounds; the graph itself encodes no relational ontology.

Theorem (any type). Where two forms differ, an order brings every start to agreement exactly where it gives all formations one origin. Table: a resolution written back into the records that later cohorts read rests from the next cohort on.
Row, a code formed between formations (约定俗成): 荀子 同则同之, 名无固宜; 止戈之说的写回; 书同文. Proved, at 05.

account_adds.en: Four kinds of correspondence for characters, and acceptance levels.

source_adds.en: The history of negotiating tribes, characters as its record, and characters evolving as memes. Conjecture 2 of the SSBX README is related.

name.en: Cultural observations: power, engineering

source.locator: Claims 60-61; own words 10, 75; critiques

sense.en: Observations: relational thinking does not habitually meet power with fear, hostility and confrontation; Chinese engineering skill and pragmatic method come from relational thinking. The folder marks the last as unsourced with rival explanations, and in tension with listing pragmatism among the kernel's degenerations.

quote: 这也是为什么中国人很擅长工程这样的问题

reading.en: Claims about cultures, untaken and out of the account's form, which argues about dynamics. 06 says the relational start is no property of every system, and 08 that no cultural origin validates a method. On power the account has a structural neighbour only: checks that carry acts back into what selects the rule. It says nothing of attitude. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole; kept as Ren's observations in the folder.

name.en: Thinking past oneself extends the horizon

source.locator: Own words 2-3; genealogy, 2026-03-14 'the observation that starts it'

sense.en: The observation that starts the folder: think about what comes after our children, the future world, the next generation, as if we are a part of the world, not just ourselves; thinking beyond yourself extends the horizon you can see at all. Ren's own, spoken of as a cultural difference.

quote: as if we are a part of the world, not just ourselves

reading.en: Reach past one's own end has exact forms. Read with time, and where lines share no condition, self-concern without the step of invariance reaches only one's own line of descent. Under an organism's class nothing of the self follows its end; under a coarser one the line goes on through new members; which class a center's line runs under is open. The members a condition one affects later feeds are reached with no step; whether an actual commons is so is empirical. [AI reading]

says.en: Step 2: read with time and where lines share no condition, self-concern without the step reaches only one's own line of descent. Under P1 to P4 it reaches everything downstream of what one conditions, a law given the premises; P2 and P4 are the crux.

Reading [AI reading, new]: under an organism's class nothing of the self follows its end, under a coarser one the line can go on through new members; which class a center's own line runs under is what the represented dynamics leave open.

Reaches the members a condition one affects later feeds, with no step of invariance; which class a center's line runs under is open, and the one is not chosen; whether an actual commons is so is empirical.

account_adds.en: Which later members are reached, under which class, and that seeing further does not by itself change what is valued (seeing is not valuing).

source_adds.en: 'As if we are a part of the world' as a stance one can take up, and the contrast of cultures that first carried it (own words 1), which the account does not make.

name.en: The narrative-value frame as the selected unit

source.locator: The unit: the narrative-value frame; claims 18-24

sense.en: Every actor interprets and justifies through a constructed ranking of values and licensed strategies. The environment writes it, so it is contingent; it needs a collective of carriers, mutates in transmission and is under selection. It works at individual, collective and dominant levels, the last manufacturing the next generation's frames through six channels.

quote: The ordering is not chosen. It is written into the actor by the environment that made it

reading.en: No one transmissible bundle, but a ranking formed within the unfolding is stated: its acts show it only so far, acted on it selects, read from the share it can lock. 'A frame with no carriers does nothing' has a form in one family of models: taught by members, no holder stays no holder and the quota is read by nothing. 03 keeps informing and revaluing as two moves, which the frame bundles. 'Narrative' stands live once, in a free-energy quotation listed as failing when read as a guarantee. [AI reading]

says.en: On the thesis of one relational unfolding, argued and not proved, positions, regions and standards form within the unfolding; none outside it owns value. Whether a standard so formed gains influence, recognizes its target, has warrant or is followed are four questions; it can be wrong.

Theorem (World; activity read as carrying): under the passing premise, a pattern outlasting carriers brief for d is passed across one of every d steps, and where no carrier passes it from T on, nothing carries it from T + d on.
Theorem: hearing makes no form; a hearer takes a form in use, by a given rule of adoption. Coining is another mechanism. Not shown: that actual conventions form by hearing in this way.

Theorem (natural weights; one decision; none claimed new). Reading: informing and revaluing are two ways one part of a loop can move what another part's reading answers: the first changes what the reading formation tells apart, the second what it values.

Ranking, order: no law of the dynamics gives one. A ranking a formation holds formed within the unfolding: its acts show it only as far as 03 §11 says, acted on it selects, so what forms next can depend on it, and read from the share it raises it can lock.

Theorem (root; a family of models, one minimal model of a rule of entry): taught by members or not at all, no holder stays no holder, and two such states differing only in quota have the same later levels and members, so the quota is then read by nothing. Holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation into one count.
No law says that a standard which formed is a significance. Whether standards that actually form are narrower than the condition is empirical.

account_adds.en: Keeps influence, recognition, warrant and following apart, says a formed standard can be wrong, separates copying from coining, which the source's 'mutation' runs together, and telling apart from valuing, which its frame bundles.

source_adds.en: The frame as one transmissible, rankable unit; its contingency as a claim about value orderings; its three levels, three stages of collective formation, six channels, list of failure modes and nine naturalised beliefs.

name.en: Frames are selected for spread, not truth

source.locator: The unit; claims 25-28; called 'the single most load-bearing claim'

sense.en: Traits that win are traits of spread: speed, identity, coordination, legitimising power, hostility. Dominance does not imply benefit, and good narratives are usually less fit than those that do not match reality. This disconnects the winning frame from the true one.

quote: The selection traits `NVF.md` lists are traits of *spread*, not of truth

reading.en: Forms: a selection separates only what couples into its selector, and one selects exactly what matters exactly where that is read off its map. Selection on offspring number raises the mean exactly where numbers vary, but only under exact transmission, where the source's frames mutate, and near-tautologically, spread read as spread. Among hearings copying a form in use, what breaks the symmetry settles which wins. None reads whether a form is true. That what is selected is usually false or less fit is stronger, empirical, unstated. No live text says selection favours spread over truth; the join is proposed here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry.

Theorem (any type; for the selection, the alternatives' equality decided): what matters goes alike across what a map lumps exactly where it is read off the map, and a selection through the map selecting exactly what matters exists exactly there. It does not say which map a selector uses.

Theorem (any type): over cohorts read by offspring number, with exact transmission, the mean offspring number rises across a step exactly where offspring numbers vary: Fisher's theorem in counts, exact case.

Theorem: the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use; from a symmetric start a law keeping the symmetry never brings agreement; a preferred form or an order of hearing breaks it. How long agreement takes is not stated.

targets.part: §4 row, Information true to the world

says.en: §4 row, Information true to the world: selections through a selector's couplings, together, separate exactly what it couples apart.

account_adds.en: An exact statement of what a selection cannot reach, for any selector and with no premise; of where a selection can be right; and of what settles which form wins.

source_adds.en: The claim itself, the one the folder calls most load-bearing: winning frames are disconnected from true ones, and truthful narratives are usually less fit. Also the list of spread traits and mutation in transmission. None is stated.

name.en: Selfishness as a ledger that omits what it spends

source.locator: What selfishness is, first facet; claims 10, 17

sense.en: A frame is selfish when its ledger counts only self-centred measures, so a broken law, degraded norm, drawn-down trust or poisoned river is justifiable whenever the actor's gain exceeds the actor's cost. It is a measurement problem, not greed or malice.

quote: It is a *measurement* problem — a ledger whose columns exclude most of what is being spent.

reading.en: A ledger omitting columns has the form of a center's represented region: covering what it requires it keeps its own support and can still undermine another; omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose it. And of an optimum: with room, every optimum of an order rising with a family sits at the least level beyond, even an order counting the beyond second. 'Selfish' appears only in one record's provenance. No law says a drain is a harm: a drain can end a formation whether or not anyone counts that ending, and calling it a harm is a ranking naming its scope and order, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): over a region covering what a formation requires, requirements not tightening, it keeps its own support and can still undermine another; omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support. How a center represents the region is unmodelled.

Theorem: with room every optimum of an order rising with a family lies at the least level beyond among eligible outcomes; a lexicographic order counting the beyond after what couples in drains all the same.
Theorem (World: balance): formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more. Near-definitional arithmetic restating the commons, not who ought to take less.

Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided): where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside the region, and is mixed exactly when it goes beyond for one. Mixed is not ordered; that widening is better rests on C or another named order.

targets.part: Reading D65, on what is external

says.en: Reading: 'External' is relative to an accounting's scope; those affected remain in the one unfolding.

account_adds.en: The drain does not need self-centred measures: any rising order does it, however benevolent its family. And the ledger's other half: omitting what one requires can end oneself.

source_adds.en: Selfishness as a measurement problem and not greed or malice, the word as the system's name; the actor's cost-against-gain calculation; norms, trust and law as items spent.

name.en: Hypocrisy: sincere people running a self-serving justification

source.locator: What selfishness is, second facet; claim 11

sense.en: An actor may not believe the calculated ideology, behave as if it does, and justify itself by other beliefs, still believing it is good. No cynics are needed: sincere justification gives the same outcome and is harder to argue with. The folder calls this the facet later drafts lose.

quote: You do not need cynics. Sincere people running a self-serving justification produce the identical outcome

reading.en: The laws are indifferent to sincerity, so they permit this without stating it. Neighbours, none this mechanism: complying when read and acting by one's own law when not is best under a stated inequality, read as an incentive, which is the strategic case, the reverse in form of the sincere; and acts underdetermine the order they show. 03 lists a recipient's false belief and an intention to cause one as open, so this is unmodelled, not ruled out. 07 keeps informed harm as the hard rival, where the source dissolves the cynic. [AI reading]
