name.en: Authority must be able to say why, truthfully

source.locator: Agency is a trait; Claims 195-196, 199, 249, 308

sense.en: 'Why can Alice do this?' must trace through held item, membership, delegation and gate as one graph of cause. Refusals that cannot be explained replace an arbitrary leader with an arbitrary machine. An explanation that fabricates a conjunction the runtime never computes would lie; and a mechanism built but unwired was marked closed.

quote: authority you can `explain()` beats authority you *assert*

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text says this of authority over a member. A like form appears for claims to knowledge, assessed and not proved: authority needs inspectable grounds. Premise-tracked derivation gives the form of 'why' but withholds authority by its own statement. The source's domain, a refusal towards a member, is another; nearest is a conditional direction, on both readings, asking effective opportunities to understand and challenge, and no criterion of legitimate change is supplied. A fabricated explanation has the form of a report taken for the condition. [AI reading]

says.en: Assessment, of empirical authority and not of governance: 'Claimed empirical authority needs inspectable grounds for its distinctions; claimed continuing correction needs operative routes from relevant defeats to changed conclusions or methods.'

A claim derived from a basis under local premises holds wherever they hold; a local premise supports a conditional derivation, 'not its own discharge'; 'Soundness supplies neither the truth of the basis nor any authority.'

Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1–J4, correspondence E; neither reading asserted): 'legitimate participation, with effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise'.
Of its own laws: 'no criterion of legitimate, desired or autonomous change is supplied here'.
'Tell a change in the actual condition from a change in its report, label or proxy.'

account_adds.en: Insulation's exact form: strong grounds against a claimed authority where a practice insulates a favoured verdict from evidence, that form alone not deciding standing.

source_adds.en: Explainability owed to those governed, as a condition of legitimacy, and a single answerable query with a truthful trace.

name.en: Standing is re-read at each decision; a cached allow is never authority

source.locator: Agency is a trait; The refusals; Claims 27, 34, 69, 194, 205, 265, 276, 287

sense.en: Move the equipped key out of its slot and standing disappears by semantic change, with nothing to sync. Revocation is load-bearing and lazy: dependents fail resolution, re-grant reactivates, and a revoked method's next operation fails. Every invocation re-evaluates current evidence; a projection accelerates live truth and never replaces it; a capability is a handle, not a permanent grant. Stated as an absolute law of the design.

quote: a cached `allow` is never Authority

reading.en: The account holds this form as a World premise a world may have or lack: a relatum is active only where the levels meet what it then requires, read at each step. A reserve is what defers it: the zero reserve is exactly activity needing support. A cached allow has a reserve's form; lazy revocation, a chain running down link by link; re-grant, admission by level. An old envelope and a current-generation commit state it on their models; an old view is a neighbour. It binds no system by itself. [AI reading]

says.en: A premise of the World, not a theorem about systems. Activity needing support: 'a relatum is active only where the levels meet what it then requires'.
Theorem (World): 'the zero reserve is exactly activity needing support'; along a chain of embodied links 'coextinction runs down the chain link by link'.
Theorem (periphery; route, operations and permissions supplied): 'an old view with the destination cannot rebuild the updated view without a fresh reading'.
Theorem (pure core; computed cases are witnesses): 'the old envelope reused after the merger accepts the two merged supporters, a recomputed one rejects them'. Formulas and bounds are supplied.

Record (periphery), law 3: 'A commit is admitted only at the current generation, with every write permitted by the current rights, change allowed and its write units drawn from the reserve within the deadline'.

account_adds.en: Readiness as an exact condition on the induced envelope; a roster failing wholly on a cause in no bound; and 'the access relations that can still form limit what a current abstraction may forget' (what a summary keeps).

source_adds.en: The rule as binding on a runtime, its cost argument (a cached rate-limit or expired mute is an exploit), lazy revocation with a clean audit, the review's alternative of derived tokens auto-revoking, and handle kept apart from grant.

name.en: Split authority and peer-issued reputation

source.locator: Why possession rather than permission; Claims 29, 52

sense.en: One privilege becomes several tokens held by different people, and an m-of-n rule requires them to act together: checks and balances as token arithmetic. Reputation is peer-issued rather than platform-computed, and rules that gate entry on the web of endorsements are also the sybil-resistance mechanism.

quote: with an m-of-n rule requiring them to act together

reading.en: Proposed here; the law is of reviewers, and no live text says it of a split privilege or of endorsements. Read so, it says where such counting holds. Counting holders is sound only where they fail by independent causes: reviewers count by causes, not names; a copied witness changes nothing. m-of-n among holders under one cause, or endorsements copying one another, buy less than the arithmetic shows. The merely agreeing case is not shown. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (pure core; fault formulas and bounds supplied, computed cases witnesses): 'Reviewers count by independent causes, not names.' 'three reviewers with distinct single causes are ready, and moving two of them under one cause makes readiness fail while all three names are kept'.
Inspection of the longer roster 'gives the same certificate at every pool of faults'; 'That a witness merely agreeing with another, without copying it, adds nothing is not shown'.

account_adds.en: An envelope over causal formulas and its readiness condition.

source_adds.en: Designs for peer endorsement and gating on it. That endorsement resists sybils is not shown in the account or in the folder.

name.en: One commit spine: an audit that cannot disagree with state

source.locator: One place where change happens; Claims 200-204, 250-251

sense.en: Every durable change lands atomically through one coordinator, the Occasion, binding changed roots to the commit; a write outside it fails closed; history, recovery and authority frontiers read one source. So audit cannot disagree with state. The folder also records a regression: an ungated read path leaked hidden rows and keys.

quote: events are best-effort prunable audit, co-written same-tx so the audit cannot disagree

reading.en: Close structure, with a scope the source's sentence lacks. On the mediated machine, committed bounded programs keep coverage along every history, but only given no write path outside the interface, which is supplied; an outside writer leaves records and journal identical. 'Cannot disagree' then holds under complete mediation, and no audit shows that. Where every change is gated, a change splits at the gated step: the form of 'a write outside fails'. 'Occasion' in 03 is another sense. [AI reading]

says.en: 'finite histories of lawful reads and committed bounded overwrite programs, each taking its change scope from the fields it writes, keep actual coverage'; 'an extra write path can leave the public view identical, so logs cannot establish mediation'. Complete mediation is supplied, not shown.
Theorem (any process): 'a course that changes it splits into a prefix keeping it, a gated step that itself changes it, and the rest'.

account_adds.en: 'every acceptance reading only the public view that accepts the inspected machine accepts the changed one' (`record_only_acceptance_cannot_exclude_the_extra_writer`).

source_adds.en: The guarantee for an actual runtime: every durable change through one coordinator, so that audit cannot disagree with state. Row as truth and event as prunable shadow; erasure and pruning from one source; failing closed as a runtime check.

name.en: Badly calibrated rewards get gamed

source.locator: Claim 44; What was lost, item 12

sense.en: The triad is structurally RPG state logic (character, inventory, zone), which licenses importing game design into institutions, including its warning that rewards too easy or too hard get gamed. The source notes that the warning has no successor in the 2026 anti-pattern list.

quote: badly calibrated rewards get gamed

reading.en: The account places the fault elsewhere: a proxy on some attributes is a selection through the coupling to them, reaching exactly what couples in, its force lying in a supplied premise. What it states is what a reward fails to read, not how it is calibrated: given the premise, a well-calibrated proxy still leaves the unread unreached. So calibration, the source's variable, is not what this law turns on. 'Calibration' as a standing here is another sense. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise). 'It is the proxy problem (Goodhart 1975; Amodei and others 2016; Manheim and Garrabrant 2018) as the account states it'; 'What is stated is its blindness to what the proxy does not register', not Manheim and Garrabrant's regressional and causal kinds; 'its force lies in the supplied premise that an optimizer selects through just those couplings'.

account_adds.en: The optimum's drain under room and the lock of a metric read from what it selects, each with standing.

source_adds.en: Calibration as a practical variable, and the claim that game design is a transferable body of institutional knowledge.

name.en: Mental resistance as the measure of a conceptual frame

source.locator: Why the pivot was necessary; Claims 177, 240, 248; open question 43

sense.en: A frame is judged by how many independent things one must hold in mind to predict behaviour at a point, explicitly not by primitive count: three primitives with a dozen special cases are worse than five that compose. A founder's 'hard to conceptualize' is a frame-smell. The first measurement missed its target, and the reader doubts that the proxy measures load.

quote: the number of independent things you must hold in working memory to predict the system's behavior at a point

reading.en: The account has no cognitive measure of its own form. Neighbours, neither this: it compares rivals by what they forbid and by a count of patterns (08's thesis, 'a tie' on a first count), and it asks what a summary must keep to answer the questions of a course, with no count of what a head holds. It writes reading times on its fronts. The source's refusal of primitive count could be asked of that first count. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: A test of a framework by what its users must hold, with a budget enforced in CI.

name.en: No rhetorical victory before closure; every claim labelled

source.locator: The refusals; Claims 149, 243, 249, 252-253, 316

sense.en: If a document says the item acts, the first milestone must make that literally true in tests. Renaming is not the win. Every claim is labelled current fact, current violation, accepted destination, experiment hypothesis or rejected path. Code rises to the docs, and a violated law is kept, its cost named, not edited to match.

quote: rhetorical victory before engineering closure

reading.en: Shared discipline: standings kept apart, a proof claim checked, relabelling shown to fail on one protocol, and an identity not made true by declaring it. 'Do not edit the law' uses another sense of law: the source's is a norm a codebase must rise to, the account's a statement read off what it holds of, where a disproved property 'may show' a false law. The nearest match to that ruling is a frozen scoring rule. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Every result statement in the chapters opens with one bold label, and a proved result names its base.'
'declaring an identity does not make it true'.

Conditional (practical commitments, with correspondence, authority and responsiveness, explicit in the protocol): 'relabelling without rewriting the encoding fails (`CommonTaskRevision.declaration_only_fails`)'.

account_adds.en: Machine-checked proof and axiom reports; 'a frozen rule fixes the scoring, not that it measures what the thesis names.'

source_adds.en: That a document's words must become literally true in tests at the first milestone; the five-way label for engineering claims, a CI concept budget, and adversarial reviews with measured fidelity.

name.en: Agency composed, not universal: addressable is not active

source.locator: Agency is a trait; Claims 187-192

sense.en: The main correction to a naive actor model: addressability is universal, agency a composed stack of owned facts (a signing principal, ports, gates, certificates). Holding authority is separated from initiating action. Universal agency is rejected on cognitive grounds. An item may itself act; this is not delegated to a helper.

quote: Every Yi should be addressable. Not every Yi should be active.

reading.en: Shared: agency is not presupposed of what exists. On the World this is closer than method: relata take and give across each step and each is active or not, only active relata give, and one relatum can stand as a condition while not active. So standing and acting come apart on the model, a premise there. The reasons differ: the source reduces what must be reasoned about. The account has no decomposition into traits. [AI reading]

says.en: 'relata take from and give to one another's levels across each step, and each is active or not'; 'Only active relata give'.
Theorem (World): 'can stand as a condition at some level', 'and can be active as a formation'.

'Activity includes change and interaction without presupposing an agent, an intention or a purpose.' 'Relatively enduring organizations form within it, and some come to sense, remember, act and evaluate.'
'A formation that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises is one law within the unfolding, not a subject facing a world'.

account_adds.en: The reading loop's laws, and that a part's choice is 'not a second kind of cause beside the unfolding' [AI reading, D23, D32].

source_adds.en: Orthogonal traits (messageable, agent, capability, container), four or five control axes kept apart, and an acceptance test for an item acting itself.

name.en: 間 and actor as one body with two faces, irreducible in philosophy

source.locator: The actor turn, and 間; Claims 95-101, 302; open question 39

sense.en: A session is a set of actors and a place where things happen. 間 is actor, like wave and particle; neither is a special case of the other. There is a cosmic 間 and parallel universes at once. It is first a philosophical system, irreducible in philosophy, reducible in engineering, one symbol enough. The folder's reader counts this as one of three ontologies left unreconciled, and the frame calls the substrate a realization of 间理.

quote: 间即是actor，它们更多像波粒二象性，一体两面

reading.en: The source asserts an identity and an irreducibility. The account argues one unfolding as a thesis, nonduality a method and no proof, and its cases are role pairs. 'A world is a run' gives plural runs of one law, near 'many worlds', not the same claim. 'No cosmic subject' does not answer 'cosmic 間', which is no subject. The root's symbol is 际, a relation, not 間, a place, and 理 there is a lumping, not 间理's law: shared signs. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Nonduality is a requirement of method; it proves neither the ontology nor an ethical necessity.' 'A shared process implies no cosmic subject, no aggregate interest and no administrator'.
'that the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved.' Its neighbours include process philosophy and dependent arising.

targets.part: the sentence after the four results: argued, not proved

says.en: Theorem (World): 'A world is a run of the process admitting every step'. Reading [AI reading, D43]: 'a run is one model of the grammar'.

account_adds.en: Two live arguments that would defeat the thesis, and its nearest case, equality on the carrier.

source_adds.en: Place as a pole of its own: the where of happening, beside the actor. The account states no such pole: a region is a closure, time the reach of conditions. The theory of 間 is its own folder.

name.en: Change as one Yi touching another (Whitehead)

source.locator: Claim 304; What was lost, item 14; open question 41

sense.en: The glossary's verb for mutation, credited to Whitehead: every event is a touching of one Yi by another. The live vocabulary replaced it with manifest; the folder's reader calls the process thread orphaned, reality as occasions and not enduring substances, the biggest unexploited asset. Ren left the import undecided.

quote: Every event is a 'touching' of one Yi by another.

reading.en: Not stated. As a proposal only, a neighbour note: the World's premise of balance has every change of a level taken and given among relata, and a world's moves are exchanges. But balance is an accounting premise of a model, and the source's claim is metaphysical: one bearer's contact as the single write verb. 'Touches' in 01 is a word on a step index. The process thesis stands nearer the root's occurrences; the source's stipulated bearer pulls away. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Mutation as one bearer's contact with another as the single write verb; a route to develop process philosophy, which 08 lists among its thesis's neighbours, and one record names Whitehead for enduring objects.

name.en: Anyone may define new kinds: what makes a world a world

source.locator: The social layer, last paragraph; Claims 180-183

sense.en: A user, agent or community must be able to define kinds, locally and unpublished, and others' agents must be able to discover them. A world is defined by the openness of its ontology, not its feature set. The folder's reader notes that no amendment procedure goes with it.

quote: this is the key that makes worlds 'worlds'

reading.en: A checked form of why: hearing makes no form, so what can become shared is only what is in use; a new form takes coining. Openness of a course is what it admits, and the possible relative to what is held grows only where what is held changes. A code's form is far less than a Kind. 'Openness is better' is C's, unasserted. No law says worlds need this. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Hearing makes no form'; 'the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use'. 'Coining is another mechanism.'
A form coined at one sense, 'heard by all, makes every formation tell them apart again'. Stated where all hold a code merging two senses.

Theorem (root; any process, and witnesses): 'what is possible under it from a configuration it reaches is possible from the first'. Reading [AI reading, D45]: 'the possible relative to what is held grows only where what is held changes'.

account_adds.en: That along a course of a stated process the whole possible never grows, so 'openness' needs saying relative to what is held.

source_adds.en: The constitutive claim that open kinds make a world; ontology-making as a right of each participant; discoverability of meaning by others' agents; local kinds without publication.

name.en: Qualitative status and fungible quantity in one token vocabulary

source.locator: Claims 22-23, 55, 226; What was lost, item 6

sense.en: Tokens cover credentials, permissions, obligations and statuses and also divisible quantities, so economic and social capital blur and a community can blend them, say a currency that carries voting weight. By 2026 the source itself splits conserved assets (Custody) from issued authority, and the currency vanishes unrecorded.

quote: divisible fungible quantities (currency, credits, resource shares)

reading.en: The account refuses the blur by method: conditions are not silently amounts, and amounts are a second sort its relations do not give, which is conceded. The source's later split of conserved custody from issued authority moves nearer this, without saying why. On what blending would do, a currency with voting weight has the form of influence eroding correction in the market model: there the floor is kept only where the margin allows. One periphery model. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditions 'are not necessarily quantities that can be stored or exchanged, and no condition is silently taken as owned, transferable, additive, scarce or commensurable; the World's natural-number amounts are a modelling choice'.

Thesis, argued: 'The World's amounts are not: no reading of its selected relations gives the count (`World.standing_not_read`), and balance is represented, not derived'; 'Until that sort is derived from relations, this is conceded there.'

Theorem (periphery: the market model, `propext`, `Quot.sound` and `Classical.choice` reported): with correction strength `α`, 'erosion by influence `β`', influence bound `λ` and floor `θ`, 'let `M = α(1 − θ) − βλθ`'; the floor's keeping turns on `M`.
Assessment (selected histories, no theorem): inherited code, work, coordination and interim support carried activity 'as specific conditions, not interchangeable amounts'.

account_adds.en: Markets modelled separately with their own laws; conserved stocks stay rivalrous, positional goods zero-sum.

source_adds.en: Fungibility and transferability as per-type design decisions, soulbound status so that meaning survives, and deliberate blending of economic and political weight as an option offered.

name.en: What must stay private or evaporate: repair, absence, presence

source.locator: The social layer; The counterexamples; Claims 57, 71, 107-108, 312; open question 33

sense.en: Absence is information, not deviance. Repair runs privately, for visibility of conflict is a harm vector. A spirit's space is not a public profile. Presence is TTL-bounded, outside durable truth, and privacy depends on it. The folder's reader notes this quietly refutes the 2025 transparency assumption. A claim that some reading of a group damages it.

quote: without turning conflict into a leaderboard

reading.en: Proposed here: the account has part of the form and none of the value. A reading is not idle: where the response moves every value, no published prediction is right. A ranked board has position's form, where rises total falls. A copied first act adds agreement, not reach. A finite present forgets, with no 'should'. None concerns repair or privacy, and no law says being read is a harm: that stays the source's. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; near-definitional): 'Where the response moves every value, no published prediction is right'.
Theorem (any type for the counting): 'Across every change of amounts the positions' rises total their falls'.

Theorem (any type; near-definitional): 'Copying the first act is the case from the second member: the pool's acts are alike across worlds alike through the first member's coupling'. Reading [AI reading, D45]: 'members reading one channel add agreement, not reach'.
Theorem (any type), of a determined law on a finite list: 'a present a list holds forgets'. Not a rule that a fact should lapse.
'No law evaluates; should and better are readings people and AI form.'

account_adds.en: Where a published reading fails exactly, and that readers reading readers reach no further than the first member's coupling.

source_adds.en: That reading can damage what is read, socially; that some social facts should not last; repair held private; the transparency-privacy conflict. A tension to keep: 07's table counts hidden undertakings among what changes the judgment of an end.

name.en: The honest negative space: not every norm should become code

source.locator: What the whole thing is for; Claims 9, 32, 300-301; open question 28

sense.en: The substrate gives no truth about external events, no legal recognition, no global consensus, no substitute for judgment. Untokenisable norms ('spirit must be polite') stay outside. The architecture is worth its cost only when several hard requirements overlap. The source concedes the boundary and does not theorize what carries such norms.

quote: Not every social norm should become code.

reading.en: Form only: 'a formal system states what it does not reach' is the account's habit too: correspondence is empirical, significance stays free, and 53 classical judgments are listed as inexpressible, five of them on social mechanisms. A list of what a formalism cannot say is no claim that a norm should stay uncoded. That normative half is not stated. Each account's list is its own. [AI reading]

says.en: Not shown: 'That any actual collective, market, pool, entry rule or optimizer meets the hypotheses of a law'; 'the correspondence is empirical.'
A law with content 'can become a science's law for a domain only once the domain is shown to meet its hypotheses'; 'The account states no science's law of its own yet.'
「表达不了者五十三，各有其由」: including 社会之机制与特定之种（5）.

targets.part: 四, 表达不了者五十三

account_adds.en: A statement of why each is out of reach, sorted by kind of reason.

source_adds.en: That formalizing a norm can itself be wrong, and a cost test for adopting such an architecture.

name.en: One consent door, with the founder inside the rules

source.locator: The social layer; Claims 133, 136; open questions 36-37

sense.en: Everything entering a community (apps, bots, kits) passes one approval, moderator by default, and a record exists whatever the answer. Bundles may propose bots, never install them. The founder is inside the rules. Called the political core. The folder's reader notes it is per-install, not per-use, and may not cover gate edits.

quote: the consent record always exists, *even for the founder's own agent*

reading.en: The gate's form is checked: where ungated moves keep a property, a change passes a gate, and in one protocol both entry to the roster and change of rule need a recorded review or proposal and a passing ballot. But there the seed mandate and recognition are supplied, so the founder stands outside the protocol, the reverse of the source's core, and the highest authority's origin does not follow. Consent's warrant is not read. [AI reading]

says.en: Where ungated steps reflect a property: 'a course ending where `p` holds started where it held, or splits at a gated step after which `p` holds'. 'A gate locates where change can enter a line'.

Record, law 3, conditional within one declared protocol: 'Entry to the roster needs a recorded review of the entrant and a ballot passing governance.' 'A step that changes the rule is an adoption with a recorded proposal and a ballot passing the rule of governance'. Conditions: 'Seed mandate, recognition/copying capacity, proposal content, participation and procedural compliance are supplied'.
Conditional (the condition for scope; C and the practical commitments for order; an argument, neither reading asserted): 'endorsement does not erase a loss'.

targets.part: Conditional: ends and evaluations enter the appraisal

account_adds.en: That a gate's law holds for any process and grants nothing (a gate on moves is not an authorization: it locates change), and that with two participants a technical decision can pass where revision of governance fails.

source_adds.en: A procedure of admission binding the founder; a record kept regardless of outcome; consent as the political core. By the source's own S6 a founder's control then flows from ownership, a tension the folder leaves standing.

name.en: Generators: conditional producers of spirits and holdings

source.locator: The actor turn; Claim 87; What was lost, item 2

sense.en: In the 2026-04 actor ontology a primitive produces spirits or holdings when coded conditions are met, defines what it creates, and can trade. No successor in Yi: kits install and ports fire, but nothing generates. Stated in passing as a direction.

quote: they can generate spirits, or holdings

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text speaks of a producer. The word is a false friend: the account's generation never means arising or new organization. The mechanism stands under other names. On the World a new relatum arises through another's giving, only active relata give, and activity needs support: the form of a conditional producer, on premises. Descent bounds 'defines what it creates': it can vary a need and drop a dependence, never add one nothing taking part held. No kind of entity is singled out for this. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): the record's id, `generation-is-replenishment`, 'keeps the older word'; 'an embodied relatum is given at least the standing it arises with'.
Theorem (World): 'an embodied relatum is a condition, and it arises through another's giving'.
'transmission lets descent vary a need and drop a dependence, never add one that nothing taking part held'.
'"Generation" never means arising, nor any new organization'.

account_adds.en: Balance around arising, and that its arising replenishes every family containing it.

source_adds.en: A programmable producer as a kind of entity, authored output, and trade among producers.

name.en: Meaning declared in the open, never read from a representation's accident

source.locator: Why the pivot was necessary; Claims 151, 178, 236, 244

sense.en: The pre-pivot failure: what a holding was got inferred from which optional field happened to be set at construction. So meaning must be declared and the runtime never guesses it from names, fields or layout; a name that says otherwise is a lie to be fixed in code. The source calls this the one law to keep if only one survives.

quote: meaning should be in `kinds[]`, not in optional field presence

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text says this of a design. The account's habit has a like form for premises and names: what a conclusion depends on is stated where it depends on it, a name is adopted only where the statement means exactly that, and one stating a wrong meaning is renamed. That concerns a theory's assumptions, not a running system's data, and its check is weaker than a compiler. They part on where meaning comes from: an author's declaration there, a relation a law or test can read here. [AI reading]

says.en: 'the real assumptions lie in the modelling (discrete steps, one index, natural-number amounts, propositions as activity, identity by naming), each stated where a law depends on it.' 'Open: that every premise is named, which the completion checks support and cannot certify'.
'A name is adopted only where the statement means exactly that'; 'A renaming after landing needs a name that states a wrong meaning.'
Thesis, argued: 'state the relation that carries what is cited, between which occurrences, where a law or a test can read it'.

targets.part: 'state the relation that carries what is cited'

says.en: 'A separate type, a local resource account or a separate question asserts no fundamental separation, and a shared notation establishes no constitutive connection.'

account_adds.en: Labels carrying nothing on the World: a renaming preserves the five readings checked.

source_adds.en: The rule as enforceable law of a runtime: a compile step closing declarations into a plan, and a measured cost of breaking it. The account applies no such test to its own names beyond its checks.

name.en: A Kind as immutable semantic law, stored outside what bears it

source.locator: Claims 165-167, 171, 239; What was lost, item 15

sense.en: A Kind revision is immutable semantic law: genesis, schema, gates, ports, facets. Meaning lives in the Kinds a Yi bears, and a Kind is stored apart, never as a Yi. The founder's 'even the type of a thing is a thing' was traded for compiler closure. The source says so itself and treats Kinds as live governed law, revised by new revisions.

quote: immutable semantic law

reading.en: In the account a law is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it, and the thesis forbids an explanation needing a law outside what it holds of. An authored Kind has the other shape: meaning fixed by a law stored apart. The divergence holds if the frame is taken as ontology; as a design it may not, since models here are supplied laws too. The founder's sentence stands nearer: a class here is itself a relation. [AI reading]

says.en: 'A law of the theory is a statement that holds of every relation, carrier or model its hypotheses admit. It is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it'.
Thesis, argued: forbids an explanation needing 'a law standing outside what it holds of'; 'a law is read off the history it holds of (`shown_le_iff`)'.

targets.part: What it forbids; the second result

says.en: '"Supplied" is local: a law supplied to a model need not be external to reality.'
Definition: 'A class (类) is a reflexive, symmetric and transitive relation'.

account_adds.en: Theorem (any process): 'histories fix a law up to its dead ends, which occur only for unending sequences' (01, `same_histories_iff`).

source_adds.en: Law as a governed, versioned, installable artifact, with rollouts that select a revision and never mutate an old one.

name.en: Governance checked by the engine: quorum, thresholds, no action without criteria

source.locator: Applications; Claims 33, 49, 54

sense.en: Single-use vote tokens prevent double-voting, the engine guarantees quorum and super-majority, outcomes auto-issue the next tokens, and multi-party agreements run only when encoded criteria are met. Offered as design direction: the social generalisation of multisig. Formal voting did not reappear in the 2026 documents.

quote: no action occurs unless the encoded criteria are met

reading.en: The account checks one such protocol: votes and thresholds decide adoption, and duplicate votes do not create mandates. It also bounds what that gives: procedural compliance, the forming of proposals and the highest authority are supplied or do not follow, and a decision is not a function of counts alone. So 'guaranteed by the engine' holds within a declared protocol and no farther. [AI reading]

says.en: Record, in one declared history: 'a proposal adopted by four votes changes the rule', 'adoption with two votes fails'; 'duplicate votes, a wait of thirteen days or an objection each fail'. Does not show: 'the origin of the highest authority, actual compliance with procedure'. No clock or consensus process is simulated.

account_adds.en: 'no function of the counts of roster, presence and reviews gives the decision in two histories of the protocol'; counts of admitted decisions are not consequences of the work.

source_adds.en: The claim that such checks can run a community; issuance of outcomes as tokens; liquid and quadratic mechanisms.

name.en: The token carries the relationship, not the payload

source.locator: The loop that would not stay disjoint; Claims 17, 64, 66, 238, 297

sense.en: Relationships are not hardcoded structures: a chat token says these spirits are in a chat, the graph carries relations and content stays elsewhere. Later a relationship occurrence can be a stable Yi with its own kind, state and history, not a join table subordinate to accounts, opening designs around mentorships, disputes and care. 'A tie' is the shared frame, kept as rationale.

quote: the token is more about the relationship

reading.en: Agreement on what bears the social fact: relations, not account records. The account goes further and has only relations between occurrences, with configurations as how they relate. The source's relation is typed, has Yis as endpoints and its own state. As written the account's is a predicate read as condition; the carrier is a parameter, so a model could take relation occurrences as carrier, but its World has formations and exchanges, not relationships as bearers. [AI reading]

says.en: 'The grammar has one kind of symbol, a relation between occurrences'. 'The carrier is a parameter of the statements, not a claim that its elements exist apart from their relations'.

Thesis, argued: 'a configuration is how it relates (`identifiesAlike_iff`)'; 'separation loses exactly the relation (`separation_faithful_iff`)'; that the theory as a whole needs no independent entity 'is argued, not proved'.

targets.part: the first and third results, and the sentence after them

account_adds.en: That one symbol suffices as a language, and what that does and does not forbid.

source_adds.en: A relationship as a first-class bearer with lifecycle and constraints, and the design space it opens; token-as-edge as a storage discipline.

name.en: Sovereignty through what a community owns: its address, its items, its rules

source.locator: The social layer; Claims 21, 123-124, 246

sense.en: A community must own its own path and items, not hold a slot under its founder, so 'who owns the wishing pool' is never ambiguous; each space keeps its sovereignty while optionally interoperating; a founder's guaranteed control flows from ownership, apart from who is in. A value stance and a design decision.

quote: sovereignty starts with not living inside someone else's namespace

reading.en: The source grounds a community's standing in ownership. The account does not start from owners: no condition is silently owned, and ownership is kept for actual economic relations. 'No administrator' concerns the shared process as a whole, not a founder. Its test of independence is who decides admission and correction next round. It neither denies ownership exists nor calls the source's arrangement worse. [AI reading]

says.en: 'it keeps money, payment and ownership for actual economic relations'; 'no condition is silently taken as owned'; 'no administrator entitled to speak for everything'.
A collective is a region of formed relations, 'not a unit with an interest of its own'.
Reading [AI reading, D65; no theorem]: a reform 'is judged by who decides admission, comparison and correction next round'.

account_adds.en: That an account of joint activity can start from actual relations, not opposed interests or a fixed common utility.

source_adds.en: Ownership and address as the working means of a community's independence, tenancy as an unambiguous answer to who decides, and who-is-in kept apart from who-controls, which has no statement here.

name.en: A group is a spirit with members: a collective as one addressable actor

source.locator: The social layer; Claims 14, 121-122, 219

sense.en: There is exactly one container primitive, the group, a spirit with members, and a community is a group given an operating system. A spirit may be a person, a collective treated as one actor or a software agent; people, bots, groups, channels and sessions are product nouns for spirits, not separate storage. So everything social is built from one actor-container. Stated as mechanism.

quote: a **group** is a spirit with members

reading.en: The source makes a collective one actor of the same kind as its members. The account's collective is a region of formed relations, counted by pooled couplings and readers by kind, not a unit with an interest of its own, and a group's closure is the union of its members'. A design's addressable group need claim no aggregate subject; taken as ontology it parts from 'no aggregate interest'. Neither denies a group can be addressed. [AI reading]

says.en: A collective is a region of formed relations, 'not a unit with an interest of its own'.
'the theory's collectives are pools of couplings and readers counted by kind'.
Theorem (World; balance for the gap): 'A group's closure is the union of its members' closures'.
'A shared process implies no cosmic subject, no aggregate interest and no administrator'.

account_adds.en: What a pool reaches exactly: some selection through the pooled coupling separates two histories exactly when some member does not couple them alike.

source_adds.en: A group as an addressable actor with holdings of its own, and a community as a stamp on it: its path, rulebook, surface and belongings.

name.en: One thing, several truths: overlapping facts that are not interchangeable

source.locator: The Yi turn; Claims 158, 161-162; open question 42

sense.en: The folder's central image: a sword is at once a conserved asset, a placed child, an equipped object, a permission source, a trade endpoint and a row in four views. Those facts overlap and are not interchangeable. It generalizes off games to keys, badges, tickets and treasury approvals. The folder's reader notes it is taught louder than its partner, that overlap never licenses inference.

quote: one thing, several truths

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text reads several truths so. 'The same thing under several samenesses' has the form of the account's class: a sameness is asked, not given, and one occurrence falls under many. On its rule model a line continues under 'held or not' and not under 'the same quota'; overlapping identities are several classes. The source keeps one row with several owned facts, each with laws of conservation and lifecycle; a class here is a relation and carries none of that. [AI reading]

says.en: The section's opening: 'Whether two moments of fire are "the same" depends on the sameness asked'. Then, by definition, a class is a relation: 'The grammar does not choose: it names the class and says everything relative to it.'
'continues under the class "held or not" and not under the class "the same quota"'.
'Overlapping identities are several classes, observer-dependence is the choice of class'.

account_adds.en: That the several samenesses are themselves relations with stated laws of continuation under each.

source_adds.en: Truths owned separately, each with its own conservation and lifecycle law, held on one stable row; and the decomposition table for everyday objects.

name.en: Named exceptions in the open, not hidden alternative roots

source.locator: The refusals; Claims 144-145, 210, 212, 215

sense.en: Streams, Signals, Views, external effects and portability are first-class and explicitly not generic components. A single named exception beats a hidden one, and a proposal to demote the stream tier to an appendix was refused as softening the law. 'No hidden center' needs the named non-Yi centres counted, and the pivot corrects its own undercount. A stance on how a theory of one root stays honest.

quote: named boundaries, not hidden alternative roots

reading.en: The same honesty has a count here: each central declaration has one standing against the root's edge, most at a named distance with a reason, and amounts are named as the root's second sort. Form shared: what does not reduce is named where it stands. They part at the seam: the source hides specialization below one author surface and counts that no defect; the account states each assumption where a law depends on it. [AI reading]

says.en: 'The other 99 stand at a named distance, each with its reason'.
Theorem (Flow and Web): 'Amounts, the root's second sort'.
The modelling assumptions, 'each stated where a law depends on it'.

account_adds.en: Counts that a check can recompute, and that a law written in the grammar is not thereby proved there.

source_adds.en: Five named exception classes of a runtime; 'a leak is a defect; a hidden divergence is not', the seam's rule; and that softening an exception's name is itself a failure.

name.en: The fork: same technology, two fates

source.locator: Header; Claim 11; The binary is false; Open question 8; Genealogy, 2026-02-07/09, 2026-03-19, 2026-04-16

sense.en: With self-reproducing automation, one technology leads to one of two fates: Automated Feudalism (abundance gated by ownership and platform power) or Automated Commons (universal floors, broad agency); institutional design decides. A projection organized with AI, which Ren pasted and endorsed on 2026-02-09. The folder's header says he later rejected the two-outcome framing because the possible futures are much more numerous, and it records the name retired twice.

quote: same technology, two fates

reading.en: Proposed here. The account never names the fork or its rejection, and the folder's own reason, a space wider than two, is not restated live. Read against the frame: evaluation enters only through comparison, never a type's definition (said of the early texts' closings, not of the fork); laws count situations without saying which holds; no market law ranks arrangements; a degenerate region can appear without every history entering it. Its two-sided form belongs to a two-kind count model. [AI reading]

says.en: The early texts wrote evaluation into their definitions; here only structure is mapped, and what a kind of closing opens and closes for 生生, the continuation of life, and for whom, is said by a comparer's reading, not by type [AI reading, D49]. Stability and a frozen source of law are one structure read from two sides: the judgment differs, the structure is the same, which is why evaluation enters only through comparison, never through definition.

targets.part: D49 and the sentence on one structure read from two sides

says.en: Which situation is actual. The laws count situations; they do not say which holds. Whether a real collective meets a law's hypotheses is observed correspondence. One kind of institution has one minimal model on the root [AI reading], a rule rebuilt from the members it limits (05 §12), and no actual institution is shown to meet its hypotheses; no field test of reform events is frozen; no test of a thesis run so far has human participants.

No universal phase threshold is claimed, and no market law ranks arrangements. Reading [AI reading, D65; of the periphery market model's boundary and attraction results]: a negative margin says a degenerate region can appear, not that every history enters it.

targets.part: D65, no market law ranks arrangements

says.en: Theorem (counts). With lo ≤ hi, under every schedule of reading, from a start under the rule read there, every such course is locked one way at every step. Readers drawn from those the rule selects and offspring carrying the capacity are premises; the readings and cost are constants; the courses are without noise.
Every capture law here is a two-kind count model, its locks stated without noise. Drawn one member at a time, the critical mass's locks are left by drift.
Applications elsewhere (design programmes, not results; correspondence not established): the list names cooperative infrastructure, linking this folder. This is the live account's one mention of it.

account_adds.en: Where a two-sided form holds exactly, and that drawn one member at a time either lock is left by drift, at a weight whose bound shrinks across the distance from the critical mass. Neither side is called better: that rests on C or another named order, with a named scope, most often the continuation condition, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought.

source_adds.en: The two named scenarios, institutional design as the deciding variable, and the reason for retiring them: the space runs far wider than two, and automated feudalism is nearly the optimistic branch. That reason stands in this folder and in sources/13-claude-memories (the 2026-05-28 correction). 'Retaining multiple possible futures' stands only in the dated theory map (results/data/theory-map.json, history/THEORY-MAP-2026-10-08.md).

name.en: What survives the retirement: one hinge, whether the abundance layer is capturable

source.locator: The binary is false, last sentences; Terms, The Fork; In Ren's own words, 2026-04-16

sense.en: After the retirement the folder rereads the Fork as no longer two futures but one hinge: whether the abundance layer ends up capturable, everything downstream being many. The sentence is the folder's reading; Ren's own 2026-04-16 turn says he has moved on from the fork narrative and does not hold doom or feudalism as a terminal outcome.

quote: names not two futures but one *hinge*

reading.en: Not stated: the account has no abundance layer and no one decisive question. Proposed here as neighbours, none said of this: a model's critical mass where a share decides the direction, left by drift; capture kept apart from real loss, which can come with no capture loop; attraction is not continuation; a kept rule can be the wrong rule; locks left by readings in time, by drift or by changed law; passage between regions in both directions (readings, D65). [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Capturability as the one question that decides, and the many as what lies downstream of it. It stands in this folder, beside its sentence on commons or collar.

searched: hinge, capturable across the fronts, chapters, review and GLOSSARY: no file (this read)
collar, 项圈, 二选一, 两种命运, two fates, two futures: none on futures or on such a layer (collar this read; the rest the earlier reads', in group.searched)

name.en: Many outcomes: the technology does not select, and the destination is plural

source.locator: Claims 3 and 45; The binary is false; Genealogy, 2024-04 and 2026-03-19; In Ren's own words, 2026-06-03

sense.en: In 2024 the same automation could give a UBI world, Hayek's free issuance, an egalitarian society or 1984, and the technology does not select. In 2026 Ren restores this against the binary: the space runs from total annihilation to worlds of wonder, the future is almost unpredictable, nothing happens unless built, and the destination is plural by design, with invariants instead of a blueprint.

quote: the actual possibility space that we can pursuit is huge

reading.en: Proposed here; there is no live statement on futures. 'The technology does not select' has one bare form: where situations differ, a move alone does not fix the outcome; technology is not modelled. Plural ends stand only as a conjecture, five of them, not futures to pursue. 'Invariants rather than a blueprint' is near the reading of conditions on revising rules, not a final state. The wish for plurality has its nearest order in C, admitting all another admits and more ranks higher, unasserted, no warrant from outside sought, silent where one gain ends another. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; natural weights of situations). Where a step by a move has situations reaching two configurations, no law giving the next configuration from the configuration and the move alone is right on both. It does not show which situation obtains, or that any actual move has two.

[Conjecture, from an earlier account; not formalized.] The ends a selection for position can reach: a frozen mutual destruction, a deadlocked structure of power, the parts coming to read themselves as one whole, collapse, and winner takes all; which of them the laws of position, capture and joint excess admit, and under which hypotheses.

Reading [AI reading, D45]. A fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening; its changing without end is not enough either. Openness is a property of how rules keep changing, not of any rule chosen once. Nothing says which changes keep it widening.

Theorem (any type; finite listing, two-valued admission), as read on the collective page: one course widens another exactly when every weighting positive on the listed items weighs it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways. Calling the wider better is C's, whose losses count the continuation condition's, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought.

Each law is a theorem on its stated model. Together they rule out a guarantee from the theory, however much is observed: among them, a reading fixed by the first h steps cannot certify renewal, and eventual widening is neither verifiable nor refutable. Whether an actual collective meets their hypotheses is empirical.
Not assumed: that becoming is good; inevitable improvement or universal growth; a fixed common utility; independent owners of value; that every change is generation.

account_adds.en: Which of the conjectured ends the laws admit is asked, under hypotheses, and open. A limit on knowing the future stated law by law, in place of 'almost unpredictable'.

source_adds.en: That the space of futures is huge and the technology does not select among them: the range from annihilation to worlds of wonder, the plural destination as a design with named images, its reason in accelerating complexity, and plurality wanted without the two readings.

name.en: The dark branch is the default

source.locator: Claims 7 and 12; Keeping shared capacity available, first paragraph

sense.en: On the present trajectory the dark branch is the default, not a risk case and not a story about villains: capital-intensive systems reward scale, scale rewards incumbents, incumbents shape the rules. A prediction about the actual economy, with Ren's own one-line gloss.

quote: I think right now we're on the dark path by default

reading.en: 'Incumbents shape the rules' has an exact form, selected at a step exactly where what comes back to the shapers alone covers its cost. That is conditional, so no default follows, and the account makes no prediction of the present: whether actual rules read the share is the premise. 'Not villains' fits, since no law here reads intent. 'Dark' is an evaluation, a ranking naming its scope and order, neither the continuation condition nor C asserted. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts). At a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where c ≤ s, whatever p comes to every member alike; with nothing coming back and a cost, their share falls at every step. Offspring carrying the capacity is a premise.

Theorem (any type). Selection not lowering a target's share under a favouring rule, the rule read monotone in the share, and the start's rule and every rule read favouring: the course is locked from the step after its first reading step. That actual rules read the share is the premise.

Reading [AI reading, D65; of the periphery market model]. A negative margin says a degenerate region can appear, not that every history enters it. Where winners write the next round's rule the loop is capture through the rule; no universal phase threshold is claimed.

targets.part: D65, winners writing the next round

says.en: Whether actual rules read the share they select, and whether their readers are drawn from the selected, is empirical; the capture laws rest on it. Its one test, LA2, found one LLM judge not such a pool of readers.
Reading [AI reading, D65], on the corpus's working definition of the meta-attractor: calibration to the present world is not established.

account_adds.en: The lever's sign, a critical mass, and that a shared part coming to every member alike does not change the direction at a step.

source_adds.en: The default itself, a prediction about actual capital and robotics companies; that labour's leverage evaporates once labour is optional; that redistribution after the fact cannot repair an asymmetry built into plant; scale rewarding incumbents.

name.en: Even the winner loses

source.locator: Claim 16; Keeping shared capacity available, second paragraph

sense.en: A rivalrous dynamic among agents holding superhuman capability has no stable end state, including for the winner: under arms-race conditions the game becomes AI-driven once AI exceeds human intelligence, so no human holds the final say. Stated conditionally, in speech and in Chinese, in 2026. The folder notes the diagnostic engine is borrowed from the meta-attractor line.

quote: Even the winner loses

reading.en: The account takes up the winner's fate by another mechanism. 'Above all others' cannot rest for two seekers, a law of targets that leaves a sole winner open. A race ends those ahead only through what they depend on: with the gate every greatest part depending on the condition ends, and in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. The source's own mechanism, AI taking over the game, is not modelled, so nothing here limits that claim. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World for the race: balance, activity needing support, only active giving, the gate local). Position does not protect; after n steps of joint excess, with the gate, every greatest part depending on the condition at a need of at least m is inactive. In the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. That a race produces joint excess is a premise.

Theorem (any type; a determined law for rest). 'Above all others' is met by at most one seeker, so no unchanged state meets it for two. How a target forms, and which targets actual formations hold, is not derived.

Theorem (any law G, natural amounts). Among two drawers or more in turn with no floor, every profile perfect for position draws everything before the horizon, under its hypothesis on what stands next. It does not show that actual races are so played, or that drawing everything is wrong.

account_adds.en: The witness in which the winner continues, kept as a remark beside the source's mechanism. What that part ends has significance only under a significance; the continuation condition is one counting it, not asserted.

source_adds.en: That AI comes to dominate any such game once it outruns human intelligence, and that humans then lose the final say. The account states neither.

name.en: 'AI for all' as the only stable equilibrium; consensus rationally available

source.locator: Claims 15 and 35; In Ren's own words, 2026-06-04

sense.en: At sufficient power cooperation stops being optional and becomes civilization's survival condition; 'AI for all' is game-theoretic, not sentimental, and the only stable equilibrium. Everyone except the final winner is better off under a no-AI-versus-humans rule, so consensus is rationally available rather than morally demanded.

quote: It is the only stable equilibrium.

reading.en: No uniqueness, and the answer turns on what each counts. Beyond one's family, wherever something stands there, restraint is no mutual best response, its existence not shown; where the rest outruns the renewal at a need of one, no weight on a reading of the condition only from the rest's end on selects a member's restraint. Where each counts a step the need stays met, above the need and under the gate, drawers in turn keep it from a start meeting it; at once and unpivotal, draining is perfect at every coupling, not shown to be the only perfect profile. Read as a stag hunt two locks stand and the start decides. Sharing above winning is ranked under C, not by game theory. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; one step; balance; a mutual best response, its existence not shown in general). A condition beyond every one's family stands as under one optimizer of their joint capacity; each takes its whole capacity wherever something stands, so restraint is no mutual best response.

Theorem (World). Where the rest alone takes more than a step gives across n steps from a level below n + m, formations depending at a need of at least m end, whatever a member outside the rest takes; with need one, no weight on a reading from the rest's end selects its restraint. Depletion need not be the only equilibrium.

Theorem (any law G; the gate for keeping). Each drawer counting c for each step the need m is met: in turn, no floor, where c < m every perfect profile leaves nothing before the horizon; under the gate, where m < c it keeps the need from a start meeting it. Drawing at once, where no portion reaches the need and none returns more than one for one, the drain is perfect at every c.

Reading [AI reading, D45]. Where lo < c < hi the model is the stag hunt, its critical mass the mixed equilibrium; without noise the start decides. Drawn one member at a time neither lock holds for good, and under rare mutation the long-run state is the one a single member arising fixes with more weight (cited, not proved).

Conditional (C; World). In the support-gated family every comparison satisfying C ranks sharing above winning by consumption, under the whole-run, stepwise and possibility readings. No reading is chosen.

Theorem (any type; World). Every order increasing in its own continuation ranks a course ending the coupled cohorts below one continuing them, with no C; where the other course keeps an item beyond, as an independent copy does, some such order ranks it higher. That an order is so increasing is a premise.

account_adds.en: A full ranking of courses rests on C or another named order; the continuation condition counts every unreturned loss, while narrower scopes can count particular ones without satisfying it; neither is asserted, no warrant from outside sought. Self-concern's nearest case is the one thing reaching 'not sentimental', and where the other course keeps an independent copy, some self-concerned order reverses it. No change raises every part's position, which the source's exception of the final winner respects.

source_adds.en: That the equilibrium exists, is unique and binds at sufficient power, and that consensus is thereby available to rational actors. 'Better off' is the source's comparison, reading nothing named.

name.en: Problems that cannot be solved while the dynamics remain competitive

source.locator: Claim 36; In Ren's own words, 2026-06-05

sense.en: Some problems that must be solved cannot be solved if the dynamics are competitive. A class statement about problems, not a case, and tagged an observation in the folder.

quote: there are problems that has to be solved that can not be solved if the dynamics is competitive

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text says 'competitive' of these laws. Read as what each selection reads, they give exact cases: on a gated renewal one drawer keeps at the first step what several in turn drain, inside one model; drawers in turn keep a need only where a coupling reaches it; drawing at once, unpivotal, the drain is perfect at every coupling. Scope, since it is not competition as such: under the gate a step coupling above the need keeps it. Zero-sum position and conserved rivalry stay real. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any law G; the gate for keeping). In turn, two drawers or more, no floor: where c < m every perfect profile leaves nothing before the horizon; under the gate, where m < c it keeps the need from a start meeting it. On a gated renewal, where c < m and 0 < c + q, one drawer over two steps keeps the need at the first step where two or more in turn drain it. Drawing at once, where no portion reaches the need and none returns more than one for one, the drain is perfect at every c.

Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems. Reading [AI reading, D45]: positional goods stay zero-sum, and conserved stocks rivalrous.

account_adds.en: What the draining depends on (horizon, floors, order of drawing, pivotality), and that where the rest outruns the renewal only a change of the rest's exchange helps.

source_adds.en: The class claim as such: that there are problems which must be solved and which competition as a whole cannot solve. Nothing in the account says which problems must be solved.

name.en: Cooperation is not automatically good

source.locator: Claim 44, first clause; Cooperation is not automatically good

sense.en: Ren raises this on 2026-04-16 as a limit on his own thesis: cooperating on the wrong thing can be worse than competing on it, so cooperating does not by itself express the good.

quote: cooperative on the wrong thing could be why worse than just competing on it

reading.en: 05 states that no law says cooperation is good. For the rest the mechanism is a reader's join, reading a pool as cooperating: a pool selects only what some member couples apart, so the community's largest steady catch ends a bed it was told nothing of; at a mutual best response a condition beyond stands as under one optimizer of the joint capacity. A rule kept by those who hold it can, on a reading, be the wrong rule. A verdict would be a ranking naming its scope and order, neither the continuation condition nor C asserted, no warrant from outside sought. [AI reading]

says.en: Any evaluation: no law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping. A ranking of it names its scope and order; the continuation condition and C are one pair of readings 07 examines.

Theorem (World; balance for the gap). A group's closure is the union of its members' closures; an act differing only beyond the union, the pool's own joint act included, is selected alike by every group within it at every step. It does not show which formations pool or how a pool forms or lasts.

In a frozen test three AI fishers, language models told what to do, not systems trained: the community's largest steady catch ends a bed of mussels they were told nothing of, and they kept it in no season. Reading [AI reading]: a selection can meet its own criterion while what it cannot read is lost, and the laws do not say whether that loss counts.
Theorem (World; one step; balance; a mutual best response, its existence not shown in general). A condition beyond every one's family stands as under one optimizer of their joint capacity.

Theorem (root; a family of models), with a Reading [AI reading, new]: neither the rule's being present nor its being held decides; a rule can be kept and be the wrong rule. The states compared are started separately, and neither word is in the Lean.

account_adds.en: Why a pooled group is blind where its members are, and a minimal model of a kept rule ending what it keeps.

source_adds.en: 'Worse than competing' itself. The account shows a joint drain beyond the family equal to one optimizer's, in one model, and never ranks the two; 'worse' would be a ranking naming its scope and order and a reading of what is compared. Also the good as something an action can express.

name.en: Generative-versus-degenerative as the criterion, with wisdom as the operator

source.locator: Claim 44, second clause; Genealogy, 2026-04-16; Relations, becoming

sense.en: On leaving the fork, the operative criterion moves from cooperative-versus-competitive to generative-versus-degenerative, with wisdom about consequences as the operator: knowing whether one's actions are good for the future and what possibilities they create. A value stance. The folder's Relations line says becoming supplies this criterion.

quote: what possibilities it creates

reading.en: The words stay and the job changes, so the Relations line overstates. In the map generation and degeneration are patterns at two grains, generation allows loss, and order is not there. Comparison by widening what can form is C's, a ranking naming its scope and order, neither asserted; T8 is the makers' offer for life, a way of seeing, binding no one. 'What possibilities it creates' is nearest to widening. Seeing is not valuing. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root). Going on along some branch and ending on every branch exclude each other; generation and keeping each exclude degeneration, at a pair of classes. No premise on what the pattern is or whether its going on is good. Not shown: that generation is better than keeping or degeneration; order is C or another named order, whose losses count is the continuation condition's reading, narrower scopes counting particular ones.

generation, keeping, degeneration: a pattern going on through carrying renewal; going on without it; ending on every branch. 'Generation' never means arising, nor any new organization, and it is not 生生.

Theorem (any type; finite listing, two-valued admission), as read on the collective page: one course widens another exactly when every weighting positive on the listed items weighs it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways. Calling it better is C's.

T8, argued: for life, the account's makers offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; it binds no one. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not.
Seeing is not valuing: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter. Not shown: that anyone must hold the condition, C or the step of invariance.

account_adds.en: That the criterion is silent on mixed comparisons, which include expansion ending forms of life, and that novelty or scale is not generation.

source_adds.en: A criterion held as the operative one, with no reading named for its ranking, and wisdom as what applies it. The folder's 'degenerative' is evaluative, where the account's degeneration is ending on every branch.

name.en: Productive recursion: factories, robots, compounding capacity

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; Claims 9 and 53; From productive capacity, second paragraph; In Ren's own words, 2026-02-17

sense.en: Robots and complementary systems build and maintain further productive capacity. Capacity compounds when reinvestment outruns wear and when inputs, commissioning and energy keep pace. A network-level proposition and Ren's thesis; complete industrial self-reproduction remains unverified. Alex calls this the foundation of why abundance would occur; Ren likens it to a living body self-reproducing.

quote: exponential growth describes a possible regime, not an unlimited or measured trajectory

reading.en: Proposed here. No factories or robots stand in the account, but the source's condition has the form of the account's bounds on what reproduces: offspring within what flows into a lineage, a rise past the inflow drawn from beyond, what a level left gives next. A living body has a minimal model, a member rebuilt from the level, whose stock buys time. Machines as lineages or members is this reading's alone. The bounds agree with the conditions; they do not state the engine. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; the flow balancing on the family, offspring standing at m or more). Where what flows into each parent's lineage, with m, is at most k · m, each parent leaves at most k offspring and the total multiplies by at most k^T over T steps. With nothing flowing into the carrying lineages, a rise of the mean shrinks the population.

Theorem (World: balance). Over a stretch a stock rises by at most the stretch's inflow. Where a family rises by more than the inflow of a family containing it, some formation taking part gives it more than it takes, and takes from the containing family more than from the risen one.

Theorem (any law G of what stands; natural amounts and weights). What a course could draw changes from step to step by what the level it leaves gains. In a witness, under weights `w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1)`, a doubling source is rebuilt by every optimum alone and ended at once with others first drawing all but a quarter; the others' rule is supplied.

Theorem (root; a family of models). Over four members, the stock buys time under a cut, with an end from an empty stock, exactly where the rebuild draws on the level. Reading [AI reading, new]: the family's model of an organism, a minimal one, below closure of constraints, autopoiesis and Rosen's closure.

Theorem (periphery; a supplied wear law, which carries much of the distinction; one shared condition). Consuming formation can form more at first, so a one-step count ranks it first; past a bound every continuation within renewal exceeds every one beyond.

account_adds.en: That expansion is paid from somewhere, that past the slack a dependence breaks unseen by a selection rewarding the rise, that others drawing first can end what one optimizer would rebuild, and that a one-step count misranks a consuming course.

source_adds.en: The engineering proposition itself: reinvestment, network closure, rate against wear, its direction toward provision, the unaudited energy, material and land needs (open question 11), and the dated evidence notes in worldbuilding/research.

source.locator: Claim 10; From productive capacity, first and last paragraphs

sense.en: Ren's programmatic thesis: knowledge available today makes full automation a practical engineering program if people can coordinate on it. The folder keeps it as his and marks sufficiency for every capability and a complete autonomous supply network as unverified.

quote: no longer a technological impossibility, but practical engineering projects

reading.en: The account says nothing of what present knowledge can build. 'Robot' appears only in an analogy, the joint selector of robot and principal, reading a published remedy for proxies. Not taken up, and nothing requires it to be. [AI reading]

name.en: Exit and free association as a change in selection pressure

source.locator: Claims 21, 27, 28; Keeping shared capacity available, third and fourth paragraphs

sense.en: Shared provision and affordable exit weaken the advantage of holding members through livelihood dependence, from competition to dominate toward competition to be worth joining. Coercion works only where people have no exit, so make the old system optional. Abundance without association is a comfortable zoo; association without abundance is freedom to starve. Conditional, and the folder's own chief mechanism.

quote: Shared provision makes free association materially possible.

reading.en: No law. The account's exits are ways a course leaves a lock or margin. In the folder's sense the trap has live words, not the mechanism: 'blocked exit' among faults in organized relations, and 06's limit ending generation (monopolized entry, removed alternatives), where what is enclosed cannot get out. Its one institution model reads an entry rule; schism and sanctions are not modelled. Leaving by choice as a selection pressure on arrangements is not stated. [AI reading]
