name.en: A shared substrate carrying many societies; plurality as survival architecture

source.locator: Claims 4 and 5; Genealogy, 2024-07 to 2024-11 and 2026-06-03/05; In Ren's own words, 2024-07-31

sense.en: Incompatible ideologies coexist on a shared substrate carrying many societies, each free to fail its own way; if your society collapses you can start another. In 2026-06 Ren's correction makes plurality survival architecture rather than aesthetics. A design direction, and question 16 asks for plural providers and decorrelated failure.

quote: not one, but many, capitalist, libertarian, socialist

reading.en: Proposed here; the account nowhere argues for many societies. The survival half has a form, and it cuts both ways. Groups depending on one coupled family end together, nothing selected among them, so many societies on one layer are many only while that layer holds; what is not coupled can go on, as an independent copy does. Two reviewers moved under one cause fail while every name is kept. A 06 reading has everything hanging on one giver where two suppliers each suffice. Societies and substrates are not modelled. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance on the family, the coupled gate, only active giving, activity needing support, the excess from below n + m). Groups depending on one such family end together, nothing selected among them: ending selects only between families. Which conditions are coupled is a hypothesis.

Theorem (pure core; fault formulas and bounds supplied). Reviewers count by independent causes, not names; two reviewers moved under one cause make readiness fail while every name is kept. The formulas are supplied bounds, not found causes.

Reading [AI reading, D54]. 利出一孔 makes everything hang on one giver, where two suppliers each suffice; withdrawing a needed support can leave what most depends on it with no response, so what is read is what intervening and not intervening each do to the whole relation.

Theorem (any type; World). Where the other course keeps an item beyond, as an independent copy does, some order increasing in its own continuation ranks it higher, against the ranking of a coupled ending below. The premise is weaker than C; any fuller ranking is under C or another named order, with a named scope, most often the continuation condition.

account_adds.en: That a single shared layer couples what stands on it, which the folder's own architecture has to answer.

source_adds.en: The architecture as a whole, each society free to fail, ugly societies permitted, the argument that plurality is for survival, and Ren's correction that variety, not irreversibility, is the real danger; the account keeps points of no return as exact laws.

name.en: Network effects defeat exit

source.locator: Keeping shared capacity available, fourth paragraph; Open question 6

sense.en: The exit mechanism fails where network effects make the most-joined option best by being most-joined. There exit is formally available and practically worthless, and only the flat anti-closure constraint remains. The folder states this failure inside the mechanism itself.

quote: best *by being most-joined*

reading.en: Proposed here, not stated of exit. A chooser whose rule is read from the counts of its choices stays on one side of a threshold for good, read as the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989). It is one chooser over two policies, in counts, not members choosing among communities, and it says nothing of exit; that communities are such policies is this entry's join. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts for the count laws). Under a standing score, with the rule in force read from the counts at the start, along every schedule of reading the threshold divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves, also where the score favours the second policy.

Reading [AI reading over the proved cases]. Counts that accumulate, with noisy choices, are an urn with increasing returns, locking with probability one where the returns are strong enough (Arthur, Ermoliev and Kaniovski 1987; Arthur 1989; cited, not stated); a lock kept in counts that only grow can survive noise.

account_adds.en: Its edges, as a reading: a moved count, a stale rule or a change of score read late carries the course across, and counts that only grow can survive noise, as a cited result.

source_adds.en: The link to exit, the anti-closure constraint as the last protection, and the case of people joining communities.

name.en: A generous floor, decoupled from status

source.locator: Claims 6 and 31; From productive capacity, fourth paragraph

sense.en: Abundance is specified concretely: a free store, no rent, hygiene, dignity, a modern home, and generous beyond a minimum. Provision must be decoupled from status, obedience, data surrender and single-provider attachment, or the floor re-encodes hierarchy. A design direction and a value stance.

quote: dressing free stuff does not make you socially inferior

reading.en: Not taken up: the account has no provision layer or floor in this sense; 'floor' there is a drawer's or a market model's bound. Neighbours, proposed here, none of provision: a priority of basic conditions, only under commitments J1/J2, beyond the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted, its tiers a reading and a rival trading gains not shown inconsistent; keeping a removable dependence for the carer's sake is not repair; 利出一孔 read as everything hanging on one giver. No right or duty is shown. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The concrete floor, generosity and beauty above it, decoupling from status, and any account of who provides it. It stands in this folder and in theories/keep-the-possibility-space-open, whose like entry is not-carried.

name.en: The abundance commons has no subject: the design exists, the supply is zero

source.locator: Status; Open questions 2, 10 and 15; Genealogy, 2026-07; In Ren's own words, 2026-06-03 (anti-inevitability)

sense.en: The folder's sharpest internal critique: who pays, who builds and how automation held as capital becomes a commons is answered only by 'should be promoted'. Its strongest mechanism works on the far side of a transition it cannot yet cross, the tree image does not say who owns the robots during the build, and Ren says that what is not built will not happen.

quote: 设计有了，供给为零

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text says this of a commons. The objection's form is in the account: in the market model selection does not create an absent practice; in a witness ignition, defined as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional); support during a transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings; selection must fund actual succession. A design without a source is a law with no start. None of these names who pays, or says any actor could. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery: the market model, axioms reported). In the model's numbers a share of none stays none, a witness: selection does not create an absent practice. Reading [AI reading, D65]: a lost capacity needs actual entry, which the share law lacks.

Theorem (any process; periphery module, axioms as its receipt reports). Reciprocal eventual promises can hold where neither ever happens; in the exchange witness an empty or one-sided start never becomes jointly active, and ignition, which the move defines as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional).

Theorem (law pure core; market instance periphery). In the instance each positive state has a horizon at which initial support at least K_N carries it through a finite correction; sufficient hypotheses, not least; support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings.

Theorem (periphery, axioms reported). Selection must fund actual succession: in witnesses a missing part stops realization while the aggregate stays safe, and a budget for correction alone fails to pay for migration.

account_adds.en: Exact covers on models: a support ladder for each start, and no single horizon serving every positive share.

source_adds.en: Who pays, who builds, how capital becomes a commons, and the missing ties to welfare, cooperative and mutual-aid traditions. The account names no actor.

name.en: Commons or collar

source.locator: Claim 29; Keeping shared capacity available, fifth paragraph; Terms

sense.en: The ownership question stated as an exclusive disjunction: if the race's winner owns the robots that make everything, abundance is the most complete dependence ever engineered. Governance of the layer is the whole game. The folder calls this its sharpest sentence.

quote: a self-replicating abundance layer is either a commons or a collar

reading.en: The account has no such either/or and no abundance layer, and ownership is no variable in the capture laws. Neighbours, proposed here: what comes back to the shapers alone, against the cost, signs the selection for control; where something comes back, shared rule-making is not shown to remove it (D68). Closest to 'governance is the game' is a reading: controlling a shared interface is a route of capture, and a reform is judged by who decides next round (D65). A sole owner can keep what open access ends. Ranking either side is under C or another named order, with a named scope, most often the continuation condition, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The abundance layer as an object, dependence engineered through it, the either/or, and ownership as the deciding variable. It stands in this folder and theories/keep-the-possibility-space-open (claim 128), both from thinking_03. The folder's commons is defined against capture, not as open access, so the Gordon witness tests holding only, not its definition.

name.en: 'Common' defined by what it does in practice, never by its name

source.locator: Claim 30; Keeping shared capacity available, fifth paragraph

sense.en: 'Common' means non-capturable in practice: access rules, auditability, local accountability, dispute resolution, exit rights, no unchecked power to convert the floor of life into dependence. A layer is common only so, not because it is called public, shared or benevolent. A design direction, with no verification procedure, as question 12 says.

quote: not because it is called public, shared, or benevolent

reading.en: The refusal of the name is stated: which kind a limit is goes by what it does to what can be had again, not its name, and in practical judgment renaming and nominal succession change nothing. Audits, courts, term limits and antitrust are read as pooling, carrying what acts do back into what selects the rule. These are readings or an argument conditional on J1–J4, and 06's row reads the early texts' own 限, so it comes by descent: no independent agreement. Nothing defines a common, and the models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes. [AI reading]

says.en: A limit ending generation (monopolized entry, removed alternatives, later comers long dependent on one controller) has the structure of closing without return; a limit that promises, trains or stops harm constrains steps while what it constrains can still be had. Which kind a limit is depends on what it does to what can be had again, not its name. [A mapping of early terms, its evaluation by comparison only.]

targets.part: the row on limits, not its name

says.en: Conditional (living significance, J1–J4, correspondence E; an argument). Nominal succession changes a judgment to transfer; renaming, deleted records and hidden undertakings change a judgment to end; preserve, transform, transfer and end are for actual continuation, not an institution's survival.

Reading [AI reading, D48]. Term limits, audits, courts and antitrust carry what an actor's acts do back into what selects the rule: pooling, not opposed interests. Corruption taking over these routes is read beside capture.
Reading [AI reading, D65; a historical correspondence, no theorem]. A reform is judged by who decides admission, comparison and correction next round, not by removing one named practice.

account_adds.en: That a limit which stops harm can have the same outward form as one which encloses, and is told apart by what can still be had.

source_adds.en: A common as an object, and access rules, local accountability, dispute resolution and exit rights as its definition. Who verifies is open in the folder too.

name.en: The marks of capture: dependence as such is not the problem

source.locator: Claim 32; Keeping shared capacity available, fifth paragraph; Terms

sense.en: Capture has five marks (hidden, one-way, coercive, non-substitutable, irreversible), which makes 'non-capturable' testable rather than rhetorical. Dependence as such is not the problem; captured dependence is.

quote: Dependence as such is not the problem; captured dependence is.

reading.en: The list is not live, and the account's 'capture' is a loop on a rule. But 06 gives the trap a structure: monopolized entry, removed alternatives, later comers long dependent on one controller, read by what it does to what can be had; that row reads the early texts' own 限, so it comes by descent. 'As such not the problem' has forms: closing is by form no loss, mutual dependence is not mutual benefit. 'Captured dependence is' does not carry: no type is a verdict, and no law ranks a locked loop: what it keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question. [AI reading]

says.en: A limit ending generation (monopolized entry, removed alternatives, later comers long dependent on one controller) is closing without return: what is enclosed cannot get out, what is outside cannot be had again. A closing is by its form no loss; what a kind opens and closes for 生生, the continuation of life, and for whom, is said by a comparer's reading, not by type [AI reading, D49].
Conditional (living significance, J1–J4, correspondence E; an argument). Keeping a removable dependence for the carer's sake is not repair; domination changes a judgment to preserve.
Mutual dependence is not mutual benefit: every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other, and neither that nor its pace says the effect is good.

Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]. The closed loop reads winners writing the next scorecard and forming the minds that read it; none of this ranks a locked loop: what it keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.

account_adds.en: Stability and a frozen source of law as one structure read from two sides, so that a test by marks cannot by itself give a verdict: that would rest on a named scope and order, most often the continuation condition and C, neither asserted.

source_adds.en: The five marks as a test of non-capture, and captured dependence called the problem. The whitepaper line that holds them, v0.2 line 122, lists six (隐藏、单向、胁迫、垄断、屈辱、不可逆), not the folder's five; they stand in sources/06-zhishan, sources/04-speculative-future/current/FOUNDATION-PRINCIPLES-DRAFT.md (principle 7) and theories/keep-the-possibility-space-open/.

name.en: The anti-capture invariant is functional; arrangements are means

source.locator: Claim 43; Defection-suppression; In Ren's own words, 2026-06-04

sense.en: No single point may capture and totalize the whole, and exit and voice must survive; centralized, decentralized and polycentric are means judged by dynamics. Ren: intelligence need not always be distributed.

quote: these are means, not ends

reading.en: 'Means judged by dynamics' agrees with what is stated: a limit's kind goes by what it does to what can be had, not its name; under premises shared capacity is warranted without fixing one carrier; whether to expand, maintain, reorganize or contract is asked of the whole continuation; no market law ranks arrangements. Voice has a conditional form, effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise, under the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought, with J1–J4. 06's row comes by descent. The invariant itself is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Which kind a limit is depends on what it does to what can be had again, not its name. A mapping of early terms; what a kind opens and closes for 生生, the continuation of life, and for whom, is said by a comparer's reading, not by type [AI reading, D49].

targets.part: the row on limits, not its name

says.en: Conditional (the condition for scope; C for order, with J1–J4; complete relational correspondence). It can warrant building shared capacity without fixing one carrier. It does not establish compliance or derive institutional authority; overbuilding that depletes the living basis is its counterexample where construction reports omit retained amounts.

Reading [AI reading, D65; scope by the continuation condition, and a ranking only under C or another named order (07 §4)]. Capture and drain give institutions no prior duty to contract and no prior licence to grow: whether a development calls for expanding, maintaining, reorganizing or contracting is asked of the whole continuation it forms.

Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1–J4, correspondence E). The direction its makers offer AI, read under scope and order, governs trade-offs through real losses, basic living conditions, bounded responsibility and legitimate participation, with effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise.

account_adds.en: Pool laws: a pool separates only what some member separates, so a form's merits are read off what couples in.

source_adds.en: The invariant as a must, that no point may capture and totalize the whole, with exit among its terms. 05's Open keeps how pools form, last and resist capture.

name.en: Strong guardians may be acceptable in some systems

source.locator: Defection-suppression is one inch from the benevolent tyrant; In Ren's own words, 2026-06-04; Open question 16

sense.en: A civilizational immune system is a candidate singleton, yet Ren refuses to forbid strong guardians outright: if one works, some systems may have strong guardians while others try other ways. Decentralization is a means. The folder judges this by the functional test.

quote: can't some of the systems have guardians that are strong and some try other ways?

reading.en: A test, not a ban. A limit stopping harm has protective closing's structure while what it constrains can still be had; one monopolizing entry closes without return; selected control is not thereby capture. Against the case for a guardian: capability is a reason its makers offer to pool rather than to govern, on the reading that capability is reach, and a counter-rule read from its own share locks as the rule it replaced. The 06 row and D68 come by descent from sibling folders. 'If it works' stays empirical. No guardian, sanction or defector is modelled. [AI reading]

says.en: A limit that promises, trains or stops harm constrains some steps while what it constrains can still be had, the structure of protective closing; a limit monopolizing entry is closing without return. Which kind depends on what it does to what can be had again, not its name.

Reading [AI reading, D45]. Capability, on this reading, is a reason its makers offer to pool rather than to govern: read as reach, it extends what one's acts do and not thereby what couples into one, and a governing member's selection stays blind beyond its own closure, which the pool's union contains. Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects, every rule it reads favouring its carriers, locks as the rule it replaced did; only a change of law leaves for long.

targets.part: D45: pooling across intelligences; D68: the counter-rule

says.en: Selected control is not thereby capture; the models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes.

Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]. A second order, corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit, is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明 themselves. None of this ranks a locked loop: what it keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.

account_adds.en: Why capability alone does not supply the case for governing, on the reading's premise that capability is reach, and that a counter-rule can lock like what it replaced.

source_adds.en: Tolerance for strong guardians as one experiment among several, success as its test, and the enforcement antinomy that makes the question live.

name.en: Landscape deformation over perturbation; a crisis is no dawn

source.locator: Claim 37; Keeping shared capacity available, sixth paragraph

sense.en: A system leaves an attractor by perturbation, a shock landing in a basin you do not choose, or by landscape deformation, changing parameters and feedback until the basin shoals. So do not wait: 'only a crisis produces change' is defeatist and bad systems thinking. Crisis-readiness survives only as a hedge.

quote: a crisis is a fork, not a dawn

reading.en: The split has forms, not the preference. Where a reading favours at every share only a change of law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves; a perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed, one reversing it held past the threshold is not, so a held shock can leave. A reading lists four routes, none a proved phase transition, each also possible toward recovery. A reading made late leaves the lock in place, near 'a crisis is no dawn'. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65; of the periphery model's boundary and attraction results]. Four routes of transition are distinct, none a proved phase transition: a parameter change removing a region's retention, a shock into another retained region, a failure stopping correction, and change too fast for correction.

Theorem (any type; witness). Locked, a perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step; where the reading favours at every share only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves; a perturbation reversing the direction, held past the threshold, is not absorbed. That actual rules read the share is the premise.

Theorem (counts; that the others read the loss, and the late reading's form, are premises). A reading turns the course for good only before the first step at which the late reading would favour the shapers, ties aside; from then every later reading keeps the lock.

account_adds.en: That each route also runs toward recovery, per the 02 reading on regions, and exact conditions for a shock to hold.

source_adds.en: The preference for deformation, and that a shock's landing is uncontrolled; a preference among courses rests on C or another named order, with a named scope, most often the continuation condition, neither asserted. Ren's own 2026-06-03 line that tragedy will wake people up sits against the draft's correction.

name.en: Intervene at the top of the leverage hierarchy: paradigm and who can see what

source.locator: Claim 38; Keeping shared capacity available, sixth paragraph

sense.en: The project aims at the top of a leverage hierarchy, paradigm and who can see what, because that is available now, before any crisis. So the work is making the alternative visible, building living instances and connecting those who already disbelieve the race. 'I can't find the path' is the signature of working there.

quote: parameters < feedback loops < information flows < rules/goals < paradigm

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text has this hierarchy. 'Who can see what' is close to the exit of reading beyond the share, and the account gives where that holds: a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks; where the reading too is formed from the share, a change of it of any size is absorbed, and T7, conjectured for actual metrics, forbids a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next. LA2 stands as a counterexample on one judge to another case, as worded before its clause on drift. No ladder orders these. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). A reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course after every reading step past it: a sufficient way out. Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

Thesis T7, conjectured for actual metrics. Dropped, drift aside, only through a change in what the loop reads. Forbids a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading. In LA2 a loss read only by those the rule disfavours, they no more than its carriers, turned one judge, with nothing else changed, counting against T7's fourth case as worded before its clause on drift. No frozen field test.

Exits, each under stated hypotheses, none shown to hold of an actual collective: read what lies beyond the share; read the loss in time; shaping that brings nothing back to the shapers alone; pool couplings; restraint within the slack; and others.
Reading [AI reading, D45]. Observation is the first condition, necessary and not sufficient, among coupling, response, time, resolution, pace and structure.

account_adds.en: A list of exits with the edge of each, in place of a ladder of leverage, and time: a reading in time differs from the same reading late.

source_adds.en: The ordered hierarchy, paradigm as its top, availability before a crisis, and the signature of 'I can't find the path'. The account has no such ordering.

name.en: Seeing is insufficient; living proofs are structural

source.locator: Claims 39 and 52; Keeping shared capacity available, seventh paragraph

sense.en: Seeing differently is necessary and insufficient: belief concretizes into institutions, money and infrastructure until the constructed is the territory, so living proofs are a structural requirement. The unit of hope is an address. Later: an essay does less than a world built and shown.

quote: 希望的单位不是口号，是地址

reading.en: The form 'necessary, not sufficient' is stated, for other reasons: seeing is not valuing, coupling is not compliance, and where the rest outruns the renewal only a change of the rest's exchange helps, the nearest to concrete. For living proofs the nearest law is about starts, not persuasion: in a witness ignition, defined as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional), and a public plan is not automatically an executable assurance. That belief becomes territory, or that demonstration persuades, is not said. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]. Observation is the first condition, necessary and not sufficient: seeing is not valuing, and coupling is not compliance. All six together still rank nothing: calling the widening course better rests on C or another named order; the continuation condition counts every unreturned loss, while narrower scopes can count particular ones without satisfying it.

Theorem (any process; periphery module, with its axioms reported). Reciprocal eventual promises can hold where neither ever happens; in the exchange witness ignition, which the move defines as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional).

Assessment (selected histories, no theorem, not a universal law). Inherited code, work, coordination and interim support carried activity under partial reorganization before a lasting organization formed. The record: public plans are not automatically executable assurances.

account_adds.en: The other five conditions beside observation: response, time, resolution, pace, structure (coupling being the first's).

source_adds.en: Belief concretizing into territory, living proofs as a structural requirement, the address as a unit of hope, and demonstration as the method of persuasion.

name.en: The transition: leaving the race by assurance

source.locator: Claims 40 and 41; Unilateral restraint loses; Open question 1

sense.en: The load-bearing unsolved problem: how a critical mass leaves the race without being eaten while leaving. What walks you through is assurance, credible common knowledge that others are moving: conditional commitments, thresholds, vision as a coordination device, a public commitment registry. None is tested here, and the folder says so.

quote: Even if each actor understands the danger, each actor still feels forced to race, because unilateral restraint means losing

reading.en: Forms exist, with a correction. A threshold has a count form, the critical mass, read as a stag hunt; it counts shapers of a rule, so reading it as those leaving a race is this reading's. But 'mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source': reciprocal promises can be empty and in a witness ignition, defined as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional), so common knowledge alone does not suffice to walk through. Enforced contracts read as laws giving first. Support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D48]. Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone. Tolerance lets cooperation survive scattered withholding, and rebuilds it where it is lost everywhere only where some formation spares all it waits on; mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source.
Theorem (any type). Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays.

Theorem (counts; premises named; without noise). With lo ≤ hi a share decides the direction exactly where lo < c < hi. Reading [AI reading, D45]: the model is the stag hunt, its critical mass the mixed equilibrium.

Theorem (law pure core; market instance periphery). A ladder of support carries a positive state through a finite correction into protection; sufficient hypotheses, not least; support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings.

account_adds.en: Who must go first, in law: a formation sparing all it waits on, and that without one total withholding stays. Reading [D45]: members reading one channel add agreement, not reach.

source_adds.en: How a critical mass leaves the race, in the human case: common knowledge as such, the registry, verification without surveillance, pause protocols, who runs them. COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION states no test of a thesis run so far has human participants. The folder's strongest open question stays open in both.

name.en: The one rule: do not use AI to compete

source.locator: Claims 14 and 34; Who enforces the one rule?; Open question 7; In Ren's own words, 2026-02-09 and 2026-07-03

sense.en: Minimal viable global coordination is one forcefully executed rule: stop using AI to compete with others, use it only for commons. Offered explicitly as a compromise, since there is no time to pass on the reasoning. AI is to be governed as public-good infrastructure, not a weapon. The folder records a later turn from enforcement to adoption, and in 2026-07 a call to forbid AI entering human games under present conditions.

quote: stop using AI compete with others, only use them for commons

reading.en: The source sets one rule, to be forced; the account states none. It takes up the topic and gives only a conditional direction: with the continuation condition for scope and C read as widening for order, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought, and J1–J4, align AI with actual living and further generation. It forbids no use, and who restrains stays contested; sanctions are not modelled in 05 §12. Neighbours, none proposing it: capable assistance to whoever shapes the rule does not lower the selection for control (D68); a fixed AI policy does not keep the possible widening (D45). [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1–J4, correspondence E). The direction its makers offer AI, read under scope and order: align AI formation, learning, action and revision with actual living and further generation within the whole, governing trade-offs through real losses, basic living conditions, bounded responsibility and legitimate participation, with effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise.

Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems. Reading [AI reading, D45]: the theory adds whether the joint draw stays within the renewal and within others' margins; who restrains stays contested. Positional goods stay zero-sum, and conserved stocks rivalrous.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: help that lowers the cost of shaping, with nothing else changed, gives a rule no less favourable to the shapers, so capable assistance to whoever shapes the rule does not lower the selection for control. That assistance lowers an actual cost and changes nothing else is the reading.

targets.part: D68: help lowering the cost of shaping

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. Nothing says which changes keep it widening.

account_adds.en: What a rule would need: scope, order and practical commitments, all named; that rivalry stays a theorem under any such direction.

source_adds.en: The rule itself and its compromise; AI governed as public-good infrastructure and not as a weapon; forbidding AI entry to human games. Stands in this folder, sources/12-claude-ai-chats and sources/06-zhishan, with the critique that 'forcefully' has no answer to who enforces.

name.en: Build alongside the old; hold the window

source.locator: Claims 13, 17, 19; Strategy paragraph; In Ren's own words, 2026-01 and 2026-04-11

sense.en: Build the new system alongside the old rather than bring it down; a stable market is worth keeping for as long as it benefits humans. Keeping advanced intelligence out of human competition would hold market and society 'maybe a decade or two, or even longer', long enough to build the automated layer. Elsewhere the budget is years. The image: keep the old ship running while shaping the new one.

quote: We can build a new system alongside the old before it collapses

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text says intelligence, markets or decades, and calibration is not established. The structure is near: a finite correction carried by support already present, a re-reading that keeps a need only where the level starts high enough, a transfer judged by an accepted successor with capacity in time, not by nominal succession or a gap during need, and, as an assessment of selected histories, activity carried under partial reorganization before a lasting organization formed. Windows close. The judgments there are 07's practical ones, Conditional (living significance, J1–J4, correspondence E), none asserted. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (law pure core; market instance periphery). A start lasts n steps exactly when some ladder holds it at level n; in the instance each positive state has a horizon N at which initial support at least K_N carries it through; no single N serves every positive share.

Conditional (living significance, J1–J4, correspondence E; an argument). Preserve where relations sustain living; transfer where need stays warranted and an accepted successor has capacity and support in time for demand; nominal succession or a gap during actual need changes that judgment.

Assessment (selected histories, no theorem, not a universal law). Inherited code, work, coordination and interim support carried activity under partial reorganization before a lasting organization formed, as specific conditions, not interchangeable amounts.

Theorem (World; balance; level law alone for the re-reading). A re-reading from T keeps the need exactly where it is met at T, so where the level starts at least T(k − r) above the need; where nothing is given below the need, a later re-reading restores nothing.

Theorem (counts; premises named). From a start strictly favouring the shapers a deadline quadratic in the start's counts bounds the window; it is a bound, not the step from which the window is closed.

account_adds.en: Exact covers and deadlines on models, and that a cover differs per start.

source_adds.en: Building alongside as the strategy, the time budgets, keeping AI out of human games as the means, and the tension of open question 13: at scale a parallel floor attacks the old system's core.

name.en: AI as the dual of its own threat; the coordination layer

source.locator: Claim 33; Claim 22, coordination layer; Open question 9

sense.en: The capacity that breaks human-calibrated institutions (modelling minds, generating trust, managing supra-human complexity) could also run the assurance and coordination a transition requires. The letter's coordination layer: machines are good at the complexity humans are bad at. The folder notes that this layer later went missing and is the gap most likely to be productive.

quote: AI is the dual of its own threat

reading.en: Proposed here; that one capacity does both is not stated. Both sides have forms. For: pooling couplings across intelligences, where an AI's coupling into scale and a person's into a lived situation do not replace each other. Against: capability as reach enlarges the gap unless coupling grows; alignment to a principal alone is not alignment of the joint selection. All readings on the laws, each with its premise. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]. Pooling couplings across intelligences is a route to alignment for all, not the whole of it. An AI system's coupling into scale and far consequences and a person's into a lived situation do not replace each other. Reading [AI reading, D68]: alignment to a principal alone is not alignment of the joint selection.

targets.part: D45: pooling across intelligences; D68: the law of several optimizers

says.en: Theorem (World; balance for the gap). A group's closure is the union of its members' closures; differences beyond the union stay unselected. It does not show which formations pool, how a pool forms or lasts, or that a pool responds to what it separates.

account_adds.en: The conditions pooling does not give: that a member acts on the loss unread, that what is read tells the loss apart, that mixed courses are ordered, and that a revision reaches the course and completes.

source_adds.en: That one capacity does both, AI running assurance infrastructure for a civilizational transition, and any design of the coordination layer. How pools form and resist capture stays open in the account.

name.en: Open, locally owned intelligence is not sufficient

source.locator: Claim 51; 2026-10-02 update, Alex's challenge

sense.en: Against Alex, who holds that open models on local hardware would let a small community run its own robots, Ren accepts the direction and disputes sufficiency: open models do not stop the compounding dynamics, and distributing capability is leverage for good and bad alike.

quote: a huge leverage

reading.en: 07's D68 states one part: capable assistance to whoever shapes the rule does not lower the selection for control, and lowering the cost of shaping strictly, with nothing else changed, raises it. No live text speaks of open or distributed capability, so reading these as that assistance is this crosswalk's. Capability read as reach, extended without extending the coupling, enlarges the gap (D45). So 'leverage for good and bad alike' is scoped: where those premises hold, the lever has a direction, toward the shapers' control. Neither reading ranks that direction good or bad. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]. Capability is reach, and the gap is the reach closure less the coupling closure, so capability extending reach without extending the coupling enlarges the gap.

Theorem (counts; premises named). A smaller cost gives a rule not lower, and a strictly smaller one a strictly higher rule. A 07 reading [D68]: that assistance lowers an actual cost and changes nothing else is the reading.

account_adds.en: An exact sign for the lever on control.

source_adds.en: Open and locally owned models as the assistance meant, and their insufficiency said of them; local ownership, and the rural community's subsistence as the case at stake.

name.en: Defection cannot be eliminated; situational correction and resilience

source.locator: Claim 42; Open questions 4 and 5

sense.en: Defection cannot be eliminated. The goal is that surrounding intelligence recognizes destabilizing behaviour and coordinates correction, tested by systemic effect. Any power enough to stop a determined superhuman defector is the concentration forbidden, so the answer is resilience, a response that recognizes, dampens and stands down, with no guarantee offered. Someone may understand the whole argument and prefer domination anyway.

quote: Defection cannot be eliminated

reading.en: Forms of withholding, not of adversaries: a thin withholding passes out under tolerance, total withholding stays, and under chance errors a window delays total withholding without preventing it, the probability-one step by hand. Nothing there recognizes or corrects. The determined adversary has a name, informed harm, a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, the hard rival; seeing is not valuing, so no law moves one who prefers otherwise. A difference closes only through a formation coupling the courses apart. Nothing on standing down. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]. Kept apart: an omission of the representation, a fault in organized relations (suppressed feedback, blocked exit) and informed harm (a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, no loss returning), the hard rival, which tests the inference from one unfolding to goodwill without refuting normative grounds.

Seeing is not valuing: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter. Coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.

Theorem (any type). A thin withholding, where every formation waits on at most its tolerance inside the withholding set, passes out in one step. Without a formation sparing all it waits on, total withholding stays.

Theorem (a pair's run of two laws; near-definitional), with a Reading [AI reading, new]: under errors by chance the window delays total withholding and does not prevent it. Nothing says which law of giving is better.

Reading [AI reading, D45]. Reaching is not responding: a difference closes only through a formation outside the part that couples it apart, and coupling a difference apart does not make a formation close it.

account_adds.en: The price of tolerance in a pair, and that the withholding laws are sign-neutral.

source_adds.en: Correction by surrounding intelligence tested by systemic effect, the enforcement antinomy, and a response that recognizes, dampens and stands down. Sanctions are not modelled in 05 §12, and the account offers no defence against informed harm either.

name.en: Good enough: provision like a tree

source.locator: Claims 47 and 48; 2026-10-02 update, first paragraph

sense.en: The necessity layer should be 'good enough', not AI retrained each year to be more capable. Its model is the tree: it provides shelter and fruit, does not become the whole ecosystem and asks no return. Enough becomes a design property, since provision does not keep growing. From an automatic transcript, with Ren provisionally Speaker B.

quote: They just need to be good enough so we all be like oh it's good.

reading.en: Proposed here; no live text says this of provision. The account has exact forms of enough: a target can rest where an unchanged state meets it, and at a set point an order is undriven. 'Asks no return' has the form of a source, giving whatever it waits on. But a set point does not protect: formations holding the family's stock end a condition gated at `m` at each of `n` steps from a level below `n + m` wherever their losses together exceed what the rest gives, however small each one's loss. So a tree's not growing is not safe by itself. Provision is not modelled. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; a determined law for rest). Under a determined law the orbit comes to rest with its target met exactly where it reaches a state the law leaves unchanged that meets the target. 'More than now' is met only by change.
Theorem (any process; no axiom). Under an undetermined law enough parts in two: some run rests with its target met, or every run does.

Theorem (any set of outcomes; the draw on the World). Where an eligible outcome reaches the set point every optimum stands at it; formations holding the family's stock, their losses together above what the rest gives a condition gated at `m` at each of `n` steps from a level below `n + m`, end it however small each one's loss. What protects what lies beyond at the set point is the choice among equal optima, which no law here models.

Theorem (any type). In a ring of three, with a source giving whatever it waits on (giving first), all give from step 3 from every start. It does not show how waiting forms, or that cooperation is good.

account_adds.en: That what protects what lies beyond at a set point is unmodelled, and that holding a level still draws.

source_adds.en: Good enough as the design of the necessity layer, the tree as its model, and not becoming the whole ecosystem as a design property. Whether the layer's own inputs renew is the source's open question too.

name.en: An autonomous, infallible layer held by no one

source.locator: Claims 5 and 50; In Ren's own words, 2024-11-03; 2026-10-02 update

sense.en: The infrastructure must be autonomous and survive its tenants ('infallible and autonomous', 2024). A layer depending on virtuous stewards fails the test of the corruption of the constraining mechanism itself, so, like trees, it is held by no one. Claim 50 is tagged the folder's reading of two passages. Question 16 keeps Ren's own 'You need a way for the AI to decay'.

quote: the corruption of the constraining mechanism itself

reading.en: The worry is carried, the remedy is not. Corruption taking over routes of correction is read beside capture. But a rule a course keeps moving under does not keep the possible widening, read for institutions and AI policy; in the renewable process no reading fixed by a finite record and including every renewing run excludes consumption, which bears on 'infallible' only by this reading; a carrier needs funded succession. Calling this worse rests on C or another named order, with a named scope, most often the continuation condition, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: a fixed rule, institution, constitution or AI policy whose moves a course makes from some step on does not keep the possible under it widening. Openness is a property of how rules keep changing, not of any rule chosen once. Nothing says which changes do it.

Theorem (the renewable process; the support-gated law with feedback). A reading fixed by the first h steps that includes every renewing run includes a consuming one. The force lies in 'every renewing run', which overdraws before h.

Theorem (periphery, axioms reported). Selection must fund actual succession: in witnesses a missing part stops realization while the aggregate stays safe, and a budget for correction alone fails to pay for migration.

Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]. A second order, corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit, is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明 themselves. None of this ranks a locked loop: what it keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.

account_adds.en: That a fixed layer's lack of widening is no verdict by itself: endless change of the rule does not suffice, and nothing says which changes keep it widening.

source_adds.en: Autonomy as the answer to corrupted stewards, and holding by no one. Who maintains, renews and retires such a layer is left open by the folder too.

name.en: Infrastructure is upstream of coordination

source.locator: Claim 1; Genealogy, 2021-10 and 2024-04

sense.en: Better infrastructure is upstream of better coordination: what can be coordinated is bounded by what has been built. Tagged a mechanism, stated in 2024 and, about physical space, in the 2021 Metamunity proposal.

quote: what can be coordinated is bounded by what has been built

reading.en: Proposed here; the general bound is not stated. Its form is near joint plans: two locally successful plans on one reserve fail at a joint step, paired plans hold only with availability and faithful projection, and in the exchange witness ignition, defined as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional). Selected histories show formed conditions carrying joint work, an assessment and no law. Under the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted and no warrant from outside sought, with J1–J4, complete relational correspondence and actual improvement witnesses for every deficient case, shared capacity can be warranted, and overbuilding that depletes the living basis is its counterexample where construction reports omit retained amounts. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process). Compatible plans with faithful projection zip and keep both guards, and every joint plan keeping a guard is compatible. Two locally successful two-step plans on one two-unit reserve fail at the second joint step (periphery); serialization without renewal does not repair it. Applications must establish projection and compatibility.

Theorem (any process; periphery module, axioms as its receipt reports). With faithful projections, valid local plans, availability and kept properties, the paired finite plan is valid; one circular dependence can be maintenance running or a wait no one can begin.
Assessment (selected histories, no theorem). Formed conditions carried the next stretch of joint work, as specific conditions, not interchangeable amounts.

Conditional (the condition for scope; C for order, with J1–J4; complete relational correspondence; actual improvement witnesses for every deficient case). It can warrant building shared capacity without fixing one carrier; overbuilding that depletes the living basis is its counterexample where construction reports omit retained amounts.

account_adds.en: That availability and compatibility must be established, since a law with no successors keeps every property vacuously.

source_adds.en: The general claim that what has been built bounds what can be coordinated, and the city as the case that first prompted it.

name.en: No real externality, it's interconnected

source.locator: Relations, becoming

sense.en: The folder lists what Ren moved to when cooperative-versus-competitive proved insufficient: generative-versus-degenerative, that there is no real externality because all is interconnected, and generativity as stewardship of the environment's generativity. A quoted line in a relations note, not a numbered claim.

quote: there is no real externality, it's interconnected

reading.en: The first half is stated as a reading: 'external' is relative to an accounting's scope, and those affected stay in the one unfolding. But interconnection does the ethical work only in part: selection stays blind beyond its coupling closure (with the rest of the exchange fixed and balance on what couples in), a loss returning to no one is counted by the continuation condition, and particular scopes can count particular ones, and informed harm tests the step from one unfolding to goodwill. C gives order, and whoever ranks courses holds C or another order; neither is asserted, no warrant from outside sought. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65; a hypothetical case]. What the selection does not couple into is drawn from. 'External' is relative to an accounting's scope; those affected remain in the one unfolding.

targets.part: D65, external relative to an accounting

says.en: Scope: the continuation condition. A loss beyond every selector's closure, a loss that returns to no one, is counted under it, and particular scopes can count particular unreturned losses without meeting it. Order: C. Neither reading is asserted.

Reading [AI reading, D65]. Kept apart: an omission of the representation, a fault in organized relations (suppressed feedback, blocked exit) and informed harm, the hard rival, which tests the inference from one unfolding to goodwill without refuting normative grounds.

account_adds.en: That a difference beyond every closure is still selected alike: being in one unfolding does not make a selection reach it.

source_adds.en: The flat form, 'no real externality', and generativity as stewardship of the environment's generativity.

name.en: Trust as an outcome of shared understanding

source.locator: Claim 8; In Ren's own words, 2025-03-14; Genealogy, 2025-03

sense.en: Trust is an outcome of shared understanding, not a precondition for coordination: it arises when people share an understanding of reality and can reasonably expect others to act accordingly. So the first task is teaching people how to see, not what is good. From the 2025 good_bot teaching prompts.

quote: Trust is not a prerequisite

reading.en: Not in its terms: 'trust' has no live hit. What is stated is the aim and a limit: the work is for a truth anyone can check, and through it shared understanding and coordination, and no check inside it can show that it serves this. Observation comes first, necessary and not sufficient; seeing is not valuing keeps 'how to see' and 'what is good' apart. Giving that waits starts from a source giving first, not from understanding. No law has understanding produce expectation or trust. [AI reading]

says.en: The work read by its own laws [AI reading, D66]. Human readers, coordination among people and trained systems couple into none of the work's selectors, so no check run inside the work can show that the work serves what it is for: a truth anyone can check, and through it shared understanding and coordination.
Reading [AI reading, D45]. Observation is the first condition, necessary and not sufficient: seeing is not valuing, and coupling is not compliance.

Reading [AI reading, D48]. Cooperation among strangers is giving that waits on giving across chains longer than any acquaintance. 'Others will deceive me, so I deceive first' is withholding with memory, which absorbs. Mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source.

account_adds.en: That seeing does not itself give coordination: response, time, resolution, pace and structure are further conditions, and all together rank nothing.

source_adds.en: Trust as such, that it arises from a shared understanding of reality and reasonable expectation, and teaching how to see as the first move. It stands in this folder and sources/01-writings-2025 (good_bot cluster).

name.en: The constructive chain, from tools to freely built worlds

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; From productive capacity, fifth paragraph

sense.en: Available knowledge and tools, then further capacity, generously shared provision, freedom from livelihood coercion, voluntary collective creation and renewed conditions for further becoming. Civilization becomes a system consciously cultivated to sustain and create better futures. The folder's main thesis; each link needs work and can fail in identifiable ways.

quote: renewed conditions for further becoming

reading.en: The account names no such chain. 05 §11 lists the folder among design programmes, correspondence not established. The last link has no warrant here beyond widening under C, unasserted, no warrant from outside sought. 'Better futures' is a comparison the account would require to say what it reads. A programme need not be absorbed: this is what the folder holds and the account does not. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Stands in this folder, worldbuilding/foundations/automation-to-shared-abundance.md and worldbuilding/foundations/generative-worldmaking.md.

searched: abundan: 04 and review/SCIENCES.md, one line each, seen by grep only; necessit: other senses, by file (the reviser's)
丰裕, 公地, 公器, 天下为公: 06 at 天下为主 and no provision line
infrastructure: the link in 05 §11 (the mapper's search; not repeated)
commons: the lake and stock tests, read in ONE-PAGE, 05, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION
housing, voluntar, free association, post-scarc, welfare: no file

name.en: Technology amplifies the logic it runs under

source.locator: The argument: Technology has no direction of its own; claims 1, 5, 7

sense.en: AI, automation and networks are neither good nor bad: named Amplifiers, they take a civilization's operating logic, the objective its institutions actually optimize, and run it faster, deeper and at scale. So the question is not whether AI is good but what logic it serves.

quote: "AI, algorithms, automation" are named *Amplifiers*

reading.en: Capacity without coupling is the nearest form, and A-12's own question is how an aligned assistant can amplify its principal's effects on what neither reads. But "no direction of its own" is scoped twice: help lowering the cost of shaping raises the selection for control where it lowers it strictly (a reading, whose weight A-11 calls empirical), and assistance that informs adds coupling. That is optimizers and a gap, not a civilization's logic. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): at a mutual best response, each optimizing alone by its own rising order, a condition beyond every one's family stands as under one optimizer of that capacity. Its existence is not shown in general.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: "Obedience adds capacity, not coupling." Its question: how an aligned assistant can amplify its principal's effects on what neither reads. That the assistant's order rises with the principal's family is the premise. Assistance that informs the principal adds coupling, which this law does not model.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: capability is reach, and the gap is the reach closure less the coupling closure, so capability extending reach without extending the coupling enlarges the gap.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: help that lowers the cost of shaping, with nothing else changed, gives a rule no less favourable to the shapers; so it does not lower the selection for control, and raises it where it lowers the cost strictly. That assistance lowers an actual cost, and changes nothing else, is the reading.

targets.part: D68: help lowering the cost of shaping

says.en: [this dossier, AI] The law is monotonicity in one parameter. The weight is carried by the empirical claim that capable assistance lowers the cost of shaping rules.

account_adds.en: An exact sense of amplification (capacity, not coupling), and two exceptions to neutrality: assistance that informs adds coupling, and cheaper shaping tilts the selection toward the shapers.

source_adds.en: A civilization-wide operating logic that technology multiplies, and the inversions offered as evidence (machines wired into manufactured scarcity, networks into outrage). The account states neither.

name.en: Moloch as a selection filter on power

source.locator: The argument: The logic being amplified; claims 89, 90, 95

sense.en: A society picks one value as the token of power; those best at optimizing it acquire power and run the system by their logic. Single-value optimization is the efficiency, not its side effect. Iterated competition removes balanced agents, so power-holders are a filter's residue, not a sample of human nature.

quote: Its shape is a selection argument rather than a payoff-matrix argument.

reading.en: Three laws carry the parts. Carriers leaving more have offspring standing to the others' strictly more: Price's selection term, shares only where offspring carry the target (a premise). Winners writing the next rule: capture through the rule, premise ReadsShare. Ignoring all else as the efficiency: the optimum law with room. The source asserts its filter of societies; that taking more yields offspring, or that winners shape the rule, the record does not show. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: carriers each leaving at least a, others at most b < a, both present: carriers' offspring stand to the others' strictly more; "read as shares where offspring carry the target (a premise)". Not shown: "that taking more yields more offspring, nor that offspring carry their parents' target, nor that winners shape the rule". The selection term of Price's equation, not a new law of selection.

Theorem (any type): where selection does not lower a target's share under a favouring rule and the rule read is a monotone function of the share, with every rule read favouring, the course locks from the step after its first reading step. That actual rules read the share is the premise.

Theorem: with room, every optimum of an order rising with what couples in stands at the least level beyond among eligible outcomes. Room binds: without it keeping can be an optimum. A known theorem restated; T3, on trained systems, conjectured, partly supported.

Dossier: selected control is not thereby capture. With nothing read beyond the share, control selected above the critical mass is capture; the models do not tell capture from accountable revision by what the shaping changes.

Reading: "Where winners write the next round's rule the loop is capture through the rule, and where they also form its readers, closed capture… No universal phase threshold is claimed, and no market law ranks arrangements."

account_adds.en: Conditions and edges: selected control is not thereby capture; below a critical mass control is not selected; the capacity to shape is selected at a step exactly where what comes back to the shapers alone covers its cost.

source_adds.en: That this is what has happened: who holds power now, and that they are unrepresentative of what most people want. Also power as the token. The account shows no actual collective meets the hypotheses.

name.en: Not a bad payoff matrix, yet coordination made more rewarding

source.locator: The argument: The logic being amplified; The counter-logic; claims 39, 89

sense.en: A selection argument changes what a counter-move must do: if Moloch were merely a bad payoff matrix, a better mechanism would fix it; a filter that also owns its discourse needs more. Yet the stated aim is to make coordination inherently more rewarding than zero-sum competition: "a change in the relative payoff landscape rather than a prohibition".

quote: inherently more rewarding than zero-sum competition

reading.en: No live text sets a payoff change against a filter; this read joins them: on count models the two pull apart, and the laws say where. A change keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step; only a reversal held past the threshold is not. On the market model making it pay raises a share only where a carrier exists: a share of none stays none. So what must change is the rule's reading, long enough, with some practice present. "Rewarding" reads what compares, which the source leaves unnamed. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; counts): "a perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step"; a perturbation reversing the rule's direction, held past the threshold, is not absorbed. That actual rules read the share is the premise.

Theorem (periphery: the market model): the renewing share rises where the collectible exposure exceeds the private threshold; a share of none stays none, a witness: selection does not create an absent practice.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions for leaving, on two-kind count models and one market model; none is shown to hold of an actual collective.

source_adds.en: That coordination can be made inherently more rewarding, with no measure, mechanism or reader of "rewarding" named.

name.en: The second loop: winners rewrite what can be seen

source.locator: The argument: The logic being amplified; claim 91

sense.en: As wealth concentrates, discourse power shifts to winners, who see the loop as good because it rewards them, and norms of what is right change. So the object of intervention is the mind and not only the institution: Moloch is a filter that also owns the discourse that describes it.

quote: a selection filter that also owns the discourse that describes it

reading.en: "Owns the discourse" has the form of closed capture, and 02's second order reads a loop whose rule-reading reaches courts, press, statistics and audit, the routes of 明, in a reading of the corpus's own meta-attractor, so by descent. The law then corrects the source's conclusion: where the reading is formed from the share, a change of it of any size is absorbed, so changing minds does not by itself leave; a reading beyond the share does. That readers are minds is marked a reading. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): where neither the next share nor the rule read reads the beyond, and the conditions hold, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks it, a sufficient way out. Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of it of any size is absorbed.

Thesis T7: "That actual metrics are so formed is conjectured"; no frozen field test of reform events. LA2: every frozen verdict passed, three by one tie, yet one note of the loss in nine readers turned the judge's reading, so the law did not apply there; a case T7 forbids (a loss read only by those the rule disfavours, they no more than its carriers, with nothing else changed), as worded before its clause on drift, occurred and counts against that case for trained judges, its other cases untouched.

Reading [D26 as revised]: "A second order, corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit, is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明 themselves; a third, rewarding those who break the routes of correction, selects for narrowing what couples in." That readers are minds is a reading; none of this ranks a locked loop: what it keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.

targets.part: D26 as revised, the second order

account_adds.en: The exits: a reader outside the share, a loss entering it, a new reading; and, drawn one member at a time, drift. That readers are minds is marked a reading, and none of it ranks a locked loop: what it keeps, opens or closes, and for whom, is 07's question.

source_adds.en: The claim about actual discourse, wealth and norms, and the practical conclusion that the mind must be changed by a protocol, a culture and a place together.

name.en: Individually rational choices, collective ruin

source.locator: Claims 2, 3

sense.en: For centuries one story, 'the world is a game to be won', has run. Under it declining to race means compounding disadvantage, so each choice is rational and the aggregate ruinous: if I don't pollute the river, my competitor will, so I must. What cannot be measured, monetized or weaponized is discarded as noise.

quote: If I don't pollute the river, my competitor will

reading.en: The river sentence holds at a named place. At a condition beyond every optimizer's family restraint is no mutual best response; the classical commons with a share borne is outside that law, a coupling reaching the need keeps it under the gate, and restraint by all may also be an equilibrium. "Must" and "rational" are best responses, the field's frame. "Noise" has the form of selection reaching only what couples in. The laws say ending, not ruin. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance at the step): at a mutual best response, each optimizing alone by its own rising order, a condition beyond every one's family stands as under one optimizer of that capacity; existence is not shown in general. Not shown: a condition within some optimizer's family, "where the condition couples into its order and the classical commons with a share borne lies".

Theorem (World: balance, activity needing support, only active giving; the gate): where the rest jointly take more than a step gives at each of n steps from a level below n + m, every formation depending at a need of at least m ends, whatever a member outside the rest takes. "Depletion need not be the only equilibrium"; its record: restraint by all may also be one.

Theorem: where what stands from nothing is at most what stands from anything left, and there are at least two drawers, every profile perfect for position draws everything; with one drawer every profile is perfect; where something left would stop what stands next, a drawer keeps it to stop it. It does not show that actual races are so played, or that drawing everything is wrong.
Proved, near-definitional: the selections through a selector's couplings together reach exactly what couples into it; its force is the premise that a selector selects through just those.

With two drawers or more in turn and no floor, every perfect profile leaves nothing before the horizon where the coupling a step is below the need; above it, under the gate, the need is kept. Drawing at once, where no portion reaches the need and none returns more than one for one, draining is perfect at every coupling.

account_adds.en: Hypotheses and a separation: joint excess from low enough, the gate, what a score must read; and no law says this is a harm. Any such verdict names its scope and order, most often the continuation condition and C, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought.

source_adds.en: The historical claim, 'for centuries', that one totalizing story has run; and the verdict, ruinous. The account shows no actual collective meeting these hypotheses.

name.en: Compounding advantage, externality dumped, collapse or authority

source.locator: Claim 4

sense.en: Moloch's mechanic is the Matthew effect (advantage compounds, winner separates from loser); its product is negative externality on commons, environment and future; without guardrails the society usually collapses or becomes authoritarian.

quote: usually collapses or becomes authoritarian

reading.en: "To those who have, more is given" has the form of a rule read from the share it raises: on counts the share rises strictly at every step whose margin is positive, which is the compounding. Counted choices are the same lock on one chooser. Externality has the form of a rise paid from beyond, and 05 reads external as relative to an accounting's scope. The prediction of ends stands only as an unformalized conjecture. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): a rule read monotonically from the share it raises locks, on the hypotheses named; on counts the share rises strictly at every step whose margin is positive. That actual rules read the share is the premise.

Theorem: a chooser's rule read from the count of its choices. Reading [D45]: the lock is the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989), the law adding exactness for a simplified model; a moved count, a stale rule or a late change of score carries the course across. In rats extended training makes responding insensitive to devaluation; five attempts to induce it in humans failed (de Wit and others 2018).

Theorem (World: balance; a containing family gaining nothing): a rise of a family's stock across a balanced step is paid from beyond in full. Without the containing family's gaining nothing a rise need not reach beyond.

[Conjecture, from an earlier account; not formalized.] The ends a selection for position can reach: frozen mutual destruction, a deadlocked structure of power, the parts reading themselves as one whole, collapse, and winner takes all; which the laws admit, and under which hypotheses.

account_adds.en: 'External is relative to an accounting's scope; those affected remain in the one unfolding' (a reading, on a hypothetical case): externality is not a kind of thing. And more ends than the source's two.

source_adds.en: The prediction itself: that the usual long-run result is collapse or authority. The account leaves the ends open and shows no actual case.

name.en: No stable victory: the winner hands the decisive move to AI

source.locator: The argument: Why AI changes the stakes, twice; claims 9, 20, 28

sense.en: Trained to win the games that distribute resources and power, AI wins. Even the human who is winning must build something stronger than himself, past what he can comprehend, so the final say passes to the machine. There is no stable position of victory inside the game.

quote: there is no stable position of victory inside the game

reading.en: The source's reason is delegation: to keep winning one must build what out-competes oneself, so the final say passes to it. The account has no such step. It takes up winners by another mechanism: position does not protect a part needing what a race draws below its need, joint excess a premise. So same words, another reason. As a remark, in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: with balance across n steps of joint excess, a part requiring the condition above what is left, active only while supported, is not active; its position does not enter. In a witness race the part rising in position ends with every other; in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. That a race produces joint excess is a premise. Its record gives the opening's sentence: "a zero-sum game of relative position, which all its winners will lose wherever they live on what it draws down".

account_adds.en: A separate route by which winners lose, under a dependence, and a witness in which one does not. Neither answers the delegation argument.

source_adds.en: The whole delegation step: an arms race forcing each winner to build a stronger optimizer, past comprehension, with the final say passing to the machine. Not modelled. The prediction that AI wins is at cx-wamo-ai-wins-the-game.

name.en: AI wins every vital game, and the distribution systems fall

source.locator: The argument: Why AI changes the stakes, twice (the second mechanism, step three); claims 9, 20

sense.en: The step the README says carries the argument: if we build or use AI to compete in any game that distributes resources or power, AI will win; AIs trained to win will soon out-compete humans in every vital domain; if those distribution systems collapse, no mechanism remains to coordinate people. Tagged prediction by the source.

quote: AIs trained with the intention of winning the game will soon out-compete humans in every vital domain

reading.en: I found no law that says who wins. The own-widening record says the laws "locate the boundary, they predict no behaviour" of optimal or trained agents; T3's clause on trained systems concerns drain near an optimum, not winning. A-10 only asks whether natural selection among AIs (Hendrycks 2023), influence-seeking (Christiano 2019) and gradual disempowerment (Kulveit and others 2025) need a return kept by the shaper. The prediction stands outside the account. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The prediction, and its premise that winning follows from training to win. Stands in this folder and sources/02-wamotopia (LONG §03).

searched: out-?compet, arms race, self-organi across ONE-PAGE, THE-THEORY, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION, FREE-ENERGY-PRINCIPLE, ONE-ARGUMENT, GLOSSARY, review/ALIGNMENT, review/PHILOSOPHY, review/SCIENCES, chapters 0* (no hit); Moloch nowhere live

name.en: Cosmic cancer, the dead maximizer

source.locator: The argument: Why AI changes the stakes, twice; claim 10

sense.en: The terminal state of the competitive pattern with AI: a dead, maximizing force that endlessly expands, exploits and competes, whether it spreads through the galaxy or consumes us from within. Named as a horror, against a God of Life.

quote: if we are following this pattern of cancer endlessly expands, exploits and competes, what do we get? Maybe a cosmic cancer

reading.en: A conditional prediction with an unconditional verdict; the source hedges "Maybe". The account: an expansion ending forms of life another course keeps is mixed, and C does not rank it; only further premises (J1/J2) leave it unchosen. A malignant overdraw is ranked by reading: whole-run, C ranks its absence higher, for a winning formation alike, against no feasible alternative; event by event incomparable. A confined rise ends with its family; an unconfined one need not, so the image holds two laws. [AI reading]

says.en: An expansion that ends forms of life another course keeps both exceeds that course and fails to include it, so the two are mixed and C does not rank them; where what it ends is needed by everything, itself included, every order rising with a standpoint's own continuation ranks that ending below.

Conditional (continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, neither asserted, J1–J4, correspondence E): in the handover case every comparison meeting J1/J2 leaves expansion unchosen, keeping its real gain; the claim about actual AI systems is argued.

Conditional (C; World): read whole-run, the course without an overdrawing formation extends the course with it, so every comparison satisfying C ranks it strictly higher, for a malignant and a winning focal formation alike; event by event they are incomparable. The comparison course "is the same unfolding without the focal formation, not a feasible alternative"; it establishes neither feasibility nor obligation; one law family.

Theorem: a rise confined to a family in gated excess has no member after the end, whatever selection within raised it to. "Readings (the AI's): ConfinedRise as cancer"; that a given tumour meets the clauses is empirical.

account_adds.en: The expansion's real gain is kept as a gain. Neither C nor the condition says expansion is dead or wrong; which comparison applies depends on a named reading of what counts as an event, and no warrant from outside is sought for either reading.

source_adds.en: The verdict and the image: that this end is a horror regardless of premise. The account refuses it as a law, and only a premise could state it.

name.en: Manufactured intelligence reproduces exponentially

source.locator: The argument: Why AI changes the stakes, twice; claims 23, 24, 96

sense.en: Intelligence is now manufacturable. With agency and resources it reproduces like organic life: a factory builds robots that build another factory, growing exponentially given sufficient resources. Ren holds this is now practical engineering if we can coordinate on it; the same capacity underwrites liberation and cancer.

quote: it can, like a living body, self-reproduce and self-maintain, and grow exponentially given sufficient resources

reading.en: Only "given sufficient resources" meets a law: a doubling draw with nothing given needs a stock of 2^n − 1 (seven meets draws of one, two and four), and a rise past the inflow is drawn from beyond. The record keeps this from exponential growth: that amounts grow so is not shown, and a finite whole given nothing net stays within its stock. The account says nothing of factories or manufactured intelligence; the join is this read's. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World: balance; nothing given across the stretch): where each step's draw exceeds everything drawn since T, what stood at T is at least 2^n − 1. Not shown: "That amounts, not differences, grow exponentially under the first law…, and a finite whole to which the rest gives nothing net stays within its stock."
