What passes through changes no level: from the same standings, a gift arriving whole and each need covering upkeep, mutual giving at every step leaves the levels as no giving does while both stand. After one failed renewal, keeping, a formation never stands again; sharing, its partner's slack lifts it and the pair's lines gain, carried by the resumed renewal, an inflow from beyond. A formation at its need giving to one that never gives falls below it for good. Nothing here says giving or keeping is better.

Theorem (World: balance; single small witnesses; a factor's reading supplied). Two ways a gift can bring support beyond what it draws on the giver: need asymmetry within the pair, or renewal from outside. Under needs two and two the gift only moves support.

targets.part: the reading of the sign of β and γ

says.en: Theorem (a pair's run; offspring a supplied reading with natural factors). Reading, AI: where a received step brings no more than a withheld step keeps, giving moves what it draws. Which sign holds is not derived.

Conditions are not necessarily quantities that can be stored or exchanged, and no condition is silently taken as owned, transferable, additive, scarce or commensurable; the World's natural-number amounts are a modelling choice.

account_adds.en: Under balance, a family's rise past the inflow of a family containing it is drawn from beyond, and past the slack there a dependence breaks. That part is exact. The ways a gift gains are witnesses, so this scope is a list and not a bound.

source_adds.en: That scarcity is produced by an order of exchange: 08 only warns against taking a condition as scarce silently, and no law here reads how scarcity is made. That sharing forms those who share. A claim about whole economies, where the witnesses are pairs.

name.en: The Honorable Harvest: rules for taking

source.locator: chapter 'The Honorable Harvest'

sense.en: From memory. She presents it, as I recall, as a teaching drawn from Indigenous practice: take only what is given, ask permission and abide by the answer, never the first or the last, never more than half, take only what you need, use it well, give back. These are rules of a relationship with the one harvested, and leave some for others. She also reports, as I recall, sweetgrass doing better harvested than left alone.

reading.en: Bounded taking has a checked form, but the words part: what she calls given is what another being yields, what the law calls given the flow into a condition. Taking jointly within what is given keeps the level. Never taking more than half is a share of the stock: by instance it keeps the level where that share is within what a step gives, sufficient only, which she does not state. The exact threshold is stated for re-optimizers, not for a rule of restraint. Every comparison satisfying C ranks restraint above overdraw in 07 §5's support-gated family, on the readings and hypotheses stated there (with a third formation sharing, not on the stepwise reading); C is unasserted. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World: balance, only active giving, activity needing support, the gate at the need). Taking jointly within what is given at every step keeps the level, and every formation depending on that condition alone at a need met at the start stays supported; full taking alongside another taker at each of n steps from a level below n + m ends every formation depending at a need of at least m, the full taker included.

Theorem (World: balance; a course of re-optimizing steps or of mutual best responses). Where the rest renews a condition beyond by exactly r a step at or above a positive need, by at most r below, and the withdrawal k is the same at every step, a formation depending on it at that need, met at the start, loses the dependence for good exactly where r < k, and never where k ≤ r. A renewal varying with the level at or above the need is outside it.

Theorem (any R: renewal a law of the level, at most r; reach; y + r ≤ k). Every optimum of every order rising with the draw holds a level of greatest renewal to the n-th step and leaves nothing; a need above every such level breaks at the first step.

Conditional (C; World), the support-gated family. Every comparison satisfying C ranks restraint above overdraw with two parts under all three readings; with a third formation sharing, the stepwise reading leaves it unranked. A formation drawing within renewal ranks above its absence under the whole-run and stepwise readings and ties under the possibility reading. No reading is chosen.

account_adds.en: Exact thresholds on the model. Renewal may be any law of the level, which admits, on my reading, a greatest renewal below the full stock, the form of her sweetgrass report; a maximizer holds that level and breaks a need above it. A drawer within renewal above its absence bears on the same report, under C on two of 07 §5's readings of living. No law evaluates. A drain can end a formation whether or not anyone counts that ending; significance decides whether it counts from a standpoint, and a ranking names its scope and order, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought.

source_adds.en: Asking permission and abiding by the answer, which treats what is taken as one who can refuse; nothing in these laws reads that, and 07's refusal is a chooser's value, not the taken's. A rule usable with no measured level or need. Gratitude and giving back as part of the taking. Taking only what one needs, as a stance: 07 has sufficiency only as ties above a threshold, and she does not order by widening.

name.en: Other beings as kin and persons

source.work: Robin Wall Kimmerer, Braiding Sweetgrass (2013); Leroy Little Bear (Blackfoot), 'Jagged Worldviews Colliding', in Battiste ed., Reclaiming Indigenous Voice and Vision (2000)
source.locator: Kimmerer, chapter 'Learning the Grammar of Animacy'; Little Bear, locator unverified

sense.en: From memory. Kimmerer: Potawatomi grammar marks many beings English calls things as animate, and to speak so is to stand toward them as kin, not resources. Little Bear: a Blackfoot view of constant flux in which everything is animate and related, with relation as what one must keep up. I take both as ways of standing in relation, and may be flattening them; they are not one doctrine.

reading.en: Under the condition, unasserted, scope is not where they part: 'anything' holds a river's continuation. Short of it they can: the step across standpoints forces only centers, and 4.6 leaves present beings beyond every closure to the step. They part on what the relation is: the sources assert kin, with duties and address; significance here is a bare proposition with no valence, C's order unasserted, no warrant from outside sought. Which formations hold standpoints is open, so a river as one who answers is neither given nor excluded. [AI reading]

says.en: Definition, not asserted: from every standpoint, the continuation of anything has significance at every step. AI reading: significance is neither graded nor necessarily positive.
Significance is a proposition, not a number, with no valence. Standpoints may be of any type; on the theory's reading a standpoint is a center, a formation of the unfolding.

Theorem: from each standpoint's presupposition about its own continuation with standpoint-invariance, exactly the centers' continuation is forced to have significance, the condition only where every formation is a center.

Why 'anything' has significance: sharpened. The centers' scope parts from the condition at a formation that is no center; a tumour does not tell the scopes apart, a hurricane only on a stronger reading of wanting; covering by feeding is defensible, by affecting not.
Open: the centers and covering: which formations hold standpoints, and does every formation lie within some standpoint's closure?

An AI reading, argued. Its question: if one's act changes a river a village drinks from, is what becomes of the village part of one's own continuation? The river's own continuation is not asked there.

account_adds.en: The exact point where the two scopes part, and a scope that does not depend on any being's standing as kin or person; it also takes in a tumour, which kinship need not. Little Bear's flux and relatedness have the form of 08's thesis, argued, with no law of persons.

source_adds.en: Kinship as what the relation is, with duties and a way of speaking. An answer to what the account leaves open, that these beings do hold standpoints, and one given in practice and grammar, not by a premise. A search finds no animacy and no kinship in the live account.

name.en: The person formed through others, be-ing as becoming (ubuntu)

source.work: John S. Mbiti, African Religions and Philosophy (1969); Mogobe B. Ramose, African Philosophy through Ubuntu (1999)
source.locator: Mbiti, the chapter on ethnic group, kinship and the individual; Ramose, the chapters on ubuntu; both unverified

sense.en: From memory. Mbiti: the individual exists only corporately, the person owing being to others living and dead; his well-known formula puts the group's being before the 'I'. Ramose reads ubu-ntu as one word for be-ing becoming, motion and wholeness rather than fixed entities. Hountondji warns against reading any of this as what a continent unanimously holds; Mbiti's generalizing has drawn that charge.

reading.en: In common only: no self prior to relations. The thesis forbids explaining by a self with a nature of its own; a configuration is how it relates, as represented; a center's region is a closure. None is of persons. The checked part is dependence: centers sharing a condition lie within one another's feeding closures, and a member is needed only where it alone can carry. Dependence is not constitution, which 08 would test apart; 05 allows no unit with an interest of its own. Same words, not the same reference, nor descent. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis, philosophical, argued: there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it. It forbids explanations needing a determination no relation carries, such as a self with a nature of its own; by the section's measure it has no strength. That the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved, and neither shows that reality has none.

Theorem (any process): configurations related by a bisimulation are alike: they realize the same claims, match each other's steps by the same move into alike configurations, and pass the same tests. Of configurations in a frame, not of persons.
Thesis: a collective is a region of formed relations, not a unit with an interest of its own; conflict and difference stay real.
On the thesis, argued and not proved, positions, regions and standards form within the unfolding. A center is a formation; its own region is its closure under some relation of the unfolding.

Theorem (any type; World): centers that at one step take part in one condition, require it and give to it lie within one another's feeding closures; where some member of a class is needed and each can carry the continuation alone, a member is needed exactly where it is the only member. That human beings so depend is read as plausible and empirical.

A claim that two things are constitutively joined is tested in five steps: state it through features assessed independently; reconstruct the strongest alternative; tell a change in the condition from a change in its report; say why a formal countermodel is relevant; say what would defeat it. A shared notation establishes no constitutive connection.

account_adds.en: A formal side: configurations, laws and parts as represented need no determination beyond relations, in the laws 08 names. A five-step test any constitutive claim must pass, not applied to this one here. 08's listed neighbours of the thesis do not include these authors.

source_adds.en: That a person is constituted by others, and not only dependent on them. The living-dead and the unborn as parties to personhood; rite and name as how one is incorporated; a 'we' put before the 'I', where 05 allows no unit with an interest of its own; and for Ramose a political use, against conquest and for restitution, on which see the entry on losses already taken.

name.en: Personhood earned in conduct, and one can fall short of it

source.work: Ifeanyi Menkiti, 'Person and Community in African Traditional Thought', in R. A. Wright ed., African Philosophy: An Introduction (3rd ed., 1984); Kwame Gyekye, 'Person and Community in African Thought' (1992)
source.locator: locator unverified

sense.en: From memory. Menkiti: personhood is not given with being human; it is attained through incorporation and the discharge of duties, so one can fail at it, and the newborn is not yet one in the full sense. On this side the saying that a person is a person through persons is also a demand. Gyekye rejects this: a person has dignity and rights before and apart from community. I recall it as a title of conduct, not a statement of whose losses count less.

reading.en: I found no form for this. A center is any formation, and a person is one formation among others. The graded law is not this: a grade is what a standpoint gives an item, and this is a standing earned among others, so a link there would be the word 'degree'. Read onto whose losses count, it would part from the condition, whose scope no one earns, but I do not recall Menkiti meaning that. The condition for scope and C for order stay unasserted, no warrant from outside sought. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: That standing is a work done over a life, in a community, that one can fall short of it, and that saying so is part of how people are formed. Ubuntu as a demand and not only a description. It stands in these works and nowhere in the live account.

searched: a person, persons (07: persons as formations; Rawls's separateness; the reference of 'my'; no account of what constitutes one)
dignity, moral status (no hit in chapters and fronts)
attain, earned, achievement (mathematical and learning senses in those sampled)
virtue, character (unrelated senses, such as 'characterized', in those sampled)
read: 07 section 1's definition of significance and center
07's r-graded-significance-and-priority and the objections row on graded status
07 section 6's opening sentence on a person as a formation

name.en: Whose loss: what befalls the group befalls me

source.work: John S. Mbiti, African Religions and Philosophy (1969); Kwame Gyekye, Tradition and Modernity (1997), for moderate communitarianism against it
source.locator: locator unverified

sense.en: From memory. Mbiti: whatever happens to the individual happens to the whole group, and the reverse, in his account of kinship societies. So a kinsperson's loss is one's own, by shared life, not by what one did or meant. Gyekye, Akan-based, objects that this understates the individual's own will and dignity, and keeps community as constitutive only in part.

reading.en: 4.7 asks for a criterion of 'one's own' narrower than all effects, apart from identity. Shared kin life is a candidate to test, not an answer: where effects leave the group it fails P4, reaches at most its own descent, and its boundary needs a reason. Mbiti meets 'the wrong bearer' with a shared bearer; the objection counts the loss as the village's own, the formal identity marks no bearer. 族 is a net's family, not kin. A ranking here names its scope and order, most often the condition and C, unasserted, no warrant from outside sought. [AI reading]

targets.part: Against: The wrong bearer; What follows, if only some are held; Where it stands, question 2

says.en: An AI reading, argued, not proved; P4 is not shown. Objection: a village's loss counted on my line counts as mine; the condition counts it as the village's own, though at the own-closure reading 4.5 identifies them formally, marking no bearer. If only some effects are held, a family's class that some of a member's effects leave reaches at most its own line of descent. Open: a criterion of 'one's own', narrower than all effects, stated apart from identity.

Reading, AI: what the represented dynamics leave open, held de se, is which class a center's own line runs under, which occurrences are centers, and, for what lies on no center's line, the step or a reading of one's own as one's family under the class; which holds is not shown.
Thesis: a collective is a region of formed relations, not a unit with an interest of its own; conflict and difference stay real.

Nonduality erases no difference in experience, history, access, control, consent or consequence. A shared process implies no cosmic subject, no aggregate interest and no administrator entitled to speak for everything.
Agent-relative reasons and partiality: answered. Partial choices are mixed comparisons, decided either way by weightings counting everything; C leaves gross partiality unranked where numbers differ.

account_adds.en: The laws that fix what a class must hold for its line to reach something, and the guard against an aggregate interest.

source_adds.en: A loss borne jointly as a fact of how people live, including grief and honour; and an internal dispute, Mbiti against Gyekye, that has the shape of the wrong-bearer objection and could be read with it.

name.en: A moral theory from identity and solidarity

source.work: Thaddeus Metz, 'Toward an African Moral Theory', Journal of Political Philosophy 15 (2007); 'An African Theory of Moral Status', Ethical Theory and Moral Practice 15 (2012)
source.locator: locator unverified

sense.en: From memory. Metz, an analytic philosopher working in South Africa, reconstructs ubuntu as a secular principle: an act is right insofar as it prizes communal relationships, of identity (sharing a way of life) and solidarity (caring for another's good); wrong insofar as it is discordant. Moral status, as I recall, follows and grades with the capacity to be party to such relations. It is a reconstruction, not a report of any community, and others may refuse it.

reading.en: 07 says a ranking is under C or another named order. Metz supplies one; its 'better' reads the quality of relations among those who can commune, C's what can form. It decides mixed pairs C leaves open. A course adding forms and ending a relation another keeps is mixed, so no clash; a clash needs an added item he weighs below zero, which T5 files as negative valuation. Status by capacity to commune leaves out what cannot, so scope would not be the condition's. [AI reading]

says.en: Whoever ranks courses holds C or another order. The continuation condition fixes scope, C gives order; neither is asserted, and no warrant from outside is sought.
Theorem (World): on level paths an extension with every claim counted is exactly a widening; that this relation is better is C's content, supplied, not shown.

Theorem (World) and Conditional (C, for the ranking). On a reading whose claims are relations, a relation included when active, taking part and not undermining, easing withdraws exactly the relations the easing course no longer takes part in or undermines; restraint keeping its part extends overdraw exactly where it includes a relation overdraw withholds, and C then ranks it higher. Which reading of living to use is not shown.

Theorem (any process; witness) and Conditional (C): under one event law, retaining and releasing a coupling have identical marginal possibilities while retention adds the full joint bundle, so comparing joint compositions under C needs relational information. Richer possibility forces no joint actualization.

Theorem on net weightings: a ranking of a narrowing above its widening by one item is a misread or framing, or the item weighs at zero or below. That a judgment is such a ranking is a premise. T5's reduction is proved for net weightings, its bound conjectured.

Theorem (any type): a graded significance gives each item a natural grade from each standpoint; an item counts where its grade is positive, and its status is the grade. Equal status is not asserted, and status is listed as open.
Theorem (any type): a rule holding exactly within a region accepts the condition's rule there and is not the condition where something lies outside.

account_adds.en: A formal test, not worked here: whether Metz's order, ranking a narrowing above a widening, must weigh some item at zero or below, or falls outside net weightings. And where a status of zero would make his scope a rival. T8's refuter until 9 November 2026 asked a mixed case argued better from every standpoint counting everything positively, with no further premise; its refuter now is selections reading a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not. The comparison with Metz's order does not test this claim.

source_adds.en: An order reading the quality of relations, and treating estrangement as wrong in itself. The account has a reading whose claims are relations, but it reads whether a relation is active, taken part in and not undermined, not its quality, and no reading is chosen. Where C is silent it leaves a mixed pair unranked, while this theory answers. Partiality to those one is in relation with, which 07 leaves to mixed comparisons.

name.en: A tipping point in the relations themselves

source.work: Kyle Whyte (Citizen Potawatomi), 'Too Late for Indigenous Climate Justice: Ecological and Relational Tipping Points', WIREs Climate Change 11 (2020)
source.locator: locator unverified

sense.en: From memory. Whyte: coordinated response to climate change takes relational qualities such as consent, trust, accountability and reciprocity. Colonial history damaged these, and they take long to build. So there can be a relational tipping point: it becomes too late to build them before the harm comes, and fast action without them repeats the damage.

reading.en: Parts have checked forms. Where nothing is given below a need, a later re-reading restores nothing once the level falls below it. In giving, a clear loop is never restored, without a source total withholding stays, promises alone force no start, and in the exchange witness ignition, defined as spending a reserve, needs one already there (near-definitional). A collective's response must come before the point of no return, as a reading. But waits and pools are given: no law takes consent or trust as what forms slowly, or races that forming against a harm. So the claim itself is not stated. [AI reading]

targets.part: the re-reading on the level law

says.en: Theorem (World: balance; the re-reading on the level law alone). With the draw above the renewal until a step T, a re-reading from T on that keeps the need keeps it at every step exactly where it is met at T; where nothing is given below the need, a level below it stays below whatever is drawn, so a later re-reading restores nothing.

Theorem (any type; the sources decided for the exact converse). Under giving first, a formation gives at n from every start exactly where no clear chain of n waits leads into it, and a clear loop is never restored; with memory no step restores giving.
Theorem (any type). Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start: without one, total withholding stays.

Theorem (any process; periphery, axioms reported). Reciprocal eventual promises hold on both sides where neither ever happens; in the exchange witness an empty or one-sided start never becomes jointly active, and ignition, which the move defines as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional). How a supported start forms is not shown.

Reading, AI, D45: enough of the situation includes the pool's members responding, and in time, before the regime's point of no return. Seeing is not valuing and coupling is not compliance; all six conditions together rank nothing: calling the widening course better rests on C or another named order; the continuation condition counts every unreturned loss, while narrower scopes can count particular ones without satisfying it.
Reading, AI, D48: term limits, audits, courts and antitrust carry what an actor's acts do back into what selects the rule: pooling, not opposed interests.

targets.part: How pools form; laws of giving with amounts

says.en: Open: how pools form, last and resist capture beyond recruitment through their own coupling; laws of giving with amounts and thresholds with memory.

account_adds.en: Exact forms of no return, the deadline on a level, and that mutual promises alone force no start. One mechanism read for accountability. No law evaluates. A relation can end whether or not anyone counts that ending; significance decides whether it counts from a standpoint, and a ranking names its scope and order, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought.

source_adds.en: The join, as new work that could be tested: a relation needed for coordinated response has a point past which it cannot form in the time left, and speed without it repeats the damage. Consent and trust as the relations in question, with reciprocity as more than giving on or off. Colonial history as what damaged them, on which see the entry on losses already taken.

name.en: Losses already taken: conquest and dispossession as the present condition

source.work: Kyle Whyte, 'Our Ancestors' Dystopia Now: Indigenous Conservation and the Anthropocene', in Heise, Christensen and Niemann eds., The Routledge Companion to the Environmental Humanities (2017); Mogobe B. Ramose, African Philosophy through Ubuntu (1999)
source.locator: locator unverified

sense.en: From memory. Whyte: for many Indigenous peoples the ecological losses others fear ahead have already come, through colonial and industrial dispossession, so talk of a coming crisis misplaces them. Ramose: conquest in Africa is a wrong that stands until land and sovereignty are restored, and reconciliation without restitution does not answer it. Both speak of actual histories, not of change in general. Whether either would accept being read in one entry, I cannot say.

reading.en: The account states drains and captures in general, with no history of conquest or dispossession in its chapters or fronts. Nearby, not this claim: 08 says responsibility needs its own argument, historical contribution alone not proving it nor its absence proving no reason to respond; RP, a disclosed, revisable commitment, gives an answerable actor a reason for repair; domination is named once among what changes a judgment. A general account may not hold this, which is no defect by itself. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: That particular losses have already happened and are the condition of those who must now coordinate, and that restitution is owed for them. It stands in these works; the live account has neither the history nor the claim.

searched: conquest, empire, settler, slavery, sovereign (no hit in chapters, fronts and dossiers)
repair (11 lines in chapters and fronts; the sampled are technical, with RP and the preserve row read)
dominat (6 lines, the preserve row read)
read: 07 section 5's response table and commitments table, RP
08 section 1's paragraph on wording and responsibility
05's thesis, bases and 'What this chapter does not show'

name.en: Place before time, and a future not first

source.work: Vine Deloria Jr. (Standing Rock Sioux), God Is Red (1973); John S. Mbiti, African Religions and Philosophy (1969)
source.locator: Deloria, the chapter on thinking in time and space; Mbiti, the chapter on the concept of time; both unverified

sense.en: From memory, thin. Deloria argues that Western religion and thought order themselves by time and history, tribal peoples' by space, lands and particular places, and that this reaches what counts as truth and ethics. Separately, Mbiti reports from Kikamba and Gikuyu material that time runs mostly toward the past and a long future is virtually absent; this is contested, by Gyekye as I recall. It sits awkwardly with seventh-generation reasoning: not one voice. Neither addresses this account.

reading.en: The form tested: significance stated as continuation 'into the future', compared by what courses admit. The root starts from neither time nor place: its order is the reach of the condition relation, a region a closure. So the contrast misses the root as stated. It presses the ethics, where a particular place is at most a formation or condition read along steps. Deloria's is the argument; Mbiti's a report. Whether place can come first is tested here, not settled. [AI reading]

says.en: The grammar has one kind of symbol, a relation between occurrences; no frame or kind of thing is chosen before the relations. Nor is a time: its order is the reach of the condition relation, a strict order where that relation has no cycle.

Definition, not asserted: for anything, its continuation into the future is counted. AI reading: a continuation at a step reads 'its continuation into the future'. The condition fixes scope and C order, neither asserted, no warrant from outside sought.
A center is a formation; its own region is its closure under some relation of the unfolding, on a thesis argued and not proved.

Theorem (any type; World): where some member of a class is needed and each can carry the continuation alone, a member is needed exactly where it is the only member. Reading, AI: several conditions all human beings need plausibly have no second copy; whether they do is empirical.
No condition is silently taken as owned, transferable, additive, scarce or commensurable; the World's natural-number amounts are a modelling choice.

account_adds.en: A time derived from the condition relation, not given. Significance is still indexed by a standpoint, a step and a formation, and most of 05's laws are on the World model with discrete steps.

source_adds.en: Particular lands as what truth and obligation are tied to, and a future that is not the first direction of concern, where C orders by what can form. Need's 'no second copy' is one form of no substitute, and 08 takes no condition as silently commensurable; neither ties truth or obligation to land. A reader who knows these works should say whether this reading holds at all.

name.en: Whitehead: an enduring object as a society in serial order

source.work: A. N. Whitehead, Process and Reality (1929)
source.locator: Part I ch. 3 and Part II ch. 3, on societies and personal order; locator from memory

sense.en: An enduring object is a society of actual occasions in serial order, each inheriting a defining form from its predecessor by prehending it. What endures is the inherited pattern, not a substance beneath it; occasions become and perish and do not change.

reading.en: 续 has this form: a condition met with likeness, as inheritance is prehension with common form, and a line is the serial order. The passing law is nearer still: under its premise whatever carries a pattern carried it before or was given it by a carrier. The record says only 'close to'. Nothing is proved of Whitehead, and same form is not same meaning. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root): continuation is `R ⊓ E`, `x` a condition of `y` and the two alike under `E`. Its record: 'close to genidentity (Lewin 1922) and to Whitehead's enduring objects (1929)'; Whitehead's only mention on the live account.

Theorem (World; any web, its activity read as carrying): a pattern present from T with carriers brief for d has a carrier beginning within d steps, in a double-negation form. Under the passing premise (`Web.ByPassing`) every beginning is a passing, and where no carrier passes it, nothing carries it from T + d on.

account_adds.en: The class is named and plural: every single condition is a continuation under some class; fission and merge witnesses; a core, and the law that a class under which a line ends is not constant.

source_adds.en: The likeness is carried through feeling (subjective form) and is the society's own defining characteristic, which its members reproduce. In the account the class is free and supplied, and the record says 续 does not tell 'a fire passed on from one fire ending and another starting', every single condition being a continuation under some class. His society does tell them apart.

name.en: Whitehead: laws of nature as immanent habits

source.work: A. N. Whitehead, Adventures of Ideas (1933)
source.locator: Part II ch. VII, Laws of Nature; locator from memory

sense.en: Laws are neither imposed from outside nor bare descriptions of sequence. They are immanent: the characters of what they govern, the habits of the dominant societies of an epoch, expressing how things are related, and so they can change as those societies change.

reading.en: 08 keeps three senses of law apart; his laws of nature are the third, a science's law, and the account 'states no science's law of its own yet'. Nearest is the second: `Law` is one relation, its configurations 'related by it, not ruled by it'. 01's reading D65 gives his immanence a form for three World premises, which hold 'by what their terms are', on one model and without epochs; and 08 holds that calling an input immanent does not discharge it. [AI reading]

says.en: 'The word has three senses, kept apart.' `Law`, 'the spine's name for a determined step, is one relation, `next x = y`, among the others: its configurations are related by it, not ruled by it.' A law of the theory 'is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it'. 'The account states no science's law of its own yet.'

targets.part: the second sense, `Law` as one relation

says.en: A thesis, argued: a law is read off the history it holds of (`shown_le_iff`); it forbids an explanation needing 'a law standing outside what it holds of'.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: 'A relation is internal where it holds by what its terms are'; read off one exchange, 'balance, only active giving and taking, and activity needing support are internal so'. 'This reaches no necessity beyond the World model read off one exchange'.
'Calling an input immanent, or moving it into a definition, does not discharge it.' The target requires 'showing whatever universal content the theory asserts'.

account_adds.en: An exact statement of the reading-off (`shown_le_iff`), and the sense in which a root law forbids nothing.

source_adds.en: His immanent law as a statistical habit of an epoch's dominant societies, changing as they do, and immanence as the nature of law in general, beyond three premises of one model. A tower of changing rules adds nothing to the whole possible (07 §2's reading).

name.en: Whitehead: creativity as the ultimate, the creative advance into novelty

source.work: A. N. Whitehead, Process and Reality (1929)
source.locator: Part I ch. 2, the Category of the Ultimate

sense.en: Creativity is the ultimate category: the many become one and are increased by one. Every occasion is a novel unity, so advance into novelty is a metaphysical generality, holding of whatever is actual, not a contingent fact about some systems.

reading.en: He makes novelty ultimate, holding of whatever is actual. The account too starts from a process, 'activity forming and changing the conditions of further activity', but asserts no novelty in it: formation covers generation and degeneration alike, 01 names a stationary process with moments alike in every relation, and novelty is neither generation nor 生生. On the World, novelty without end needs gain; his novelty is not an amount, so that law need not touch him. [AI reading]

says.en: With the rest of the whole counted, every rise is given net by some relatum; under the first law a whole listed without repetition that the rest gives nothing net is not new at every step. 'Novelty, and formations first supported without end where what each requires stays fixed within the family, need gain; gain is not openness.'

'An expansion producing ever more novelty is generative': answered, the order left open; generation is a pattern going on through carrying renewal, and 生生 is the continuation of life, not novelty or scale.

targets.part: the objection on an expansion producing ever more novelty

says.en: The start: 'activity forming and changing the conditions of further activity, some of whose effects persist and condition what follows'. 'Formation covers generation and degeneration alike, and generation is the narrower term.'
'a stationary process has two moments alike in every relation, which nothing but that equality tells apart'.

account_adds.en: Where novelty's gain comes from under balance, and that novelty is neither generation nor 生生. These structural results can inform the makers' offer without a ranking; any ranking drawn from them names its scope and order, neither the condition nor C asserted.

source_adds.en: Novelty at every occasion and every grain, with no conserved amount to pay it; the many-into-one of concrescence as the form of all becoming.

name.en: Whitehead: perishing and objective immortality

source.work: A. N. Whitehead, Process and Reality (1929)
source.locator: locator unverified; perpetual perishing and objective immortality recur from Part II

sense.en: An occasion perishes as a subject and goes on as a datum for every later occasion, which must take it into account, positively or by exclusion. Its ending is the condition of its further efficacy.

reading.en: Ending under a finer class while effects go on under a coarser one has this shape: «过亡而续» keeps what continues past an ending on the line, and the account's start says some effects persist. Thin where it differs: the law needs a named class, only 'some' effects persist, nothing says every occasion is taken up by all later ones, and the ending is no condition of the efficacy, as it is for him. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root; witnesses): on a line under `L`, what continues under `L` an occurrence at which the line under `O` ends is reached on the line under `L`, and lies on no line under `O` from that occurrence.
AI reading, argued: 'The reach counts what happens, not what is lost; a loss is read by comparing courses, which the reach does not do.'

targets.part: the reading on what the reach counts

says.en: The start: activity, 'some of whose effects persist and condition what follows'.

account_adds.en: The dependence on the class chosen, and that the reach counts no foreclosed occurrence. It bears on §4.6's separate actor-line argument, P1 to P4, with P2 and P4 not shown. These structural results can inform the makers' offer without a ranking; any ranking drawn from them names its scope and order, neither the condition nor C asserted.

source_adds.en: That the whole past is objectively present to each occasion, a universal feeling of what has perished. The account's net need not join everything: that it does is a correspondence not shown.

name.en: Whitehead: experience in every occasion, eternal objects and God

source.work: A. N. Whitehead, Process and Reality (1929)
source.locator: Part II ch. 7 (the reformed subjectivist principle); Part V (God and the World); locator from memory

sense.en: Apart from the experience of subjects there is nothing. Every occasion has a mental pole and subjective aim, and so value in itself. Eternal objects are pure potentials that ingress into occasions, and God's primordial nature orders them. So process philosophy here is not only relations.

reading.en: Calling process philosophy a neighbour hides this. The thesis forbids a determination no relation carries, an intrinsic value among them. 08 says a shared process implies no cosmic subject, which leaves his God unargued, not refuted. Nor is he the objector 08 names: for him how an experience feels is how it takes in others. Eternal objects may be relational too, so the distance is mine to argue and a reader's to check. [AI reading]

says.en: Argued, not proved: forbids an explanation needing 'an intrinsic value, a self with a nature of its own, or a law standing outside what it holds of'. Live against it: 'that relations need relata with natures of their own, and that what an experience is like is not how it relates'.

targets.part: What it forbids; What would defeat it

says.en: 'A shared process implies no cosmic subject, no aggregate interest and no administrator entitled to speak for everything.'

account_adds.en: It names what would defeat its thesis, and that the thesis excludes no observation.

source_adds.en: An account of why a form recurs at all (eternal objects), and of what experience is at the lowest grain; in 03, consciousness stands among what cognition has not yet reached.

name.en: Whitehead: an occasion is constituted by what it prehends

source.work: A. N. Whitehead, Process and Reality (1929)
source.locator: locator unverified; the categories of explanation in Part I ch. 2, and the theory of prehensions in Part III

sense.en: An actual occasion is what it is through its prehensions of others, so its relations to its past enter into its being and are internal to it. Later occasions enter it only as anticipated, so this internality runs one way.

reading.en: The nearest form is not 01's 'internal' but 08's 'a configuration is how it relates' (`identifiesAlike_iff`), whose own scope is that naming makes sense exactly where alike configurations are one, failing for twin successors. It reads onward, by steps and tests; his constitution reads backward, from what is prehended, so the mechanism parts. 01's 'internal' is narrower still: a relation holding by what its terms are, read off one exchange. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process): configurations related by a bisimulation 'realize the same claims, match each other's steps by the same move into alike configurations, and pass the same tests'. 'Naming the configurations makes sense exactly where alike configurations are one, which fails for twin successors of one move.'

Reading [AI, D65]: 'A relation is internal where it holds by what its terms are: no pair of terms of that kind lacks it.' 'This reaches no necessity beyond the World model read off one exchange', nor evaluation, significance or direction.
Reading [AI, D65]: 'the passage from inclusion to relation': read off one exchange, balance, only active giving and taking and activity needing support hold by what their terms are.

account_adds.en: Which premises hold by the reading and which are states of the law, and that the moments stay distinct: requirement lies beyond the course.

source_adds.en: Constitution of each occasion by its whole past, with feeling as how it is taken in, and the one-way asymmetry.

name.en: Whitehead: the fallacy of misplaced concreteness

source.work: A. N. Whitehead, Science and the Modern World (1925)
source.locator: ch. III, simple location and misplaced concreteness; ch. V, the critic of abstractions; locators from memory

sense.en: To take a high abstraction for the concrete is the error behind the scientific scheme of matter at a simple location in instants of time. An abstraction is legitimate while known as one, and philosophy's task is to criticize abstractions by what they leave out.

reading.en: The method has this form: a model represents selected relations, every split states its basis and what it leaves out, and 08 says the empty axiom report leaves the real assumptions in the modelling, each named where a law depends on it. He would press further: discrete steps and natural-number amounts are such abstractions, and his remedy is a new scheme of the concrete. The account keeps its abstractions and lists their cost. No live page names him here. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Subject and object, actor and patient, observer and world, inside and outside ... fact and value are each drawn within the unfolding, along relations, together with what they leave out.' 'a model represents selected relations'.

'The report concerns logic only: the real assumptions lie in the modelling (discrete steps, one index, natural-number amounts, propositions as activity, identity by naming), each stated where a law depends on it.'
Commitments of the representation, 'which the axiom report does not check', a table with what depends on each.

account_adds.en: A table of commitments with what depends on each; what each discreteness costs, law by law.

source_adds.en: That the concrete is the actual occasion, so that substance and simple location are the abstractions; the bifurcation of nature as the error's consequence.

name.en: Bergson: duration against spatialized time

source.work: H. Bergson, Time and Free Will (1889); Creative Evolution (1907)
source.locator: Time and Free Will ch. 2; Creative Evolution ch. 4, the cinematographic mechanism of thought

sense.en: Lived duration is qualitative and interpenetrating, not a line of juxtaposed instants. To cut change into states and string them on abstract time is the intellect's cinema: it recovers everything about change except the changing.

reading.en: The strongest test of the form: steps indexed by naturals, a course as a sequence of configurations. What the account can set against him keeps instants: discrete steps are a choice, and they represent real-valued time exactly for balance, yet real-valued time is the spatialized time he rejects. Time as the order of conditions is nearer him and still counts occurrences. [AI reading]

says.en: A commitment of the representation: 'Discrete steps, one shared index', activity, levels and exchange indexed by one sequence of natural-number steps.
'Discrete steps represent real-valued time exactly for balance.'
No time is chosen before the relations: 'its order is the reach of the condition relation', a strict order where that relation has no cycle.

account_adds.en: What each discreteness costs, law by law, and time as derived from the net.

source_adds.en: A claim about what change is that no representation by states can state; free act as no choice among prior options. A history study read Creative Evolution ch. 1 on interpenetrating change as a comparator (DEDUCTIVE-FOUNDATION-TEST), for the foundation's deduction, not against steps.

name.en: Bergson: the possible is a retrospective shadow of the real

source.work: H. Bergson, 'The Possible and the Real' (1930), in The Creative Mind
source.locator: essay as a whole

sense.en: We imagine the possible as a stock of pale reals from which one is actualized. Rather, the possible is made after the fact: only once something real and new has come can we project that it was possible. Genuine novelty cannot be prestated.

reading.en: C, unasserted like the condition that fixes scope, compares courses by what can form, and its theorem needs a finite listing; the whole possible is read under a stated process. Bergson argues against the form. The account concedes part: its laws do not reach what cannot be prestated. If he is right, a comparison by widening holds only retrospectively. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D45]: 'If the one unfolding were one stated process, nothing would be added to its whole possible along its course: what a course adds is the actual.'

These laws 'do not yet reach the adjacent possible that cannot be prestated (Longo, Montévil and Kauffman 2012): none is stated for a space of rules not given with the carrier'; a limit holding so far.
Theorem (any type), on a finite listing with two-valued admission: one course widens another exactly when every positive weighting ranks it higher. C itself, that widening is better, stays a premise.

account_adds.en: That the possible relative to what is held grows only across a change of what is held; a law, on any process.

source_adds.en: That the possible is not there to be compared in advance, 07 §4.4's 'merely possible chooser' among it. Stated nowhere, and the account's order would need another reading to survive it.

name.en: Bergson: the élan vital

source.locator: chs. 1 to 3

sense.en: Life is one original impetus dividing along diverging lines, neither mechanism (selection of chance variations alone) nor finalism (a plan). Adaptation explains the windings of evolution, not its general direction.

reading.en: 生生 read as a direction may sound like this, and no mechanism joins them; the account reads 生生 as the continuation of life, not a direction measured by widening. T8 is the makers' offer for life, a way of seeing, binding no one, not an impulse. Evolution in 04 is read through transmission, variation, selection and drift. The account has no impetus. [AI reading]

says.en: T8, argued: for life, the account's makers offer a way of seeing, not a verdict: what each course draws on, from what renewal and at which grain, what ends and what goes on, and who bears it; 生生 is the continuation of life; it binds no one. Forbids and refuted by: selections that read a course's draw and what ends with it selecting a draw beyond the renewal their readers depend on no less often than selections that do not.
Thesis: 'Evolution is read as change along descent through transmission, variation, selection and drift.'

account_adds.en: Checked laws of descent, and a standing for its own direction: argued, with what would refute it.

source_adds.en: One source for life's divergence, and a direction no selection law explains. The account asserts neither.

name.en: Bergson: closed and open morality differ in kind

source.work: H. Bergson, The Two Sources of Morality and Religion (1932)
source.locator: ch. 1

sense.en: Closed morality is social pressure keeping a group cohesive against others. Open morality, love of humanity, comes from exemplary persons as aspiration. One cannot reach humanity by widening from family through nation: between them lies a difference of kind, a leap, not a stage.

reading.en: 07 sets a standpoint's own good, route (b) (P-13 calls it enlightened self-interest) and the condition on one scale: closures nest, and the presupposition's scope runs from the empty relation to the total. Bergson argues against that form: widening a closed concern gives a larger closed concern. It is the strongest test of §4.6's path. The condition for scope and C for order stay unasserted. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): along a relation, the presupposition sub-true is significance over the closure, super-true the condition; along the empty relation sub-truth is a standpoint's own good, along the total relation the condition.

Argued joining of root laws: under §4.6's P1 to P4, with P2 and P4 not shown, concern for one's own continuation reaches everything downstream with no step of invariance; ranking still rests on C or another named order.

account_adds.en: An exact account of how far a self-held scope reaches, and what it needs at each widening; warrant and motivation kept apart.

source_adds.en: That the wide concern has a different source (exemplars, emotion) and is not gained by extending the narrow one. If so, the step is a change of kind, which P-10's across-drawings form hides.

name.en: Hegel: self-consciousness exists only in being recognized

source.work: G. W. F. Hegel, Phenomenology of Spirit (1807)
source.locator: ch. IV.A, about §§178 to 184

sense.en: Self-consciousness is in and for itself only as acknowledged by another self-consciousness. A self is not first there and then related: it is what it is through a mutual movement in which each sees itself in the other.

reading.en: That a self is not first there and then related is carried: the thesis forbids explaining by a self with a nature of its own, and a center's region is a closure along a relation. They part at the relation: feeding, need or a line under a class, never being acknowledged. Recognition here is a holder grasping a reason or an effect; 08's recognitional binding concerns reference. Mutual closures (P-14) are feeding; readers reading readers take acts, not selves. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis, argued, not proved: it forbids an explanation needing 'an intrinsic value, a self with a nature of its own, or a law standing outside what it holds of'.

On that thesis, a center is a formation; 'its own region is its closure under some relation of the unfolding: along the empty relation its own events, along feeding its feeding closure'. Whether a standard 'recognizes its target' is one of four questions.

Theorem (near-definitional): 'Members act in turn, each by its law on what couples into it and on the acts before it' (`Turns`). The nearest law to one reading another; nothing in it constitutes the reader.

account_adds.en: A self's regions read as laws of closure along each relation, and what each forces. These structural results can inform the makers' offer without a ranking; any ranking drawn from them names its scope and order, neither the condition nor C asserted.

source_adds.en: That selfhood is constituted by being read by another who is read in turn, a mutual movement in which each sees itself in the other. No law makes a center what it is through another center's reading of it. A grep of theories and _process for Hegel near recognition, lord or bondsman found only the atlas plan and one unrelated results page.

name.en: Hegel: recognition from the one reduced certifies nothing

source.work: G. W. F. Hegel, Phenomenology of Spirit (1807)
source.locator: ch. IV.A, lordship and bondage, about §§189 to 193

sense.en: The lord wins acknowledgment from one he has made dependent. But recognition from a consciousness he does not recognize, reduced to a thing, is not the independent confirmation he sought, so his certainty rests on something inessential.

reading.en: The form: a reading drawn from those a selection has formed reads the share, not beyond it, and 'Later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it' states the point generally. The bondsman is no copy, so the witness law stops short of him: an agreeing witness is 'not shown' to add nothing. That readers are minds is a reading, and the laws say nothing of certainty or its lack. Structural agreement only. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D65]: 'Later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it.'

Theorem (any type): the rule read as the pool of its readers' readings is a monotone function of the share exactly where `v` is not above `u`, and where who reads is itself a monotone function of the share, it still reads the share.

Theorem (any type): where each witness added copies one already on the roster, inspection gives the same certificate. 'That a witness merely agreeing with another, without copying it, adds nothing is not shown.'

account_adds.en: Exactly when a pool reads the share, and who reading, when, decides whether a reading of the loss turns it. None of this ranks anything: a ranking names its holder, scope and order, the condition and C one pair examined in 07, neither asserted.

source_adds.en: That the lord himself finds the confirmation inadequate: an experience of its failure. The account has no such experience; its loop is not disturbed by what it does not read.

name.en: Hegel: the reversal of lord and bondsman; contradiction moves the relation

source.work: G. W. F. Hegel, Phenomenology of Spirit (1807)
source.locator: ch. IV.A, about §§193 to 196; introduction on determinate negation

sense.en: The lord depends on the bondsman's labour, while the bondsman, through fear and formative work, comes to see himself in what he makes. The relation turns by its own inner inadequacy. A shape of consciousness passes over through what it itself cannot sustain.

reading.en: The account gives no such movement as a general form, and under stated premises a loss alone moves nothing: where nothing in the loop reads it, the lock outlives it at any size. A named way out is a change of what is read, and some locks are left by drift. The top need not depend: a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues. His bondsman does come to read, so these premises do not catch him. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): where each step adds at least one beyond, selection does not lower the share under a favouring rule and the rule is read monotonically from the share, 'from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked'; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks it.

T7: in the model, invariance under what the loop does not read and the lock outliving a growing unread coordinate proved, without noise; 'drift aside', dropped only through a change in what the loop reads; that actual metrics are so formed conjectured.
Witness, beside the race laws: 'in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues'.

account_adds.en: The exact premise (`Unread`) under which no loss reaches the loop. On one trained judge (LA2) every frozen verdict passed and the conjecture failed for that judge, so it tests neither side here.

source_adds.en: Formative work as a route by which the dependent comes to read beyond the share, and a claim that shapes supersede themselves by an inner inadequacy. No law here has a contradiction moving anything, and none states such a tendency.

name.en: Hegel: the struggle to the death defeats what it seeks

source.work: G. W. F. Hegel, Phenomenology of Spirit (1807)
source.locator: ch. IV.A, about §§187 to 188

sense.en: Each self-consciousness must stake its life to prove itself and seeks the death of the other. But death removes the very consciousness whose acknowledgment was wanted, so victory fails. The failure points to unequal, then mutual, recognition.

reading.en: Read as rank, more Kojève's reading than his, the struggle has position's form: a rise needs a fall, and 'above all others' never rests for two; the ends of such races are a conjecture in 05. Nearer his own point: read the other's acknowledgment as a required condition the self's region leaves out, and its own draw loses its own support. That reading is mine. The account parts at mutual recognition: positions sum to zero by counting, recognition raises both. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem: 'No change raises every part's position, and a part's rise needs another part's fall'. 'That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived.'
Theorem (any type; a determined law for rest): '"above all others" is met by at most one seeker, so no unchanged state meets it for two'.

Conjecture, 'from an earlier account; not formalized': the ends of a selection for position, among them 'a frozen mutual destruction, a deadlocked structure of power, the parts coming to read themselves as one whole'.
Theorem (World): 'omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support' (`Omitted.loses_own`). 'How a center represents the region is unmodelled.'

account_adds.en: A witness race in which the part rising in position ends with every other, and the clearing witness in which a greatest part that does not depend continues.

source_adds.en: That what is sought exists only in the rival, and mutual recognition as where the failure points. Neither is stated; no law here treats a rival's end as the winner's loss unless he depends on it.

name.en: Hegel: Spirit and absolute knowing

source.work: G. W. F. Hegel, Phenomenology of Spirit (1807); Encyclopaedia (1817 to 1830)
source.locator: Phenomenology ch. VIII; Encyclopaedia §§6 and 574 to 577; locators from memory

sense.en: Knowing is immanent: criteria are not brought from outside, and each shape tests itself. Yet the movement closes in absolute knowing, with Spirit as the subject of the whole and history as reason's own development.

reading.en: The first half agrees: knowing happens inside and has no vantage outside. The second the account does not take up: a shared process implies no cosmic subject, and self-reference does not certify itself. No formation's course is good by being the course; no dynamic is here read as reason realizing itself. Whether closure in absolute knowing can be refused rather than left out is not argued here, and his readers dispute how closed it is. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Knowing, modelling and criticizing happen inside it too, so their adequacy is part of the inquiry, not a vantage outside it.' 'A shared process implies no cosmic subject.'
'So self-reference does not certify itself, and the reference back of a bound use is stipulated rather than derived.' Stated there; the Lean is pre-spine.

account_adds.en: A statement of what it cannot show about itself; a metalogic without presuppositions stays open.

source_adds.en: Completion of knowing, and direction in history. Asserted by neither law nor thesis.

name.en: Hegel: being, nothing, becoming

source.work: G. W. F. Hegel, Science of Logic (1812)
source.locator: Doctrine of Being, ch. 1

sense.en: Pure being and pure nothing are the same; their truth is becoming, the vanishing of each into the other. Becoming here is a category reached by the immanent movement of thought, not a process in time.

reading.en: The word is shared and the object differs: he means a category reached by thought's movement, the account activity conditioning activity. Its open target takes up the form, determinations as moments of one unfolding, and its record says a Hegel comparison separates a category from a causal mechanism. The comparison itself is in a history study. [AI reading]

says.en: Open target: 'philosophically, its determinations as moments of one unfolding'; the direct whole-inclusion argument 'still lacks the passage to relational constitution; a primary Hegel comparison separates a category of becoming from a causal mechanism'. Hegel's only mention on the live account.
Reading [AI, D65]: 'the passage from inclusion to relation': what is read off one exchange holds by what its terms are; 01 says this reaches no necessity beyond the World model read off one exchange.

account_adds.en: Laws with Lean, and an admission that the deduction is not done.

source_adds.en: A deduction of becoming from being and nothing alone, which the account neither makes nor claims.

name.en: Marx: capitalists as personifications, the circuit outlasting its carriers

source.locator: Preface, on personifications; Part II ch. 4, the general formula M-C-M'; ch. 24, on accumulation (Fowkes numbering)

sense.en: Capitalists act as personifications of capital, whose imperatives they carry and by which they are replaceable. What persists through changes of persons and firms is the circuit M-C-M', in which value is the subject of the process.

reading.en: Replaceable carriers have a form here: a pattern outlasting brief carriers lasts only through passing, 02's 传, and under the passing premise ends when no carrier passes it on. That is the wide sense the glossary sets aside: the formal 元吸引子 says nothing of carriers, and whether a capture loop is 生成 at some pair of classes stays open. Form at most, of carriers alone: nothing here reads value, which for him is the subject, so the claim parts. [AI reading]

says.en: Meta-attractor: closed capture; 'It never means the corpus's working definition, a recurrent organization of activity whose consequences help reproduce the conditions selecting that organization across changes in its particular carriers: that sense is another, neither shown to contain the other: the formal 元吸引子 says nothing of carriers'.

Reading [AI, D65], the wider working definition: 'Continuation across carriers is the map's 传; the formal 元吸引子 says nothing of carriers', whether a capture loop is 生成 at some pair of classes staying open; 'Calibration to the present world is not established.'
Theorem (World; any web, its activity read as carrying): a pattern whose carriers are brief lasts only while carriers keep beginning, under the passing premise only while carriers pass it on.

account_adds.en: What ends the pattern: no carrier passing it, within d steps. The record's limit: not whether carrying forms by passing, or what carrying does to the carriers.

source_adds.en: That value is the subject, and that wage and class relations are what make carriers replaceable. Of earlier folders, selfishness-spiral only names Marx as prior art on accumulation (its README), and reads nothing.

name.en: Marx: production reproduces the capital relation itself

source.locator: ch. 23, simple reproduction; Part VIII, so-called primitive accumulation (Fowkes numbering); locators from memory

sense.en: Seen as a continuous process, capitalist production produces not only commodities and surplus value but the capital relation: owners on one side, the propertyless worker on the other, who leaves each round as he entered and must sell again. Its start was not its own product: expropriation and force made the relation that then reproduces itself.

reading.en: The corpus's wide working definition has this form: consequences reproducing the conditions that select the organization. The laws state a narrower one: where winners write the next round's rule the loop is capture through the rule, and shaping locks where what comes back covers its cost, on counts of a share. A class relation is not a share, and reading the wage relation as such a rule is mine. That any actual market meets the premises is not shown. [AI reading]

says.en: The working definition, 'a recurrent organization of activity whose consequences help reproduce the conditions selecting that organization across changes in its particular carriers', is not the formal term: 'that sense is another, neither shown to contain the other'.
Reading [AI, D65], just below: 'Calibration to the present world is not established.'

Theorem (counts): at a step the rule favours the shapers exactly where `c ≤ s`, whatever `p` comes to every member alike; 'monotone and covering the cost at every share, the loop locks'. That offspring carry their parent's capacity and that what comes back is read from the share are premises.

'No universal phase threshold is claimed, and no market law ranks arrangements.' Where winners write the next round's rule the loop is capture through the rule, and where they also form its readers, closed capture; who reads, and when, decides whether a reading of the loss turns it.

targets.part: the paragraph on capture through the rule

account_adds.en: An exact condition on the return to shapers (`c ≤ s`), a threshold from which the course tips either way, and that who reads, and when, decides whether a reading of the loss turns the loop.

source_adds.en: Why the worker must return: propertylessness as the product of each round. Force at the start, which no selection makes: in 05's model 'selection does not create an absent practice'. And that the relation is historically transient, which a lock does not state.

name.en: Marx: expansion without end as the form of the circuit

source.locator: Part II ch. 4, the general formula; ch. 24 (Fowkes numbering); locators from memory

sense.en: A sum of money is limited in quantity while its form as wealth is not, so M-C-M' has no measure in itself: each result starts the circuit again. The boundless drive belongs to the movement, not to any capitalist's appetite.

reading.en: A target of 'more than now' has this form: it cannot rest. 03 adds where it can go on: met only by change, at every step only in an open world, and where what stands runs down, exhaustion, not enough. That corrects nothing of his, who states a form and not that it is met; on value the law may not bite, a money sum not being what stands on the World. Whether growth draws on what stands is the empirical bridge. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; on the World model, what stands listed, for the rises): '"More than now" is met only by change, and met at every step it needs an open world, no list holding its configurations'; 'Where what stands runs down at every step from some step on, no condition rises at arbitrarily late steps: exhaustion, not enough.'
§9's head reads this into capture: 'That a target needing ever more cannot rest, and that "above all others" never rests for two, is 03's'.

account_adds.en: Enough parted from expansion, and that under an undetermined law enough itself parts in two.

source_adds.en: Why the form is boundless: money's sameness of quality, with only quantity left to change; and how such a target forms and passes on, which the record says it does not state. His barriers are social and crises are their form; none is mapped.

name.en: Marx: surplus cannot arise from the exchange of equivalents

source.locator: Part II ch. 5, contradictions in the general formula

sense.en: If equivalents exchange, circulation creates no surplus value, and if they do not, one party's gain is the other's loss and the class as a whole gains nothing. So the source of the rise must lie outside circulation proper, in a commodity whose use creates value.

reading.en: The accounting form holds in World: a rise past the inflow has a formation giving more than it takes and drawing from beyond, and unequal exchange nets to nothing as positions do. This matches his shape only if value is read as an amount, itself contested, and 08 says no condition is silently commensurable. His answer parts there: labour-power's use creates value, while under balance every rise is given. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World: balance): where the family rises by more than the inflow of a family containing it, some formation taking part gives it more than it takes, by more than its own part of that inflow, and takes from the containing family more than from the risen one. 08 lists it as 'the entropy balance in counts'.
Theorem (any type for the counting): 'Across every change of amounts the positions' rises total their falls'; 'No change raises every part's position'. Near-definitional by 08's row.
'no condition is silently taken as owned, transferable, additive, scarce or commensurable; the World's natural-number amounts are a modelling choice'.

account_adds.en: A bound: over a stretch a stock rises by at most the stretch's inflow.

source_adds.en: The answer: labour-power, sold at its value and yielding more. See the entry on exploitation.

name.en: Marx: competition as an external coercive law

source.locator: ch. 10 §5 ('après moi le déluge'); ch. 24 §3 (Fowkes numbering); locators from memory

sense.en: Competition makes capital's immanent laws act on each capitalist as external compulsion, whatever his personal goodwill. So capital takes no account of the worker's health or length of life unless society forces it to: the exhaustion is foreseen, and each counts on its falling elsewhere.

reading.en: The form: a selection reaches only what couples into its selector, and own counts miss a joint draw. That much is shared, and it parts at once: the law covers any selection, so it reads nothing peculiar to capital, while Marx's whole point is the specific form. No law here calls the drain a harm. [AI reading]

says.en: T3: 'A selection through couplings, whether a reward, a training run, a market or natural selection, reaches only what couples into its selector, and with room its optima drain what lies beyond as far as any eligible outcome does, where it ranks outcomes by an order rising with what couples in'. The law for optima proved; the clause on trained systems conjectured.

Theorem (World: balance; for the ending also activity needing support, only active giving, the gate local): formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more; `n` steps of joint excess from below `n + m` end every formation depending at a need of at least `m`.

Reading [AI, D65; a hypothetical case]: where buyers cannot tell future reliability and finance rewards present margins, 'a provider deferring maintenance can outgrow one maintaining and training successors: what the selection does not couple into is drawn from'.

account_adds.en: The exact conditions and the point of no return, near-definitional by 08's verdict; and that every selection holding only where a family rises past its inflow favours a draw on what no member couples into (`Flow.favours_reaching_beyond_inflow`).

source_adds.en: Why this selection compels: separated producers and the wage relation. And its limit by struggle: the Factory Acts as a reading forced from outside.

name.en: Marx: the rift in the metabolism with the soil

source.work: K. Marx, Capital, vol. I ch. 15 §10 and vol. III ch. 47; the term 'metabolic rift' is J. B. Foster's reading (2000)
source.locator: as named; locators from memory

sense.en: Capitalist agriculture carries nutrients off to the towns and does not return them. An irreparable rift opens in the metabolism prescribed by natural laws, and production undermines the sources of its own wealth, soil and worker. On Foster's and Saito's reading, value does not represent the soil's renewal.

reading.en: A formation whose represented region omits a required condition can lose its own support through its own draw: same shape, on the World. Marx's rift is a historical claim about one mode of production; the law is a witness and says nothing of value. Whether soil and capital meet the premises is empirical. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): over a region covering what it requires, requirements not tightening, a formation keeps its own support and can still undermine another; 'omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support'. 'How a center represents the region is unmodelled.'

account_adds.en: The exact split of self-undermining from undermining another. T1 on renewable conditions: proved in the model, conjectured beyond it, passing and failing on frozen tests, with 'no field test of a need measured in advance'.

source_adds.en: The historical mechanism: town and country, rent, and the value form's blindness to what it does not price.

name.en: Marx: the fetishism of commodities

sense.en: Value is a social relation among producers that appears as a property of things. The appearance is not mere error: under commodity production relations among persons really are mediated as relations among things, so it holds objectively.

reading.en: The method's demand has the form: reconstruct the relation before treating a term as given, state the relation that carries what is cited. 'Intrinsic value' in 08 is not Marx's value, so the match is of form only. It is a rule of explanation, with no law of why the appearance forms or holds; Marx's second sentence has no counterpart. [AI reading]

says.en: Argued: forbids an explanation needing 'a determination no relation carries, such as an intrinsic value'. 'Its content is a demand on explanations: state the relation that carries what is cited.'

targets.part: What it forbids; its content as a demand

says.en: 'Before two terms are treated as independently given, the relation said to join them is reconstructed.'

account_adds.en: The demand generalized to subject and object, fact and value, with a five-step test of constitutive claims.

source_adds.en: That the misreading is produced by the relation itself. 02's closed loop comes near in form, and does not state it of value.

name.en: Marx: labour value, exploitation and class

source.locator: Part I ch. 1; Part III chs. 7 to 9

sense.en: The value of commodities is socially necessary labour time. The wage buys labour-power at its value while its use yields more, and the unpaid part is surplus. So exploitation is a structural relation of classes, compatible with equal exchange, and the source of a moral and political critique.

reading.en: No such theory stands in the account. Who draws from whom it can state, and a formation giving a family more than it takes (05), but 'exploitation' asks for a measure of a due that its amounts do not carry, and it claims no right or duty. 05's 'extracting' practice pays for political organization, in a model with no classes, and 'class' here is an equivalence. Not a defect by itself. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Any theory of value or of class. The market model of 05 §10 has no class relation, and 08 §8 assesses it: 'the theory's vocabulary adds no mathematical advantage there.'

read: 07 what the chapter does not show

name.en: Marx: the system's contradictions and its supersession

source.work: K. Marx, Capital, vol. I (1867), ch. 32; Preface to A Contribution to the Critique of Political Economy (1859); with Engels, The Communist Manifesto (1848), ch. 1; The German Ideology (1846, published 1932)
source.locator: as named (Fowkes numbering); German Ideology locator unverified

sense.en: Forces of production outgrow the relations that shaped them, and capital produces its own gravediggers. History has a direction from its material contradictions, and critique is warranted partly by this tendency, with communism as the movement abolishing the present state of things. How far this is a law of history his readers dispute, and his later letters limit it.

reading.en: The account gives no such tendency and asserts no dynamic good. A loop reading only its share stays locked under its premises; a way out is a change of what is read, and whether anyone makes it is not a law. Ordering arrangements would be a ranking naming its scope and order, neither the condition nor C asserted, and would take further premises. [AI reading]

says.en: 'No law evaluates; should and better are readings people and AI form.' The account asserts no should; where it ranks, it names its readings, each an unasserted hypothesis wherever used, most often the continuation condition for scope and C for order.
'No universal phase threshold is claimed, and no market law ranks arrangements.'

targets.part: the paragraph on capture through the rule

account_adds.en: What does turn a loop, by which readers and when, under stated premises.

source_adds.en: A theory of why those who read the loss come to be many and organized; the account's nearest case is a reading in time by the others, on counts. The shengsheng lineage's synthesis (history) lists 'Marx's historical telos and determinism' as refuted, an earlier sieve, not argued live.

name.en: Simondon: the individual as a phase of individuation

source.work: G. Simondon, L'individuation à la lumière des notions de forme et d'information (1958; 2005)
source.locator: Introduction, against substantialism and hylomorphism

sense.en: To explain the individual from a given principle, substance or form-on-matter, begins from what must be explained. Being is pre-individual; the individual is one result of an operation of individuation, and never exhausts the pre-individual charge it carries.

reading.en: The account's word 'individuation' is the supply of identity, another sense. At formations it is near him: who continues whom is read, labels carry nothing and a class is free. Below that his objection bites: the grammar starts from occurrences on a carrier, whose equality comes with it, 'a commitment of the model'. He would count that as beginning from individuals. 08 reads it as belonging to the representation, and says that reading is not shown. [AI reading]

says.en: Time and the four positions 'tell two occurrences alike in every relation apart only by equality on the carrier, a commitment of the model'.

'In the account itself the nearest case is equality on the carrier, which the model uses and does not derive; the thesis reads it as belonging to the representation and not to what is represented, and that reading is not shown.'

Theorem (World): labels carry nothing; the pattern of names across steps carries identity, 'a correspondence premise the representation supplies'; 'the individuation of formations' is taken up there as who continues whom.
§3.4: 'Individuation fixes what counts as a loss; the reading of `living` is a choice.'
